recognition.en: The resistor voltage directly gives the current phasor. Convert total voltage to rectangular form, subtract 6 V, then divide by the current. The given 53.1° is the one-decimal approximation to the 6−8−10 triangle angle 53.130…°.

title.en: Find current from the resistor voltage

text.zh: 3 Ω为纯电阻，电流与U̇₁同相，大小为6/3。
text.en: The 3 Ω resistor gives current in phase with U̇₁ and magnitude 6/3.
To the precision of the given angle, 10∠53.1°≈6+j8 V. Thus U̇₂≈(6+j8)−6 = j8 V, not the scalar difference 10−6 = 4 V.

title.en: Find impedance and identify the element

text.zh: U̇₂除以İ得到正的纯虚阻抗，按本题精度为电感元件，感抗ωL≈4 Ω；题目未给ω，不能单独求L数值。
text.en: Dividing U̇₂ by İ gives a positive imaginary impedance. To the problem’s precision it is an inductor with ωL≈4 Ω. No numerical L can be found without ω.

steps.formula: Z_2=\frac{\dot U_2}{\dot I}\approx j4\,\Omega,\qquad L\approx\frac4\omega\,\mathrm H

title.zh: 保留题目角度舍入的含义

text.zh: 若把53.1°当作完全精确数，计算得到U̇₂≈0.004202+j7.996847 V，Z₂≈0.002101+j3.998423 Ω。其极小实部来自给定角度舍入；教材标准答案j4 Ω对应理想6−8−10关系。
text.en: If 53.1° is treated as mathematically exact, U̇₂≈0.004202+j7.996847 V and Z₂≈0.002101+j3.998423 Ω. The tiny real part results from the rounded input angle; the textbook j4 Ω answer uses the ideal 6−8−10 relation.

answer.zh: İ=2∠0° A；U̇₂≈8∠90° V；Z₂≈j4 Ω，为电感元件（按题目相角精度）。
answer.en: İ = 2∠0° A; U̇₂≈8∠90° V; Z₂≈j4 Ω, an inductor to the stated phase precision.

pitfalls.zh: 相量减法应先化矩形式，不能直接相减电压有效值。
pitfalls.en: Convert to rectangular form for subtraction; do not subtract RMS magnitudes directly.

pitfalls.zh: 纯虚阻抗j4 Ω不等于电感4 H；还需角频率。
pitfalls.en: Reactance j4 Ω does not mean an inductance of 4 H; angular frequency is also required.

methods.zh: 独立回代：İ(3+j4)=2(3+j4)=6+j8，其模为10 V、相角arctan(8/6)=53.130102…°，按一位小数正好53.1°。复功率为U̇İ*=12+j16 VA，3 Ω消耗12 W，电感吸收无功16 var，功率一致。同时保留按53.1°字面计算的微小实部以避免伪称完全精确。书第337页/PDF346页7-17的2∠0°、8∠90°、j4 Ω与此精度解释一致。
methods.en: Independent substitution: İ(3+j4) = 2(3+j4) = 6+j8, with magnitude 10 V and angle arctan(8/6) = 53.130102…°, rounding to 53.1°. Complex power is U̇İ* = 12+j16 VA: 3 Ω consumes 12 W and the inductor absorbs 16 var. The tiny real part obtained from a literal 53.1° calculation is retained explicitly rather than claiming exact equality. Answer 7-17 on printed p. 337/PDF p. 346 gives 2∠0°, 8∠90° and j4 Ω, consistent with this precision.

appendixComparison.reason: 53.1 degrees is a rounded 53.130102... degree angle; the literal-angle tiny real part is documented.

title.zh: 零支路电流不等于右侧无电流：并联无功相抵
title.en: Zero branch current can coexist with circulating reactive currents

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图7-17所示正弦交流电路中，已知ω=100 rad/s，İ=0，求İ_L₁、İ_C和C的值。
statement.en: For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-17, ω = 100 rad/s and İ = 0. Find İ_L₁, İ_C and C.

alt.zh: 100∠0° V源上正下负，顶端经100 Ω到节点A；A经j100 Ω到地，I_L₁向下；A经200 Ω到节点B，该支路I向右。B经j500 Ω及电容阻抗−j/(ωC)两支路到地，I_L₂和I_C均向下。
alt.en: A top-positive 100∠0° V source connects through 100 Ω to A. A connects through j100 Ω to ground, with I_L₁ downward. A 200 Ω resistor joins A to B, carrying I rightward. B connects through parallel j500 Ω and −j/(ωC) branches to ground, with I_L₂ and I_C downward.

prerequisites.zh: 相量KCL/KVL；零电阻支路电流意味着两端等电位；并联LC导纳相消。
prerequisites.en: Phasor KCL/KVL, equal potentials across a resistor with zero current and cancellation of parallel LC admittances.

recognition.zh: İ=0使200 Ω压降为0，故A、B电压相同。右侧电感和电容电流不必分别为0，只需大小相等、方向相反的相量相加为0。
recognition.en: İ = 0 makes the 200 Ω voltage drop zero, so A and B have equal voltage. The right inductor and capacitor currents need not vanish individually; equal and opposite phasors can sum to zero.

title.zh: 由零电流确定右侧导纳
title.en: Use zero current to determine the right-side admittance

text.zh: B点KCL为İ_L₂+İ_C=0。B电压非0，因此并联导纳必须为0，电容容抗大小等于500 Ω。
text.en: KCL at B is İ_L₂+İ_C = 0. Since B’s voltage is nonzero, the parallel admittance must vanish; capacitive reactance magnitude is 500 Ω.

text.zh: 右侧不取净电流，左源只驱动100 Ω与j100 Ω串联，所以电流就是İ_L₁。
text.en: The right side draws zero net current, so the source drives series 100 Ω and j100 Ω; their current is İ_L₁.

title.zh: 求公共节点电压与电容电流
title.en: Find common voltage and capacitor current

text.zh: A、B电压均为j100İ_L₁=50+j50 V。电容阻抗−j500 Ω，因此İ_C=U̇_B/(−j500)。
text.en: A and B are both at j100İ_L₁ = 50+j50 V. The capacitor impedance is −j500 Ω, so İ_C = U̇_B/(−j500).

pitfalls.zh: İ=0不意味着İ_L₂=İ_C=0；它们相量相消。
pitfalls.en: İ = 0 does not imply İ_L₂ = İ_C = 0; their phasors cancel.

pitfalls.zh: 电容电流是电压除以−jX，即相位超前90°。
pitfalls.en: Dividing by capacitive −jX makes current lead voltage by 90°.

methods.zh: 独立完整双节点方程求解（保留200 Ω支路）得到A=B=50+j50 V，故200 Ω电流严格为0；İ_L₂=0.1−j0.1 A，恰与İ_C相反。复功率核验：100 Ω耗散50 W；左电感+50 var，右电感+10 var，电容−10 var；源提供50+j50 VA，总和为0。书第337页/PDF346页7-23的两个相量与20 μF均一致。
methods.en: An independent full two-node solve, retaining the 200 Ω branch, gives A = B = 50+j50 V and zero 200 Ω current. İ_L₂ = 0.1−j0.1 A exactly cancels İ_C. Complex-power check: 100 Ω dissipates 50 W; the left and right inductors absorb +50 and +10 var, and the capacitor −10 var. The source supplies 50+j50 VA, balancing all loads. Both phasors and 20 μF match answer 7-23 on printed p. 337/PDF p. 346.

title.zh: 跨节点电压源：用超节点KCL反求源相量
title.en: A voltage source between nodes: recover its phasor with supernode KCL

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图7-18所示正弦交流电路中，已知U̇₁=4∠0° V，试求U̇ₛ。
statement.en: For the sinusoidal circuit in Fig. 7-18, U̇₁ = 4∠0° V. Find U̇ₛ.

alt.zh: 底部公共节点。左中节点A经2 Ω接地，电压U₁上正下负；A还经−j1 Ω电容、再经左侧1 Ω接地。A到右中节点B之间有电压源Uₛ，左负右正。B经−j1 Ω电容接地，并经顶端j1 Ω、再经右侧2 Ω串联接地。
alt.en: The bottom is common. Left-middle A connects through 2 Ω to ground, with U₁ positive at A. Another A-to-ground path contains −j1 Ω then left 1 Ω. Voltage source Uₛ lies between A and right-middle B, negative at A and positive at B. B connects to ground through −j1 Ω, and through upper j1 Ω in series with right 2 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 相量节点法；电压源超节点；复数导纳；源电压极性。
prerequisites.en: Phasor nodal analysis, voltage-source supernodes, complex admittances and source polarity.

recognition.zh: U̇₁已给出A=4 V。把A、B及它们之间的电压源看成超节点，直接对所有向地支路列KCL，避开未知源电流；最后按右正左负求Uₛ=B−A。
recognition.en: U̇₁ fixes A = 4 V. Treat A, B and their intervening voltage source as a supernode, summing all currents to ground without the unknown source current. Finally use the right-positive polarity: Uₛ = B−A.

text.zh: A对地有2 Ω及(1−j) Ω两条支路；B对地有−j Ω及(2+j) Ω两条支路。各串联路径之间没有分叉，可先相加阻抗。
text.en: A has paths of 2 Ω and (1−j) Ω to ground. B has paths of −j Ω and (2+j) Ω. Each series path has no intermediate branch, so its impedances add.

text.zh: 没有电流源向超节点外部注入，全部向地电流相加为0。A=4∠0°=4 V，于是可直接解B电位。
text.en: No current source injects from outside the supernode. Sum all ground-directed currents to zero and use A = 4 V to solve B.

title.en: Calculate Uₛ with its stated polarity

text.zh: 图中Uₛ右正左负，源电压是B相对A的电压，不能反过来相减。
text.en: Uₛ is positive on the right and negative on the left, so it is B relative to A, not the reverse.

answer.zh: U̇ₛ=−8+j3 V（图示右正左负）。
answer.en: U̇ₛ = −8+j3 V, positive on the right as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: B电位−4+j3 V还不是所求源电压；还需减去A=4 V。
pitfalls.en: B’s potential −4+j3 V is not the source voltage; subtract A = 4 V.

pitfalls.zh: 电容阻抗−j的导纳为+j，不能漏掉符号变化。
pitfalls.en: The admittance of capacitive impedance −j is +j; retain this sign change.

methods.zh: 独立完整MNA：将−8+j3 V源接回原电路，解得A=4 V、B=−4+j3 V，左最外节点2+j2 V、右最外节点−2+j4 V，确实重现题设。源正端流入电流4+j2 A，吸收复功率(−8+j3)(4−j2)=−26+j28 VA；三只电阻共耗散26 W，电感与两只电容净无功−28 var，总复功率为0。书第337页/PDF346页7-24为−8+j3 V。
methods.en: Independent full MNA: restoring the −8+j3 V source to the original circuit gives A = 4 V and B = −4+j3 V, with outer-left node 2+j2 V and outer-right node −2+j4 V, reproducing the given voltage. Current entering the source’s positive terminal is 4+j2 A, so its absorbed complex power is (−8+j3)(4−j2) = −26+j28 VA. The three resistors dissipate 26 W and the inductor/capacitors have net reactive power −28 var, giving zero total complex power. Answer 7-24 on printed p. 337/PDF p. 346 is −8+j3 V.

title.zh: 参考方向与实际方向：用正负号判断
title.en: Reference and actual directions: interpret the sign

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 已知在如题图1-1所示电路的电压、电流参考方向下，u=5 V，i=−2 A，请标出电压、电流的实际方向。
statement.en: With the voltage and current references in Fig. 1-1, u = 5 V and i = −2 A. Mark the actual voltage and current directions.

alt.zh: 元件左端a、右端b；电流i参考箭头由a指向b；电压u左正右负。
alt.en: A two-terminal element has a at the left and b at the right. The reference current points from a to b, and voltage u is positive at a.

prerequisites.zh: 参考方向是预先指定的坐标；正值表示与参考相同，负值表示相反。
prerequisites.en: A reference is a chosen coordinate direction: a positive value agrees with it; a negative value reverses it.

recognition.zh: 这类题不需要另列电路方程。先把u解释为Vₐ−Vᵦ，再把i的负号解释为箭头反向。
recognition.en: No additional circuit equations are needed. Interpret u as Vₐ−Vᵦ, then reverse the current arrow because i is negative.

text.zh: u=Vₐ−Vᵦ=5 V>0，所以a端比b端高5 V；电压降的实际方向为a→b，即左高右低。
text.en: u = Vₐ−Vᵦ = 5 V > 0, so a is 5 V above b. The actual voltage-drop direction is a→b.

text.zh: i的参考方向为a→b，但i=−2 A，故实际电流为2 A，方向b→a。解答示意图给出了两个实际方向。
text.en: The current reference is a→b, but i = −2 A. The actual current is therefore 2 A from b to a. The solution diagram shows both actual directions.

steps.formula: i_{a\to b}=-2\,\mathrm A\ \Longleftrightarrow\ i_{b\to a}=2\,\mathrm A

answer.zh: 电压：a高、b低，实际电压降a→b；电流：2 A，由b→a。
answer.en: Voltage: a is higher and b lower, with a→b voltage drop. Current: 2 A from b→a.

pitfalls.zh: 负电流不是“没有电流”，而是与选定参考箭头相反。
pitfalls.en: A negative current is not an absent current; it flows opposite the chosen reference arrow.

pitfalls.zh: 电压的方向表示高低电位；不要把它误当作一定与电流同向。
pitfalls.en: Voltage direction describes potential order and need not match the current direction.

methods.zh: 独立参考反转核验：令Vₐ=5 V、Vᵦ=0，则Vₐ−Vᵦ=5 V；把电流坐标改为b→a，数值由−2变成+2 A。与书第332页/PDF341页1-1一致。
methods.en: Independent reference-reversal check: Vₐ = 5 V and Vᵦ = 0 reproduce u = 5 V. Reversing the current coordinate to b→a changes −2 A into +2 A. This matches answer 1-1 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

alt.zh: 实际方向示意：左端a电位较高、右端b较低，5 V电压降向右；实际2 A电流向左，由b流向a。
alt.en: Actual directions: a at left is higher than b at right. The 5 V voltage drop points right; actual 2 A current points left, from b to a.

title.zh: 电荷求电流：正弦函数求导
title.en: Current from charge: differentiate the sinusoid

source.title: 电路分析基础
source.figure: 题干原式（本题无独立题图）

statement.zh: 已知通过某二端元件的电荷q(t)=2sin(3t) C，t>0，求电流i(t)。
statement.en: The charge through a two-terminal element is q(t) = 2sin(3t) C for t > 0. Find i(t).

alt.zh: 原书1-2完整题干，电荷为2sin(3t) C，时间范围t>0。
alt.en: The complete original 1-2 statement: q(t) = 2sin(3t) C for t > 0.

prerequisites.zh: 电流定义i=dq/dt；复合函数求导；C/s=A。
prerequisites.en: Current definition i = dq/dt, the chain rule and C/s = A.

recognition.zh: 给的是电荷而不是电流。求电流只需对时间求导，正弦求导后的系数还要乘以内部的3。
recognition.en: The given quantity is charge. Differentiate it with respect to time, including the inner factor 3.

text.zh: 电流是沿同一参考方向的电荷变化率，单位为库仑每秒。
text.en: Current is the rate of charge change in the same reference direction, measured in coulombs per second.

text.zh: 2sin(3t)求导后是2×3cos(3t)，其中3来自3t对t的导数。
text.en: Differentiating 2sin(3t) gives 2×3cos(3t), where 3 is the derivative of the inner argument 3t.

answer.zh: i(t)=6cos(3t) A，t>0。
answer.en: i(t) = 6cos(3t) A, t > 0.

pitfalls.zh: 不要漏掉链式法则中的3。
pitfalls.en: Do not omit the chain-rule factor 3.

pitfalls.zh: q是有符号的累计电荷，不要求在所有时刻为正。
pitfalls.en: q is signed accumulated charge; it need not be positive at every instant.

methods.zh: 独立积分核验：∫₀ᵗ6cos(3τ)dτ=2sin(3t)=q(t)−q(0)。另在多个时间点对原始q做中心差分，与6cos(3t)相符，误差小于10⁻⁸ A。与书第332页/PDF341页1-2一致。
methods.en: Independent integral check: ∫₀ᵗ6cos(3τ)dτ = 2sin(3t) = q(t)−q(0). Central differences of the original q at multiple times agree with 6cos(3t) to less than 10⁻⁸ A. This matches answer 1-2 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 指数电荷求导：常数消失，指数不变
title.en: Exponential charge: constants vanish and the exponent remains

source.title: 电路分析基础
source.figure: 题干原式（本题无独立题图）

statement.zh: 已知通过某二端元件的电荷q(t)=(10+5e^(−3t)) C，t>0，求通过此元件的电流。
statement.en: The charge through a two-terminal element is q(t) = (10+5e^(−3t)) C for t > 0. Find the current through it.

alt.zh: 原书1-3完整题干，指数清楚为−3t；q(t)=(10+5e^(−3t)) C。
alt.en: The complete original 1-3 statement, clearly showing exponent −3t in q(t) = (10+5e^(−3t)) C.

prerequisites.zh: 电流i=dq/dt；指数函数链式法则；电荷守恒。
prerequisites.en: i = dq/dt, the chain rule for exponentials and charge conservation.

recognition.zh: 10 C是常数项，其导数为0；e^(−3t)求导只增加系数−3，不会把原指数改成别的数。
recognition.en: The constant 10 C differentiates to zero. Differentiating e^(−3t) multiplies it by −3 without changing its exponent.

title.en: Differentiate the original statement term by term

text.zh: 严格采用题干指数−3t：常数10的导数为0，5e^(−3t)的导数为−15e^(−3t)。
text.en: Use the original exponent −3t. The derivative of 10 is zero and that of 5e^(−3t) is −15e^(−3t).

title.zh: 用总电荷变化排除错误指数
title.en: Reject a wrong exponent using total charge change

text.zh: q(0⁺)=15 C，q(∞)=10 C，所以从0到∞的总电流积分必须为−5 C。正确式积分为−15/3=−5 C；附录−15e^(−5t)的积分仅−3 C，不能还原原题。
text.en: q(0⁺) = 15 C and q(∞) = 10 C, so total integrated current must be −5 C. The correct expression integrates to −15/3 = −5 C; the appendix expression −15e^(−5t) integrates to only −3 C and fails to reconstruct the given charge.

answer.zh: i(t)=−15e^(−3t) A，t>0。书后答案的指数−5t与原题不一致，应按题干−3t。
answer.en: i(t) = −15e^(−3t) A for t > 0. The appendix exponent −5t conflicts with the original statement; use −3t.

pitfalls.zh: 求导会改变前面的系数，不会把e^(−3t)改为e^(−5t)。
pitfalls.en: Differentiation changes the coefficient, not e^(−3t) into e^(−5t).

pitfalls.zh: 不能仅因书后印有答案就覆盖原题和积分守恒。
pitfalls.en: Do not override the original statement and charge balance solely because an appendix answer is printed.

methods.zh: 独立双重核验：对原q做多点中心差分，误差小于10⁻⁸ A；正确电流从0到∞的积分为−5 C，与15 C降到10 C完全相符。高分辨率核对题干第32页/PDF41页为−3t，附录第332页/PDF341页印为−5t，确认为附录指数错误。
methods.en: Two independent checks: central differences of the original q agree to less than 10⁻⁸ A, and integrating current to infinity gives −5 C, exactly the fall from 15 C to 10 C. High-resolution inspection confirms −3t in the statement on printed p. 32/PDF p. 41 but −5t in the appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341; the appendix exponent is wrong.

appendixComparison.reason: Derivative and total-charge integral both require exponent -3t.

title.zh: 电荷波形到电流与功率：斜率和能量符号
title.en: From charge to current and power: slopes and energy signs

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 设通过题图1-2(a)所示元件的电荷波形如题图1-2(b)所示。若单位正电荷由a端移至b端时获得的能量为2 J，求流过元件的电流i(t)及元件的功率p(t)，并画出i(t)与p(t)的波形。
statement.en: The charge waveform through the element in Fig. 1-2(a) is shown in Fig. 1-2(b). A unit positive charge gains 2 J when moving from terminal a to b. Find current i(t) and element power p(t), and draw both waveforms.

alt.zh: a在左、b在右，i参考方向a→b，u左正右负。q由0到1 s按5t² C增加到5 C；1到2 s保持5 C；2到3 s线性降至0。
alt.en: a is left, b right, reference i is a→b and u is positive at a. q rises as 5t² C from 0 to 1 s, stays at 5 C from 1 to 2 s, then falls linearly to 0 at 3 s.

prerequisites.zh: i=dq/dt；电压为单位正电荷的电位能差；关联方向下p吸收=ui；分段函数单侧极限。
prerequisites.en: i = dq/dt, voltage as potential-energy difference per unit charge, absorbed power p = ui under passive references, and one-sided limits of piecewise functions.

recognition.zh: 先从“正电荷获得能量”判断b比a电位高，得到u=−2 V；再逐段读取q的斜率求i，最后按原图关联参考方向相乘得到吸收功率。
recognition.en: First interpret the gained energy: b is above a in potential, so u = −2 V. Then differentiate each charge segment and multiply by u using the original passive references.

title.zh: 把获得的能量换成图示电压
title.en: Convert gained energy into the referenced voltage

text.zh: 单位正电荷从a到b获得2 J，故Vᵦ−Vₐ=2 V；图示u=Vₐ−Vᵦ，所以u=−2 V。
text.en: A unit positive charge gains 2 J from a to b, so Vᵦ−Vₐ = 2 V. The drawn voltage is u = Vₐ−Vᵦ = −2 V.

title.en: Write and differentiate the charge pieces

text.zh: 0<t<1时q=5t²；1<t<2时q=5；2<t<3时q=15−5t。对应斜率分别为10t、0、−5，单位A。
text.en: For 0<t<1, q = 5t²; for 1<t<2, q = 5; for 2<t<3, q = 15−5t. Their slopes are 10t, 0 and −5 A.

title.en: Compute absorbed power and draw the waveforms

text.zh: i从u正端流入，因此p=ui=−2i。第一段负功率表示元件提供能量；第三段正功率表示吸收能量。解答图中的虚线只提示跳变，不代表额外冲激。
text.en: Current enters u’s positive terminal, so p = ui = −2i. Negative first-segment power means energy delivery; positive third-segment power means absorption. Dashed jump guides in the solution plot do not represent impulses.

title.zh: 说明分段交界和图外延拓
title.en: State the corner and extension conventions

text.zh: 在t=1、2、3处，q的斜率发生跳变，通常不为导数单独指定一个值，应按左右极限画图。q本身连续，因此电流没有冲激。若按图中3 s后的零值水平线延拓，则t>3时i=p=0。
text.en: At t = 1, 2 and 3 the charge slope jumps, so use one-sided limits rather than assigning a unique derivative value. Charge is continuous, hence no current impulse. If the zero-charge horizontal continuation after 3 s is used, i = p = 0 for t > 3.

answer.zh: u=−2 V。i：0<t<1为10t A，1<t<2为0，2<t<3为−5 A；p吸收依次为−20t W、0、10 W。波形见解答图；交界点用单侧极限。
answer.en: u = −2 V. i is 10t A for 0<t<1, 0 for 1<t<2 and −5 A for 2<t<3. Absorbed power is respectively −20t W, 0 and 10 W. See the solution plots; use one-sided limits at corners.

pitfalls.zh: “电荷获得能量”给出Vᵦ−Vₐ>0，图示u却是Vₐ−Vᵦ。
pitfalls.en: The gained energy implies Vᵦ−Vₐ > 0, whereas the drawn u is Vₐ−Vᵦ.

pitfalls.zh: q的恒定平台对应零电流，不是5 A。
pitfalls.en: A constant charge plateau means zero current, not 5 A.

pitfalls.zh: q连续但斜率跳变，只产生电流跳变，不产生电流冲激。
pitfalls.en: Continuous q with a slope jump creates a current jump, not an impulse.

methods.zh: 独立电荷/能量核验：三段电流积分为+5、0、−5 C，总计0，重建q由0回到0；吸收能量为−10、0、+10 J，总计0，等于uΔq。各非交界时间点对原q作差分也相符。附录第332页/PDF341页列出的各段电流、功率与此一致。
methods.en: Independent charge/energy checks: integrated segment currents are +5, 0 and −5 C, totaling zero and reconstructing the return of q to zero. Absorbed energies are −10, 0 and +10 J, totaling uΔq = 0. Differentiation checks away from corners also agree. The appendix segment currents and powers on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 match.

alt.zh: 两幅精确分段波形：i从0线性升到10 A的左极限，在1 s降到0，2 s降到−5 A，3 s回0；p从0线性降到−20 W的左极限，在1 s回0，2 s升到10 W，3 s回0。虚线为跳变提示，开圆为单侧极限。
alt.en: Exact piecewise plots: i rises linearly from 0 to the 10 A left limit, drops to 0 at 1 s, then to −5 A at 2 s and returns to 0 at 3 s. p falls linearly to the −20 W left limit, returns to 0 at 1 s, rises to 10 W at 2 s and returns to 0 at 3 s. Dashed lines guide jumps; open circles show one-sided limits.

title.zh: 局部电路KCL：允许未知电流取负
title.en: Local KCL: allow a negative unknown current

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-4所示部分电路中的电流i₁和i₂。
statement.en: Find currents i₁ and i₂ in the partial circuit of Fig. 1-4.

alt.zh: 左节点2 A流入、5 A流出；4 A源从左到右；下方电阻i₁参考向右。右节点8 A流出、6 A流入；i₂参考从右下方流入。
alt.en: At the left node 2 A enters and 5 A leaves. A 4 A source points left to right, as does bottom reference i₁. At the right node 8 A leaves and 6 A enters; i₂ enters from the lower right.

prerequisites.zh: 基尔霍夫电流定律；按参考箭头代数求和；整体边界电流守恒。
prerequisites.en: Kirchhoff’s current law, algebraic currents in their reference directions and boundary-current conservation.

recognition.zh: 每个节点写一条“流入=流出”。未知量先按题目箭头保留，求出负值后再解释实际方向。
recognition.en: Write entering = leaving at each node. Keep each unknown in the given reference, then interpret its actual direction after solving.

title.en: Use the left node for i₁

text.zh: 2 A流入；5 A、4 A和参考i₁流出，所以2=5+4+i₁。
text.en: 2 A enters; 5 A, 4 A and reference i₁ leave, giving 2 = 5+4+i₁.

title.en: Use the right node for i₂

text.zh: 4 A、参考i₁、6 A及i₂流入，8 A流出。代入i₁=−7 A，得到i₂=5 A。
text.en: 4 A, reference i₁, 6 A and i₂ enter; 8 A leaves. Substituting i₁ = −7 A gives i₂ = 5 A.

answer.zh: i₁=−7 A（实际由右向左7 A）；i₂=5 A（按原图从右下方流入右节点）。
answer.en: i₁ = −7 A, actually 7 A right to left. i₂ = 5 A, entering the right node from the lower right as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: i₁在右节点参考流入，代入时必须保留−7 A，不能改成+7而不改箭头。
pitfalls.en: At the right node i₁ is referenced inward; retain −7 A unless you also reverse its arrow.

pitfalls.zh: 4 A是连接两个节点的内部电流，整体边界KCL中会相消。
pitfalls.en: The 4 A source is internal to the two-node region and cancels in the boundary KCL.

methods.zh: 独立整体边界核验：外部总流入2+6+5=13 A，总流出5+8=13 A；内部4 A和i₁均相消。另独立联立两节点方程得到同样的−7、5 A。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-6一致。
methods.en: Independent boundary check: external inflow 2+6+5 = 13 A equals outflow 5+8 = 13 A; internal 4 A and i₁ cancel. An independent simultaneous solve of both node equations gives −7 and 5 A. This matches appendix 1-6 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 复杂极性图：先赋节点电位
title.en: A polarity-heavy figure: assign node potentials first

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-6所示电路中的电压u₁、u₂和u₃。
statement.en: Find voltages u₁, u₂ and u₃ in Fig. 1-6.

alt.zh: 菱形节点T顶、B底、L左、R右。外10 V源T正B负；左下10 V为L正B负；右下6 V为R正B负。u₁为L正R负，u₂为R正T负，u₃为T正L负。
alt.en: Diamond nodes are T top, B bottom, L left and R right. Outer 10 V is positive at T relative to B; lower-left 10 V at L relative to B; lower-right 6 V at R relative to B. u₁ = V_L−V_R, u₂ = V_R−V_T and u₃ = V_T−V_L.

prerequisites.zh: 节点电位；电压等于正端电位减负端电位；KVL。
prerequisites.en: Node potentials, voltage as positive-terminal potential minus negative-terminal potential, and KVL.

recognition.zh: 将底节点设为0 V，可直接读出T、L、R三个电位。随后所有未知电压只需按图示极性相减，避免在斜边上反复判断符号。
recognition.en: Set the bottom node to zero and directly read T, L and R. Obtain each unknown by subtracting the negative-terminal potential from the positive-terminal potential.

text.zh: 令V_B=0。三个已知电压分别给出V_T=10 V、V_L=10 V、V_R=6 V。
text.en: Choose V_B = 0. The given voltages yield V_T = 10 V, V_L = 10 V and V_R = 6 V.

title.zh: 按三个未知量的正负端相减

text.zh: u₁左正右负；u₂右节点为正、顶节点为负；u₃顶节点为正、左节点为负。
text.en: u₁ is positive at L and negative at R. u₂ is positive at R and negative at T. u₃ is positive at T and negative at L.

answer.zh: u₁=4 V，u₂=−4 V，u₃=0 V。
answer.en: u₁ = 4 V, u₂ = −4 V and u₃ = 0 V.

pitfalls.zh: 原图斜向正号旋转后外形近似×，应结合两端极性看清位置。
pitfalls.en: The rotated plus signs resemble ×; identify which end of each diagonal branch is positive.

pitfalls.zh: 两端都有10 V对地电位时，端间电压是0，不是20 V。
pitfalls.en: Two terminals each at 10 V relative to ground have zero voltage between them, not 20 V.

methods.zh: 独立KVL核验：中央三边环路u₁+u₂+u₃=4−4+0=0。节点差值同时重现外10 V、左下10 V及右下6 V三个已知量。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-8一致。
methods.en: Independent KVL check: u₁+u₂+u₃ = 4−4+0 = 0 around the central triangle. The potentials also reproduce all three given 10 V, 10 V and 6 V differences. This matches appendix 1-8 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 各元件功率：先统一节点，再判断关联方向
title.en: Element power: solve nodes, then use passive signs

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-7所示，已知i₁=2 A，i₃=−3 A，u₁=10 V，u₄=−5 V，试求各元件吸收的功率。
statement.en: In Fig. 1-7, i₁ = 2 A, i₃ = −3 A, u₁ = 10 V and u₄ = −5 V. Find the power absorbed by each element.

alt.zh: 四元件：1在上方，u₁左正右负而i₁向左；2在左竖支路，u₂上正下负；3在中竖支路，u₃上负下正而i₃向下；4在右竖支路，u₄上正下负。底部为共节点。
alt.en: Element 1 is on top, with u₁ positive left and i₁ leftward. Element 2 is on the left, u₂ positive at top. Element 3 is central, u₃ positive at bottom and i₃ downward. Element 4 is on the right, u₄ positive at top. The bottom is common.

prerequisites.zh: KCL；节点电位；关联方向p吸收=ui，非关联方向p吸收=−ui；总功率守恒。
prerequisites.en: KCL, node potentials, absorbed p = ui for passive references or −ui for opposite references, and total power balance.

recognition.zh: 不能对所有元件机械使用ui。先由u₄和u₁求两个上节点电位，再用KCL补齐支路电流，逐个按“流入高参考端”的规则求吸收功率。
recognition.en: Do not blindly use ui for every element. Determine the two upper potentials from u₄ and u₁, recover currents by KCL, then evaluate each absorbed power with its reference polarity.

title.zh: 设底部为0 V求节点电位
title.en: Set the bottom to zero and recover potentials

text.zh: 令右上节点B、左上节点A。u₄=V_B=−5 V，u₁=V_A−V_B=10 V，故V_A=5 V；于是u₂=5 V、u₃=0−V_B=5 V。
text.en: Let B be upper right and A upper left. u₄ = V_B = −5 V and u₁ = V_A−V_B = 10 V, so V_A = 5 V. Therefore u₂ = 5 V and u₃ = 0−V_B = 5 V.

text.zh: 元件2从A向下电流为i₂=i₁=2 A。定义元件4向下为i₄，B点流出代数和i₁+i₃+i₄=0，所以i₄=1 A。
text.en: Element 2 carries i₂ = i₁ = 2 A downward from A. Define i₄ downward; the outgoing sum at B is i₁+i₃+i₄ = 0, giving i₄ = 1 A.

text.zh: 1和3的图示电流均从电压负参考端流入，故用−ui；2和4用ui。元件3应为−5×(−3)=15 W。
text.en: For 1 and 3 the drawn current enters the negative voltage-reference terminal, so use −ui. For 2 and 4 use ui. Element 3 absorbs −5×(−3) = 15 W.

steps.formula: p_1=-u_1i_1=-20\,\mathrm W,\quad p_2=u_2i_2=10\,\mathrm W,\quad p_3=-u_3i_3=15\,\mathrm W,\quad p_4=u_4i_4=-5\,\mathrm W

title.en: Audit the answer with power balance

text.zh: 四元件吸收功率之和−20+10+15−5=0。1和4总共提供25 W，2和3总共吸收25 W。附录把元件3印成5 W会使总和变成−10 W，不满足守恒。
text.en: The sum −20+10+15−5 = 0. Elements 1 and 4 deliver 25 W, while 2 and 3 absorb 25 W. The appendix value 5 W for element 3 instead gives −10 W total, violating conservation.

answer.zh: 按元件1、2、3、4顺序：−20 W、10 W、15 W、−5 W。负值表示提供功率。附录第三个值5 W有误。
answer.en: For elements 1, 2, 3 and 4: −20 W, 10 W, 15 W and −5 W. Negative values mean delivered power. The appendix’s third value 5 W is wrong.

pitfalls.zh: 元件3的u₃上负下正、i₃向下，属于非关联参考方向。
pitfalls.en: For element 3 u₃ is positive at the bottom while i₃ points down, so the references are nonpassive.

pitfalls.zh: 有符号的i₃=−3 A要直接代入，不能丢掉负号。
pitfalls.en: Substitute the signed i₃ = −3 A without discarding its negative sign.

methods.zh: 独立按物理支路首末节点计算p=(V起−V终)i，四项仍为−20、10、15、−5 W；全部节点KCL和总功率残差均为0。题干和完整极性原图第33页/PDF42页清楚；附录第332页/PDF341页印第三项5 W，与节点电位和功率守恒同时冲突。
methods.en: Independent physical branch calculation p = (V_start−V_end)i gives −20, 10, 15 and −5 W, with zero KCL residual at every node and zero power residual. The original statement and full polarity diagram on printed p. 33/PDF p. 42 are clear. The appendix’s third value 5 W on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 conflicts with both node potentials and power conservation.

appendixComparison.reason: Element 3 has u3=5 V with nonpassive current reference i3=-3 A, so absorbed power is 15 W; only this value balances all power.

title.zh: 对地电压求支路电流：分清4 Ω与4 S
title.en: From node voltage to current: distinguish 4 Ω from 4 S

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电阻元件两端的对地电压如题图1-8所示，求通过各电阻元件的电流i。
statement.en: The terminal voltages relative to ground are shown in Fig. 1-8. Find current i through each resistive element.

alt.zh: (a)左端3 V、右端1 V，电阻4 Ω，i参考向左。(b)左端u₁、右端u₂，标注电导4 S，i参考向左。
alt.en: (a) Left terminal 3 V, right 1 V, resistance 4 Ω, with i leftward. (b) Left terminal u₁, right u₂, conductance 4 S, again with i leftward.

prerequisites.zh: 欧姆定律i=ΔV/R=GΔV；S为西门子，1 S=1 Ω⁻¹；按电流箭头选电压差。
prerequisites.en: Ohm’s law i = ΔV/R = GΔV, Siemens 1 S = 1 Ω⁻¹, and the voltage drop along the current reference.

recognition.zh: 两图电流都由右向左，因此电压差都取“右端减左端”。(a)给电阻，除以4；(b)给电导，乘以4。
recognition.en: Both currents are referenced right to left, so use right-terminal minus left-terminal voltage. Divide by 4 for the resistance in (a), but multiply by 4 for the conductance in (b).

text.zh: 沿i向左的电压降为1−3=−2 V，除以4 Ω得到−0.5 A，实际电流向右。
text.en: The voltage drop along leftward i is 1−3 = −2 V. Dividing by 4 Ω gives −0.5 A, actually rightward.

text.zh: 图中4 S是电导，不是4 Ω。等效电阻为1/4 Ω；因此i=G(u₂−u₁)=4(u₂−u₁)。
text.en: The original 4 S is conductance, not 4 Ω. Its equivalent resistance is 1/4 Ω, so i = G(u₂−u₁) = 4(u₂−u₁).

steps.formula: G=4\,\mathrm S,\quad R=\frac14\,\Omega,\quad i=4(u_2-u_1)\,\mathrm A\quad\text{when voltages are in V}

answer.zh: (a) i=−0.5 A；(b) i=4(u₂−u₁) A（u₁、u₂以V计，原图给的是4 S电导）。
answer.en: (a) i = −0.5 A. (b) i = 4(u₂−u₁) A for voltages in volts; the original figure gives 4 S conductance.

pitfalls.zh: S和Ω表示互为倒数的物理量，不能将(b)当成4 Ω。
pitfalls.en: S and Ω describe reciprocal quantities; do not read (b) as 4 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 对地电位不能直接当电阻端电压，先沿参考箭头做两端差。
pitfalls.en: A single ground-referenced potential is not the resistor voltage; take the terminal difference along the reference.

methods.zh: 独立量纲与功率核验：(a)吸收功率(−2 V)(−0.5 A)=1 W；(b)S×V=A，且p=4(u₂−u₁)²≥0；以等效R=0.25 Ω计算得到相同电流。高分辨率原图确认4 S，附录第332页/PDF341页两问均正确。
methods.en: Independent dimensional and power checks: (a) absorbs (−2 V)(−0.5 A) = 1 W. (b) has S×V = A and p = 4(u₂−u₁)² ≥ 0; using equivalent R = 0.25 Ω gives the same current. High-resolution inspection confirms 4 S, and both appendix answers on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 are correct.

title.zh: 有分流的电阻链：从末端逐级累加电流
title.en: A tapped resistor chain: accumulate current from the bottom

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电阻电路中各点对地电压及各支路电流如题图1-9所示，求各电阻的阻值。
statement.en: Ground-referenced node voltages and branch currents are shown in Fig. 1-9. Find all resistor values.

alt.zh: 30 V经R₁至24 V节点，该处向右流出10 mA；R₂下接12 V节点，向右流出15 mA；R₃下接6 V节点，向右流出20 mA；R₄下接0 V，向下电流5 mA。
alt.en: 30 V connects through R₁ to 24 V, which has 10 mA outgoing. R₂ leads to 12 V with 15 mA outgoing; R₃ to 6 V with 20 mA outgoing; R₄ to 0 V carries 5 mA downward.

prerequisites.zh: KCL累加分流；电阻端电压为相邻节点差；mA换算。
prerequisites.en: KCL with outgoing taps, adjacent-node voltage differences and mA conversion.

recognition.zh: 这不是四只电阻同流的简单串联链。每层有分流，应从已知最底5 mA向上逐层加上流出的电流，再用各自压降除以各自电流。
recognition.en: The four resistors do not share one current because taps draw current. Start from the given 5 mA at the bottom, add each outgoing tap upward, then divide each voltage drop by its own current.

text.zh: R₄电流为5 mA；R₃须另供20 mA，故25 mA；R₂须另供15 mA，故40 mA；R₁须另供10 mA，故50 mA。
text.en: R₄ carries 5 mA. R₃ must also supply 20 mA, so it carries 25 mA; R₂ adds 15 mA to reach 40 mA; R₁ adds 10 mA to reach 50 mA.

text.zh: 各段压降依次为6、12、6、6 V，除以各段电流50、40、25、5 mA。
text.en: The respective voltage drops are 6, 12, 6 and 6 V. Divide by the corresponding currents 50, 40, 25 and 5 mA.

answer.en: R₁ = 120 Ω, R₂ = 300 Ω, R₃ = 240 Ω and R₄ = 1200 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 每个节点有支路分流，不能令四只电阻电流相同。
pitfalls.en: The node taps draw current, so the four resistor currents are unequal.

pitfalls.zh: V/mA直接给出kΩ；若答案写Ω，先把mA化为A。
pitfalls.en: V/mA gives kΩ; convert mA to A when reporting Ω.

methods.zh: 独立逐节点回代KCL全部为0；源输入30×0.05=1.5 W，电阻共吸收0.96 W，三个外接端口带走24×0.01+12×0.015+6×0.02=0.54 W，和为1.5 W。高分辨率附录第332页/PDF341页R₄实际印为1200 Ω，与结果一致。
methods.en: Independent node-by-node substitution gives zero KCL residual. Input power is 30×0.05 = 1.5 W; resistors absorb 0.96 W and the three external ports take 24×0.01+12×0.015+6×0.02 = 0.54 W, totaling 1.5 W. High-resolution appendix inspection confirms R₄ = 1200 Ω on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341, matching the result.

title.zh: 理想电压源并联电阻：电压固定，源电流调整
title.en: A resistor across an ideal voltage source: voltage fixed, source current adjusts

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-10所示，其中Uₛ为理想电压源，试判断当外电路不变，仅电阻R变化时，将会引起电路中哪条支路电流的变化。
statement.en: In Fig. 1-10, Uₛ is an ideal voltage source. With the external circuit unchanged, determine which branch current changes when only R changes.

alt.zh: 理想电压源Uₛ上正下负，与R并联，共同接到右侧外电路端口；端口u上正下负，外电流i由上端向右流出。
alt.en: An ideal top-positive voltage source Uₛ is parallel with R and the right external port. Port u is positive at the top and external current i leaves the upper terminal to the right.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源固定端电压；并联电压相同；KCL；固定外电路的工作点。
prerequisites.en: Fixed ideal-source voltage, common parallel voltage, KCL and the operating point of an unchanged external circuit.

recognition.zh: Uₛ直接钳定外端口电压u=Uₛ。R变化会改变自身电流，但外电路输入电压未变，因此其原工作电流i不变；理想源会补足R电流变化。
recognition.en: Uₛ directly fixes port voltage u = Uₛ. Changing R changes its own current. The external circuit retains the same voltage and its operating current i; the ideal source supplies the extra resistor current.

text.zh: 理想电压源与外端口并联，故u始终等于Uₛ。对工作点确定的固定外电路，i由这个固定端电压决定，因此不随R变化。
text.en: The ideal voltage source is across the external port, so u remains Uₛ. For an unchanged external circuit with a determined operating point, i is fixed by this voltage and does not change with R.

title.zh: 写出R支路及电源支路电流

text.zh: 定义R中向下电流i_R，电源从下向上供出电流i_s。则i_R=Uₛ/R，节点KCL为i_s=i+i_R。一般R变化时，i_R和i_s都相应变化；端口i不变。
text.en: Define i_R downward through R and i_s upward supplied by the source. Then i_R = Uₛ/R and KCL gives i_s = i+i_R. In general both i_R and i_s change as R changes, while external i remains fixed.

title.zh: 补充附录简答省略的源电流

text.zh: 附录只写“电阻R支路的电流变化”，说明了R支路的变化，但若把电源支路也计入题目，电源电流必须同步调整，不能宣称其恒定。若Uₛ=0等退化情况，具体变化由上述公式判断。
text.en: The appendix states only that the resistor-branch current changes. This identifies R’s response, but if the source branch is included, its current must adjust as well. The formulas also cover degenerate cases such as Uₛ = 0.

answer.zh: 一般R变化会使R支路电流i_R=Uₛ/R变化，理想电压源供出电流i_s=i+i_R也随之调整；外电路电流i不变。
answer.en: In general changing R changes i_R = Uₛ/R and also the ideal source’s supplied current i_s = i+i_R. External current i is unchanged.

pitfalls.zh: 理想电压源固定的是电压，不是自身电流。
pitfalls.en: An ideal voltage source fixes its voltage, not its current.

pitfalls.zh: “外电路电流不变”不能推广成“源支路电流也不变”。
pitfalls.en: Unchanged external current does not imply unchanged source current.

methods.zh: 独立数值反例与功率核验：Uₛ=10 V，固定外负载10 Ω。R从10 Ω变到5 Ω时，外电流保持1 A；R电流1→2 A，源电流2→3 A。源功率20→30 W，恰等于外负载10 W加R功率10→20 W。附录第332页/PDF341页定性简答省略了这项源电流调整，记录中已补全。
methods.en: Independent numerical and power check: with Uₛ = 10 V and fixed external 10 Ω load, changing R from 10 to 5 Ω leaves external current at 1 A, increases resistor current from 1 to 2 A and source current from 2 to 3 A. Source power rises from 20 to 30 W, balancing the fixed 10 W external load plus 10 to 20 W in R. The qualitative appendix answer on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 omits the source-current adjustment, which is included here.

results.externalCurrent: unchanged at unchanged external operating point

appendixComparison.completion: R current changes and source-branch current must adjust by the same amount; external i remains unchanged.
appendixComparison.reason: KCL i_source=i_external+Us/R requires source current adjustment.

title.zh: 含源支路特性：下降斜率的绝对值就是R
title.en: A source-containing branch: resistance is the negative slope

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 一段含源支路及其u-i特性如题图1-11所示，图中3条直线对应于电阻R的3个不同数值R₁、R₂、R₃，试根据该图判断各电阻的大小关系。
statement.en: A source-containing branch and its u-i characteristics are shown in Fig. 1-11. The three lines correspond to R₁, R₂ and R₃. Determine their ordering.

alt.zh: 串联电压源Uₛ上正下负、上方电阻R，电流i向上并从正端口流出；端电压u上正下负。u-i图纵轴u、横轴i，R₁线水平，R₂缓降，R₃陡降，共同纵截距Uₛ。
alt.en: A top-positive source Uₛ is series with R above it. Current i flows upward and leaves the positive port; u is top-positive. The plot has u vertical and i horizontal: R₁ horizontal, R₂ gently descending, R₃ steeply descending, all intercepting Uₛ.

prerequisites.zh: KVL；含源支路端口特性；u-i图斜率du/di=−R。
prerequisites.en: KVL, source-containing port characteristics and slope du/di = −R.

recognition.zh: 先按端口电流“流出正端”的参考方向写u=Uₛ−Ri。电阻越大，曲线随电流下降越快；不要套用无源电阻的正斜率。
recognition.en: Because current leaves the positive port, the branch law is u = Uₛ−Ri. Greater resistance gives a steeper downward line; do not use the positive slope of a passive resistor reference.

title.en: Write the port law from the figure

text.zh: 电流从源正端向上流过R，电阻压降为Ri，端口剩余电压为Uₛ−Ri。
text.en: Current rises from the source’s positive terminal through R, dropping Ri. The remaining port voltage is Uₛ−Ri.

text.zh: R₁曲线水平，所以R₁=0；R₃比R₂下降更陡，因此R₃>R₂>0。
text.en: R₁’s line is horizontal, giving R₁ = 0. R₃ descends more steeply than R₂, so R₃ > R₂ > 0.

answer.zh: R₁=0，且R₁<R₂<R₃。
answer.en: R₁ = 0 and R₁ < R₂ < R₃.

pitfalls.zh: 图的横轴为i、纵轴为u，斜率单位才是Ω；轴反过来则读的是电导。
pitfalls.en: With i horizontal and u vertical, the slope has units Ω; reversed axes would describe conductance.

pitfalls.zh: 此题电流流出正端口，特性斜率为−R，不能直接用+R。
pitfalls.en: Here current leaves the positive port, so the slope is −R rather than +R.

methods.zh: 独立固定正电流比较：三条线同截距Uₛ，若i>0，则u₁>u₂>u₃；由R=(Uₛ−u)/i即得R₁<R₂<R₃。再以有限差分检查Δu/Δi=−R。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-13一致。
methods.en: Independent fixed-current comparison: all lines share intercept Uₛ; for i > 0, u₁ > u₂ > u₃. Then R = (Uₛ−u)/i gives R₁ < R₂ < R₃. A finite-difference check also gives Δu/Δi = −R. This matches appendix 1-13 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 电流源网络：外节点KCL直接确定电阻压降
title.en: Current-source network: outer-node KCL fixes resistor drops

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-12所示电路中的u_ae、u_be、u_cf、u_df、u_ef。
statement.en: Find u_ae, u_be, u_cf, u_df and u_ef in Fig. 1-12.

alt.zh: 外矩形节点a左下、b左上、c右上、d右下，内部e左、f右。电流源a→b为1 A，b→c为2 A，a→d为3 A，d→c为4 A。电阻b-e为5 Ω、a-e为4 Ω、c-f为10 Ω、d-f为8 Ω、e-f为20 Ω。
alt.en: Outer nodes are a lower left, b upper left, c upper right, d lower right; inner e left and f right. Sources: a→b 1 A, b→c 2 A, a→d 3 A, d→c 4 A. Resistors: b-e 5 Ω, a-e 4 Ω, c-f 10 Ω, d-f 8 Ω, e-f 20 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: KCL；电阻电压u_xy=V_x−V_y；电流源方向；节点法与全电路功率守恒。
prerequisites.en: KCL, u_xy = V_x−V_y, source directions, nodal analysis and full-network power conservation.

recognition.zh: 四个外节点各只连一只电阻，另两支路是已知电流源，因此每只外围电阻的电流可以直接由KCL确定。再到e点求20 Ω电流；无需先解大量未知电压。
recognition.en: Each outer node has one resistor and two known current sources, so KCL directly determines each outer resistor current. Then use node e for the 20 Ω current, avoiding an unnecessary large voltage calculation.

title.en: Use left nodes a and b

text.zh: a向外流出1+3=4 A，故e→a为4 A，u_ae=−4×4=−16 V。b流入1 A、流出2 A，故e→b为1 A，u_be=−1×5=−5 V。
text.en: At a, sources take 1+3 = 4 A outward, so e→a carries 4 A and u_ae = −4×4 = −16 V. At b, 1 A enters and 2 A leaves, so e→b is 1 A and u_be = −1×5 = −5 V.

title.en: Use right nodes c and d

text.zh: c收到2+4=6 A，故c→f为6 A，u_cf=6×10=60 V。d收到3 A、流出4 A，故f→d为1 A，u_df=−1×8=−8 V。
text.en: At c, sources deliver 2+4 = 6 A, so c→f carries 6 A and u_cf = 6×10 = 60 V. At d, 3 A enters and 4 A leaves, so f→d is 1 A and u_df = −1×8 = −8 V.

title.en: Use node e for the central 20 Ω drop

text.zh: e向a、b分别流出4 A、1 A，总共5 A，所以中央支路必须由f向e流入5 A。u_ef=−5×20=−100 V。
text.en: e sends 4 A to a and 1 A to b, so 5 A must enter from f. Therefore u_ef = −5×20 = −100 V.

title.zh: 建立一组节点电位用于回代

text.zh: 取V_e=0，可得V_a=−16、V_b=−5、V_f=100、V_c=160、V_d=92 V。它们重现五个所求电压以及每个电流源节点的KCL。
text.en: With V_e = 0, obtain V_a = −16, V_b = −5, V_f = 100, V_c = 160 and V_d = 92 V. These reproduce all five requested differences and source-node KCL.

answer.zh: u_ae=−16 V；u_be=−5 V；u_cf=60 V；u_df=−8 V；u_ef=−100 V。
answer.en: u_ae = −16 V; u_be = −5 V; u_cf = 60 V; u_df = −8 V; u_ef = −100 V.

pitfalls.zh: u_ae表示V_a−V_e；不能只把电阻压降大小当作答案。
pitfalls.en: u_ae means V_a−V_e; the unsigned drop magnitude is insufficient.

pitfalls.zh: d点电流源3 A流入、4 A流出，因此电阻实际电流必须由f流向d。
pitfalls.en: At d the sources provide 3 A inward but 4 A outward, so the resistor current must run from f to d.

methods.zh: 独立按原图搭建五节点电导矩阵，以有理数高斯消元求得V_a=−16、V_b=−5、V_c=160、V_d=92、V_f=100 V（V_e=0），全部节点残差精确为0。五电阻功率为5、64、360、8、500 W，总937 W；四源吸收功率−11、−330、−324、−272 W，总−937 W，全电路功率和0。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-14五项全部一致。
methods.en: An independent five-node conductance matrix stamped from the original topology and solved by exact rational Gaussian elimination gives V_a = −16, V_b = −5, V_c = 160, V_d = 92 and V_f = 100 V with V_e = 0; every nodal residual is exactly zero. Resistor powers 5, 64, 360, 8 and 500 W total 937 W. Source absorbed powers −11, −330, −324 and −272 W total −937 W, giving zero overall power. All five values match appendix 1-14 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 指定端电压反求电源：由固定电压逐层做KCL
title.en: Recover the source from a target terminal voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-13所示，欲使u_AB=5 V，问电压源电压uₛ应是多少？
statement.en: For Fig. 1-13, determine source voltage uₛ so that u_AB = 5 V.

alt.zh: B为底部公共节点、A为上节点。左源uₛ上正下负，其上端经1 Ω接A。A与中节点M之间5 V源上正下负；M经1 Ω接B。右支路A经1 Ω接N、N经1 Ω接B。10 A源由M向右流入N。
alt.en: B is the bottom common node and A the top node. The top-positive left source uₛ connects through 1 Ω to A. A top-positive 5 V source joins A to middle M; M connects through 1 Ω to B. On the right A connects through 1 Ω to N and N through 1 Ω to B. A 10 A source runs from M to N.

prerequisites.zh: 节点电位；理想电压源约束；KCL；按实际压降求源电压。
prerequisites.en: Node potentials, ideal-source constraints, KCL and voltage drops.

recognition.zh: 目标u_AB先给出A电位，5 V源随即给出中节点电位。先对右中节点列KCL，再对A、M组成的超节点列KCL，可以直接反求左源。
recognition.en: The target fixes A, and the 5 V source then fixes M. Apply KCL first at the right-middle node, then to the A–M supernode to recover the left source.

text.zh: 取V_B=0，目标u_AB=5 V给出V_A=5 V。5 V源要求V_A−V_M=5 V，因此V_M=0，中央下方1 Ω无电流。
text.en: Choose V_B = 0. The target gives V_A = 5 V. The 5 V source imposes V_A−V_M = 5 V, so V_M = 0 and the center-bottom 1 Ω carries no current.

title.en: Use the right-middle node for V_N

text.zh: 10 A向N流入；从N流向A和B的电阻电流之和为10 A。
text.en: The 10 A source enters N; the resistor currents from N to A and B total 10 A.

title.en: Use the supernode for the left source

text.zh: A、M超节点向外流出：(5−uₛ)/1、(5−7.5)/1、0/1和10 A。令其代数和为0，解得uₛ=12.5 V。
text.en: Outgoing currents of the A–M supernode are (5−uₛ)/1, (5−7.5)/1, 0/1 and 10 A. Their algebraic sum is zero, giving uₛ = 12.5 V.

answer.zh: uₛ=12.5 V（原图上正下负）。
answer.en: uₛ = 12.5 V, positive at the top as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: 10 A源由中央流向右侧，不能在N点按流出10 A列式。
pitfalls.en: The 10 A source enters N from the center; do not count it as 10 A leaving N.

pitfalls.zh: u_AB是A相对B的电压，参考节点可直接选B。
pitfalls.en: u_AB is A relative to B, so B is a convenient reference.

methods.zh: 独立原拓扑MNA回代uₛ=12.5 V，得到A=5、M=0、N=7.5 V，重现目标。四只电阻总耗散118.75 W；5 V源吸收50 W，左源提供93.75 W，10 A源提供75 W，吸收功率总和0。与第332页/PDF341页1-15的12.5 V一致。
methods.en: Independent MNA of the original topology with uₛ = 12.5 V gives A = 5, M = 0 and N = 7.5 V, reproducing the target. The four resistors dissipate 118.75 W; the 5 V source absorbs 50 W, the left source supplies 93.75 W and the 10 A source supplies 75 W, yielding zero total absorbed power. This matches 12.5 V in appendix 1-15 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 串联电流源定电流：逐个判断吸收和提供
title.en: Series current source: classify every element by passive power

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-14所示，若uₛ>0，iₛ>0，R>0，请指出电路中各元件是吸收功率还是提供功率。
statement.en: In Fig. 1-14, uₛ > 0, iₛ > 0 and R > 0. State whether each element absorbs or supplies power.

alt.zh: 单回路：左电压源uₛ上正下负，顶端电阻R，右电流源iₛ向上。电流由右上向左穿过R，再从电压源正端向下流过电压源。
alt.en: One loop contains a top-positive left voltage source uₛ, upper resistor R and right current source iₛ pointing up. Current runs right to left through R, then downward into the voltage source’s positive terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 串联支路同流；电阻功率Ri²；电流流入正端为吸收；KVL。
prerequisites.en: Equal series current, resistor power Ri², passive sign convention and KVL.

recognition.zh: 电流源把全回路电流固定为iₛ>0。顺着这个实际电流画方向，可以直接看出电压源的电流进入正端；电流源承担供给两者吸收功率。
recognition.en: The current source fixes the loop current at positive iₛ. Following that actual direction shows current entering the voltage source’s positive terminal. The current source supplies the power absorbed by the other two elements.

text.zh: R>0且iₛ>0，所以电阻耗散R iₛ²>0。
text.en: R > 0 and iₛ > 0 give positive resistor dissipation R iₛ².

text.zh: 电流沿左支路向下，从uₛ正端流入，故p_Us=uₛiₛ>0。电压源不一定供电，本题明确在吸收功率。
text.en: Current goes downward in the left branch and enters the positive uₛ terminal, giving p_Us = uₛiₛ > 0. This voltage source absorbs power.

title.zh: 电流源提供两者所需功率
title.en: The current source supplies both loads

text.zh: 右源上端电位为uₛ+Riₛ，电流却由下向上，因此其吸收功率为−(uₛ+Riₛ)iₛ<0，即提供相同大小的功率。
text.en: The right source’s top potential is uₛ+Riₛ, but current rises from bottom to top. Its absorbed power is −(uₛ+Riₛ)iₛ < 0, so it supplies that magnitude.

answer.zh: 电阻R和电压源uₛ吸收功率；电流源iₛ提供功率。
answer.en: R and voltage source uₛ absorb power; current source iₛ supplies power.

pitfalls.zh: 电源元件也可以吸收功率，不能只根据名称判断。
pitfalls.en: A source element can absorb power; its name alone does not determine the power sign.

pitfalls.zh: 先跟随iₛ的向上箭头，顶端电阻电流是向左，不是向右。
pitfalls.en: Follow the upward iₛ arrow: current through the upper resistor is leftward.

methods.zh: 独立符号功率平衡Riₛ²+uₛiₛ−(uₛ+Riₛ)iₛ恒等于0。另以uₛ=3 V、iₛ=2 A、R=4 Ω搭建原拓扑MNA，电阻/电压源/电流源吸收功率分别16、6、−22 W，节点方程及功率残差精确为0。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-16一致。
methods.en: The symbolic power sum Riₛ²+uₛiₛ−(uₛ+Riₛ)iₛ is identically zero. Independent original-topology MNA with uₛ = 3 V, iₛ = 2 A and R = 4 Ω gives absorbed powers 16, 6 and −22 W for resistor, voltage source and current source, with exact zero residuals. This matches appendix 1-16 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 并联理想源的功率：电压源也会吸收
title.en: Parallel ideal sources: a voltage source can absorb power

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-15所示，试验证该电路功率守恒。
statement.en: Verify power conservation for the circuit in Fig. 1-15.

alt.zh: 三支路并联：左1 V电压源上正下负，中1 Ω电阻，右2 A电流源向上。
alt.en: Three parallel branches: a left top-positive 1 V source, central 1 Ω resistor and right 2 A source pointing up.

prerequisites.zh: 并联共电压；欧姆定律；KCL确定电压源电流；有符号功率守恒。
prerequisites.en: Common parallel voltage, Ohm’s law, KCL for voltage-source current and signed power balance.

recognition.zh: 先用1 V源确定所有支路电压，再由电阻电流和2 A注入电流求左源电流。只有把电压源的吸收功率也计入才能验证守恒。
recognition.en: Use the 1 V source to fix every branch voltage, then obtain the voltage-source current from resistor current and 2 A injection. Include the voltage source’s absorbed power in the balance.

text.zh: 电阻上下电压1 V，向下电流1/1=1 A。右源向上注入2 A，因此剩余1 A从左电压源向下流回。
text.en: The resistor has 1 V top to bottom and carries 1 A downward. The right source injects 2 A upward, so the remaining 1 A flows downward through the voltage source.

text.zh: 电阻吸收1 W；电压源电流进入正端，吸收1 W；电流源由低电位端向高电位端送2 A，吸收功率−2 W。
text.en: The resistor absorbs 1 W. Current enters the voltage source’s positive terminal, so it also absorbs 1 W. The current source sends 2 A from lower to higher potential, giving −2 W absorbed.

text.zh: 全部吸收功率之和1+1−2=0；等价于电流源提供2 W，电阻与电压源各吸收1 W。
text.en: Total absorbed power is 1+1−2 = 0. Equivalently, the current source supplies 2 W and the resistor and voltage source each absorb 1 W.

answer.zh: 电阻吸收1 W，1 V电压源吸收1 W，2 A电流源提供2 W；总吸收功率为0，功率守恒。
answer.en: The resistor absorbs 1 W, the 1 V source absorbs 1 W and the 2 A source supplies 2 W. Total absorbed power is zero.

pitfalls.zh: 不能遗漏1 V源的电流；理想电压源的电流由KCL决定。
pitfalls.en: Do not omit the 1 V source current; KCL determines it.

pitfalls.zh: 统一用吸收功率求和，提供功率应记负号。
pitfalls.en: When summing absorbed power, record supplied power with a negative sign.

methods.zh: 独立MNA解原三并联支路得到上节点1 V、电压源向下1 A；三元件功率1、1、−2 W，KCL/KVL及功率残差精确为0。附录第332页/PDF341页从1-16跳到1-18，未列1-17答案，本题据原图独立完成。
methods.en: Independent MNA of the original three parallel branches gives top potential 1 V and 1 A downward through the voltage source. Powers 1, 1 and −2 W give exact zero KCL/KVL and power residuals. The appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 skips from 1-16 to 1-18, so 1-17 has no listed answer and is independently solved from the original figure.

appendixComparison.reason: The supplied book appendix jumps from 1-16 to 1-18. No answer for 1-17 is listed; original-circuit MNA and full power balance verify the result.

title.zh: 理想源并联电阻网络：电压源功率取决于负载
title.en: Ideal sources in parallel: voltage-source power depends on load

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-16所示电路中，若电压源uₛ=10 V，电流源iₛ=1 A，试说明电压源和电流源是否一定都在提供功率。
statement.en: In Fig. 1-16, uₛ = 10 V and iₛ = 1 A. Explain whether both sources necessarily supply power.

alt.zh: 左1 A电流源向上，中10 V电压源上正下负，右侧为电阻网络；三者跨接同一上下节点。
alt.en: An upward 1 A source, a top-positive 10 V source and a resistor network are all parallel across common upper and lower nodes.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源钳定电压；电阻网络等效电阻；KCL；源的功率正负。
prerequisites.en: Ideal-source voltage clamping, equivalent network resistance, KCL and source power signs.

recognition.zh: 电压恒为10 V，因此向上的1 A源必定把电流送向高电位端，提供10 W。电压源补充还是吸收剩余电流，取决于电阻网络需求是否超过1 A。
recognition.en: Voltage is fixed at 10 V, so the upward 1 A source always drives toward the higher potential and supplies 10 W. The voltage source supplies a deficit or absorbs a surplus depending on whether the resistor network requires more or less than 1 A.

title.en: The current source always supplies 10 W

text.zh: 电流源从下端向上端流1 A，下到上电位升高10 V，所以吸收功率为−10 W，即提供10 W。
text.en: The current source carries 1 A from bottom to top across a 10 V rise, so it absorbs −10 W and supplies 10 W.

title.zh: 用等效电阻表示负载需求
title.en: Express the load demand by equivalent resistance

text.zh: 设正常工作的正电阻网络等效为R_eq>0，其向下电流I_R=10/R_eq。定义电压源向上供出电流I_V，则KCL给出I_V=10/R_eq−1。
text.en: For an admissible positive equivalent resistance R_eq, the network draws downward I_R = 10/R_eq. Define voltage-source supplied current I_V upward; KCL gives I_V = 10/R_eq−1.

steps.formula: I_R=\frac{10}{R_{\rm eq}},\qquad I_V=\frac{10}{R_{\rm eq}}-1,\qquad P_{V,\rm supplied}=10\left(\frac{10}{R_{\rm eq}}-1\right)

title.zh: 分三种负载判断电压源
title.en: Classify the voltage source in three cases

text.zh: R_eq<10 Ω时负载需超过1 A，电压源提供功率；R_eq=10 Ω时电压源电流为0；R_eq>10 Ω时1 A源供给过剩，电压源吸收功率。因此两源不一定都提供。
text.en: If R_eq < 10 Ω, the load requires more than 1 A and the voltage source supplies power. At 10 Ω its current is zero. Above 10 Ω the current source supplies a surplus and the voltage source absorbs it. Thus both sources need not supply power.

answer.zh: 电流源一定提供10 W；电压源不一定，随负载可提供、零功率或吸收功率，分界为R_eq=10 Ω。
answer.en: The current source always supplies 10 W. The voltage source may supply, exchange zero power or absorb power, with boundary R_eq = 10 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 电压源保持10 V，不意味着其电流或功率符号固定。
pitfalls.en: Fixing 10 V does not fix the voltage-source current or its power sign.

pitfalls.zh: 并联理想电压源和电流源时，剩余电流由电压源承担。
pitfalls.en: With parallel ideal voltage and current sources, the voltage source carries the remaining current.

methods.zh: 独立原拓扑MNA分别取R_eq=5、10、20 Ω，电压源提供功率分别10、0、−5 W；电流源始终提供10 W，电阻耗散20、10、5 W，三种情况功率总和均精确为0。与附录第332页/PDF341页“电流源提供功率，电压源不一定”一致。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA for R_eq = 5, 10 and 20 Ω gives voltage-source supplied powers 10, 0 and −5 W. The current source always supplies 10 W; load dissipation is 20, 10 and 5 W, with exact zero power residual in all cases. This matches the appendix statement on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 that the current source supplies power while the voltage source need not.

title.zh: 电压源钳位与平衡桥：先求总负载电流
title.en: Voltage clamp and balanced bridge: recover total load current

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-17所示电路中电流源和电压源提供的功率。
statement.en: Find the powers supplied by the current source and voltage source in Fig. 1-17.

alt.zh: 左10 A源向上，经顶端1 Ω接20 V上正下负源的上节点。该20 V节点另接5 Ω对地；右桥为10 Ω/20 Ω左臂、20 Ω/40 Ω右臂，两中点用30 Ω相连。
alt.en: An upward 10 A source feeds a top 1 Ω into the positive node of a top-positive 20 V source. That node also connects to ground through 5 Ω and a bridge: 10 Ω over 20 Ω on the left, 20 Ω over 40 Ω on the right, joined at their midpoints by 30 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源固定负载电压；平衡桥；KCL；提供功率等于负吸收功率。
prerequisites.en: Fixed load voltage, bridge balance, KCL and supplied power as negative absorbed power.

recognition.zh: 20 V源直接固定右侧负载电压。电流源的10 A全部先流过1 Ω，因而源上端比20 V节点再高10 V；右侧桥臂比例相同，30 Ω不取电流。
recognition.en: The 20 V source fixes the right load voltage. All 10 A passes through 1 Ω first, lifting the current-source top by 10 V. The bridge ratios match, so the 30 Ω branch carries zero current.

title.zh: 求电流源电压与提供功率
title.en: Find current-source voltage and supplied power

text.zh: 1 Ω电流10 A，从左向右压降10 V；源上端电位为20+10=30 V。电流从下向上，因此提供30×10=300 W。
text.en: The 1 Ω resistor carries 10 A left to right and drops 10 V. The current-source top is 20+10 = 30 V, so its upward current supplies 30×10 = 300 W.

steps.formula: V_{\rm current\ source}=20+10(1)=30\,\mathrm V,\qquad P_{I,\rm supplied}=300\,\mathrm W

title.en: Find total load current using bridge balance

text.en: Since 10/20 = 20/40, the midpoints are equipotential and the 30 Ω bridge has no current. Total load current is 20/5+20/30+20/60 = 4+2/3+1/3 = 5 A.

title.en: Use KCL for the 20 V source power

text.zh: 流入顶节点10 A，负载取5 A，剩余5 A向下流入20 V源正端。因此电压源吸收100 W，所问“提供功率”为−100 W。
text.en: 10 A enters the top node and the load takes 5 A. The remaining 5 A enters the 20 V source’s positive terminal downward. It absorbs 100 W, so its supplied power is −100 W.

answer.zh: 电流源提供300 W；电压源提供−100 W，即吸收100 W。
answer.en: The current source supplies 300 W; the voltage source supplies −100 W, meaning it absorbs 100 W.

pitfalls.zh: 提供功率可以为负，负值应解释成吸收，不应擅自改成+100 W。
pitfalls.en: Supplied power can be negative; interpret it as absorption rather than changing it to +100 W.

pitfalls.zh: 30 Ω无电流来自桥臂比例相等，需要先检查平衡条件。
pitfalls.en: The 30 Ω carries no current because the bridge ratios match; check that condition first.

methods.zh: 独立保留30 Ω桥支路的完整MNA得到桥两中点均40/3 V、源顶节点30 V、电压源向下5 A。1 Ω耗散100 W，右负载共100 W，电压源吸收100 W，恰等于电流源提供300 W；全电路功率和0。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-19的300 W、−100 W一致。
methods.en: Independent full MNA retaining the 30 Ω bridge gives both midpoints 40/3 V, current-source top 30 V and 5 A down through the voltage source. The 1 Ω resistor dissipates 100 W, the right load 100 W and voltage source absorbs 100 W, balancing the 300 W supplied by the current source. This matches 300 W and −100 W in appendix 1-19 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 短接电流源串联电阻：右侧仍注入同样电流
title.en: Bypass a resistor in series with a current source

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-18所示，试判断当开关S由打开到闭合时，电路中的电压u和电流i是否发生变化。
statement.en: In Fig. 1-18, determine whether voltage u and current i change when switch S closes.

alt.zh: 左1 A源向上，经左2 Ω到顶节点T；S并联在左2 Ω两端。中央T经2 Ω到C、再经4 Ω到底；右T经5 Ω到D、再经4 Ω到底。C、D间1 V源左正右负。u为中央上2 Ω上正下负；i为右下4 Ω向下。
alt.en: An upward left 1 A source connects through left 2 Ω to top T, with S bypassing that resistor. T connects through center 2 Ω to C, then 4 Ω to bottom; through right 5 Ω to D, then 4 Ω to bottom. A 1 V source is positive at C relative to D. u is across upper center 2 Ω, positive at T; i is downward through lower-right 4 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电流源固定注入电流；电流源串联电阻；超节点KCL；开关短接。
prerequisites.en: Fixed current injection, a resistor in series with an ideal current source, supernode KCL and a shorting switch.

recognition.zh: S只短接左源串联的2 Ω。无论开关状态，理想源向右侧网络注入的净电流仍为1 A；右侧元件和1 V约束均未改变，因此其唯一稳态解中的u、i不变。
recognition.en: S bypasses only the resistor in series with the left source. The ideal source still injects 1 A into the right network in either state. With the right elements and 1 V constraint unchanged, u and i retain the same unique steady-state values.

text.zh: 开路时1 A流经左2 Ω后到T；闭合时1 A改走开关到T，左2 Ω被短路。右侧收到的总电流始终1 A。
text.en: With S open, 1 A passes through left 2 Ω to T. With S closed, it flows through the switch and the resistor is bypassed. The right network always receives 1 A.

title.en: Use the right-side supernode for C and D

text.zh: 取底部0 V。C、D超节点向底部流出的电流之和等于注入1 A，因此(V_C+V_D)/4=1；1 V源给V_C−V_D=1。解得V_C=2.5、V_D=1.5 V。
text.en: Take the bottom as zero. The C–D supernode sends the injected 1 A to ground, so (V_C+V_D)/4 = 1, while the source gives V_C−V_D = 1. Thus V_C = 2.5 V and V_D = 1.5 V.

title.en: Compute the shared u and i as a check

text.en: KCL at T gives (V_T−2.5)/2+(V_T−1.5)/5 = 1, hence V_T = 51/14 V. Therefore u = V_T−V_C = 8/7 V and i = V_D/4 = 3/8 A in either switch state.

steps.formula: u=\frac87\,\mathrm V,\qquad i=\frac38\,\mathrm A\qquad\text{for both states}

answer.zh: u和i均不变；两种状态都为u=8/7 V≈1.143 V，i=3/8 A=0.375 A。
answer.en: Neither u nor i changes. Both states give u = 8/7 V ≈ 1.143 V and i = 3/8 A = 0.375 A.

pitfalls.zh: 闭合S短接的是左侧2 Ω，不是中央测u的2 Ω。
pitfalls.en: S bypasses the left 2 Ω, not the central 2 Ω across which u is measured.

pitfalls.zh: 右侧u、i不变，不代表电流源端电压和左电阻功率不变。
pitfalls.en: Unchanged right-side u and i do not imply unchanged current-source voltage or left-resistor power.

methods.zh: 分别以开路原节点及闭合后合并节点建立独立MNA，两次都得到T=51/14、C=5/2、D=3/2 V及u=8/7 V、i=3/8 A，全部KCL/KVL精确满足。左源端电压开路79/14 V、闭合51/14 V，相差2 V；左2 Ω耗散由2 W降为0，完整功率平衡两态均为0。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-20“不变”一致。
methods.en: Separate independent MNA models for the open topology and merged closed-switch node both give T = 51/14, C = 5/2 and D = 3/2 V, with u = 8/7 V and i = 3/8 A, exactly satisfying KCL/KVL. Current-source voltage changes from 79/14 to 51/14 V, and the bypassed resistor dissipation from 2 W to zero; full power balance holds in both states. This matches “unchanged” in appendix 1-20 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 部分电路的负电流箭头：逐节点传递到端电压
title.en: Signed boundary arrows in a partial circuit

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-19所示部分电路中A、B两点间的电压U_AB。
statement.en: Find U_AB between A and B in the partial circuit of Fig. 1-19.

alt.zh: 左上节点L经3 Ω及8 V左正右负源到A；L经5 Ω到左下D，D经2 Ω到中节点C；C经10 Ω到开端B，并经2 A源流向A。L的外引线箭头向外标−1 A；D的外引线箭头向内标−1 A。
alt.en: Upper-left L connects through 3 Ω then an 8 V left-positive source to A. L connects through 5 Ω to lower-left D; D through 2 Ω to C. C connects through 10 Ω to open terminal B and through a 2 A source toward A. L has an outward boundary reference labeled −1 A; D has an inward boundary reference labeled −1 A.

prerequisites.zh: 负参考电流的实际方向；局部KCL；开端支路电流0；电压沿路径相加。
prerequisites.en: Actual directions of negative referenced currents, local KCL, zero current at an open terminal and voltage summation along a path.

recognition.zh: 先把两个−1 A解释正确：上边界实际流入1 A，下边界实际流出1 A。A只有两条内部支路，2 A源流入A后必从顶支路返回L；B为开端，10 Ω压降为0。
recognition.en: First interpret the boundary signs: 1 A actually enters at the upper cut and leaves at the lower cut. A has two internal branches, so the 2 A entering A returns through the upper branch to L. B is open, so the 10 Ω drop is zero.

title.zh: 从A沿顶支路求相对电位
title.en: Start at A and follow the upper branch

text.zh: 顶支路实际电流A→L为2 A。令8 V源左端为S，则V_S−V_L=2×3=6 V，且V_S−V_A=8 V，得到V_A=V_L−2 V。
text.en: The upper branch carries 2 A from A to L. Calling the source’s left terminal S, V_S−V_L = 2×3 = 6 V and V_S−V_A = 8 V, so V_A = V_L−2 V.

title.en: Follow the left and lower resistors to C

text.zh: L收到上边界1 A及顶支路2 A，故5 Ω向下3 A，V_D=V_L−15 V。D再由边界流出1 A，故2 Ω从D向C流2 A，V_C=V_D−4=V_L−19 V。
text.en: L receives 1 A from the upper boundary and 2 A from the top branch, so 3 A flows down 5 Ω and V_D = V_L−15 V. At D, 1 A leaves through the boundary, leaving 2 A through 2 Ω toward C. Thus V_C = V_L−19 V.

text.zh: B没有外接通路，10 Ω中电流0，所以V_B=V_C。于是U_AB=V_A−V_B=(V_L−2)−(V_L−19)=17 V。
text.en: B has no external path, so current in 10 Ω is zero and V_B = V_C. Hence U_AB = V_A−V_B = 17 V.

answer.zh: U_AB=17 V（A比B高17 V）。
answer.en: U_AB = 17 V; A is 17 V above B.

pitfalls.zh: 两个外引线都标−1 A，但箭头相反，所以实际方向也相反。
pitfalls.en: Both boundary references are labeled −1 A, but their arrows differ, so their actual directions differ.

pitfalls.zh: B是开端，10 Ω不是“流入1 A”的支路。
pitfalls.en: B is an open terminal; the 10 Ω branch does not carry 1 A.

methods.zh: 独立把两边界流量等效为D→L的1 A转移源，仅用于核验原部分电路。精确MNA得V_L=0、V_A=−2、V_D=−15、V_C=V_B=−19 V；10 Ω电流0，U_AB=17 V。内部电阻共耗散65 W，内部2 A源和8 V源提供34+16=50 W，边界净输入15 W，恰平衡。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-21一致。
methods.en: For independent validation only, represent the two boundary flows as an equivalent 1 A transfer D→L. Exact MNA gives V_L = 0, V_A = −2, V_D = −15 and V_C = V_B = −19 V, yielding zero 10 Ω current and U_AB = 17 V. Internal resistors dissipate 65 W; the internal sources supply 34+16 = 50 W and the boundary supplies the remaining 15 W. This matches appendix 1-21 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 电流源端电压：沿两边固定电压定位端点
title.en: Current-source voltage: determine both terminal potentials

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-20所示，求3 A电流源两端的电压U。
statement.en: Find voltage U across the 3 A current source in Fig. 1-20.

alt.zh: 顶3 A源由左节点A向右节点B，U左正右负。A经1 Ω和6 V上正下负源到底节点；中1 A源由底向上流入B；右4 V源上负下正连接B与底节点。
alt.en: The top 3 A source runs from left A to right B, with U positive at A. A connects through 1 Ω and a top-positive 6 V source to bottom. A central 1 A source runs upward into B; a right 4 V source has its positive terminal at the bottom and negative at B.

prerequisites.zh: 串联电流由KCL确定；电压源正负端；电阻沿电流压降；U=V_A−V_B。
prerequisites.en: KCL for series current, source polarity, resistor drops and U = V_A−V_B.

recognition.zh: 底部设0 V，右4 V源的上端不是+4而是−4 V。左1 Ω为了给3 A源供电，实际电流向上3 A，左顶电位由6 V减去3 V得到。
recognition.en: Set the bottom to zero. The top of the right 4 V source is −4 V. The left 1 Ω supplies the 3 A source with 3 A upward, making its upper potential 6−3 = 3 V.

text.zh: 右4 V源下正上负，所以0−V_B=4 V，得V_B=−4 V。
text.en: The 4 V source is positive at the bottom, so 0−V_B = 4 V and V_B = −4 V.

text.zh: 左6 V源上端为6 V。A节点向右流出3 A，因此左1 Ω向上流入3 A；沿电流由6 V节点到A降3 V，V_A=3 V。
text.en: The 6 V source’s upper terminal is at 6 V. Since A sends 3 A rightward, the 1 Ω carries 3 A upward into A, dropping 3 V from its lower terminal to A. Thus V_A = 3 V.

text.zh: U左正右负，因此U=V_A−V_B=3−(−4)=7 V。
text.en: U is positive on the left, so U = V_A−V_B = 3−(−4) = 7 V.

answer.zh: U=7 V（3 A源左端比右端高7 V）。
answer.en: U = 7 V, with the 3 A source’s left terminal 7 V above its right.

pitfalls.zh: 右4 V源的正端在下面，不能令V_B=+4 V。
pitfalls.en: The right 4 V source is positive at the bottom; do not set V_B = +4 V.

pitfalls.zh: 左1 Ω电流向上，电位沿向上电流降低3 V。
pitfalls.en: The left 1 Ω current is upward, with a 3 V drop upward.

methods.zh: 独立完整MNA得左顶3 V、右顶−4 V、6 V源上端6 V；U=7 V。吸收功率：1 Ω为9 W、3 A源21 W、1 A源4 W、6 V源−18 W、4 V源−16 W，总和0。节点及源电压约束均精确满足。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-22的7 V一致。
methods.en: Independent full MNA gives top-left 3 V, top-right −4 V and 6 V at the left source’s upper terminal, hence U = 7 V. Absorbed powers are 9 W in 1 Ω, 21 W in the 3 A source, 4 W in the 1 A source, −18 W in the 6 V source and −16 W in the 4 V source, totaling zero. This matches 7 V in appendix 1-22 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 纯电源网络：先求电位，再补电压源电流
title.en: A source-only network: find potentials, then source currents

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-21所示，求各个电源提供的功率。
statement.en: Find the power supplied by every source in Fig. 1-21.

alt.zh: 底节点公共。左节点A由6 V电压源Uₛ₂上正下负接底；2 A源Iₛ₂由底向上流入A。右节点B由1 A源Iₛ₃从底向上流入。A、B间10 V源Uₛ₁左正右负；上3 A源Iₛ₁由B向左流入A。
alt.en: Bottom is common. A connects to bottom through top-positive 6 V source Uₛ₂ and receives upward 2 A source Iₛ₂. B receives upward 1 A source Iₛ₃. A 10 V source Uₛ₁ is positive at A relative to B; upper 3 A source Iₛ₁ runs from B to A.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源约束；KCL确定电压源电流；提供功率为−p吸收。
prerequisites.en: Ideal voltage constraints, KCL for voltage-source currents and supplied power = −absorbed power.

recognition.zh: 两只电压源先固定A=6 V、B=−4 V。三个电流源的电压随即已知；最后对A、B做KCL求两只电压源电流。必须对五个电源全部作答。
recognition.en: The voltage sources first fix A = 6 V and B = −4 V. That determines all three current-source voltages. Then apply KCL at A and B for the two voltage-source currents and report all five powers.

text.zh: 令底部0 V。Uₛ₂给V_A=6 V，Uₛ₁给V_A−V_B=10 V，因此V_B=−4 V。
text.en: Set the bottom to zero. Uₛ₂ gives V_A = 6 V, while Uₛ₁ gives V_A−V_B = 10 V, hence V_B = −4 V.

title.en: Find the three current-source supplied powers

text.zh: Iₛ₁把3 A从B送到A，电位升高10 V，提供30 W；Iₛ₂向A送2 A，提供12 W；Iₛ₃向−4 V节点B送1 A，提供−4 W，即吸收4 W。
text.en: Iₛ₁ sends 3 A from B to A through a 10 V rise and supplies 30 W. Iₛ₂ supplies 6×2 = 12 W. Iₛ₃ sends 1 A to B at −4 V, so it supplies −4 W, meaning it absorbs 4 W.

title.zh: 求电压源电流及提供功率
title.en: Find voltage-source currents and supplied powers

text.zh: B点3 A向左流出、1 A从底流入，故Uₛ₁需由A向B送2 A，从其正端流入，提供−20 W。A点共流入3+2=5 A，向B流出2 A，剩余3 A向下流过Uₛ₂正端，提供−18 W。
text.en: At B, 3 A leaves to A while 1 A enters from bottom, so Uₛ₁ sends 2 A from A to B, entering its positive terminal and supplying −20 W. At A, 5 A enters and 2 A leaves toward B, leaving 3 A downward into Uₛ₂’s positive terminal, supplying −18 W.

title.en: Check the total of all five sources

text.zh: 30+12−4−20−18=0。该网络没有电阻，提供功率总和也为0；一部分源向另一部分源传能。
text.en: 30+12−4−20−18 = 0. There are no resistors, so the total supplied power is zero; some sources transfer energy to the others.

answer.zh: 按Iₛ₁、Iₛ₂、Iₛ₃、Uₛ₁、Uₛ₂顺序，提供功率为30 W、12 W、−4 W、−20 W、−18 W。后三项负值表示吸收。
answer.en: Supplied powers for Iₛ₁, Iₛ₂, Iₛ₃, Uₛ₁ and Uₛ₂ are 30 W, 12 W, −4 W, −20 W and −18 W. Negative values mean absorption.

pitfalls.zh: Iₛ₁的3 A箭头向左，从右节点B流向左节点A。
pitfalls.en: The 3 A Iₛ₁ arrow points left, from B to A.

pitfalls.zh: 没有电阻并不意味着每个源功率为0，只要求全电路功率守恒。
pitfalls.en: Having no resistor does not make every source power zero; only the total must balance.

methods.zh: 独立五源MNA得A=6 V、B=−4 V，Uₛ₁正端流入电流2 A、Uₛ₂正端流入3 A。逐源吸收功率取负后得到所列五个提供功率；KCL/KVL及总功率残差精确为0。附录第332页/PDF341页1-23五项全部一致。
methods.en: Independent five-source MNA gives A = 6 V and B = −4 V, with 2 A entering Uₛ₁’s positive terminal and 3 A entering Uₛ₂’s. Negating each absorbed power gives the five supplied powers listed above, with exact zero KCL/KVL and power residuals. All five values match appendix 1-23 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 指定支路电流反求电压源：先分流再做KVL
title.en: Recover source voltage from a specified branch current

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-23所示，求电流I=0.5 A时的Uₛ。
statement.en: For Fig. 1-23, find Uₛ when I = 0.5 A.

alt.zh: 左2 A源向上注入顶节点；中3 Ω从顶到底。右支路顶节点经3 Ω和Uₛ上正下负电压源到底。I在右支路顶线参考向右，即沿右支路向下。
alt.en: An upward left 2 A source injects into the top node. A central 3 Ω runs to bottom. The right branch contains series 3 Ω and top-positive Uₛ to bottom. I points right along the upper-right wire, hence downward through the right branch.

prerequisites.zh: KCL分流；并联共端电压；串联电阻压降与源电压相加。
prerequisites.en: KCL current division, common parallel voltage and series resistor/source voltage addition.

recognition.zh: 右支路规定取0.5 A，左源总注入2 A，因此中间3 Ω承担其余1.5 A。先由它定顶节点电压，再减去右3 Ω的1.5 V压降。
recognition.en: The right branch takes 0.5 A from the 2 A injection, leaving 1.5 A in the central 3 Ω. Use this to determine the top voltage, then subtract the 1.5 V right-resistor drop.

title.en: Use KCL for the central current

text.zh: Iₘ+I=2 A，所以中央3 Ω向下电流为2−0.5=1.5 A。
text.en: Iₘ+I = 2 A, so the central 3 Ω current is 1.5 A downward.

title.zh: 求顶节点电压并做右支路KVL
title.en: Find top voltage and apply right-branch KVL

text.zh: 底部设0 V，顶节点电压V_T=3×1.5=4.5 V。右支路电阻压降3×0.5=1.5 V，故Uₛ=4.5−1.5=3 V。
text.en: With bottom zero, V_T = 3×1.5 = 4.5 V. The right resistor drops 3×0.5 = 1.5 V, leaving Uₛ = 4.5−1.5 = 3 V.

answer.zh: Uₛ=3 V（原图上正下负）。
answer.en: Uₛ = 3 V, positive at the top as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: I=0.5 A只指右支路，不是中间3 Ω的电流。
pitfalls.en: I = 0.5 A is the right-branch current, not the central 3 Ω current.

pitfalls.zh: 右支路电压等于电阻压降加Uₛ，不能把4.5 V直接作为Uₛ。
pitfalls.en: Right-branch voltage is the resistor drop plus Uₛ; 4.5 V is not Uₛ itself.

methods.zh: 独立原拓扑MNA恢复Uₛ=3 V，解得顶节点4.5 V、右支路电流(4.5−3)/3=0.5 A，重现条件。两电阻耗散6.75+0.75=7.5 W，电压源吸收1.5 W，2 A源提供9 W，总功率平衡。与附录第332页/PDF341页1-25的3 V一致。
methods.en: Independent MNA restoring Uₛ = 3 V yields top potential 4.5 V and right current (4.5−3)/3 = 0.5 A, reproducing the condition. The resistors dissipate 6.75+0.75 = 7.5 W, the voltage source absorbs 1.5 W and the 2 A source supplies 9 W, balancing power. This matches 3 V in appendix 1-25 on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 受控电流源反馈：负解必须保留参考方向
title.en: Controlled-current feedback: retain a negative reference result

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路题图1-25所示，求在下列条件下受控源的电流：(1) iₛ=1 A；(2) iₛ=3 A。
statement.en: For Fig. 1-25, find the dependent-source current when (1) iₛ = 1 A and (2) iₛ = 3 A.

alt.zh: 三支路并联：左独立电流源iₛ向上，中2 Ω电阻控制电流i₁向下，右受控电流源参考向上、数值4i₁。
alt.en: Three parallel branches: independent iₛ upward, central 2 Ω with control current i₁ downward, and dependent current 4i₁ upward.

prerequisites.zh: KCL；受控源关系；负值表示反参考方向；欧姆定律。
prerequisites.en: KCL, dependent-source control law, negative references and Ohm’s law.

recognition.zh: 受控源不是另一个独立已知电流。将其4i₁与电阻中的i₁一起代入同一节点KCL，先求控制量，再求受控输出。
recognition.en: The dependent source is not a separately known current. Substitute 4i₁ in the same node KCL as i₁, solve the control current first, then the output.

title.en: Write KCL using the original references

text.zh: 顶节点流入为iₛ和4i₁，流出为i₁。因此i₁=iₛ+4i₁，得到i₁=−iₛ/3。
text.en: At the top, iₛ and 4i₁ enter while i₁ leaves. Thus i₁ = iₛ+4i₁ and i₁ = −iₛ/3.

text.zh: iₛ=1 A时，受控源向上参考电流为−4/3 A；iₛ=3 A时为−4 A。两个负值都表示实际向下，不能改负号而保留原箭头。
text.en: For iₛ = 1 A, the upward-reference dependent current is −4/3 A; for iₛ = 3 A it is −4 A. Both actually flow downward.

steps.formula: (1)\ i_{\rm dep}=-\frac43\,\mathrm A;\qquad(2)\ i_{\rm dep}=-4\,\mathrm A

answer.zh: (1) −4/3 A；(2) −4 A，均按原图受控源向上参考方向，实际分别向下4/3 A、4 A。
answer.en: (1) −4/3 A; (2) −4 A in the original upward reference, actually downward with those magnitudes.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源4i₁与独立源iₛ箭头都向上，不能在KCL中给它们相反的参考符号。
pitfalls.en: Both source reference arrows point up; do not assign them opposite KCL signs.

pitfalls.zh: 先求i₁，再乘4；不能把iₛ直接当控制电流。
pitfalls.en: Solve i₁ before multiplying by 4; iₛ is not the control current.

methods.zh: 独立原拓扑MNA在2 Ω支路串入零伏电流传感器，严格按向下i₁控制向上4i₁；两条件分别得到i₁=−1/3、−1 A，输出−4/3、−4 A。令公共电压u=2i₁，电阻、独立源、受控源吸收功率分别2iₛ²/9、2iₛ²/3、−8iₛ²/9，总和0。附录第332页/PDF341页两问一致。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA uses a zero-volt sensor in the 2 Ω branch, measuring downward i₁ to control upward 4i₁. The two cases give i₁ = −1/3 and −1 A, and outputs −4/3 and −4 A. With common u = 2i₁, absorbed powers are 2iₛ²/9, 2iₛ²/3 and −8iₛ²/9, totaling zero. Both parts match the appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 受控电压源功率：先定控制电流，再定源电流
title.en: Controlled-voltage power: find control and output currents

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 电路如题图1-26所示，求：(1) 当R=2 Ω时受控源提供的功率；(2) 欲使受控源吸收4 W的功率，则电阻R应为多少？
statement.en: For Fig. 1-26, find (1) the power supplied by the dependent source when R = 2 Ω; (2) R for which it absorbs 4 W.

alt.zh: 左12 V源上正下负，顶端经R接中央4 V上正下负源，控制电流I从左经R向右；中央顶节点经1 Ω到右受控电压源上端。受控源电压2I，上正下负。所有下端共节点。
alt.en: A top-positive 12 V source connects through R to a top-positive 4 V source, with control I rightward through R. The 4 V node connects through 1 Ω to a top-positive dependent voltage source 2I; all lower terminals are common.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源定节点电位；受控电压2I；KCL确定源电流；区分提供与吸收。
prerequisites.en: Ideal-source node voltages, dependent voltage 2I, KCL for source current and supplied versus absorbed power.

recognition.zh: 12 V和4 V直接固定R两端电压8 V，先得到I=8/R。受控源端电压随后已知，但其功率还需通过右侧1 Ω求实际电流。
recognition.en: The 12 V and 4 V sources fix 8 V across R, giving I = 8/R. This fixes dependent voltage, but power also requires its current through the right 1 Ω.

title.zh: 建立受控源的电压与电流

text.zh: 控制电流I=8/R A，受控源上端V_D=2I=16/R V。定义受控源向下电流i_D，则i_D=(4−V_D)/1。
text.en: Control I = 8/R A sets V_D = 2I = 16/R V. Define dependent-source current i_D downward; then i_D = (4−V_D)/1.

text.zh: R=2 Ω时I=4 A，V_D=8 V，i_D=−4 A，即实际向上4 A。吸收功率8×(−4)=−32 W，提供功率为32 W。
text.en: At R = 2 Ω, I = 4 A, V_D = 8 V and i_D = −4 A, actually upward. Absorbed power is −32 W, so supplied power is 32 W.

text.zh: V_D(4−V_D)=4可改写为(V_D−2)²=0，只得V_D=2 V。因此16/R=2，R=8 Ω。此时i_D=2 A向下，确为吸收4 W。
text.en: V_D(4−V_D) = 4 becomes (V_D−2)² = 0, so V_D = 2 V and R = 8 Ω. Then i_D = 2 A downward, indeed absorbing 4 W.

answer.zh: (1) 受控源提供32 W；(2) R=8 Ω。
answer.en: (1) The dependent source supplies 32 W. (2) R = 8 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 右侧菱形是受控电压源，2I是电压，不是支路电流。
pitfalls.en: The diamond is a controlled voltage source: 2I is its voltage, not its current.

pitfalls.zh: 第一问求提供功率、第二问给吸收功率，两者符号相反。
pitfalls.en: Part (1) asks supplied power while part (2) specifies absorbed power; their signs are opposite.

methods.zh: 独立CCVS MNA用零伏传感器按R中向右电流控制2I电压。R=2 Ω时受控源吸收−32 W，R=8 Ω时吸收4 W；两条件下全部节点、控制约束及全电路功率和精确为0。第二问平方方程证明正电阻解唯一。附录第332页/PDF341页32 W、8 Ω均一致。
methods.en: Independent CCVS MNA uses a zero-volt sensor for rightward R current and dependent voltage 2I. It gives −32 W absorbed at R = 2 Ω and +4 W at R = 8 Ω; all node/control constraints and full power sums are exactly satisfied. The squared equation establishes uniqueness. Both 32 W and 8 Ω match the appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 受控电流源吸收功率：负值表示提供
title.en: Dependent-current absorbed power: a negative result means delivery

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-27所示电路中受控电流源吸收的功率。
statement.en: Find the power absorbed by the dependent current source in Fig. 1-27.

alt.zh: 底部共节点。左2 Ω上端A电压uₓ上正下负；右14 V源上端B为正。A、B间并联2 Ω和由A向B的受控电流源6uₓ；u₁左正右负。
alt.en: Bottom is common. Left 2 Ω has upper node A and top-positive control uₓ. A top-positive 14 V source fixes B. Between A and B are parallel 2 Ω and dependent current 6uₓ from A to B; u₁ is positive at A.

prerequisites.zh: 节点法；VCCS控制uₓ；电流流入电压正参考端时p吸收=ui；总功率。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, VCCS control uₓ, passive power p = ui and total power balance.

recognition.zh: uₓ就是A相对底部的电位。对A列KCL即可求它；然后用源左右端电压差乘以源向右电流，得到有符号吸收功率。
recognition.en: uₓ is A relative to the bottom. KCL at A determines it, then left-minus-right source voltage times rightward current gives signed absorbed power.

title.en: Apply KCL at control node A

text.zh: A向底部、向B电阻、向B受控源的流出电流相加为0。B=14 V，故uₓ/2+(uₓ−14)/2+6uₓ=0，得uₓ=1 V。
text.en: Sum currents leaving A through its ground resistor, A–B resistor and dependent source. With B = 14 V, uₓ/2+(uₓ−14)/2+6uₓ = 0, yielding uₓ = 1 V.

text.zh: 受控电流为6 A向右，左正右负电压u₁=1−14=−13 V。电流从u₁正参考端流入，所以p吸收=u₁·6=−78 W。
text.en: The source current is 6 A rightward and u₁ = 1−14 = −13 V. Current enters the positive reference terminal, so absorbed power is u₁×6 = −78 W.

steps.formula: i_D=6\,\mathrm A,\quad u_1=-13\,\mathrm V,\quad p_{D,\rm abs}=-78\,\mathrm W

answer.zh: 受控源吸收功率为−78 W，即实际提供78 W。
answer.en: The dependent source absorbs −78 W, meaning it supplies 78 W.

pitfalls.zh: u₁是A相对B，不能只用左支路uₓ=1 V作源电压。
pitfalls.en: The source voltage is A relative to B, not simply uₓ = 1 V.

pitfalls.zh: 题目问吸收功率，负答案应保留，并解释为提供。
pitfalls.en: Keep a negative absorbed-power answer and explain it as supplied power.

methods.zh: 独立VCCS原拓扑MNA得A=1 V、B=14 V、受控源6 A。两电阻共耗散0.5+84.5=85 W，14 V源吸收−7 W，受控源吸收−78 W，总和0；全部节点与控制约束精确满足。与附录第332页/PDF341页−78 W一致。
methods.en: Independent original-topology VCCS MNA gives A = 1 V, B = 14 V and source current 6 A. The resistors dissipate 0.5+84.5 = 85 W; the 14 V source absorbs −7 W and dependent source −78 W, totaling zero. All constraints are exact. This matches −78 W in the appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 同节点识别：两只6 Ω其实并联
title.en: Recognize shared nodes: the two 6 Ω resistors are parallel

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-29所示单口网络的等效电阻。
statement.en: Find the equivalent resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-29.

alt.zh: 上端口A通过上方及右侧导线直接连到右中节点。竖6 Ω与横6 Ω都跨A和左中C；C经7 Ω到底端口b；A另经右10 Ω到底端口b。
alt.en: Upper port A is directly wired around the top and right to the right-middle node. Both vertical and horizontal 6 Ω span A and left-middle C. C connects through 7 Ω to lower port b; A also connects directly through right 10 Ω to b.

prerequisites.zh: 理想导线等电位；并联端点判定；串并联等效；测试源法。
prerequisites.en: Equipotential ideal wires, endpoint-based parallel recognition, series/parallel reduction and test sources.

recognition.zh: 不要按图形位置判断串联。先把上方绕到右侧的整段导线认作同一节点，就能看出两只6 Ω并联，随后与7 Ω串联，再与10 Ω并联。
recognition.en: Do not infer series connection from placement. Trace the top/right wire as one node: the 6 Ω pair is parallel, then series with 7 Ω, and that path is parallel with 10 Ω.

text.zh: 两只6 Ω的两端分别是同一A、C节点，因此并联为3 Ω。
text.en: Both 6 Ω resistors share endpoints A and C, so their parallel equivalent is 3 Ω.

text.zh: 3 Ω与7 Ω串联为10 Ω；这条支路与右10 Ω并联，总等效5 Ω。
text.en: 3 Ω and 7 Ω form a 10 Ω series path, parallel with the right 10 Ω, giving 5 Ω.

answer.zh: R_eq=5 Ω。
answer.en: R_eq = 5 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 横6 Ω右端与顶端口通过导线直接相连，不是新节点。
pitfalls.en: The horizontal 6 Ω right terminal is directly wired to the top port; it is not a new node.

pitfalls.zh: 两只6 Ω不是串联，因为公共节点还有7 Ω分支。
pitfalls.en: The 6 Ω resistors are not series; their shared middle node also connects to 7 Ω.

methods.zh: 独立1 V测试源原拓扑MNA得C=0.7 V；两只6 Ω各流0.05 A，右10 Ω流0.1 A，总输入0.2 A，R=1/0.2=5 Ω。四电阻功率0.015+0.015+0.07+0.1=0.2 W，等于测试端输入功率。附录第332页/PDF341页为5 Ω。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA with a 1 V test gives C = 0.7 V, 0.05 A in each 6 Ω and 0.1 A in right 10 Ω. Input is 0.2 A, so R = 5 Ω. Resistor powers 0.015+0.015+0.07+0.1 = 0.2 W match port input power. The appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341 gives 5 Ω.

title.zh: 两层分流：先分主支路，再分子支路
title.en: Two-level current division: main branches, then subbranches

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-31所示电路中的电流iₓ和iᵧ。
statement.en: Find iₓ and iᵧ in Fig. 1-31.

alt.zh: 12 A源向上接顶底公共节点。左支路3 Ω串联4 Ω与12 Ω并联，iₓ在左4 Ω向下；右支路12 Ω与6 Ω并联后串联底6 Ω，iᵧ在底6 Ω向下。
alt.en: An upward 12 A source feeds common top and bottom nodes. Left branch: 3 Ω in series with parallel 4 Ω and 12 Ω, with iₓ downward in 4 Ω. Right branch: parallel 12 Ω and 6 Ω in series with lower 6 Ω, with iᵧ downward through the lower 6 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 串并联电阻；分流公式；并联共电压；两次KCL。
prerequisites.en: Series/parallel resistance, current division, common parallel voltage and two levels of KCL.

recognition.zh: 先把左右主支路化成6 Ω和10 Ω，分配总12 A。iᵧ就是右主支路电流；iₓ还需在左4 Ω与12 Ω之间再分一次。
recognition.en: First reduce the main branches to 6 Ω and 10 Ω and divide 12 A. iᵧ is the right main current; iₓ requires another split within the left 4 Ω/12 Ω pair.

text.zh: 左侧4∥12=3 Ω，与顶3 Ω串联为6 Ω；右侧12∥6=4 Ω，与底6 Ω串联为10 Ω。
text.en: Left: 4∥12 = 3 Ω plus upper 3 Ω gives 6 Ω. Right: 12∥6 = 4 Ω plus lower 6 Ω gives 10 Ω.
The left main current is 12×10/16 = 7.5 A, and iᵧ is 12×6/16 = 4.5 A.
The left 7.5 A enters parallel 4 Ω and 12 Ω, so iₓ = I_L×12/16 = 5.625 A.

answer.zh: iₓ=5.625 A，iᵧ=4.5 A，均按图向下。
answer.en: iₓ = 5.625 A and iᵧ = 4.5 A, both downward as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: 左主支路7.5 A还要分流，不能直接当iₓ。
pitfalls.en: The left main 7.5 A splits again; it is not iₓ.

pitfalls.zh: 分流与电阻成反比，4 Ω获得的电流大于12 Ω。
pitfalls.en: Current divides inversely with resistance; 4 Ω takes more than 12 Ω.

methods.zh: 独立原六电阻节点MNA得顶节点45 V、左中22.5 V、右中27 V；iₓ=22.5/4=45/8 A，iᵧ=27/6=9/2 A。总电阻耗散540 W，恰等于12 A源提供45×12=540 W。附录第332页/PDF341页两项一致。
methods.en: Independent MNA of all six original resistors gives top 45 V, left middle 22.5 V and right middle 27 V, yielding iₓ = 45/8 A and iᵧ = 9/2 A. Dissipation is 540 W, matching the source’s 45×12 = 540 W. Both values match the appendix on printed p. 332/PDF p. 341.

title.zh: 反求未知电阻：分清并联分流和串联分压
title.en: Recover unknown resistance: parallel current and series voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh:
求题图1-32所示各电路中的电阻R。
(1) 图(a)电路中i=2/3 A；(2) 图(b)电路中i=2/3 A；
(3) 图(c)电路中u=2/3 V；(4) 图(d)电路中u=2/3 V。

alt.zh: (a)3 A总电流注入2 Ω与R并联，i在R向下。(b)同样并联但总端电压3 V。(c)3 A通过串联R、2 Ω，u跨R上正下负。(d)同样串联但总电压3 V，u仍跨R。
alt.en: (a) 3 A enters parallel 2 Ω and R, with i downward in R. (b) The parallel pair has 3 V across it. (c) 3 A flows through series R and 2 Ω, with u positive at the top of R. (d) The series pair has total 3 V, again with u across R.

prerequisites.zh: KCL；并联共电压；串联同电流；欧姆定律；精确分数。
prerequisites.en: KCL, common parallel voltage, equal series current, Ohm’s law and exact fractions.

recognition.zh: 先判断每幅图给的是总电流还是总电压，测的是R支路电流还是R两端电压。四问不共享一个R，必须分别求。
recognition.en: Identify whether each panel gives total current or voltage and whether the measurement is R current or voltage. The four R values are independent.

title.en: (1): parallel pair with known total current

text.en: The 2 Ω current is 7/3 A, giving common voltage 14/3 V and R = 7 Ω.

text.zh: R直接承受3 V，电流2/3 A，因此R=3/(2/3)=4.5 Ω。
text.en: R directly has 3 V with 2/3 A, so R = 4.5 Ω.
R carries 3 A and drops 2/3 V, so R = 2/9 Ω.

title.en: (4): series pair with known total voltage

text.en: The 2 Ω drop is 7/3 V and the series current 7/6 A, giving R = 4/7 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: (a)的3 A是总电流，不能当R支路电流。
pitfalls.en: The 3 A in (a) is total current, not the R-branch current.

pitfalls.zh: (d)的u只跨R，不能把总3 V直接当u。
pitfalls.en: In (d), u is across R only, not the total 3 V.

pitfalls.zh: 先保留2/9、4/7等精确值，最后再按题目需要舍入。
pitfalls.en: Retain exact fractions such as 2/9 and 4/7 until final rounding.

methods.zh: 四个原拓扑分别恢复所得R，并用3 A测试注入或3 V源独立MNA：两并联问的R电流均严格2/3 A，两串联问的R压降均严格2/3 V；每问全部元件功率相加精确为0。附录第333页/PDF342页为7、4.5、0.22、0.57 Ω，后两值是精确分数的舍入。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA restores each R using either 3 A injection or a 3 V source. Both parallel R currents are exactly 2/3 A; both series R drops are exactly 2/3 V, and full power balances vanish. The appendix on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 gives 7, 4.5, 0.22 and 0.57 Ω, with the latter two rounded from the exact fractions.

appendixComparison.reason: Appendix 0.22 and 0.57 ohm round exact values 2/9 and 4/7 ohm.

title.zh: 非直接串并联网络：用Δ-Y化简并以测试源复核
title.en: A non-series-parallel network: Δ-Y and a test-source audit

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-33所示电路ab端口的等效电阻。
statement.en: Find the equivalent resistance at port ab of Fig. 1-33.

alt.zh: 上顶点A为端口a，内中心C为端口b，外左L、外右D。六电阻：A-L为2 Ω，A-C为2 Ω，A-D为4 Ω，L-C为2 Ω，D-C为2 Ω，L-D为4 Ω。从C向右的b引线与A-D斜边交叉处没有连接点。
alt.en: Top A is port a and center C port b; outer vertices are L and D. Resistors: A-L 2 Ω, A-C 2 Ω, A-D 4 Ω, L-C 2 Ω, D-C 2 Ω and L-D 4 Ω. The b lead crossing the A-D diagonal has no junction dot.
