prerequisites.zh: 按节点识别连接；Δ-Y变换；串并联；端口1 V测试源与节点法。
prerequisites.en: Node-based connectivity, Δ-Y transformation, series/parallel reduction and a 1 V port test.

recognition.zh: 不能按图中交叉线虚构连接点。外圈是2、4、4 Ω三角形，转成星形后可直接串并联；最后用完整六电阻节点法独立核验。
recognition.en: Do not create a node at an unmarked crossing. Transform the outer 2–4–4 Ω triangle into a star, reduce the result, then independently check the original six-resistor graph.

title.en: Transform the outer triangle to a star

text.zh: 外三角形边A-L=2、A-D=4、L-D=4 Ω，总和10 Ω。新增星点O，三臂分别A-O=0.8、L-O=0.8、D-O=1.6 Ω。
text.en: The outer triangle has edges 2, 4 and 4 Ω, totaling 10 Ω. With star center O, its A, L and D arms are 0.8, 0.8 and 1.6 Ω.
O-L-b is 14/5 Ω and O-D-b is 18/5 Ω. In parallel they give 63/40 Ω; adding A-O = 4/5 Ω yields an A-to-b path of 19/8 Ω.

title.en: Combine with the direct 2 Ω branch

text.zh: 原有A-C的2 Ω仍在，最终与19/8 Ω并联。
text.en: The original A-C 2 Ω remains and is parallel with 19/8 Ω.

answer.en: R_ab = 38/35 Ω ≈ 1.085714 Ω, or 1.1 Ω to one decimal place.

pitfalls.zh: b引线跨过外斜边但没有连接点，不可将外右4 Ω短接。
pitfalls.en: The b lead crosses an outer edge without a junction; do not short the outer 4 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 原图不是直接串并联网络，两个相邻2 Ω不能不看分支就相加。
pitfalls.en: The original graph is not directly series-parallel; adjacent 2 Ω resistors cannot be combined without checking branches.

methods.zh: 独立在原六电阻网络a-b加1 V，以b=0。精确节点法得V_L=9/19、V_D=7/19 V，端口电流35/38 A，R=38/35 Ω，与Δ-Y结果完全相同；全部电阻功率之和等于35/38 W端口输入。附录第333页/PDF342页的1.1 Ω为一位小数舍入。
methods.en: An independent 1 V test on the original six-resistor network with b = 0 gives V_L = 9/19 and V_D = 7/19 V by exact nodal analysis. Port current is 35/38 A, giving R = 38/35 Ω, exactly matching Δ-Y. Total dissipation equals port input 35/38 W. The appendix’s 1.1 Ω on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is rounded to one decimal place.

appendixComparison.reason: Exact 38/35 ohm = 1.085714... ohm rounds to appendix 1.1 ohm.

title.zh: 桥接电阻网络：先求输入电阻再求源电流
title.en: A bridged resistor network: recover its input resistance

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-34所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Find current i in Fig. 1-34.

alt.zh: 10 V源上正下负，顶端经2 Ω到T，i向右。T经1 Ω到C、C经4 Ω到底左地节点；T经右4 Ω到D、D经底4 Ω到地；C、D间有8 Ω。
alt.en: A top-positive 10 V source connects through top 2 Ω to T, with i rightward. T connects through 1 Ω to C and C through 4 Ω to ground; T through right 4 Ω to D and D through bottom 4 Ω to ground; C and D are joined by 8 Ω.

prerequisites.zh: 桥接网络节点法；同节点判定；输入电阻测试；串联总电阻。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis of a bridge, shared-node identification, input-resistance tests and series total resistance.

recognition.zh: 中间4 Ω与8 Ω的下端不是同一节点，不能直接并联。先把顶端2 Ω以右的桥网络作为一端口，用任意端电压v求其输入电流，再得到等效3 Ω。
recognition.en: The lower ends of the central 4 Ω and 8 Ω are different nodes, so they are not parallel. Apply arbitrary voltage v to the network after the top 2 Ω and find its input current; its equivalent is 3 Ω.

text.en: Set T to v and bottom to zero. KCL at C and D yields the two equations shown.

text.zh: 解得V_C=7v/9、V_D=5v/9。输入电流为(v−V_C)/1+(v−V_D)/4=v/3，因此桥网络等效3 Ω。
text.en: Solving gives V_C = 7v/9 and V_D = 5v/9. Input current is (v−V_C)/1+(v−V_D)/4 = v/3, so the bridge equivalent is 3 Ω.

title.en: Include the top 2 Ω to obtain i

text.zh: 10 V源看到2+3=5 Ω，因此i=10/5=2 A，按图向右。
text.en: The 10 V source sees 2+3 = 5 Ω, so i = 2 A rightward.

answer.zh: i=2 A，按原图向右。
answer.en: i = 2 A, rightward as drawn.

pitfalls.zh: 不能将中央4 Ω和8 Ω直接并联，它们底端之间还有4 Ω。
pitfalls.en: The central 4 Ω and 8 Ω are not parallel; a 4 Ω separates their lower nodes.

pitfalls.zh: 该桥的1/4和4/4不成比例，不能擅自令8 Ω无电流。
pitfalls.en: Bridge ratios 1/4 and 4/4 do not match; do not assume zero current in 8 Ω.

methods.zh: 独立原六电阻MNA恢复10 V源，解得T=6 V、C=14/3 V、D=10/3 V，顶2 Ω电流2 A；8 Ω电流1/6 A，确非0。源提供20 W，六电阻总耗散20 W，全部节点残差精确为0。与附录第333页/PDF342页2 A一致。
methods.en: Independent MNA of all six original resistors with 10 V gives T = 6 V, C = 14/3 V and D = 10/3 V, hence 2 A through the top resistor. The 8 Ω current is 1/6 A, not zero. The source supplies 20 W and all resistors dissipate 20 W, with exact nodal residuals. This matches 2 A in the appendix on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342.

title.zh: 电流源功率：不能漏掉串联电阻的端电压
title.en: Current-source power: include its series resistor drop

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-35所示电路中电流源提供的功率。
statement.en: Find the power supplied by the current source in Fig. 1-35.

alt.zh: 左支路上2 Ω、下2 Ω，中点L；右内支路上1 Ω、下1 Ω，中点M；外右1 Ω跨顶T与底0。中横支路5 A源由L向右到X，再经2 Ω到M。
alt.en: Left vertical branch has 2 Ω above and below midpoint L; inner-right branch has 1 Ω above and below M; outer-right 1 Ω spans top T and bottom 0. The middle branch has a 5 A source from L to X, then 2 Ω from X to M.

prerequisites.zh: 节点法；电流源串联支路电流固定；源端电压；提供功率为−p吸收。
prerequisites.en: Nodal analysis, fixed current in a current-source series branch, source terminal voltage and supplied power = −absorbed power.

recognition.zh: 5 A经中间2 Ω流向M，其源右端X比M高10 V。要计算电流源功率，必须求L与X之间电压，不能仅用L与M之间电压。
recognition.en: The 5 A through middle 2 Ω makes source terminal X 10 V above M. Source power needs the L-to-X voltage, not just L-to-M.

title.en: Find the three main node potentials

text.zh: 底部设0。L点KCL给2V_L−V_T=−10；M点给2V_M−V_T=5；T点给5V_T−V_L−2V_M=0。解得V_T=0、V_L=−5、V_M=2.5 V。
text.en: With bottom zero, KCL gives 2V_L−V_T = −10, 2V_M−V_T = 5 and 5V_T−V_L−2V_M = 0. Thus V_T = 0, V_L = −5 and V_M = 2.5 V.

text.zh: 中间2 Ω流过5 A，X到M降10 V，因此V_X=2.5+10=12.5 V。
text.en: Middle 2 Ω carries 5 A and drops 10 V from X to M, so V_X = 12.5 V.

text.zh: 源电流从L向X，沿电流电位升高12.5−(−5)=17.5 V。吸收功率(V_L−V_X)×5=−87.5 W，提供87.5 W。
text.en: Current runs from L to X through a 17.5 V rise. Absorbed power is (V_L−V_X)×5 = −87.5 W, so supplied power is 87.5 W.

answer.zh: 5 A电流源提供87.5 W。
answer.en: The 5 A current source supplies 87.5 W.

pitfalls.zh: 中间2 Ω与电流源串联，源端X和右中M不是同一节点。
pitfalls.en: Source terminal X and right-middle M are separated by the series 2 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: V_T=0是解方程的结果，不是顶底导线直接短接。
pitfalls.en: V_T = 0 is a solved result, not a physical short between top and bottom.

methods.zh: 独立保留源与中间2 Ω之间节点X的完整MNA，得到T=0、L=−5、M=2.5、X=12.5 V。六电阻耗散分别12.5、12.5、6.25、6.25、0、50 W，总87.5 W；电流源吸收−87.5 W，功率和0。与附录第333页/PDF342页87.5 W一致。
methods.en: Independent full MNA retains X between source and series resistor and gives T = 0, L = −5, M = 2.5 and X = 12.5 V. Resistor powers 12.5, 12.5, 6.25, 6.25, 0 and 50 W total 87.5 W; source absorption is −87.5 W, balancing power. This matches 87.5 W in the appendix on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342.

title.zh: 无限梯形电路：自相似方程与正根
title.en: Infinite ladder: self-similarity and the positive root

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-36所示电路为具有无限多级的梯形电路，求输入端a、b之间的等效电阻R_ab。
statement.en: Fig. 1-36 is an infinite ladder. Find the equivalent resistance R_ab between input a and b.

alt.zh: 从a先串联R到c，c经竖R到底导线b；c向右又串联R并在下一节点经R到底，逐级无限重复。底部为公共返回线，所有电阻均为正值R。
alt.en: From a, series R leads to c, where shunt R connects to common bottom b. The series-R/shunt-R pattern repeats infinitely to the right. All resistors have positive value R.

prerequisites.zh: 串并联；无限网络自相似；二次方程；无源网络电阻非负；有限截断收敛。
prerequisites.en: Series/parallel reduction, infinite self-similarity, a quadratic, passive nonnegative resistance and convergence of finite truncations.

recognition.zh: 从第一段串联R后看，当前竖R与右侧剩余无限梯形并联；右侧剩余网络与整个输入网络同形。令整体为x，即可建立一个标量方程。
recognition.en: After the first series R, the local shunt R is parallel with an unchanged copy of the remaining infinite ladder. Calling the full resistance x gives one scalar equation.

text.zh: 整个输入等效x等于第一只串联R，加上当前竖R与同形剩余网络x的并联。
text.en: The full x equals the first series R plus the parallel combination of the local shunt R and remaining copy x.

text.zh: 整理为x²−Rx−R²=0，得到x=[(1±√5)/2]R。
text.en: Rearrangement gives x²−Rx−R² = 0, with roots [(1±√5)/2]R.

text.zh: 所有电阻为正，等效电阻必须为正，所以舍弃负根，R_ab=(1+√5)R/2≈1.618034R。
text.en: Every resistor is positive, so the equivalent must be positive. Reject the negative root and retain R_ab = (1+√5)R/2.

answer.en: R_ab = (1+√5)R/2 ≈ 1.618034R, or 1.62R to two decimals.

pitfalls.zh: 自相似剩余网络已含它自己的第一只串联R，不要重复加一只。
pitfalls.en: The remaining copy already includes its own first series R; do not count it twice.

pitfalls.zh: 二次方程的负根不适用于全正电阻无源网络。
pitfalls.en: The negative root cannot represent this all-positive passive network.

methods.zh: 独立搭建20级原梯形网络并加1 V测试源，以有理数MNA求其输入电阻；同时从末端短路/开路截断生成精确下界/上界。上界与20级MNA完全一致，界宽约1.55×10⁻¹⁶R，夹住(1+√5)R/2；有限网络各节点及功率残差精确为0。附录第333页/PDF342页1.62R为两位小数舍入。
methods.en: An independently stamped 20-stage ladder with a 1 V test is solved by exact rational MNA. Short/open terminal truncations provide exact lower/upper bounds. The upper bound exactly matches the finite MNA result; the gap is about 1.55×10⁻¹⁶R and encloses (1+√5)R/2. All finite-network node and power residuals vanish. The appendix’s 1.62R on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is rounded to two decimals.

appendixComparison.reason: Exact golden-ratio coefficient 1.618033... rounds to appendix 1.62.

title.zh: 含受控源的输入电阻：允许负值并保留受控源
title.en: Input resistance with a dependent source: negative is possible

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-37所示单口网络的输入电阻。
statement.en: Find the input resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-37.

alt.zh: 端口电压u上正下负，输入电流i从上端向右流入节点A。A经5 Ω到底，并经顶3 Ω到右节点B；右受控电流源2u从底向上流入B。
alt.en: Port u is positive at the top and i enters rightward into A. A connects through 5 Ω to bottom and through top 3 Ω to B. A dependent current source 2u runs upward from bottom into B.

prerequisites.zh: 受控源不置零；测试源求u/i；节点KCL；负输入电阻的有源意义。
prerequisites.en: Keep dependent sources active, use a test source for u/i, nodal KCL and the active meaning of negative input resistance.

recognition.zh: 用端口电压u控制原受控源，求输入电流i。受控源能够向端口供能，所以输入电阻不必为正；负值应由方程与功率共同确认。
recognition.en: Use port voltage u to control the original source and solve input i. A dependent source can deliver energy at the port, so input resistance need not be positive; confirm a negative result by equations and power.

text.zh: 受控源向B注入2u，全部经3 Ω流向A。因此(V_B−u)/3=2u，得V_B=7u。
text.en: The source injects 2u into B, all returning through 3 Ω to A. Thus (V_B−u)/3 = 2u and V_B = 7u.

text.zh: A流向5 Ω的电流u/5，加上A流向B电流(u−7u)/3，得到i=−9u/5。
text.en: Add current u/5 from A to ground and (u−7u)/3 from A to B to obtain i = −9u/5.

title.zh: 求输入电阻并解释符号
title.en: Find input resistance and interpret the sign

text.zh: 按流入端口正端的参考方向，R_in=u/i=−5/9 Ω。u>0时i<0，网络向外送电，符合有源受控网络的行为。
text.en: With current referenced into the positive port, R_in = u/i = −5/9 Ω. For u > 0, i < 0, so the network delivers power outward, as an active controlled network can.

pitfalls.zh: 求输入电阻时保留受控源及u控制关系，不能把它开路。
pitfalls.en: Keep the dependent source and its u control active; do not open it.

pitfalls.zh: 无源电阻仍耗能，负输入电阻的能量来自受控源。
pitfalls.en: The ordinary resistors still dissipate energy; the dependent source supplies the negative port resistance’s energy.

methods.zh: 独立1 V端口测试原VCCS MNA得A=1、B=7 V，输入i=−1.8 A，R=−5/9 Ω。5 Ω和3 Ω共耗散12.2 W，受控源提供14 W，余1.8 W由网络送入测试电压源，全部功率和0。与附录第333页/PDF342页−5/9 Ω一致。
methods.en: Independent original-VCCS MNA with a 1 V port test gives A = 1 V, B = 7 V and i = −1.8 A, hence R = −5/9 Ω. The resistors dissipate 12.2 W and dependent source supplies 14 W, leaving 1.8 W delivered to the test voltage source. All powers balance. This matches −5/9 Ω in the appendix on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342.

title.zh: 受输入电流控制的源：先做节点KCL再求端电压
title.en: A source controlled by input current: KCL before port voltage

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 求题图1-38所示单口网络的输入电阻。
statement.en: Find the input resistance of the one-port network in Fig. 1-38.

alt.zh: 输入电流i由上端向右，经8 Ω到节点B。B经3 Ω到底，另有受控电流源3i由B向下到底。端口电压u上正下负。
alt.en: Input i enters rightward through 8 Ω to B. B connects through 3 Ω to bottom and through dependent current 3i directed downward. Port u is top-positive.

prerequisites.zh: 受控源关系；KCL分流；输入串联压降；测试源法。
prerequisites.en: Dependent-current law, KCL current splitting, input series drop and test sources.

recognition.zh: 8 Ω流过的就是控制电流i，但3 Ω不流i：受控源向下取3i，迫使3 Ω的参考向下电流为−2i。求出B电位后再加8 Ω压降。
recognition.en: The 8 Ω current is the control i, but the 3 Ω current is not i. The dependent source takes 3i downward, forcing the 3 Ω downward-reference current to −2i. Find B, then add the 8 Ω drop.

title.en: Use B-node KCL for the 3 Ω current

text.zh: 节点B流入i，流出i₃及3i，所以i₃=i−3i=−2i，V_B=3i₃=−6i。
text.en: At B, i enters and i₃ plus 3i leave, so i₃ = −2i and V_B = 3i₃ = −6i.

text.zh: 从端口到B经8 Ω压降8i，因此u=8i+V_B=2i。
text.en: The 8 Ω drops 8i from port to B, so u = 8i+V_B = 2i.

answer.zh: R_in=2 Ω。
answer.en: R_in = 2 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 8 Ω与3 Ω不串联，因为它们之间节点还有受控源支路。
pitfalls.en: 8 Ω and 3 Ω are not series; their junction also connects the dependent source.

pitfalls.zh: 控制量是流入端口的i，不能误用3 Ω中的−2i去控制3i源。
pitfalls.en: The control is input i, not the −2i current in 3 Ω.

methods.zh: 独立在输入支路放零伏电流传感器，按流入端口方向控制向下3i，并施加1 V测试源。精确MNA得i=0.5 A、B=−3 V、受控源1.5 A向下，故R=2 Ω。电阻共耗散5 W，受控源提供4.5 W，端口输入0.5 W，功率平衡。附录第333页/PDF342页为2 Ω。
methods.en: Independent MNA inserts a zero-volt input-current sensor with the original inward reference to control downward 3i, then applies 1 V. It gives i = 0.5 A, B = −3 V and dependent current 1.5 A downward, hence R = 2 Ω. Resistors dissipate 5 W, the controlled source supplies 4.5 W and the port supplies 0.5 W, balancing power. The appendix on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 gives 2 Ω.

title.zh: 端口电压：沿源极性相加，优先识别直接并联
title.en: Port voltage: source polarities and direct parallel constraints

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 写出题图1-39所示各电路的端口电压u与各独立电源参数的关系。
statement.en: Express port voltage u in terms of the independent source parameters for each circuit in Fig. 1-39.

alt.zh: (a)上u₁源上正下负，下u₂源上负下正，两源串联；端口u上正下负。(b)u₁直接跨端口，上正下负；左u₂也上正下负，其上端经向左i₁源接端口上端。
alt.en: (a) Series voltage sources: u₁ top-positive, u₂ bottom-positive; port u top-positive. (b) u₁ is directly across the port with the same polarity. Left u₂ is top-positive and its upper node connects through leftward i₁ to the upper port.

prerequisites.zh: 电压源端电压约束；串联电压代数和；并联同压；不以书后答案覆盖原图。
prerequisites.en: Ideal voltage constraints, signed series sums, equal parallel voltage and checking the original figure.

recognition.zh: (a)按端口从下到上累加电压升降。(b)先看直接并联端口的理想电压源，它固定u，左侧支路只影响内部电流。
recognition.en: For (a), sum voltage rises from lower to upper port. For (b), the ideal source directly across the port fixes u; the left branch affects internal currents.

text.zh: 从下端向上先经过u₂的正端到负端，电位降低u₂；再经过u₁的负端到正端，升高u₁，因此u=u₁−u₂。
text.en: Moving upward crosses u₂ from positive to negative, then u₁ from negative to positive, giving u = u₁−u₂.

text.zh: 端口u和u₁源都上正下负，且端点由导线直接相连，所以u=u₁，与u₂、i₁无关。
text.en: Port u and source u₁ share both nodes and are both top-positive, so u = u₁, independent of u₂ and i₁.

text.zh: 附录第333页把(b)印成−u₁，但原图端口与u₁的极性相同，没有反向；该负号不应照抄。
text.en: The appendix prints −u₁ for (b), but the original port and u₁ have identical polarity. That minus sign conflicts with the diagram.

answer.zh: (a) u=u₁−u₂；(b) u=u₁。附录(b)的负号错误。
answer.en: (a) u = u₁−u₂; (b) u = u₁. The appendix’s minus sign in (b) is incorrect.

pitfalls.zh: 串联源要按正负端相加，不能把两个源幅值一律相加。
pitfalls.en: Sum series sources by their polarities, not magnitudes alone.

pitfalls.zh: 并联源与端口同极性时直接相等，不会因另一支路电流方向改变符号。
pitfalls.en: A same-polarity parallel source equals the port voltage regardless of another branch’s current direction.

methods.zh: 独立原图MNA在3组有正有负的源参数、每组3个负载下核验两图，分别恒得u₁−u₂及u₁，全部节点及功率残差为0。(b)取u₁=7 V时端口为+7 V，直接反证附录−7 V。原图PDF45与附录PDF342高分辨率证据均保留。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA uses three source-parameter sets, including negative values, and three loads per set. The two results remain u₁−u₂ and u₁ with zero node and power residuals. In (b), u₁ = 7 V gives +7 V at the port, directly contradicting −7 V. High-resolution original PDF45 and appendix PDF342 evidence is retained.

appendixComparison.reason: Port and directly parallel u1 have identical top-positive polarity.

title.zh: 端口电流：对整个两端网络列KCL
title.en: Port current: apply KCL to the whole two-terminal network

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 写出题图1-40所示各电路的端口电流i与各独立电源参数的关系。
statement.en: Express port current i in terms of the independent source parameters for each circuit in Fig. 1-40.

alt.zh: (a)左i₂向上并联u₁电压源，内部下节点经向右i₁源接下端口；上端口电流i向右流出。(b)并联i₁向上、i₂向下，端口i从上端向右流出。
alt.en: (a) Upward i₂ is parallel with u₁. The lower internal node connects through rightward i₁ to the lower port; upper-port i is outward. (b) Parallel i₁ upward and i₂ downward feed outward upper-port i.

prerequisites.zh: 两端口边界KCL；参考方向；电流源串并联约束。
prerequisites.en: Boundary KCL, reference directions and ideal current-source constraints.

recognition.zh: (a)上下端的外流参考箭头同为从内部流向外部，故代数和为0。(b)按上节点净注入相减。
recognition.en: In (a), both terminal reference arrows point outward from the internal network, so their sum is zero. In (b), subtract the downward source from the upward injection.

text.zh: 上端流出i，下端流出i₁，整个两端网络不积累净电荷，故i+i₁=0。内部u₁、i₂只调整内部支路量。
text.en: Upper current i and lower current i₁ both leave, so i+i₁ = 0. Internal u₁ and i₂ only affect internal branch quantities.

text.zh: i₁从下流入顶节点，i₂向下流出，剩余经端口流出的电流i=i₁−i₂。
text.en: i₁ enters the upper node and i₂ leaves downward; the remaining outward port current is i₁−i₂.

answer.zh: (a) i=−i₁；(b) i=i₁−i₂。
answer.en: (a) i = −i₁; (b) i = i₁−i₂.

pitfalls.zh: (a)的i₁箭头朝下端口外侧，不是从负端流入网络。
pitfalls.en: In (a), i₁ points outward toward the lower port, not inward.

pitfalls.zh: 端口电流参考方向是向外，不能改成向内后仍保留原答案。
pitfalls.en: The port-current reference is outward; reversing it reverses the answer.

methods.zh: 独立原图MNA用3组源参数及3个有限负载，得到i=−i₁和i=i₁−i₂，全部原电源、负载功率总和为0。与附录第333页/PDF342页两问一致。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA with three parameter sets and three finite loads reproduces i = −i₁ and i = i₁−i₂, with all original source/load powers balancing. Both parts match printed p. 333/PDF p. 342.

title.zh: 理想源网络最简化：保留端口约束
title.en: Simplify ideal-source networks by preserving the port law

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 将题图1-41所示各电路化为最简形式。
statement.en: Reduce each circuit in Fig. 1-41 to its simplest form.

alt.zh: (a)u₁上正下负直接跨端口，另一支路u₂串联向右i₁。(b)u₁并联向上i₂，底部向右i₁源串接负端口。(c)i₁向上与i₂向下并联，负端口串接u₁左负右正。(d)u₁上正下负，顶u₂左正右负，端口另并联向下i₁。
alt.en: (a) u₁ directly spans the port; another branch has u₂ and rightward i₁. (b) u₁ is parallel with upward i₂, and rightward i₁ is series with the lower port. (c) Upward i₁ and downward i₂ are parallel, with bottom-positive-port series u₁. (d) Series u₁ top-positive and u₂ left-positive set the port, with downward i₁ parallel.

prerequisites.zh: 理想电压源固定端电压；理想电流源固定端电流；源串并联端口等效；参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Ideal voltage/current constraints, source equivalence and port references.

recognition.zh: 判断端口最后受固定电压还是固定电流约束，保留该约束即可。内部源的电流或电压不必保持，但端口u、i关系必须对任何允许负载相同。
recognition.en: Identify whether the port is fixed by a voltage or current law and retain that law. Internal quantities can change, but the port u–i relation must hold for any admissible load.

text.zh: u₁直接跨端口，故最简为上正下负电压源u₁。
text.en: u₁ directly spans the port, so the equivalent is a top-positive ideal voltage source u₁.

title.zh: (b) 串联电流源决定端口流量
title.en: (b): a series current source fixes terminal flow

text.zh: 底部i₁向右流出网络，上端流出i=−i₁。可画向下i₁的电流源；等价于向上参考值−i₁。
text.en: Bottom i₁ leaves rightward, so upper outward current is −i₁. Draw a downward i₁ source, equivalently an upward-reference −i₁ source.

text.zh: 上节点净注入i₁−i₂，底部串联电压源不改变端口电流。最简为从下端向上端的电流源i₁−i₂。
text.en: Net upper injection is i₁−i₂; the series lower voltage source does not alter port current. The equivalent current source is i₁−i₂ upward.

text.zh: 端口上节点电位为u₁−u₂，向下并联电流源只改变内部源电流。最简为上正下负电压源u₁−u₂。
text.en: The upper-port potential is u₁−u₂. The parallel current source changes only internal source currents, so use a top-positive voltage source u₁−u₂.

answer.zh: (a) 电压源u₁；(b) 向下电流源i₁（或向上−i₁）；(c) 向上电流源i₁−i₂；(d) 上正下负电压源u₁−u₂。图示保留原端口方向。
answer.en: (a) Voltage source u₁; (b) downward current source i₁, or upward −i₁; (c) upward current source i₁−i₂; (d) top-positive voltage source u₁−u₂. See equivalent diagrams with original port references.

pitfalls.zh: 最简等效保证端口关系，不保证每个内部源功率相同。
pitfalls.en: A simplest equivalent preserves port behavior, not every original source’s power.

pitfalls.zh: (b)若画向上的源，应标−i₁；若画向下，应标i₁。
pitfalls.en: In (b), label an upward source −i₁ or a downward source i₁.

methods.zh: 独立对四个原拓扑各取3组参数、3个负载，36个原电路MNA均符合相应最简端口律，全部原源与负载功率和为0。四结果与附录第333页/PDF342页一致；另绘原生SVG最简电路，标出极性与源箭头。
methods.en: Independent original-topology MNA checks four circuits with three parameter sets and three loads each. All 36 match the simplest port laws and have zero full power residuals. All four agree with printed p. 333/PDF p. 342. Native SVG equivalents show polarities and current arrows.

alt.zh: 四图最简等效：(a)u₁电压源上正下负；(b)i₁电流源向下，端口外流为−i₁；(c)i₁−i₂电流源向上；(d)u₁−u₂电压源上正下负。
alt.en: Four equivalents: (a) top-positive voltage u₁; (b) current i₁ downward, outward port current −i₁; (c) current i₁−i₂ upward; (d) top-positive voltage u₁−u₂.

title.zh: 画最简戴维南电路：开路电压与去源电阻
title.en: Draw the simplest Thevenin forms: open voltage and resistance

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 画出题图1-42所示各电路的最简形式。
statement.en: Draw the simplest forms of the circuits in Fig. 1-42.

alt.zh: (a)a经5 V左正右负源到C，C经2 Ω到b且有2 A由b向上注入C。(b)a经1 Ω到10 V源上负下正的上端C，1 A从b向上注入a。(c)8 V上正下负源经4 Ω到C，C经4 Ω到b、经3 Ω到a，a经5 Ω到b。
alt.en: (a) a connects through left-positive 5 V to C, with 2 Ω C-to-b and 2 A upward b-to-C. (b) a connects through 1 Ω to C at the negative top of a 10 V source; 1 A enters a from b. (c) A top-positive 8 V source feeds 4 Ω to C; C has 4 Ω to b and 3 Ω to a; a has internal 5 Ω to b.

prerequisites.zh: 戴维南等效；开路电压；独立电压源短路、电流源开路求电阻；端口外流电流。
prerequisites.en: Thevenin equivalence, open-circuit voltage, source deactivation and outward port current.

recognition.zh: 分别求a对b的开路电压V_th与去源后的R_th，再画理想电压源串联电阻。(c)的5 Ω属于网络内部，开路外端口时不能删掉。
recognition.en: Find V_th from a to b and R_th after deactivation, then draw a series voltage source and resistor. In (c), the 5 Ω is internal and remains when the external port is open.

text.zh: 2 A并联2 Ω给C对b开路4 V，再加a对C的5 V，V_th=9 V。去源后5 V短路、2 A开路，只剩2 Ω。
text.en: The 2 A/2 Ω Norton part gives C-to-b open voltage 4 V. Adding 5 V from C to a gives V_th = 9 V. Deactivation leaves 2 Ω.

text.zh: C对b为−10 V。开路时1 A经1 Ω从a流向C，a比C高1 V，所以V_th=−9 V，去源后R_th=1 Ω。图中用9 V源下正上负表示。
text.en: C is −10 V relative to b. With the port open, 1 A runs from a through 1 Ω to C, so a is 1 V higher: V_th = −9 V and R_th = 1 Ω. The diagram uses a 9 V source positive at the bottom.

title.zh: (c) 先简化左半，再保留内部5 Ω
title.en: (c): reduce the left part and retain internal 5 Ω

text.zh: 左8 V与两个4 Ω对C-b等效为4 V串联2 Ω，再串3 Ω得到4 V串5 Ω。它与内部5 Ω连接，开路a-b电压分为2 V；去源后两条5 Ω并联，R_th=2.5 Ω。
text.en: The left 8 V/two-4 Ω part is 4 V in series with 2 Ω at C-b. Adding 3 Ω gives 4 V with series 5 Ω. Internal 5 Ω halves the open output to 2 V; after deactivation two 5 Ω paths are parallel, giving 2.5 Ω.

title.en: Write the port laws and draw

text.zh: 定义i_out从a向负载流出，三图依次满足u=9−2i_out、u=−9−i_out、u=2−2.5i_out。最简图中源极性与这些符号保持一致。
text.en: With i_out leaving a, the three laws are u = 9−2i_out, u = −9−i_out and u = 2−2.5i_out. Source polarities in the simplest diagrams preserve these signs.

answer.zh: (a) 9 V上正下负源串2 Ω；(b) 9 V下正上负源串1 Ω；(c) 2 V上正下负源串2.5 Ω。
answer.en: (a) Top-positive 9 V in series with 2 Ω; (b) bottom-positive 9 V in series with 1 Ω; (c) top-positive 2 V in series with 2.5 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 端口外部开路不等于删除网络内部5 Ω。
pitfalls.en: Opening the external port does not remove internal 5 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: (b)开路电压是−9 V，不能只因源标10 V就写正值。
pitfalls.en: The open voltage in (b) is −9 V; preserve source polarity.

methods.zh: 独立保留每图所有原元件，分别检查开路及2、5、10 Ω负载，12个MNA结果严格满足对应戴维南端口律。再独立去源加1 V测试，得到2、1、5/2 Ω；所有原电路功率和为0。附录第333页未列1-44，原图与两种独立端口检查构成依据。
methods.en: Independent MNA retains every original element under open circuit and 2, 5 and 10 Ω loads. All 12 satisfy the Thevenin laws exactly. Separate deactivated-source 1 V tests give 2, 1 and 5/2 Ω, and all original powers balance. The appendix omits 1-44; the original figures and both independent port checks support these results.

appendixComparison.reason: The appendix jumps from 1-43 to 1-45; 1-44 is independently verified.

alt.zh: 三个最简戴维南电路：(a)9 V源上正下负串2 Ω；(b)9 V源上负下正串1 Ω；(c)2 V源上正下负串2.5 Ω。端口a在上、b在下。
alt.en: Three simplest Thevenin circuits: (a) top-positive 9 V with 2 Ω; (b) bottom-positive 9 V with 1 Ω; (c) top-positive 2 V with 2.5 Ω. Port a is upper, b lower.

title.zh: 电源等效变换求电流：两边化成戴维南支路
title.en: Source transformations: reduce both sides to Thevenin branches

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 利用电源等效变换求题图1-44所示电路中的电流i。
statement.en: Use source transformations to find current i in Fig. 1-44.

alt.zh: 左3 A源向上，经顶2 Ω接15 V源正端A，源负端B经底2 Ω到公共底节点0；A经3 Ω到M，M经6 Ω到底且i向下。M经10 Ω到C；C有5 A向下源，并有4 Ω、4 V上负下正源、4 Ω串联回到底。
alt.en: Upward 3 A feeds top 2 Ω into A at the positive terminal of 15 V; its negative B connects through bottom 2 Ω to ground. A connects through 3 Ω to M, with 6 Ω to ground carrying downward i. M connects through 10 Ω to C, which has downward 5 A and a series path of 4 Ω, bottom-positive 4 V, and 4 Ω to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 理想源支路端口等效；Norton/戴维南变换；串联电阻；节点法核验。
prerequisites.en: Ideal-source port equivalence, Norton/Thevenin transformations, series resistors and nodal verification.

recognition.zh: 以6 Ω两端为观察端口。左15 V理想源固定自身电压，旁边3 A串2 Ω只影响内部电流；左侧对端口可化15 V串5 Ω。右侧先把两4 Ω及反向4 V源化简，再与5 A源合并。
recognition.en: View the network from the 6 Ω terminals. The left 15 V source fixes its voltage, making the side 3 A/2 Ω branch irrelevant to that port law; the left branch is 15 V in series with 5 Ω. On the right, reduce the two 4 Ω and reversed 4 V source, then combine with 5 A.

title.en: Reduce the left side to 15 V and 5 Ω

text.zh: 左支路3 Ω、15 V源和底2 Ω串联，对M到底的关系为I_L=(V_M−15)/5。左端3 A支路并在理想15 V源旁，只改变该电压源电流。
text.en: The left path contains 3 Ω, the 15 V source and bottom 2 Ω, giving I_L = (V_M−15)/5. The adjacent 3 A branch changes the ideal voltage-source current but not this port relation.

title.en: Reduce the right side to −44 V and 18 Ω

text.zh: C到底的串联支路总电阻8 Ω，电压源沿向下为−4 V，故电流(V_C+4)/8。再加向下5 A，总电流=V_C/8+11/2，对应戴维南开路−44 V、内阻8 Ω。再串顶10 Ω，得到−44 V串18 Ω。
text.en: The C-to-ground series path has 8 Ω and a −4 V downward source drop, so its current is (V_C+4)/8. Adding downward 5 A gives V_C/8+11/2, equivalent to open voltage −44 V and 8 Ω. Adding top 10 Ω yields −44 V in series with 18 Ω.

title.zh: 并联三支路求负载电流

text.en: KCL at M gives (V_M−15)/5+(V_M+44)/18+V_M/6 = 0, hence V_M = 25/19 V and i = 25/114 A.

answer.zh: i=25/114 A≈0.2193 A，按原图向下；按两位小数约0.22 A。
answer.en: i = 25/114 A ≈ 0.2193 A downward, or 0.22 A to two decimals.

pitfalls.zh: 右4 V源上负下正，等效开路电压为−44 V，不能取+44 V。
pitfalls.en: The right 4 V source is bottom-positive, making the reduced open voltage −44 V.

pitfalls.zh: 左底2 Ω不与顶2 Ω同属一个无分支串联路径，应从端口保留正确3+2 Ω。
pitfalls.en: Do not combine the two left 2 Ω blindly; the relevant port series path is 3+2 Ω.

methods.zh: 独立完整七节点MNA保留3 A、15 V、5 A、反向4 V及全部七电阻，得到M=25/19 V、i=25/114 A；与等效三支路KCL完全一致，所有原元件吸收功率总和精确为0。附录第333页/PDF342页0.22 A是两位小数舍入。
methods.en: Independent full seven-node MNA retains all sources and seven resistors, giving M = 25/19 V and i = 25/114 A. It exactly matches reduced-branch KCL, with zero sum of all original absorbed powers. The appendix’s 0.22 A on printed p. 333/PDF p. 342 is rounded to two decimals.

appendixComparison.reason: 25/114 A = 0.219298... A rounds to appendix 0.22 A.

title.zh: 指定电压源零电流：先把其支路电阻压降置零
title.en: Zero source current: set its series resistor drop to zero

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 如题图1-45所示电路，欲使电压源uₛ中的电流为零，试确定电阻Rₓ的值。
statement.en: For Fig. 1-45, determine Rₓ such that current through voltage source uₛ is zero.

alt.zh: 底部公共。右5 V源uₛ上正下负，经5 Ω接节点A，A经Rₓ到底、经顶2 Ω到T。T经4 Ω到N；N经2 Ω到底，控制u上正下负，并由0.5 A源向上注入。左受控电压源3.5u上正下负，经1 Ω接T。
alt.en: Bottom is common. A top-positive 5 V source uₛ connects through 5 Ω to A; A has Rₓ to ground and top 2 Ω to T. T connects through 4 Ω to N; N has 2 Ω to ground with top-positive control u and receives upward 0.5 A. A top-positive dependent source 3.5u connects through 1 Ω to T.

prerequisites.zh: 零电流串联支路压降为0；VCVS控制；节点KCL；反求电阻。
prerequisites.en: Zero current implies zero series-resistor drop, VCVS control, nodal KCL and resistance recovery.

recognition.zh: uₛ电流为0也使右5 Ω电流为0，故A直接等于5 V。先在这个目标条件下解T、N，再由A的KCL求Rₓ，最后接回原图验证。
recognition.en: Zero uₛ current also makes the right 5 Ω current zero, fixing A = 5 V. Solve T and N under this target, use A-node KCL for Rₓ, then restore the full circuit to verify.

title.zh: 把零电流目标化为A电位
title.en: Convert the target into A potential

text.zh: 右5 Ω无压降，因此V_A=5 V。令N电位u，左受控源上端K=3.5u。
text.en: The right 5 Ω has no drop, so V_A = 5 V. Let N be u; the controlled source’s upper terminal K is 3.5u.

title.en: Apply KCL at N and T

text.en: At N, (u−V_T)/4+u/2 = 0.5, giving V_T = 3u−2. Combining with T-node KCL gives u = 4 V and V_T = 10 V.

title.en: Find Rₓ and restore the target

text.zh: T经2 Ω向A流(10−5)/2=2.5 A，右5 Ω不取电流，所以Rₓ承担全部2.5 A。Rₓ=5/2.5=2 Ω。
text.en: The top 2 Ω sends (10−5)/2 = 2.5 A into A. With zero current in the right 5 Ω, all 2.5 A flows through Rₓ, giving 2 Ω.

answer.zh: Rₓ=2 Ω。
answer.en: Rₓ = 2 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 零的是5 V源支路电流，不是Rₓ或整个网络电流。
pitfalls.en: Only the 5 V source-branch current is zero, not Rₓ current or all network current.

pitfalls.zh: 受控源3.5u必须保留，不能在求Rₓ时去掉。
pitfalls.en: Keep the dependent source 3.5u active.

methods.zh: 独立原VCVS拓扑MNA恢复Rₓ=2 Ω，得N=4、T=10、K=14、A=5 V，5 V源电流精确为0。六电阻总耗散58 W；0.5 A源提供2 W，受控源提供56 W，5 V源功率0，完全平衡。与附录第333页/PDF342页2 Ω一致。
methods.en: Independent original-VCVS MNA with Rₓ = 2 Ω gives N = 4, T = 10, K = 14 and A = 5 V, with exactly zero current through the 5 V source. Six resistors dissipate 58 W; the current source supplies 2 W and dependent source 56 W, while the 5 V source exchanges zero power. This matches 2 Ω in the appendix.

title.zh: 四端网络吸收功率：先补第4端电流再选参考
title.en: Four-terminal absorbed power: recover the fourth current

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 已知题图1-46所示四端网络的外部电压分别为U₁₂=5 V，U₃₂=10 V，U₄₁=−15 V，1、2、3端的电流分别如图中所示，试求此四端网络吸收的功率。
statement.en: For the four-terminal network in Fig. 1-46, U₁₂ = 5 V, U₃₂ = 10 V and U₄₁ = −15 V. Currents at terminals 1, 2 and 3 are shown. Find the power absorbed by the network.

alt.zh: 菱形四端网络：1在左，5 A向右流入；2在上，1 A向上流出；3在右，2 A向右流出；4在下，电流未知。
alt.en: A diamond four-terminal network: terminal 1 left has 5 A entering rightward; 2 top has 1 A leaving upward; 3 right has 2 A leaving rightward; terminal 4 bottom has unknown current.

prerequisites.zh: 多端网络KCL；电位差U_xy=V_x−V_y；向内电流功率求和；参考电位不变性。
prerequisites.en: Multi-terminal KCL, U_xy = V_x−V_y, inward-current power sums and reference invariance.

recognition.zh: 把所有端电流统一定义为流入网络，再补第4端。任选一端作0 V，用已给电压恢复其他端电位，求ΣVₖiₖ。
recognition.en: Define every terminal current inward, find the fourth by KCL, choose a voltage reference and evaluate ΣVₖiₖ.

text.zh: 向内为正时i₁=5、i₂=−1、i₃=−2 A，总和0给i₄=−2 A，即第4端实际流出2 A。
text.en: With inward positive, i₁ = 5, i₂ = −1 and i₃ = −2 A. Their total with i₄ is zero, so i₄ = −2 A, actually 2 A outward.

text.zh: 取V₂=0，则V₁=5、V₃=10 V。U₄₁=V₄−V₁=−15 V，所以V₄=−10 V。
text.en: Choose V₂ = 0. Then V₁ = 5 and V₃ = 10 V. Since U₄₁ = V₄−V₁ = −15 V, V₄ = −10 V.
P = 5×5+0×(−1)+10×(−2)+(−10)×(−2) = 25 W. Positive means net absorption.

answer.zh: 四端网络吸收25 W；第4端电流为流出2 A。
answer.en: The network absorbs 25 W; terminal 4 carries 2 A outward.

pitfalls.zh: U₄₁是−15 V，且下标顺序表示V₄−V₁。
pitfalls.en: U₄₁ is −15 V and means V₄−V₁.

pitfalls.zh: 不能只算已给的三个端子，第四端也输送功率。
pitfalls.en: Include the fourth terminal’s power even though its current was not initially given.

methods.zh: 独立KCL与参考平移核验：四个向内电流之和0；把所有电位共同平移0、7、−10、1.5 V后，全部给定电压差不变，ΣVₖiₖ始终精确25 W。与附录第333页/PDF342页25 W一致。
methods.en: Independent KCL and reference-shift checks: inward currents sum to zero. Shifting all potentials by 0, 7, −10 or 1.5 V preserves all given differences and leaves ΣVₖiₖ exactly 25 W. This matches 25 W in the appendix.

title.zh: 风扇四档设计：给定比值只能确定一个电阻解族
title.en: Four-speed fan: ratios determine a family of resistor designs

source.title: 电路分析基础

statement.zh: 题图1-47所示为散热风扇的转速控制电路原理图。假设开关置于1时的风扇转速为v₁，现要求开关置于2、3、4时风扇的转速分别为3v₁、4v₁和5v₁，且假设风扇转速与通过电动机的电流成比例，电动机看作电阻元件，电阻为R_L=100 Ω。试确定电阻R₁、R₂、R₃和R₄的标称电阻值。
statement.en: Fig. 1-47 shows a cooling-fan speed controller. Speed at switch position 1 is v₁; positions 2, 3 and 4 must give 3v₁, 4v₁ and 5v₁. Assume speed is proportional to motor current and model the motor as R_L = 100 Ω. Determine nominal R₁, R₂, R₃ and R₄.

alt.zh: 12 V电池经点火开关、30 A熔断器及四档转换开关供电。位置1接R₁上端，位置2接R₁/R₂间，位置3接R₂/R₃间，位置4接R₃/R₄间。下方R₄接100 Ω电动机回电池负端。
alt.en: A 12 V battery feeds an ignition switch, 30 A fuse and four-position selector. Positions 1–4 connect respectively above R₁ and at the R₁/R₂, R₂/R₃ and R₃/R₄ taps. R₄ connects through the 100 Ω motor back to battery negative.

prerequisites.zh: 速度比等于电流比；串联总电阻与电流反比；欠定设计与自由参数；区分熔断器额定值和工作电流。
prerequisites.en: Speed ratios equal current ratios, series resistance is inverse to current, underdetermined design parameters and fuse rating versus operating current.

recognition.zh: 只给四档相对速度，没有给基准绝对电流或最高档绝对速度。三条独立比值约束不足以唯一确定四个电阻；应给完整解族，再明确选一个自由参数提供可行设计。
recognition.en: Only relative speeds are given, with no absolute base current or highest speed. Three independent ratios cannot uniquely determine four resistors. Give the full family, then state a free-parameter choice for a valid design.

title.zh: 把速度比变成总电阻比
title.en: Convert speed ratios to total resistances

text.zh: 设一档电流I₁，四档电流为I₁、3I₁、4I₁、5I₁。各档串联总电阻依次为12/I₁、12/(3I₁)、12/(4I₁)、12/(5I₁)。
text.en: The four currents are I₁, 3I₁, 4I₁ and 5I₁, so their series totals are 12/I₁, 12/(3I₁), 12/(4I₁) and 12/(5I₁).

title.en: Retain R₄ as a free design variable

text.zh: 令R₄=r≥0 Ω，最高档总电阻T₄=100+r。由电流比，T₁=5(100+r)、T₂=5(100+r)/3、T₃=5(100+r)/4。相邻档总电阻之差给各电阻。
text.en: Let R₄ = r ≥ 0 Ω. Highest-position total T₄ = 100+r. The ratios imply T₁ = 5(100+r), T₂ = 5(100+r)/3 and T₃ = 5(100+r)/4. Differences of adjacent totals give the resistors.

title.zh: 给一组明确条件下的可行值
title.en: Give a design under an explicit choice

text.en: For example choose r = 20 Ω. Then R₁ = 400, R₂ = 50, R₃ = 30 and R₄ = 20 Ω. Totals are 600, 200, 150 and 120 Ω; currents are 20, 60, 80 and 100 mA, giving exactly 1:3:4:5.

title.zh: 说明欠定与标称值含义

text.zh: 上例是可行选择而非原题唯一答案。若要求唯一值，还须指定一档电流、某档绝对速度及电机比例常数，或指定一个电阻。30 A是熔断器标注，不是已知风扇工作电流，不能拿来补方程。若要求四电阻严格为正，取r>0。
text.en: The example is a valid choice, not a uniquely implied answer. A unique design needs an absolute current, an absolute speed with motor proportionality constant, or one resistor value. The 30 A fuse rating is not operating current and supplies no missing equation. Choose r > 0 if all four resistors must be strictly positive.

answer.en: The problem is underdetermined. For any r ≥ 0 Ω: R₄=r, R₁=(10/3)(100+r), R₂=(5/12)(100+r), R₃=(1/4)(100+r), in Ω. Choosing R₄=20 Ω gives (400,50,30,20) Ω and exactly meets all speed ratios.

pitfalls.zh: 四个电阻不能由三条独立速度比条件唯一解出。
pitfalls.en: Three independent speed ratios do not uniquely determine four resistors.

pitfalls.zh: 开关越往下接入，旁路的上方电阻越多，不是给电动机并联额外电阻。
pitfalls.en: Lower switch taps bypass more upper series resistors; they do not place extra resistors parallel with the motor.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把30 A熔断器额定电流当成风扇的实际电流。
pitfalls.en: Do not use the 30 A fuse rating as the actual fan current.

methods.zh: 独立按原抽头链路构建全部四电阻和100 Ω电机的MNA，分别选择r=20、60 Ω，再逐档接12 V，共8个原电路验证；每组电流比精确1:3:4:5，未接入的上段电阻电流为0，每档电源与各电阻功率总和平衡。两组不同的正电阻解直接证明非唯一。附录未列1-49，不补造唯一答案。
methods.en: Independent MNA retains the original tapped chain, all four resistors and the 100 Ω motor. Two choices r = 20 and 60 Ω are tested at all four 12 V switch connections: all eight circuits give exact ratios 1:3:4:5, zero current in inactive upper sections and full power balance. Two distinct positive designs directly demonstrate nonuniqueness. The appendix omits 1-49; no unique answer is invented.

results.solutionScope: complete parametric family plus explicit design, not a unique numeric answer

appendixComparison.reason: No 1-49 answer is listed. Three independent ratios leave one design parameter; full family and conditioned example are verified.

title.zh: 含电压源的反馈电路：先定输入端电位
title.en: Feedback with voltage sources: find input-node voltages first

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试分别求出图题2.3.2中各运放电路的V_O电压值。
statement.en: Find the output voltage V_O of each op-amp circuit in Fig. 2.3.2.

alt.zh: 四种负反馈电路。(a)同相端接地，反相端与10 kΩ、20 kΩ分压节点V₁之间串联2 V源（V₁为正端）；(b)同相端接+2 V，反相端接同一分压节点；(c)同相端接地，输出经20 kΩ和2 V源反馈到反相端，源上端为正；(d)同相端接+2 V，输出经20 kΩ反馈到反相端。
alt.en: Four negative-feedback circuits. (a) The non-inverting input is grounded; a 2 V source, positive at divider node V₁, connects V₁ to the inverting input; V₁ is between 10 kΩ to ground and 20 kΩ to the output. (b) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and the inverting input connects directly to the same divider. (c) The grounded non-inverting input is paired with feedback through 20 kΩ and a 2 V source positive at its upper terminal. (d) The non-inverting input is at +2 V and feedback uses 20 kΩ.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放虚短和虚断；电压源极性；KCL。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; voltage-source polarity; KCL.

recognition.zh: 不要先套同相/反相放大器增益公式。先由同相端求反相端电位，再沿反馈路径用电压源极性和零输入电流求输出。
recognition.en: First infer the inverting-input potential from the non-inverting input. Then use source polarity and zero input current along the feedback path to find the output.

text.zh: 四图都为负反馈。理想线性运放满足V_N=V_P，且流入两个输入端的电流均为零。串在反馈中的独立电压源仍保留其规定电压。
text.en: All four circuits use negative feedback. In ideal linear operation, V_N = V_P and both input currents are zero. An independent voltage source in the feedback path retains its specified voltage.

title.en: (a): the source sets the divider node to 2 V

text.zh: V_P=0，所以V_N=0。2 V源正端在V₁，故V₁=2 V。在V₁列KCL，流入运放支路电流为零，得到V_O=6 V。
text.en: V_P = 0 implies V_N = 0. The 2 V source is positive at V₁, so V₁ = 2 V. KCL at V₁, with no current into the input branch, gives V_O = 6 V.

title.en: (b): the virtual short sets the divider node

text.zh: 同相端为2 V，故V₁=V_N=2 V。与(a)相同的分压网络给出V_O=6 V。
text.en: The non-inverting input is 2 V, so V₁ = V_N = 2 V. The same divider as in (a) gives V_O = 6 V.

title.en: (c): the feedback resistor has no voltage drop

text.zh: V_N=V_P=0。反相端支路没有其他通路，电流为零，所以20 kΩ上压降为零。2 V源上端比V_N高2 V，因此输出为2 V。
text.en: V_N = V_P = 0. The inverting-input branch has no other current path, so its current is zero and the 20 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop. The upper source terminal is 2 V above V_N, hence the output is 2 V.

title.en: (d): a voltage follower with a feedback resistor

text.zh: V_N=V_P=2 V，反馈电阻电流为零，输出与反相端电位相等，故V_O=2 V。
text.en: V_N = V_P = 2 V. With zero current in the feedback resistor, the output equals the inverting-input potential, giving V_O = 2 V.

pitfalls.zh: 虚短是两个输入端电位相等，不是把串联的2 V源短路。
pitfalls.en: A virtual short equates the input potentials; it does not short the series 2 V source.

pitfalls.zh: (c)(d)反馈电阻电流为零；不能把它们错当作带接地输入电阻的普通放大器。
pitfalls.en: The feedback-resistor current in (c) and (d) is zero; these circuits do not have the grounded input resistor of a conventional gain network.

methods.zh: 逐图检查电压源长线正端和实际反馈连接；独立代回KCL：(a)(b)两电阻电流均为0.2 mA，(c)(d)反馈电流均为0。所有结果同时满足V_N=V_P。未声称与外部参考答案对照。
methods.en: Inspected each source positive terminal and actual feedback connection. Independent substitution into KCL gives 0.2 mA in both divider resistors for (a) and (b), and zero feedback current for (c) and (d). All results satisfy V_N = V_P. No external-answer-key comparison is claimed.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: 双运放差分输出与输入电阻
title.en: Two-op-amp differential output and input resistance

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.3.7所示，v_i=0.5sin ωt V。（1）试求v_o1、v_o2和v_o；（2）求电路的电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i和输入电阻R_i。
statement.en: The circuit is shown in Fig. 2.3.7, with v_i = 0.5 sin(ωt) V. (1) Find v_o1, v_o2 and v_o. (2) Find the voltage gain A_v = v_o/v_i and the input resistance R_i.

alt.zh: 输入v_i同时接A₁同相端前的12 kΩ和A₂反相端前的12 kΩ；A₁反馈40 kΩ、反相端对地12 kΩ；A₂反馈30 kΩ、同相端经12 kΩ接地。输出v_o定义上正下负，即v_o1-v_o2。
alt.en: Input v_i connects through separate 12 kΩ resistors to A₁’s non-inverting input and A₂’s inverting input. A₁ has 40 kΩ feedback and 12 kΩ from its inverting input to ground. A₂ has 30 kΩ feedback and its non-inverting input is grounded through 12 kΩ. Output v_o is positive at v_o1 and negative at v_o2.

prerequisites.zh: 同相、反相放大器；差分电压的参考极性；端口输入电阻。
prerequisites.en: Non-inverting and inverting amplifiers; differential-output polarity; port input resistance.

recognition.zh: 先拆成上方同相放大器与下方反相放大器，分别求输出，再按图示正负端相减。输入电阻要从信号源的总取流量计算。
recognition.en: Treat the upper stage as non-inverting and the lower stage as inverting. Find each output, then subtract according to the marked polarity. Find input resistance from the total current drawn from the signal source.

text.zh: 同相端不取电流，其前面的12 kΩ无压降，故同相端电压就是v_i。A₁增益为1+40/12=13/3。
text.en: The non-inverting input draws no current, so its series 12 kΩ resistor has no voltage drop and its voltage equals v_i. A₁’s gain is 1 + 40/12 = 13/3.

text.zh: A₂同相端为0，反相端为虚地。其增益为-30/12=-5/2。
text.en: A₂’s non-inverting input is at 0 V and its inverting input is a virtual ground. Its gain is -30/12 = -5/2.

title.en: Subtract according to the output polarity

text.zh: 图中v_o上正下负，故v_o=v_o1-v_o2。下方输出本身为负，相减后两项的幅值相加。
text.en: The output is marked positive at the top and negative at the bottom, so v_o = v_o1 - v_o2. Since the lower output is negative, the amplitudes add.

title.en: Find R_i from the total input current

text.zh: 上方同相支路输入电流为零。输入电流全部通过下方12 kΩ流向A₂虚地，所以i_i=v_i/(12 kΩ)。
text.en: The upper non-inverting branch draws zero input current. All input current flows through the lower 12 kΩ resistor into A₂’s virtual ground, so i_i = v_i/(12 kΩ).

answer.en: v_o1 = (13/6) sin(ωt) V, v_o2 = -(5/4) sin(ωt) V, and v_o = (41/12) sin(ωt) V; A_v = 41/6 ≈ 6.833 and R_i = 12 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: v_o是两个输出端之间的电压，不是某一个运放的对地输出。
pitfalls.en: v_o is the voltage between the two outputs, not either single output relative to ground.

pitfalls.zh: 上方串联12 kΩ不与下方12 kΩ并联取流，因为理想同相输入端的电流为零。
pitfalls.en: The upper series 12 kΩ does not draw current in parallel with the lower 12 kΩ, because the ideal non-inverting input current is zero.

methods.zh: 逐点代回运放反相节点KCL。A₁节点电位v_i满足v_i/12k+(v_i-v_o1)/40k=0；A₂虚地满足-v_i/12k-v_o2/30k=0。输入取流式和输出极性独立核查均一致。
methods.en: Substituted into KCL at each inverting node. A₁’s node at v_i satisfies v_i/12k + (v_i - v_o1)/40k = 0; A₂’s virtual ground satisfies -v_i/12k - v_o2/30k = 0. Input-current and output-polarity checks agree.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: 增益可调求差电路：两个反相节点列KCL
title.en: Adjustable subtractor: KCL at both inverting nodes

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 增益可调求差电路如图题2.4.5所示，试推导函数关系v_o=f(v_1,v_2)。
statement.en: The adjustable-gain subtractor is shown in Fig. 2.4.5. Derive the relationship v_o = f(v_1, v_2).

alt.zh: A₁同相输入v₁，A₂同相输入v₂。两个反相节点之间跨接R_G。A₁反相节点经R₂接地、经R₁接A₁输出v_o1；A₂反相节点经R₁接v_o1、经R₂接最终输出v_o。
alt.en: A₁’s non-inverting input is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. R_G bridges their inverting nodes. A₁’s inverting node connects through R₂ to ground and R₁ to v_o1. A₂’s inverting node connects through R₁ to v_o1 and R₂ to the final output v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放虚短、虚断；节点电流法；代数消元。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op-amp virtual short and zero input currents; nodal KCL; algebraic elimination.

recognition.zh: R_G连接两个反相节点，两个运放相互关联。直接把这两个节点电位分别写成v₁、v₂，再列两条KCL，消去中间输出v_o1。
recognition.en: R_G connects the two inverting nodes, coupling the stages. Set their potentials to v₁ and v₂, write two KCL equations, and eliminate the intermediate output v_o1.

text.zh: 在理想负反馈下，A₁反相节点为v₁，A₂反相节点为v₂。两个输入端均不取电流。
text.en: With ideal negative feedback, A₁’s inverting node is v₁ and A₂’s is v₂. Neither input draws current.

title.en: Apply KCL at A₁’s inverting node

text.zh: 以流出节点为正，把流向地、v_o1和v₂的三条支路电流相加为零，先解出v_o1。
text.en: Taking currents leaving the node as positive, sum the branches to ground, v_o1 and v₂. Solve first for v_o1.

title.en: Apply KCL at A₂’s inverting node

text.zh: 流向v_o1、v_o和v₁的三条支路电流之和为零，把最终输出写成v_o1的函数。
text.en: Sum the currents toward v_o1, v_o and v₁ to zero, then express the final output in terms of v_o1.

text.zh: 代入v_o1并合并v₁、v₂的系数，可见两者系数大小相同、符号相反，输出只与差值v₂-v₁有关。
text.en: Substitute v_o1 and collect the coefficients of v₁ and v₂. They have equal magnitude and opposite signs, so the output depends only on v₂ - v₁.

answer.zh: v_o=[1+R₂/R₁+2R₂/R_G](v₂-v₁)。减小R_G会提高差模增益；此结论以运放保持线性为前提。
answer.en: v_o = [1 + R₂/R₁ + 2R₂/R_G](v₂ - v₁). Decreasing R_G increases the differential gain, provided the op amps remain linear.

pitfalls.zh: R_G中电流为(v₁-v₂)/R_G，不是v₁/R_G；它不接地。
pitfalls.en: The current in R_G is (v₁ - v₂)/R_G, not v₁/R_G; R_G is not grounded.

pitfalls.zh: 输出对应v₂-v₁；若将差分输入定义为v₁-v₂，增益需带负号。
pitfalls.en: The output is proportional to v₂ - v₁; if the differential input is defined as v₁ - v₂, the gain is negative.

methods.zh: 以符号消元核查两条独立节点方程；v₁=v₂时输出为0，R_G趋于无穷时退化为[1+R₂/R₁](v₂-v₁)。另取R₁=10 kΩ、R₂=20 kΩ、R_G=5 kΩ、v₁=0.1 V、v₂=0.2 V，独立解节点方程得v_o1=-0.05 V、v_o=1.1 V，代回两式残差为0。
methods.en: Checked by symbolic elimination of the two independent nodal equations. Equal inputs give zero output, and R_G → ∞ gives [1 + R₂/R₁](v₂ - v₁). With R₁ = 10 kΩ, R₂ = 20 kΩ, R_G = 5 kΩ, v₁ = 0.1 V and v₂ = 0.2 V, an independent nodal solve gives v_o1 = -0.05 V and v_o = 1.1 V, with zero residuals.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

title.zh: INA128：先区分共模电压与两端信号极性
title.en: INA128: separate common-mode voltage and signal polarity

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: INA128型仪用放大器电路如图题2.4.9所示，其中R₁是外接电阻。（1）它的输入干扰电压V_C=1 V（直流），输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.04sin ωt V，当R₁=1 kΩ时，求出v₃、v₄、v₃-v₄和v_o的电压值；（2）当输入信号v_i1=v_i2=0.01sin ωt V，要求v_o=-6sin ωt V，求此时外接电阻R₁的阻值。
statement.en: The INA128 instrumentation amplifier is shown in Fig. 2.4.9, where R₁ is an external resistor. (1) Its input interference voltage is V_C = 1 V DC and its input signals are v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.04 sin(ωt) V. With R₁ = 1 kΩ, find v₃, v₄, v₃ - v₄ and v_o. (2) For v_i1 = v_i2 = 0.01 sin(ωt) V, require v_o = -6 sin(ωt) V. Find the required external resistance R₁.

alt.zh: 共模源V_C=1 V接在两信号源中点：上端v₁=V_C+v_i1，下端v₂=V_C-v_i2。前级两个反相节点之间是外接R₁，每级反馈R₂=25 kΩ。后级匹配差分电路四个电阻均40 kΩ，上端v₃进反相支路、下端v₄进同相支路，故v_o=v₄-v₃。
alt.en: The 1 V common-mode source connects to the midpoint of the signal sources: v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. External R₁ bridges the first-stage inverting nodes; each feedback R₂ is 25 kΩ. The final matched difference amplifier uses four 40 kΩ resistors, with v₃ entering its inverting branch and v₄ its non-inverting branch, so v_o = v₄ - v₃.

prerequisites.zh: 共模与差模；仪用放大器前级节点分析；匹配差分放大器。
prerequisites.en: Common-mode and differential-mode signals; first-stage instrumentation-amplifier nodal analysis; matched difference amplifier.

recognition.zh: 必须按图中两信号源的正负端先写v₁、v₂。虽然v_i1=v_i2，上下输入节点并不相等；它们对共模中点的方向相反。先求前级两输出，再作后级相减。
recognition.en: First write v₁ and v₂ from the source polarities. Although v_i1 = v_i2, the two input-node voltages differ because the signals face opposite directions relative to the common-mode midpoint. Find the first-stage outputs, then apply the final subtraction.

title.zh: 从电压源极性写实际输入
title.en: Write actual inputs from source polarities

text.zh: 图中上信号源上正下负，下信号源也上正下负，而V_C接它们的中点。因此v₁=V_C+v_i1，v₂=V_C-v_i2。第（1）问差模输入为0.08sin ωt V。
text.en: Both signal sources have their positive terminal at the top, while V_C connects to their midpoint. Thus v₁ = V_C + v_i1 and v₂ = V_C - v_i2. In part (1), the differential input is 0.08 sin(ωt) V.

steps.formula: v_1=1+0.04\sin\omega t,\quad v_2=1-0.04\sin\omega t,\quad v_1-v_2=0.08\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V}

title.en: Write the two first-stage node equations

text.zh: 由虚短，反相节点A、B分别等于v₁、v₂。令R₂=25 kΩ，在两节点列KCL，解得v₃、v₄；相减得前级差模增益1+2R₂/R₁。
text.en: The virtual short gives node A = v₁ and node B = v₂. With R₂ = 25 kΩ, KCL gives v₃ and v₄; their difference has gain 1 + 2R₂/R₁.

text.zh: R₂/R₁=25，故前级输出仍包含共同的1 V直流分量，交流分量大小为2.04 V且符号相反。
text.en: R₂/R₁ = 25. Both first-stage outputs retain the same 1 V DC component, while their AC components have opposite signs and amplitude 2.04 V.

steps.formula: v_3=1+2.04\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V},\quad v_4=1-2.04\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V},\quad v_3-v_4=4.08\sin\omega t\,\mathrm{V}

title.en: The final subtraction removes common mode

text.zh: 后级电阻比为1。v₃进入反相支路、v₄进入同相支路，所以v_o=v₄-v₃，输出的1 V直流分量消除。
text.en: The final stage has matched resistor ratios of 1. Because v₃ enters the inverting branch and v₄ the non-inverting branch, v_o = v₄ - v₃, cancelling the 1 V DC component.

title.zh: 第（2）问先算所需差模增益
title.en: Part (2): find the required differential gain

text.zh: 两信号源幅值都为0.01 V，实际差模幅值为0.02 V。要得到6 V输出幅值，需要前级差模增益300。由1+50 kΩ/R₁=300解外接电阻。
text.en: Each signal-source amplitude is 0.01 V, so the actual differential amplitude is 0.02 V. A 6 V output amplitude requires differential gain 300. Solve 1 + 50 kΩ/R₁ = 300 for the external resistor.

answer.zh: （1）v₃=1+2.04sin ωt V，v₄=1-2.04sin ωt V，v₃-v₄=4.08sin ωt V，v_o=-4.08sin ωt V。（2）R₁=50 kΩ/299≈167.22 Ω。
answer.en: (1) v₃ = 1 + 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₄ = 1 - 2.04 sin(ωt) V, v₃ - v₄ = 4.08 sin(ωt) V, and v_o = -4.08 sin(ωt) V. (2) R₁ = 50 kΩ/299 ≈ 167.22 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: v_i1=v_i2不代表v₁=v₂；必须看两个电压源相对中点的极性。
pitfalls.en: v_i1 = v_i2 does not mean v₁ = v₂; inspect each source polarity relative to the midpoint.

pitfalls.zh: 求外接电阻时保留增益公式中的1，不能以50 kΩ/300替代精确结果。
pitfalls.en: Retain the 1 in the gain equation; 50 kΩ/300 is not the exact required resistance.

pitfalls.zh: 题干在第47页，电路在第48页，需合并阅读。
pitfalls.en: The statement is on printed p. 47 and the figure on p. 48; read them together.

methods.zh: 按图中25 kΩ、40 kΩ和源极性重新推导。正弦峰值处，A=1.04 V、B=0.96 V，跨R₁电流80 μA；两25 kΩ压降均2 V，得v₃=3.04 V、v₄=-1.04 V。后级非反相节点v₄/2=-0.52 V，反相节点KCL得v_o=-4.08 V。第二问代回167.2240802676 Ω得差模增益300、输出幅值6 V。
methods.en: Re-derived from the actual 25 kΩ and 40 kΩ resistors and source polarities. At the positive sine peak, A = 1.04 V and B = 0.96 V, giving 80 μA through R₁; each 25 kΩ feedback resistor drops 2 V, so v₃ = 3.04 V and v₄ = -1.04 V. The final non-inverting node is v₄/2 = -0.52 V, and KCL at the inverting node gives v_o = -4.08 V. Substituting 167.2240802676 Ω in part (2) gives gain 300 and output amplitude 6 V.

assumptions.zh: 按本章理想运放模型，负反馈且工作在线性区。
assumptions.en: Ideal op-amp model with negative feedback and linear operation, as used in this chapter.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。结论基于所列模型假设。
completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 由指数模型求反向饱和电流与十倍电流电压
title.en: Use the exponential model for saturation current and a tenfold current increase

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在室温（300 K）情况下，若二极管加0.7 V正向电压时，产生的正向电流为1 mA。（1）求二极管的反向饱和电流；（2）当二极管正向电流增加10倍时，其电压应为多少？设n=1。
statement.en: At room temperature (300 K), a diode carries 1 mA when a forward voltage of 0.7 V is applied. (1) Find its reverse saturation current. (2) Find its voltage when the forward current increases tenfold. Assume n = 1.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管指数模型；热电压；自然对数。
prerequisites.en: Diode exponential model; thermal voltage; natural logarithms.

recognition.zh: 先用已知工作点反求I_S；换到新电流时使用同一个I_S。电流按倍数变化对应电压按对数增加。
recognition.en: Use the known operating point to recover I_S, then keep that same I_S for the new current. Multiplying the current produces a logarithmic voltage increase.

text.zh: 采用相邻题3.2.1给出的V_T=26 mV，且本题n=1。保留指数模型中的-1。
text.en: Use V_T = 26 mV, given in adjacent exercise 3.2.1, and n = 1. Retain the -1 term in the exponential model.

text.zh: 将0.7 V、1 mA代入指数模型。反向饱和电流是模型参数，不等于当前的正向电流。
text.en: Substitute 0.7 V and 1 mA into the model. Reverse saturation current is a model parameter, not the present forward current.

text.zh: 新电流为10 mA。由指数模型反解电压，得到约0.75987 V。
text.en: The new current is 10 mA. Invert the exponential relation to obtain approximately 0.75987 V.

title.en: Quick check from the voltage increment

text.zh: 因两个正向电流都远大于I_S，可以用ΔV≈V_T ln10复核，电压约增加59.87 mV。
text.en: Both forward currents greatly exceed I_S, so ΔV ≈ V_T ln 10 provides a check: the voltage rises by about 59.87 mV.

answer.en: Using V_T = 26 mV: (1) I_S ≈ 2.03 × 10⁻¹⁵ A. (2) V_D ≈ 0.75987 V, an increase of about 59.87 mV.

pitfalls.zh: 指数函数的电压单位必须一致，0.7/0.026不是0.7/26。
pitfalls.en: Use consistent voltage units in the exponent: 0.7/0.026, not 0.7/26.

pitfalls.zh: 热电压采用26 mV是教材近似；若取kT/q的更精细数值，I_S会有明显差别，因此必须说明参数。
pitfalls.en: The textbook uses the 26 mV approximation. A more precise kT/q changes I_S noticeably, so the chosen thermal voltage must be stated.

methods.zh: 将求得I_S分别代回0.7 V和0.759867 V，独立回算电流为1 mA和10 mA。精确含-1式与强正向近似的差异远小于所报精度。
methods.en: Substituting the recovered I_S at 0.7 V and 0.759867 V independently reproduces 1 mA and 10 mA. The exact -1 formula and strong-forward-bias approximation differ far below the reported precision.

assumptions.zh: 二极管指数模型，n=1；室温热电压按教材相邻题取26 mV。
assumptions.en: Exponential diode model with n = 1; room-temperature thermal voltage is 26 mV as given in the adjacent textbook exercise.

title.zh: 电池充电：先判断导通，再找正负峰值
title.en: Battery charging: check conduction, then examine both source peaks

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 12 V电池的简化充电电路如图题3.4.2所示，用二极管理想模型分析，若v_s是振幅为24 V的正弦波，则二极管流过的峰值电流和二极管两端的最大反向电压各是多少？
statement.en: The simplified charging circuit for a 12 V battery is shown in Fig. 3.4.2. Using the ideal-diode model, find the diode peak current and maximum reverse voltage when v_s is sinusoidal with amplitude 24 V.

alt.zh: 正弦源v_s经100 Ω和向右导通的二极管接12 V电池正端；电池负端与正弦源下端相连。
alt.en: The sinusoidal source connects through 100 Ω and a diode conducting to the right to the positive terminal of a 12 V battery. The battery negative terminal returns to the lower source terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 理想二极管分段模型；KVL；反向电压的定义。
prerequisites.en: Piecewise ideal-diode model; KVL; definition of reverse voltage.

recognition.zh: 电池建立固定12 V门槛。正峰值决定最大充电电流，负峰值决定最大反向电压；二者发生在不同半周。
recognition.en: The battery creates a fixed 12 V threshold. The positive source peak sets the largest charging current; the negative peak sets the largest reverse voltage.

text.zh: 二极管截止时100 Ω中无电流，阳极电位为v_s，阴极电位为12 V。只有v_s>12 V才导通。
text.en: When the diode is off, no current flows through 100 Ω, so its anode is at v_s and cathode at 12 V. It turns on only when v_s > 12 V.

title.en: Use the positive peak for peak current

text.zh: 当v_s=24 V时，理想二极管压降为零，电阻上电压为24-12=12 V。
text.en: At v_s = 24 V, the ideal diode has zero drop and the resistor voltage is 24 - 12 = 12 V.

title.zh: 负峰值求最大反向电压
title.en: Use the negative peak for maximum reverse voltage

text.zh: 当v_s=-24 V时二极管截止，电阻压降为零。最大反向电压为阴极减阳极，即12-(-24)。
text.en: At v_s = -24 V the diode is off and the resistor drop is zero. Reverse voltage is cathode minus anode: 12 - (-24).

answer.zh: 峰值电流120 mA；最大反向电压36 V。
answer.en: Peak current: 120 mA. Maximum reverse voltage: 36 V.

pitfalls.zh: 正弦源振幅是24 V，不是有效值；不再乘√2。
pitfalls.en: 24 V is the sinusoidal amplitude, not RMS; do not multiply it by √2.

pitfalls.zh: 反向峰值要叠加电池电压，不能只取24 V。
pitfalls.en: The reverse peak includes the battery voltage; it is not just 24 V.

methods.zh: 逐半周检查理想二极管互补条件：导通时v_AK=0且i_D≥0；截止时i_D=0且v_AK=v_s-12≤0。正峰值KVL为24=12+100×0.12；负峰值反向36 V。
methods.en: Checked ideal-diode complementarity in both half-cycles: on means v_AK = 0 and i_D ≥ 0; off means i_D = 0 and v_AK = v_s - 12 ≤ 0. Positive-peak KVL is 24 = 12 + 100(0.12); the negative peak gives 36 V reverse bias.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；理想12 V电池。
assumptions.en: Ideal diode and ideal 12 V battery.

completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 桥式整流：导通路径与二极管耐压
title.en: Bridge rectification: current paths and reverse-voltage rating

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.3所示，电源v_s为正弦波电压。（1）二极管采用理想模型，试绘出负载R_L两端的电压波形；（2）若v_s的有效值为220 V，则二极管的最高反向工作电压值应为多少？
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 3.4.3 has a sinusoidal source v_s. (1) Using ideal diodes, draw the voltage waveform across R_L. (2) If v_s has RMS value 220 V, what maximum reverse-working-voltage rating is required for each diode?

alt.zh: 桥式整流器：上左D₁、上右D₂、下右D₃、下左D₄；交流源接桥的上下顶点，负载接左右顶点，右端为输出正端。
alt.en: Bridge rectifier: D₁ upper left, D₂ upper right, D₃ lower right, D₄ lower left. The AC source connects to the top and bottom bridge vertices; the load is between left and right vertices, with output positive at the right.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通路径；理想全波整流；正弦有效值与峰值。
prerequisites.en: Diode conduction paths; ideal full-wave rectification; sinusoidal RMS and peak values.

recognition.zh: 分别沿正半周和负半周画闭合电流路径，确认负载电流方向始终相同，再检查每只截止管两端的节点电位。
recognition.en: Trace a closed current path in each half-cycle. The load current keeps the same direction. Then inspect the two node potentials across each off diode.

title.en: Positive half-cycle: D₂ and D₄ conduct

text.zh: v_s>0时，电流从源上端经D₂到负载正端，通过R_L后经D₄回源下端，故v_L=v_s。D₁、D₃反偏。
text.en: For v_s > 0, current flows from the source upper terminal through D₂, through R_L from its positive terminal, then through D₄ back to the source lower terminal. Thus v_L = v_s; D₁ and D₃ are reverse-biased.

title.en: Negative half-cycle: D₃ and D₁ conduct

text.zh: v_s<0时，源下端较高，电流经D₃、R_L、D₁回源上端。负载方向不变，故v_L=-v_s。
text.en: For v_s < 0, the source lower terminal is higher. Current returns through D₃, R_L and D₁ to the upper terminal. Load direction is unchanged, so v_L = -v_s.

text.zh: 把正弦负半周翻到零线上方，峰值保持V_m，周期变为输入的一半，输出脉动频率为输入的两倍。
text.en: Reflect the negative sine half-cycle above zero. The peak remains V_m, the output period is half the input period, and the ripple frequency doubles.

title.zh: 第（2）问：检查截止管反向峰值
title.en: Part (2): check the off-diode reverse peak

text.zh: 以正半周的D₁为例，其阳极在源下端电位、阴极在源上端电位，反向电压为v_s。其他管对称。因此每管PIV为源峰值，而不是两倍源峰值。
text.en: For D₁ in the positive half-cycle, the anode is at the source lower-terminal potential and cathode at the upper-terminal potential, so its reverse voltage is v_s. Symmetry applies to the others. Each diode’s PIV equals the source peak, not twice it.

answer.zh: （1）v_L=|v_s|=V_m|sin ωt|，为全波整流波形；（2）每只管的最大反向电压约311 V，反向工作电压额定值须不低于该值。
answer.en: (1) v_L = |v_s| = V_m |sin(ωt)|, a full-wave rectified waveform. (2) Each diode sees about 311 V maximum reverse voltage; its reverse-working-voltage rating must be at least this value.

pitfalls.zh: 桥式整流每只管的反向峰值为V_m；不要套用中心抽头全波电路的2V_m。
pitfalls.en: A bridge diode sees peak reverse voltage V_m; do not substitute the 2V_m result for a center-tapped full-wave circuit.

pitfalls.zh: 本题为理想管，不扣除两只实际硅管的导通压降。
pitfalls.en: The diodes are ideal here; do not subtract the drops of two real silicon diodes.

methods.zh: 按实际图上四管方向分别追踪两种导通对，并以负载电阻电流i_L=v_L/R_L≥0复核。正半周截止D₁、D₃的v_AK=-v_s≤0，负半周截止D₂、D₄的v_AK=v_s≤0，全部满足模型条件。
methods.en: Traced both conducting pairs using the actual diode directions. The resistor current i_L = v_L/R_L is nonnegative. In the positive half-cycle, off diodes D₁ and D₃ have v_AK = -v_s ≤ 0; in the negative half-cycle, off diodes D₂ and D₄ have v_AK = v_s ≤ 0. Every ideal-model condition is satisfied.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；负载为电阻，无滤波电容。
assumptions.en: Ideal diodes with a resistive load and no filter capacitor.

alt.zh: 理想桥式整流波形：灰色虚线为输入正弦，蓝绿色实线为负载输出。负半周翻到零线上方，输出峰值为V_m，输出频率为输入的两倍。
alt.en: Ideal bridge-rectifier waveform. Dashed gray is the sinusoidal input; solid teal is the load output. Negative half-cycles are reflected above zero, with peak V_m and twice the input frequency.

completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 理想二极管状态：先读电池极性，再试断路
title.en: Ideal-diode states: read battery polarities, then test an open diode

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 二极管电路如图题3.4.12所示，试判断图中的二极管是导通还是截止，并求出AO两端电压V_AO。设二极管是理想的。
statement.en: For the diode circuits in Fig. 3.4.12, determine whether each diode is on or off and find the voltage V_AO across terminals A and O. Assume ideal diodes.

alt.zh: 四个电路都含A到固定电位的3 kΩ电阻，O为参考点。(a)D阳极-6 V、下拉电位-12 V；(b)D阳极-15 V、下拉-12 V；(c)两个阳极分别0 V、-15 V，阴极同接A，下拉-12 V；(d)两个阴极分别0 V、-6 V，阳极同接A，电阻另一端+12 V。电池长线为正端。
alt.en: All four circuits have a 3 kΩ resistor from A to a fixed potential, with O as reference. (a) Anode -6 V, pull node -12 V. (b) Anode -15 V, pull node -12 V. (c) Anodes 0 V and -15 V share cathode A, with pull node -12 V. (d) Cathodes 0 V and -6 V share anode A, with resistor pull node +12 V. A battery’s longer plate is positive.

prerequisites.zh: 电池极性与节点电位；理想二极管开关模型；欧姆定律。
prerequisites.en: Battery polarity and node potentials; ideal-diode switching model; Ohm’s law.

recognition.zh: 先把电池上端写成相对O的带符号电位，再假设管截止。若出现阳极高于阴极，则改为导通；最后确认导通电流不为负、截止管不正偏。
recognition.en: Write the signed battery-terminal potentials relative to O. Start with the diode off; if its anode is above its cathode, turn it on. Finally check nonnegative on-current and nonpositive anode-to-cathode voltage for off diodes.

text.zh: 若截止，A=-12 V，阳极-6 V高于阴极，矛盾。因此D导通，A被钳位为-6 V；电阻电流2 mA从A流向-12 V。
text.en: If D were off, A = -12 V, below its -6 V anode, which contradicts the off assumption. D therefore conducts and clamps A to -6 V. The resistor carries 2 mA from A toward -12 V.

text.zh: 截止时A=-12 V，阳极-15 V比阴极低3 V，反偏成立。电阻无电流，A保持-12 V。
text.en: With D off, A = -12 V and the -15 V anode is 3 V below its cathode. The diode is reverse-biased, no resistor current flows, and A remains -12 V.

title.en: (c): D₁ is on and D₂ is off

text.zh: A由3 kΩ向-12 V下拉。阳极在0 V的D₁先导通，将A钳位到0 V；D₂阳极-15 V，因而反偏。D₁向电阻提供4 mA。
text.en: The resistor pulls A toward -12 V. D₁, whose anode is at 0 V, conducts and clamps A to 0 V. D₂’s anode is at -15 V, so D₂ is reverse-biased. D₁ supplies 4 mA to the resistor.

title.en: (d): D₂ is on and D₁ is off

text.zh: 本图12 V电池长线在上，电阻将A向+12 V拉高。两个管共阳极，阴极更低的D₂（-6 V）导通，将A钳位为-6 V。D₁阴极0 V，比阳极高6 V而截止。
text.en: The 12 V battery has its longer plate on top, so the resistor pulls A toward +12 V. With common anodes, D₂’s lower cathode potential (-6 V) makes D₂ conduct and clamp A to -6 V. D₁’s 0 V cathode is 6 V above its anode, so D₁ is off.

answer.zh: (a)D导通，V_AO=-6 V；(b)D截止，V_AO=-12 V；(c)D₁导通、D₂截止，V_AO=0 V；(d)D₁截止、D₂导通，V_AO=-6 V。
answer.en: (a) D on, V_AO = -6 V. (b) D off, V_AO = -12 V. (c) D₁ on and D₂ off, V_AO = 0 V. (d) D₁ off and D₂ on, V_AO = -6 V.

pitfalls.zh: 不能按电池旁“6 V、12 V”字样直接把上端写成正电位，要看长短线。
pitfalls.en: Do not assume a battery upper terminal is positive from its 6 V or 12 V label; inspect the plate lengths.

pitfalls.zh: 两管共同接输出时，必须同时检查另一只管的反偏条件。
pitfalls.en: When two diodes share the output, also check that the other diode remains reverse-biased.

methods.zh: 对所有四图逐项检查互补条件。导通管电流分别为2、4、6 mA，均沿阳极到阴极且为正；截止管v_AK分别为(b)-3 V、(c)D₂的-15 V、(d)D₁的-6 V。各电阻欧姆定律和节点KCL同时成立。
methods.en: Checked complementarity for all four circuits. On-currents are 2, 4 and 6 mA, positive from anode to cathode. Off-diode v_AK values are -3 V in (b), -15 V for D₂ in (c), and -6 V for D₁ in (d). Resistor Ohm’s law and nodal KCL both hold.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；按原图电池极性确定各节点。
assumptions.en: Ideal diodes with battery polarities read from the original figure.

completionNote.en: Every part of the exercise has been checked; assigned parts are identified separately. Results use the stated model assumptions.

title.zh: 浮动电源分压网络：用开路电位判二极管状态
title.en: Floating-source divider: determine diode state from open-circuit potentials

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试判断图题3.4.13中二极管是导通还是截止，为什么？设二极管是理想的。
statement.en: Determine whether the diode in each circuit of Fig. 3.4.13 is on or off, and explain why. Assume ideal diodes.

alt.zh: 三图D的阳极在右侧A、阴极在左侧B。右分压为15 V经140 kΩ和10 kΩ到地。左主分压为15 V经25 kΩ和5 kΩ到地，记其节点为C。(a)(b)10 V源接18 kΩ、2 kΩ串联，底端接C，B在两电阻之间；两图电源极性相反。(c)20 V源上正下负，C在18 kΩ和2 kΩ之间，B在源下端。
alt.en: In all three figures, D has anode A on the right and cathode B on the left. The right divider is 140 kΩ and 10 kΩ from 15 V to ground. The left main divider is 25 kΩ and 5 kΩ; call its midpoint C. In (a) and (b), a floating 10 V source drives series 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, with its lower terminal tied to C and B between the resistors; the source polarity reverses between figures. In (c), the 20 V source is positive on top, C lies between 18 kΩ and 2 kΩ, and B is the source lower terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 浮动电压源；电阻分压；理想二极管；戴维南等效与节点分析。
prerequisites.en: Floating voltage sources; resistor division; ideal diodes; Thévenin equivalents and nodal analysis.

recognition.zh: 先把二极管断开，比较A、B的开路电位。独立的浮动电源回路只经一个节点接主网络时，不向该节点净取流，不能把它当作对地分压器。
recognition.en: First open the diode and compare A and B potentials. A floating source loop connected to the main network at only one node draws zero net current from that node; do not treat it as a divider to ground.

title.en: Find the two main divider potentials

text.en: With D open, A = 15(10)/(140 + 10) = 1 V. The 25 kΩ/5 kΩ main divider gives C = 15(5)/(25 + 5) = 2.5 V.

title.en: (a): B is above A, so D is off

text.zh: 10 V源上正下负，2 kΩ上的分压为+1 V，故B=C+1=3.5 V。D阳极A=1 V、阴极B=3.5 V，反偏2.5 V。
text.en: The 10 V source is positive on top; the 2 kΩ divider drop is +1 V, so B = C + 1 = 3.5 V. With anode A = 1 V and cathode B = 3.5 V, D is reverse-biased by 2.5 V.

title.en: (b): reversing the source still leaves D off

text.zh: 10 V源反向，故B=C-1=1.5 V。A仍为1 V，阳极仍低于阴极0.5 V，因此截止。
text.en: Reversing the 10 V source gives B = C - 1 = 1.5 V. A remains 1 V, still 0.5 V below the cathode, so D is off.

title.zh: (c)：开路试算出现正偏，必须导通
title.en: (c): the open-circuit test gives forward bias

text.zh: 20 V源使C比B高20×2/(18+2)=2 V，故开路B=2.5-2=0.5 V。A=1 V高于B，截止假设矛盾，D应导通。导通后节点会相互加载，不能继续把A固定为1 V、B固定为0.5 V。
text.en: The 20 V source puts C 20(2)/(18 + 2) = 2 V above B, giving open-circuit B = 2.5 - 2 = 0.5 V. A = 1 V is above B, contradicting the off assumption; D must conduct. Once on, the dividers load each other, so A and B no longer retain their open-circuit values.

title.zh: 独立检查(c)导通电流方向

text.zh: 将两侧从A、B看入作戴维南等效。右侧电阻140 kΩ∥10 kΩ=28/3 kΩ；左侧电阻(25 kΩ∥5 kΩ)+(18 kΩ∥2 kΩ)=179/30 kΩ。短接A、B后电流从A到B为32.68 μA，正向成立。
text.en: Find the Thévenin resistance seen from each side. On the right, 140 kΩ ∥ 10 kΩ = 28/3 kΩ. On the left, (25 kΩ ∥ 5 kΩ) + (18 kΩ ∥ 2 kΩ) = 179/30 kΩ. Shorting A to B produces 32.68 μA from A to B, confirming forward conduction.

answer.zh: (a)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=3.5 V；(b)截止：V_A=1 V、V_B=1.5 V；(c)导通：开路试算V_A=1 V>V_B=0.5 V，实际导通电流约32.68 μA（A→B）。
answer.en: (a) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 3.5 V. (b) Off: V_A = 1 V and V_B = 1.5 V. (c) On: the open-circuit test gives V_A = 1 V > V_B = 0.5 V; the actual forward current is about 32.68 μA from A to B.

pitfalls.zh: D的阴极横线在左，阳极A在右；方向看反会把三图结论全部颠倒。
pitfalls.en: The cathode bar is on the left and anode A on the right; reversing this interpretation reverses every conclusion.

pitfalls.zh: 图(c)导通后的电位不能沿用开路试算值。
pitfalls.en: In (c), do not keep the open-circuit node voltages after D turns on.

methods.zh: (a)(b)使用含浮动电源的修正节点方程独立求解，结果分别A=1、B=3.5和A=1、B=1.5 V。(c)通过节点方程与戴维南法两种方法得到同一ID=1/30600 A、A=B=319/459 V、C=1210/459 V，二极管正向电流为正。
methods.en: Independently solved modified nodal equations including the floating source for (a) and (b), obtaining A = 1, B = 3.5 V and A = 1, B = 1.5 V. For (c), nodal and Thévenin methods both give I_D = 1/30600 A, A = B = 319/459 V and C = 1210/459 V, with positive forward diode current.

assumptions.zh: 理想二极管；15 V电源和浮动电源均理想。
assumptions.en: Ideal diode, ideal 15 V supply and ideal floating sources.
