completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 按跨级环路判断深反馈，再核对加载
title.en: Check global loop depth, then loading

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题8.4.3所示，试在深度负反馈的条件下，近似计算它的闭环电压增益。
statement.en: For Fig. 8.4.3, approximately calculate the closed-loop voltage gain under deep negative feedback.

alt.zh: T₁为NMOS，漏极经R_d接V_DD并驱动PNP T₂基极；T₂发射极经R_e接V_DD，集电极为v_o。T₁源极经R₁接地，并经R₂接v_o；栅极为v_i且R_g接地。
alt.en: NMOS T₁ drain through R_d to V_DD drives PNP T₂ base. T₂ emitter through R_e to V_DD, collector at v_o. T₁ source connects through R₁ to ground and R₂ to v_o. Input v_i is at the gate, with R_g to ground.

prerequisites.zh: MOS源极KCL；PNP带射极电阻的小信号输入；深反馈近似的适用条件。
prerequisites.en: MOS-source KCL; emitter-degenerated PNP input model; conditions for deep-feedback approximations.

recognition.zh: 本题问跨级深度负反馈下的近似增益，考试结论为1+R₂/R₁。要把“跨级环路很深”与“仅MOS互导很大”区分；后者单独不能保证反馈分压不被源极电流加载。
recognition.en: The requested deep global-feedback approximation gives the exam result 1+R₂/R₁. Distinguish a large interstage loop gain from merely large MOS transconductance; the latter alone does not ensure negligible source-current loading of the divider.

title.zh: 考试主线：跨级深负反馈的电压增益
title.en: Exam route: voltage gain with deep global feedback

text.zh: T₁共源与T₂共射两次反相，输出升高经R₂提高T₁源极，减小净输入v_gs1，为电压串联负反馈。按授课课件的跨级深反馈近似，v_s≈v_i，且首级源极电流相对跨级反馈电流可忽略，R₁/R₂形成近似不加载的反馈分压。因此以实际栅极电压v_i定义的闭环增益如下，R_g不引入额外源分压。
text.en: Common-source T₁ and common-emitter T₂ invert twice. A higher output raises the T₁ source through R₂ and reduces v_gs1, giving negative voltage-series feedback. Under the course’s deep global-feedback approximation, v_s≈v_i and first-stage source current is negligible relative to interstage feedback current, so R₁/R₂ form an approximately unloaded feedback divider. The gain below is referred to actual gate voltage v_i; R_g adds no source-divider factor.

title.zh: 保留加载：从原图列有限参数KCL
title.en: Retain loading: finite-parameter KCL from the original

text.zh: 取V_DD为交流地，T₁源极为v_s，T₂带符号基流i_b2定义为流入基极的增量；Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e。漏极/基极节点给i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d)，输出节点给(v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0，源节点给v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D。再用i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s)，得到有限参数下的一般增益。
text.en: With V_DD at AC ground, let v_s be the T₁ source voltage and define signed incremental i_b2 entering the T₂ base. Set Z_b=r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e. Drain/base KCL gives i_b2=−i_D/(1+Z_b/R_d); output KCL gives (v_o−v_s)/R₂+β₂i_b2=0; source KCL gives v_s/R₁+(v_s−v_o)/R₂=i_D. Combining these with i_D=g_m1(v_i−v_s) gives the finite-parameter gain.

title.zh: 用跨级环路增益核对“深度”条件
title.en: Check depth using the interstage loop gain

text.zh: 把源极局部退化吸收到前向通道，令a=m/(1+m)、T_global=aD。一般式可严格重写为下式。T_global≫1时趋于考试答案1+r；而T_global≤D，所以跨级环路足够深本身要求D很大，源极电流的加载修正随之变小。不是只检查g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1就足够。
text.en: Absorb local source degeneration into the forward path and set a=m/(1+m), T_global=aD. The general gain rewrites exactly as below. For T_global≫1 it approaches the exam result 1+r. Since T_global≤D, deep interstage feedback itself requires large D, making the source-current loading correction small. Merely checking g_m1R₁(1+D)≫1 is insufficient.

steps.formula: a=\frac{m}{1+m};\quad T_{\rm global}=aD;\qquad G=\frac{a+T_{\rm global}(1+r)}{1+T_{\rm global}};\qquad (1+r)-G=\frac{1+r-a}{1+T_{\rm global}}

title.zh: 拓展检查：仅增大MOS互导的极限
title.en: Further check: increasing MOS transconductance alone

text.zh: 若只令g_m1→∞而D保持有限，会得到1+rD/(1+D)，其中保留了源极电流加载。这个结果描述v_gs1很小的局部极限，不能当成“跨级全局深反馈”的替代答案。若需评估实际器件误差，使用一般有限参数式；题目没有给数值参数，不据此虚构数值增益。
text.en: If only g_m1→∞ while D stays finite, gain becomes 1+rD/(1+D), retaining source-current loading. This is a local small-v_gs1 limit, not a replacement for the deep global-feedback answer. Use the general finite-parameter expression to assess a real device’s error. No numerical gain is invented because the problem supplies no device values.

answer.zh: 按本题跨级深度负反馈近似，A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁，为同相增益。条件为跨级环路T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1；仅g_m1很大不等于满足此条件。有限参数加载修正见推导。
answer.en: Under the requested deep interstage negative-feedback approximation, A_vf≈1+R₂/R₁, a noninverting gain. The condition is T_global=[g_m1R₁/(1+g_m1R₁)]·β₂/[1+(r_be2+(β₂+1)R_e)/R_d]≫1; large g_m1 alone does not establish it. See the derivation for finite-parameter loading corrections.

pitfalls.zh: 考试主线用题设跨级深反馈条件，不要用仅g_m1→∞的有限D极限替代它。
pitfalls.en: Use the stated deep interstage-feedback condition for the exam answer; do not substitute the finite-D limit obtained by g_m1→∞ alone.

pitfalls.zh: MOS栅极电流为零，不代表源极电流恒为零；加载能否忽略要由环路与电流比验证。
pitfalls.en: Zero gate current does not imply zero source current. Check loop gain and current ratios before neglecting loading.

methods.zh: 依据课件第8章第47、70、80页关于1+AF≫1的深反馈定义；独立按原图源极、漏极/基极、T₂发射极及输出节点列MNA，与一般有限参数式交叉核验。再把局部源极退化并入前向，代数上严格重写为[a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global)，证明真正跨级T_global≫1时趋向1+R₂/R₁。有限D、g_m1→∞的加载式仅标为另一极限，不用于替代题设答案。合成参数检查不冒充教材数据；未使用外部标准答案。
methods.en: Used the course slides, chapter 8 slides 47, 70 and 80, defining deep feedback by 1+AF≫1. Independent original-node MNA at source, drain/base, T₂ emitter and output agrees with the general finite-parameter expression. Absorbing local source degeneration into the forward path rewrites it exactly as [a+T_global(1+r)]/(1+T_global), proving convergence to 1+R₂/R₁ for deep interstage T_global≫1. The finite-D, g_m1→∞ loading expression is identified only as a different limit, not substituted for the requested answer. Synthetic checks are not presented as textbook values; no external answer key was used.

assumptions.zh: 中频小信号，两管具有正确偏置并处于放大区；忽略Early效应与沟道长度调制，取r_o/r_ds→∞。考试近似另要求跨级T_global≫1；一般式保留有限g_m1、β₂、r_be2与电阻加载。
assumptions.en: Midband small signal with both devices correctly biased in active operation; r_o/r_ds→∞, neglecting Early effect and channel-length modulation. The exam approximation additionally requires interstage T_global≫1. The general expression retains finite g_m1, β₂, r_be2 and resistor loading.

externalReferences.title: COCOA · Introduction to Feedback (loading and return-ratio analysis)

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 先高通分压，再乘同相增益
title.en: High-pass division followed by noninverting gain

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题10.2.3所示为一阶高通滤波器电路，设A为理想运放，试推导电路的传递函数，并画出其幅频响应波特图，求−3 dB截止角频率ω_L。
statement.en: Figure 10.2.3 is a first-order high-pass filter. With ideal op amp A, derive its transfer function, draw its magnitude Bode plot and find the −3 dB cutoff angular frequency ω_L.

alt.zh: 输入v_i经串联电容C接运放同相端，同相端经R接地；反相端经R₁接地、经R_f接输出v_o。
alt.en: Input v_i reaches the noninverting input through series C, with R from that input to ground. The inverting input connects through R₁ to ground and R_f to output v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 复阻抗分压；理想运放虚短/虚断；同相放大；−3 dB定义。
prerequisites.en: Complex-impedance division; ideal op-amp input conditions; noninverting gain; the −3 dB definition.

recognition.zh: 电容在输入串联支路，低频时隔断信号。先求同相端v_p，再求运放比例，不能把R误当作R₁。
recognition.en: Series input C blocks low-frequency signals. Find v_p first, then the amplifier gain; R and R₁ are different components.

text.zh: 运放输入电流为零，同相端只由串联C、对地R分压决定。
text.en: Zero op-amp input current leaves a series C and shunt R divider.

title.zh: 同相放大与总传递函数

text.zh: 反相节点电压等于同相节点，R₁与R_f的电流相等。定义高频通带增益A₀=1+R_f/R₁。
text.en: The inverting and noninverting voltages are equal; R₁ and R_f carry equal currents. Define high-frequency passband gain A₀=1+R_f/R₁.

title.zh: 幅频、截止频率和波特图

text.zh: 幅值从直流0趋向高频A₀。截止处幅值为通带的1/√2，约低3.0103 dB。低频渐近线斜率+20 dB/十倍频，高频水平于20log₁₀A₀。附图纵轴减去了通带分贝值。
text.en: Magnitude rises from zero at DC to A₀ at high frequency. At cutoff it is A₀/√2, about 3.0103 dB below passband. The low-frequency asymptote rises at +20 dB/decade; the high-frequency level is 20log₁₀A₀. The plot subtracts the passband dB level.

answer.zh: A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC)，ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s。低频+20 dB/十倍频，高频增益1+R_f/R₁，截止点相对通带−3.0103 dB。
answer.en: A_v(s)=(1+R_f/R₁)sRC/(1+sRC), ω_L=1/(RC) rad/s. The low-frequency slope is +20 dB/decade; high-frequency gain is 1+R_f/R₁, with cutoff 3.0103 dB below passband.

pitfalls.zh: ω_L是角频率；若求Hz需再除2π。
pitfalls.en: ω_L is angular frequency; divide by 2π for Hz.

pitfalls.zh: −3 dB相对通带增益，而非固定输出增益−3 dB。
pitfalls.en: The −3 dB level is relative to passband, not an absolute gain of −3 dB.

methods.zh: 从原图分别列同相端jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0、反相端v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0及v_n=v_p，直接数值解节点，在归一化频率0.01、0.1、1、10、100处与传递函数一致；截止处归一化模平方恰为1/2；直流和高频极限相符。
methods.en: Independently solved the original noninverting-node equation jωC(v_p−v_i)+v_p/R=0, inverting-node equation v_n/R₁+(v_n−v_o)/R_f=0 and v_n=v_p. Direct node solutions at normalized frequencies 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 and 100 agree with the transfer function; normalized magnitude squared is exactly 1/2 at cutoff, and both endpoint limits agree.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放线性负反馈、零输入电流、无限开环增益；R、R₁、R_f、C均为正，忽略真实运放带宽限制。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, zero input current and infinite open-loop gain; positive R, R₁, R_f and C. Real op-amp bandwidth limits are excluded.

alt.zh: 一阶高通归一化幅频波特图；纵轴相对通带增益，横轴ω/ω_L。
alt.en: Normalized high-pass Bode magnitude relative to passband gain, versus ω/ω_L.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 按储能元件和连接判断阶数
title.en: Determine order from storage elements and connections

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设A为理想运放，试写出图题10.3.4所示电路的传递函数，指出这是一个什么类型的滤波电路。
statement.en: With ideal op amp A, write the transfer function of Fig. 10.3.4 and identify the filter type.

alt.zh: v_i经R₁、电容C串联接运放反相端；反相端经R_f接输出，同相端接地。
alt.en: Input v_i passes through series R₁ and C to the inverting input. R_f connects that input to the output; the noninverting input is grounded.

prerequisites.zh: 反相运放；输入复阻抗；低频和高频极限。
prerequisites.en: Inverting op amp; complex input impedance; low/high-frequency limits.

recognition.zh: 输入阻抗是R₁+1/(sC)，不是并联。题目位于高阶滤波章节，但本图只有一个独立储能电容，传递函数是一阶。
recognition.en: Input impedance is R₁+1/(sC), not a parallel combination. Although placed in the higher-order-filter section, this figure has one independent capacitor and a first-order transfer function.

text.zh: 虚地v_n=0，运放输入电流为零；输入串联支路电流全部流过R_f。
text.en: The inverting node is at virtual ground, v_n=0, with zero op-amp input current. All input-branch current flows through R_f.

text.zh: 分子在s=0有零点，分母为一次式。直流被隔断，高频时电容短路而恢复普通反相比例放大。
text.en: There is a zero at s=0 and a first-order denominator. DC is blocked; at high frequency C becomes a short, recovering an ordinary inverting amplifier.

title.en: Check filter type using endpoint limits

text.zh: 直流增益0，高频增益−R_f/R₁，故为反相一阶高通，R_f决定通带增益，R₁C决定截止频率。
text.en: DC gain is zero and high-frequency gain is −R_f/R₁. It is therefore an inverting first-order high-pass filter. R_f sets passband gain while R₁C sets cutoff.

answer.zh: A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁)，是一阶反相高通滤波电路；ω_L=1/(R₁C)。
answer.en: A_v(s)=−sCR_f/(1+sCR₁), an inverting first-order high-pass filter, with ω_L=1/(R₁C).

pitfalls.zh: 不能根据章节名称直接断言本题是二阶滤波。
pitfalls.en: Do not infer second order from the chapter heading.

pitfalls.zh: R₁与C串联，不能把输入阻抗写成R₁∥1/(sC)。
pitfalls.en: R₁ and C are in series; input impedance is not R₁∥1/(sC).

methods.zh: 独立保留R₁/C之间节点v_x：列(v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0、−jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0，并与传递函数做多频点复数对照；单极点−1/(R₁C)位于左半平面，直流0和高频−R_f/R₁均回代成立。
methods.en: Retained the original intermediate node v_x between R₁ and C and independently solved (v_x−v_i)/R₁+jωCv_x=0 and −jωCv_x−v_o/R_f=0. Complex solutions agree across multiple frequencies. The sole pole −1/(R₁C) is in the left half-plane; DC zero and high-frequency gain −R_f/R₁ both check.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放线性负反馈、正电阻电容、零初始条件的拉普拉斯传递函数。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, positive resistors/capacitor and zero-initial-condition Laplace transfer function.

title.zh: 先比较v₂−v₁，再沿交点画输出
title.en: Compare v₂−v₁ and switch at each intersection

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题10.8.2a所示，其输入电压的波形如图题10.8.2b所示，已知输出电压v_o的最大值为±10 V，运放是理想的，试画出输出电压v_o的波形。
statement.en: The circuit and its input waveforms are shown in Fig. 10.8.2(a) and (b). The output limits are ±10 V and the op amp is ideal. Draw output waveform v_o.

alt.zh: v₁接反相端、v₂接同相端，各有5.1 kΩ对地电阻；输出负载5.1 kΩ。图b中v₁先于v₂，起点v₁=0且v₂<0，两条近似同幅正弦曲线依次相交，未给数值幅值、周期或相位差。
alt.en: v₁ drives the inverting input and v₂ the noninverting input, each with 5.1 kΩ to ground; load is 5.1 kΩ. In Fig. (b), v₁ leads v₂, initially v₁=0 and v₂<0. The roughly equal-amplitude sinusoidal sketches cross repeatedly; no numerical amplitudes, period or phase difference are specified.

prerequisites.zh: 理想比较器；同相/反相输入符号；两信号大小比较。
prerequisites.en: Ideal comparators; input polarities; comparison of two signal levels.

recognition.zh: 这是开环比较器，不能套用虚短。输出符号由同相端减反相端决定，即v₂−v₁。
recognition.en: This is an open-loop comparator, so virtual-short analysis does not apply. Output sign follows noninverting minus inverting input, v₂−v₁.

text.zh: 理想运放无输入电流，5.1 kΩ对地电阻不改变理想电压源给定的输入。输出在题给±10 V间切换。
text.en: The ideal op amp draws no input current. The grounded 5.1 kΩ resistors do not change input voltages imposed by ideal sources. Output switches between the specified ±10 V limits.

steps.formula: v_2>v_1\Rightarrow v_o=+10\,\mathrm V;\qquad v_2<v_1\Rightarrow v_o=-10\,\mathrm V

text.zh: 按时间从左向右把输入交点记为t₁、t₂、t₃。起始v₂<v₁，输出−10 V；第一交点后v₂>v₁，输出+10 V；第二交点后回−10 V；第三交点后再+10 V。附图是定性重绘，交点定义切换时刻，不添加原题没有给出的时间、相位数值。
text.en: Label the successive input intersections t₁, t₂, t₃. Initially v₂<v₁, giving −10 V; after t₁, v₂>v₁ gives +10 V; after t₂ output returns to −10 V; after t₃ it returns to +10 V. The attached reconstruction is qualitative: intersections define switching times, without adding numerical time or phase data absent from the problem.

title.zh: 交点及理想模型的边界

text.zh: 恰好v₁=v₂时，理想无偏置比较器不唯一规定输出电平；画竖直跳变即可，不应硬指定为0 V。真实器件会受输入失调、延迟等影响，题目不要求这些参数。
text.en: At exactly v₁=v₂, the ideal zero-offset comparator does not uniquely determine an output level. Draw a vertical transition rather than assigning 0 V. Real offsets and delays lie outside the stated problem.

answer.zh: v₂>v₁时v_o=+10 V，v₂<v₁时v_o=−10 V；图示初始为−10 V，之后在相邻输入交点依次切换为+10、−10、+10 V。
answer.en: v_o=+10 V for v₂>v₁ and −10 V for v₂<v₁. The shown waveform starts at −10 V, then switches to +10, −10 and +10 V at successive input intersections.

pitfalls.zh: 反相端接v₁，不能按v₁−v₂决定输出正负。
pitfalls.en: v₁ is the inverting input; do not determine output sign from v₁−v₂.

pitfalls.zh: 未给数值相位或周期，只能依据交点给出定性波形。
pitfalls.en: Numerical phase and period are unspecified; the waveform is defined qualitatively by intersections.

methods.zh: 逐段对照原图两条输入曲线的上下关系，并在每个交点左右检查v₂−v₁的符号。输出电平严格采用题给±10 V，不误用电源±12 V；原图起点及交点顺序与定性输出一致。
methods.en: Checked which original input curve is higher in each interval and the sign of v₂−v₁ on both sides of every intersection. Output levels use the specified ±10 V rather than ±12 V supply rails; initial sign and switching order match the original sketch.

assumptions.zh: 理想开环比较器，输入为题给理想电压波形，输出限幅±10 V；忽略传播延时与失调，输入相等时不唯一。
assumptions.en: Ideal open-loop comparator driven by the given ideal voltage waveforms, output limited to ±10 V. Delay and offset are neglected; equal inputs do not determine a unique level.

alt.zh: 定性重绘输入与输出：t₁、t₂、t₃为输入交点，输出依次−10、+10、−10、+10 V；未假设原题未给的数值相位。
alt.en: Qualitative reconstruction: t₁,t₂,t₃ are input intersections; output levels are −10,+10,−10,+10 V. No numerical source phase is assumed.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 正反馈产生两个门限：随输出状态分别求
title.en: Positive feedback gives two state-dependent thresholds

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设运放为理想器件，试求图题10.8.4所示电压比较器的门限电压，并画出它的传输特性（图中V_Z=9 V）。
statement.en: With an ideal op amp, find the comparator thresholds and draw the transfer characteristic for Fig. 10.8.4, where V_Z=9 V.

alt.zh: 反相端接地；v_i经R₁=5 kΩ到同相节点v_p；输出v_o经R₂=15 kΩ反馈到v_p。运放输出经R₃=5 kΩ到限幅后的v_o，双向稳压管将v_o限制在±V_Z=±9 V。
alt.en: Inverting input is grounded. Input v_i reaches noninverting node v_p through R₁=5 kΩ; v_o returns through R₂=15 kΩ. The op-amp output reaches the clamped output v_o through R₃=5 kΩ; the bidirectional limiter holds v_o at ±V_Z=±9 V.

prerequisites.zh: 正反馈比较器；节点KCL；稳态一致性；滞回方向。
prerequisites.en: Positive-feedback comparators; nodal KCL; state consistency; hysteresis direction.

recognition.zh: 输出返回同相端，所以有记忆、两个门限。先固定输出为+9 V或−9 V，再令v_p=v_n=0求翻转边界；不要先套线性运放虚短。
recognition.en: Output returns to the noninverting input, producing memory and two thresholds. Fix output at +9 or −9 V, then set v_p=v_n=0 only at the switching boundary. Do not apply a linear virtual short throughout.

text.zh: 输入电流为零，v_p由v_i与限幅后v_o加权决定。反馈取样点在R₃之后，因此门限用±9 V。
text.en: Zero input current makes v_p the weighted average of v_i and the clamped v_o. Feedback samples after R₃, so thresholds use ±9 V.

text.zh: 此前输出为低电平−9 V。输入上升至v_p=0时满足3v_i−9=0，于+3 V跳到+9 V。
text.en: Starting from low output −9 V, increasing input reaches v_p=0 when 3v_i−9=0. At +3 V output switches upward to +9 V.

text.zh: 此前输出为高电平+9 V。输入下降至3v_i+9=0，于−3 V跳到−9 V。两个门限之间两种状态都可自洽，取决于历史。
text.en: Starting from high output +9 V, decreasing input reaches 3v_i+9=0 and switches down at −3 V. Both output states are consistent between thresholds, so history determines the state.

text.zh: 上升扫描：保持−9 V到+3 V后跳到+9 V。下降扫描：保持+9 V到−3 V后跳到−9 V。v_i>3 V唯一高电平，v_i<−3 V唯一低电平；中间保持先前状态。
text.en: Increasing sweep: stay at −9 V until +3 V, then jump to +9 V. Decreasing sweep: stay at +9 V until −3 V, then jump to −9 V. Above +3 V only high output is consistent; below −3 V only low output is consistent; between thresholds retain the previous state.

answer.zh: 同相滞回比较器；上门限V_T+=+3 V，下门限V_T−=−3 V，滞回宽度6 V。输出±9 V；上升输入在+3 V由低跳高，下降输入在−3 V由高跳低。
answer.en: Noninverting Schmitt comparator: upper threshold +3 V, lower threshold −3 V, hysteresis width 6 V and output ±9 V. Rising input switches low-to-high at +3 V; falling input switches high-to-low at −3 V.

pitfalls.zh: 门限来自±9 V限幅输出，而非未给出的运放饱和电压。
pitfalls.en: Use the ±9 V clamped output, not an unspecified op-amp saturation voltage.

pitfalls.zh: −3<V_i<3 V时输出与先前状态有关，不是一个单值线性函数。
pitfalls.en: For −3<V_i<3 V, output depends on history; it is not a single-valued linear function.

methods.zh: 独立逐状态检查比较器一致性：v_o=+9时v_p>0要求v_i>−3；v_o=−9时v_p<0要求v_i<+3。边界分别−3和+3 V；以离散上升/下降输入扫描，检查每个稳态同时满足节点KCL、限幅及比较器符号，得到图示滞回方向。
methods.en: Independently checked state consistency: v_o=+9 requires v_p>0, hence v_i>−3; v_o=−9 requires v_p<0, hence v_i<+3. Boundaries are −3 and +3 V. Discrete rising/falling input sweeps satisfy node KCL, clamping and comparator sign in every stable state, reproducing the plotted hysteresis direction.

assumptions.zh: 按图中双向限幅±V_Z=±9 V建模，不另外加未给出的正向压降；理想比较器零输入电流，忽略延时，门限等值时为切换边界。
assumptions.en: Use the drawn bidirectional clamp ±V_Z=±9 V without adding an unspecified forward drop. Ideal comparator has zero input current and no delay; exact threshold equality is the switching boundary.

alt.zh: 同相滞回特性：上升输入在+3 V由−9跳到+9 V，下降输入在−3 V由+9跳到−9 V。
alt.en: Noninverting hysteresis: rising input switches −9 to +9 V at +3 V; falling input switches +9 to −9 V at −3 V.

title.zh: 开环增益要除以真正的输入压差
title.en: Divide by the actual input difference

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题2.1.1所示电路中，假设v_i=0时，有v_o=0；而当v_i=20 mV时，测得v_o=4 V。求该运算放大器的开环电压增益A_vo。
statement.en: In the circuit of Figure 2.1.1, assume v_o=0 when v_i=0. With v_i=20 mV, the measured output is v_o=4 V. Find the op amp open-loop voltage gain A_vo.

alt.zh: R₁=1 MΩ与接地R₂=1 kΩ将v_i分压后送同相端v_P；反相端v_N接地，输出接R_L。
alt.en: R₁=1 MΩ and shunt R₂=1 kΩ divide v_i into v_P; v_N is grounded and R_L loads the output.

prerequisites.zh: 分压；开环增益定义；输入电流可忽略。
prerequisites.en: Voltage division; the open-loop gain definition; negligible input current.

recognition.zh: 没有输出回接输入的反馈通路。先算v_P−v_N，不能把外部20 mV直接当成运放输入压差，也不能在开环中套用虚短。
recognition.en: There is no output-to-input feedback path. Calculate v_P−v_N first; the external 20 mV is not the op amp input difference, and an open-loop amplifier does not justify a virtual short.

text.zh: 忽略运放输入电流，R₁与R₂构成串联分压；反相端接地。
text.en: With negligible input current, R₁ and R₂ form an unloaded divider; the inverting input is grounded.

text.zh: 题设零输入时零输出，排除了本次测量中的直流输出偏移；输出4 V按线性开环关系计算。
text.en: Zero output at zero input removes a DC output offset from this measurement; the measured 4 V is interpreted through the linear open-loop relation.

answer.en: A_vo=200200≈2.002×10⁵ V/V; the op amp input difference is only about 19.98 μV.

pitfalls.zh: 4 V/20 mV=200是整个输入分压器加运放的增益，不是开环运放增益。
pitfalls.en: 4 V/20 mV=200 is the gain including the input divider, not the op amp open-loop gain.

pitfalls.zh: 此题只让增益有限，仍按默认模型忽略输入电流；若另计有限输入电阻，R₂须与其并联。
pitfalls.en: Only the gain is treated as finite here; input current is neglected under the default model. A specified finite input resistance would load R₂ in parallel.

methods.zh: 独立检查输入节点KCL：(v_i−v_P)/R₁=v_P/R₂，再代回v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N)。
methods.en: Independently check input-node KCL, (v_i−v_P)/R₁=v_P/R₂, and reconstruct v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N).

assumptions.zh: 输入电阻无限大、输出处于线性开环区、输出4 V未被电源或负载限幅；题目未给有限输入电阻或电源限制。
assumptions.en: Infinite input resistance and linear open-loop operation; neither supply nor load clips the measured 4 V. No finite input resistance or supply limit is specified.

completionNote.zh: 整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。
completionNote.en: Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

title.zh: 把输出摆幅折算到输入压差
title.en: Refer output swing back to the input difference

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图2.1.3所示，运放的开环电压增益A_vo=10⁶，输入电阻r_i=10⁹ Ω，电源电压V_+=+10 V、V_−=−10 V。当运放输出电压的极限值为电源电压时，求线性区输入压差(v_P−v_N)的范围，以及对应其极限值的输入电流i_i。
statement.en: For the circuit in body Figure 2.1.3, the op amp has open-loop gain A_vo=10⁶, input resistance r_i=10⁹ Ω, and supplies V_+=+10 V and V_−=−10 V. When the output limits equal the supply voltages, find the linear-region range of v_P−v_N and the input current i_i at those limits.

alt.zh: 正文图2.1.3：两输入端间有输入电阻r_i，输出模型为受控电压源A_vo(v_P−v_N)，另画出r_o及正负供电。
alt.en: Body Figure 2.1.3: r_i lies between the inputs; the output is modeled by controlled voltage source A_vo(v_P−v_N), with r_o and both supplies shown.

prerequisites.zh: 开环线性关系；欧姆定律；微伏与飞安单位。
prerequisites.en: Open-loop linear transfer; Ohm’s law; microvolt and femtoampere units.

recognition.zh: 有限开环增益使线性输入范围非常窄。先用输出极限除以A_vo，再用输入压差除以跨接两输入端的r_i。
recognition.en: Finite open-loop gain makes the linear input range very narrow. Divide the output limits by A_vo, then divide the resulting input difference by the resistance between the two inputs.

text.zh: 在线性区v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N)。等号处是线性区与饱和区的交界；严格在线性区时用开区间。
text.en: In the linear region, v_o=A_vo(v_P−v_N). Equality marks the transition to saturation; strictly linear operation uses an open interval.

text.zh: 输入电阻两端承受的是输入差分电压，并非10 V电源电压。电流符号按从P端流向N端取正。
text.en: The input resistance sees the differential input voltage, not the 10 V supply. Define positive current from P to N.

answer.zh: 线性区输入压差的边界为±10 μV；严格线性范围为−10 μV<v_P−v_N<+10 μV。边界输入电流为±10 fA（±0.01 pA）。
answer.en: The input-difference boundaries are ±10 μV; strictly linear operation requires −10 μV<v_P−v_N<+10 μV. The corresponding boundary currents are ±10 fA (±0.01 pA).

pitfalls.zh: 10⁹ Ω是1 GΩ；10 μV/1 GΩ=10 fA，不是10 pA。
pitfalls.en: 10⁹ Ω is 1 GΩ; 10 μV/1 GΩ is 10 fA, not 10 pA.

pitfalls.zh: 有有限增益就不能把差分输入机械地设成零。
pitfalls.en: Finite gain requires a nonzero differential input for a nonzero output.

methods.zh: 分别把±10 μV代回开环传输式得到±10 V，再由i_i r_i恢复相同输入压差。
methods.en: Substitute ±10 μV into the open-loop transfer to obtain ±10 V; reconstruct the same input difference using i_i r_i.

assumptions.zh: 按题设，输出极限等于电源电压；采用正文简化模型，无另外的偏移、共模项、输出负载压降或输出限流。
assumptions.en: The output limits equal the supplies as stated. Use the body’s simplified model without additional offset, common-mode contribution, output-load drop, or current limiting.

completionNote.en: Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

title.zh: 差模与共模分开算，并保留未给的符号

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设某集成运放开环差模电压增益A_vd=10⁵，共模抑制比为80 dB，电源电压V_+=+15 V、V_−=−15 V，输出极限电压±V_om=±14 V。现测得v_P=6.025 mV、v_N=6.055 mV，求此时运放的输出电压。
statement.en: An op amp has open-loop differential gain A_vd=10⁵, common-mode rejection ratio 80 dB, supplies V_+=+15 V and V_−=−15 V, and output limits ±V_om=±14 V. Measured inputs are v_P=6.025 mV and v_N=6.055 mV. Find the output voltage.

prerequisites.zh: v_id=v_P−v_N；v_ic=(v_P+v_N)/2；电压比dB换算；输出叠加。
prerequisites.en: v_id=v_P−v_N; v_ic=(v_P+v_N)/2; voltage-ratio decibels; output superposition.

recognition.zh: 先看两输入之差决定主要输出，再看共模是否能忽略。正文CMRR定义用了绝对值，因此80 dB只确定共模增益大小，不提供其正负。
recognition.en: The input difference sets the main output; then assess the common-mode contribution. The body defines CMRR with an absolute value, so 80 dB specifies common-mode gain magnitude but not its sign.

text.zh: 差模信号为负的30 μV，而共同的直流电平为6.040 mV。
text.en: The differential signal is −30 μV and the common-mode level is 6.040 mV.

text.zh: 正文印刷p22–23/PDF55–56，式(2.1.10)为差模与共模输出叠加，式(2.1.11)定义K_CMR=|A_vd/A_vc|；绝对值不能给出A_vc的符号。
text.en: On printed pp22–23/PDF55–56, equation (2.1.10) adds differential and common-mode outputs, while (2.1.11) defines K_CMR=|A_vd/A_vc|. Its absolute value does not determine the sign of A_vc.

title.zh: 完整条件化输出与工作区

text.zh: 差模输出为−3 V，共模项的绝对值为0.0604 V。若A_vc=+10，输出−2.9396 V；若A_vc=−10，输出−3.0604 V。两种都远未达到±14 V，无饱和。若忽略共模，常用近似为−3 V。
text.en: The differential output is −3 V and the common-mode contribution has magnitude 0.0604 V. A_vc=+10 gives −2.9396 V; A_vc=−10 gives −3.0604 V. Both are well inside ±14 V. Neglecting common mode gives the usual −3 V approximation.

answer.zh: 差模近似v_o≈−3 V。若保留给定有限CMRR，题目未给共模增益符号，不能确定唯一精确值：A_vc=+10时v_o=−2.9396 V；A_vc=−10时v_o=−3.0604 V。均在线性区。
answer.en: The differential-only approximation is v_o≈−3 V. With finite CMRR retained, the common-mode gain sign is unspecified, so no unique exact value follows: v_o=−2.9396 V for A_vc=+10, or −3.0604 V for A_vc=−10. Both remain linear.

pitfalls.zh: 共模抑制比的分贝值用20 log₁₀，不用10 log₁₀。
pitfalls.en: A voltage-gain ratio in decibels uses 20 log₁₀, not 10 log₁₀.

pitfalls.zh: 大CMRR不等于共模输出严格为零；也不能从|A_vd/A_vc|擅自选A_vc的正号。
pitfalls.en: Large CMRR does not make the common-mode output exactly zero, and |A_vd/A_vc| does not justify choosing positive A_vc.

pitfalls.zh: 负差模输入产生负输出；不能因为两个输入端都为正而判输出正饱和。
pitfalls.en: A negative differential input gives the dominant negative output; two positive input voltages do not imply positive saturation.

methods.zh: 目视正文式(2.1.10)与绝对值定义(2.1.11)，分别重建A_vc=±10两种输出，并逐一核对±14 V限制。
methods.en: Visually verify body equations (2.1.10) and absolute-value definition (2.1.11), reconstruct both A_vc=±10 outputs, and check each against ±14 V.

assumptions.zh: 准静态线性叠加、无未给定失调项。CMRR只给增益大小比；未给A_vc的极性。−3 V仅为忽略共模项的近似，非唯一精确解。
assumptions.en: Quasistatic linear superposition with no unspecified offset. CMRR gives a magnitude ratio only; common-mode gain polarity is absent. −3 V is the differential-only approximation, not a uniquely determined exact answer.

title.zh: 增益、电流与理想输入功率分开核算
title.en: Check gain, branch currents, and ideal input power

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 同相放大电路如图题2.3.1所示。设v_s=1 V，（1）求闭环电压增益A_v=v_o/v_s、输出电压v_o、各支路电流i_i、i₁、i₂、i_L和i_o；（2）求电流增益A_i=i_L/i_i和功率增益A_p=P_L/P_i；（3）在保持输入电压和闭环电压增益不变的情况下，要求流过R₂的电流为100 μA，请再求R₁、R₂的值。
statement.en: For the noninverting amplifier in Figure 2.3.1, let v_s=1 V. (1) Find closed-loop voltage gain A_v=v_o/v_s, output voltage v_o, and branch currents i_i, i₁, i₂, i_L, and i_o. (2) Find current gain A_i=i_L/i_i and power gain A_p=P_L/P_i. (3) Keep input voltage and closed-loop gain unchanged, but require 100 μA through R₂. Find the new R₁ and R₂.

alt.zh: 同相端接v_s，R₁=1 kΩ反相端接地，R₂=9 kΩ输出反馈到反相端，R_L=1 kΩ输出接地；所有电流箭头均保留。
alt.en: v_s drives the noninverting input. R₁=1 kΩ connects the inverting input to ground, R₂=9 kΩ provides feedback, and R_L=1 kΩ loads the output; all current arrows are retained.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放负反馈；同相增益；KCL；功率。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op amp with negative feedback; noninverting gain; KCL; power.

recognition.zh: 先由虚短得反相端1 V，再沿R₁、R₂及R_L算电流。运放输出电流包含反馈电流和负载电流。
recognition.en: Set the inverting node to 1 V, then calculate currents through R₁, R₂, and R_L. Op amp output current supplies both the feedback path and the load.

text.zh: 同相端为1 V；理想负反馈使反相端也为1 V，且输入电流为零。
text.en: The noninverting node is at 1 V; ideal negative feedback places the inverting node at 1 V with zero input current.

title.en: (1) Branch currents in the original directions

text.zh: i₁向下流过R₁，i₂从输出向左流过R₂，i_L向下流过负载，i_o由运放向右流出。两次KCL都要闭合。
text.en: i₁ flows downward through R₁, i₂ leftward through R₂, i_L downward through the load, and i_o outward from the op amp. Check KCL at both nodes.

title.zh: (2) 理想模型没有有限电流、功率增益
title.en: (2) No finite ideal current or power gain

text.zh: 负载功率为100 mW，而信号源输入电流及输入功率均为零。两个增益的分母为零，因而没有有限实数值；通常以理想极限趋于无穷大表示。输出能量来自运放电源。
text.en: Load power is 100 mW, while source input current and input power are zero. The two ratios have zero denominators and no finite real value; they are conventionally described as unbounded ideal limits. Output energy comes from the op amp supplies.

steps.formula: P_L=\frac{v_o^2}{R_L}=0.10\,\mathrm W,\qquad P_i=v_si_i=0,\qquad A_i,\ A_p\ \text{unbounded in the ideal limit}

title.zh: (3) 保持比例，按目标电流定阻值
title.en: (3) Preserve the ratio and set the current

text.zh: 输出仍为10 V、反相端仍为1 V。R₂两端9 V对应100 μA，所以R₂=90 kΩ；R₁同流100 μA且压降1 V，所以R₁=10 kΩ。
text.en: The output remains 10 V and the inverting node remains 1 V. The 9 V across R₂ at 100 μA requires 90 kΩ; R₁ carries the same current at 1 V, requiring 10 kΩ.

steps.formula: R_2=\frac{9\,\mathrm V}{100\,\mathrm{\mu A}}=90\,\mathrm{k\Omega},\qquad R_1=\frac{1\,\mathrm V}{100\,\mathrm{\mu A}}=10\,\mathrm{k\Omega}

answer.zh: (1) A_v=10，v_o=10 V；按原图方向i_i=0、i₁=i₂=1 mA、i_L=10 mA、i_o=11 mA。(2) A_i与A_p无有限值，理想极限无界；P_L=100 mW，P_i=0。(3) R₁=10 kΩ、R₂=90 kΩ。
answer.en: (1) A_v=10 and v_o=10 V. In the original directions, i_i=0, i₁=i₂=1 mA, i_L=10 mA, and i_o=11 mA. (2) A_i and A_p have no finite value and are unbounded in the ideal limit; P_L=100 mW and P_i=0. (3) R₁=10 kΩ and R₂=90 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: 同相增益为1+R₂/R₁；输出电流为11 mA，不能只报负载电流10 mA。
pitfalls.en: Noninverting gain is 1+R₂/R₁; output current is 11 mA, not just the 10 mA load current.

pitfalls.zh: 电流增益的输入电流是同相信号端的i_i，不是R₁或R₂中的电流。
pitfalls.en: The input current in A_i is the signal-input current i_i, not the current through R₁ or R₂.

pitfalls.zh: 理想无穷大功率增益不表示输出能量来自零输入功率，供电电源提供能量。
pitfalls.en: Unbounded ideal power gain does not create energy from zero input power; the supplies provide it.

methods.zh: 独立求解反相节点KCL与v_N=v_P，再核对i₂=i₁及i_o=i_L+i₂；新电阻同时检查100 μA目标与增益10。
methods.en: Independently solve inverting-node KCL with v_N=v_P, check i₂=i₁ and i_o=i_L+i₂, and verify both the 100 μA target and gain 10 with the new resistors.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放，负反馈线性工作，电源及输出驱动能力足以提供10 V和11 mA。电流与功率增益在理想模型中为无界极限，不能当作有限除法结果。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with sufficient supply headroom and drive for 10 V and 11 mA. Current and power gains are unbounded ideal limits, not finite quotients.

completionNote.zh: 整道题所有小问均已独立核验；涉及欠定条件时已给出完整条件化结论。
completionNote.en: Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

title.zh: 负载限流先算总输出电流，再画削顶
title.en: Use total output current to find clipping

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 同相放大电路如图题2.3.3所示，除输出端最大电流为±40 mA外，运放其他特性如同理想运放。已知运放的电源电压为±15 V，v_i=0.2 sin ωt V。（1）当R_L=500 Ω时，求v_o波形；（2）当R_L=100 Ω时，再求v_o波形；（3）运放选用μA741（输出端最大电流为±40 mA），v_i正弦波频率为100 Hz，用SPICE分别绘出（1）和（2）情况下的v_i和v_o波形。
statement.en: In the noninverting amplifier of Figure 2.3.3, the op amp is ideal except for maximum output current ±40 mA. Its supplies are ±15 V and v_i=0.2 sin ωt V. (1) Find v_o for R_L=500 Ω. (2) Repeat for R_L=100 Ω. (3) Select a μA741 (maximum output current ±40 mA), set the input frequency to 100 Hz, and use SPICE to plot v_i and v_o for both load cases.

alt.zh: 同相端接v_i，反相端经R₁=1 kΩ接地、经R₂=59 kΩ接输出，输出经R_L接地。
alt.en: v_i drives the noninverting input; R₁=1 kΩ grounds the inverting input, R₂=59 kΩ provides feedback, and R_L loads the output.

prerequisites.zh: 同相增益；总输出电流；电流限幅；SPICE模型边界。
prerequisites.en: Noninverting gain; total output current; current limiting; SPICE model boundaries.

recognition.zh: 先画未限幅的12 V正弦，再同时检查15 V电压边界与40 mA电流边界。反馈支路也消耗输出电流，必须与负载并联计入。
recognition.en: Start with the unclipped 12 V sine, then check both the 15 V voltage limit and 40 mA current limit. Include the feedback path in parallel with the load because it also draws output current.

title.zh: 统一的增益与限流边界

text.zh: 线性增益为60。输入电流为零时，无论是否限流，R₁与R₂都是从输出到地的串联60 kΩ支路；因此限流时仍可求v_N=v_o/60，但不能令v_N=v_i。
text.en: The linear gain is 60. With zero input current, R₁ and R₂ remain a series 60 kΩ path from output to ground even during current limiting. Thus v_N=v_o/60 remains valid, but v_N=v_i does not.

text.zh: 12 V峰值时负载电流24 mA、反馈电流0.2 mA，总计24.2 mA，小于40 mA；12 V也小于15 V。
text.en: At a 12 V peak, the load draws 24 mA and the feedback path 0.2 mA, totaling 24.2 mA, below 40 mA. The 12 V peak is also below 15 V.

text.zh: 未限幅时需要120.2 mA，超出40 mA。严格题设模型的平顶高度为3.993344 V，常忽略反馈支路而近似成4 V。输入幅度超过66.5557 mV时进入限流。
text.en: The unclipped demand is 120.2 mA, exceeding 40 mA. The exact textbook-model plateau is 3.993344 V; 4 V is the approximation that neglects feedback current. Current limiting begins when input magnitude exceeds 66.5557 mV.

steps.formula: V_{\mathrm{lim}}=\frac{0.040}{1/100+1/60000}=\frac{2400}{601}=3.993344426\,\mathrm V;\quad v_o(t)=\begin{cases}12\sin\omega t,&|12\sin\omega t|\le V_{\mathrm{lim}}\\V_{\mathrm{lim}}\operatorname{sgn}(\sin\omega t),&|12\sin\omega t|>V_{\mathrm{lim}}\end{cases}

title.zh: (3) 已运行的100 Hz SPICE波形

text.zh: 已实际运行ngspice 47，保留网表、数值数据及两种负载的输入/输出图。自写严格±40 mA模型与上面分段式的最大误差小于3 μV：500 Ω输出约±12 V，100 Ω输出±3.993344 V。厂商μA741宏模型另作器件对照。
text.en: ngspice 47 was actually run; netlists, numerical data, and input/output plots for both loads are retained. A self-authored strict ±40 mA model agrees with the piecewise expression within 3 μV: about ±12 V at 500 Ω and ±3.993344 V at 100 Ω. Manufacturer μA741 macro-model runs provide a separate device comparison.

steps.formula: v_i(t)=0.2\sin(200\pi t)\,\mathrm V,\qquad T=10\,\mathrm{ms};\quad \text{transient: }0\text{–}40\,\mathrm{ms},\ \Delta t_{\max}=2\,\mathrm{\mu s}

title.zh: (3) μA741宏模型的限流参数不能混同

text.zh: TI官方SLOJ138中的UA741.301用VLP/VLN=25，100 Ω下仿真平顶约±2.55622 V。为对照题目的40 mA设定，仅把这两个控制参数改成40的研究副本得到约±4.05367 V，实测软限流约±40.6043 mA；它不是严格40 mA硬限幅。500 Ω时两个厂商模型都约为−11.98878到+11.99954 V。题设(1)(2)的精确结论仍采用严格40 mA模型；器件宏模型的有限带宽、偏置和软限流解释了细小差异。
text.en: TI SLOJ138 supplies UA741.301 with VLP/VLN=25; its simulated 100 Ω plateaus are about ±2.55622 V. A research copy changing only those two controls to 40 gives about ±4.05367 V and measured soft limiting near ±40.6043 mA, rather than an exact 40 mA hard limit. At 500 Ω, both manufacturer variants span approximately −11.98878 to +11.99954 V. The exact answers to (1) and (2) still use the strict 40 mA model; finite bandwidth, bias, and soft limiting account for macro-model differences.

answer.zh: (1) v_o=12 sin ωt V，无削顶。(2) v_o为12 sin ωt在±3.993344 V处对称削平，约±4 V。(3) 100 Hz的SPICE网表、数据与输入/输出波形已提供；严格40 mA模型复现上述结果。μA741厂商宏模型的原始25 mA参数版与改40控制参数的软限流版已另图对照，不能把其平顶当作题设精确硬边界。
answer.en: (1) v_o=12 sin ωt V without clipping. (2) Clip 12 sin ωt symmetrically at ±3.993344 V, approximately ±4 V. (3) Executed 100 Hz SPICE netlists, data, and input/output plots are supplied; the strict 40 mA model reproduces these answers. Separate plots compare the original manufacturer model with 25 mA controls and the version with controls set to 40; their soft-limit plateaus are not the exact textbook hard boundary.

pitfalls.zh: i_o不是只有v_o/R_L，还包括输出反馈电阻支路的电流。
pitfalls.en: i_o includes the feedback-resistor path as well as v_o/R_L.

pitfalls.zh: 进入限流后虚短失效；电阻分压关系v_N=v_o/60仍然成立。
pitfalls.en: A virtual short fails in current limiting; the resistor-divider relation v_N=v_o/60 still holds.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把官方UA741宏模型的25 mA控制值或改40后的软限流结果，未经说明直接当作题设±40 mA硬限幅。
pitfalls.en: Do not silently equate either the official model’s 25 mA controls or the modified model’s soft limit with the exercise’s strict ±40 mA boundary.

methods.zh: 先独立以输出节点KCL求电流极限，再逐点检查分段波形的线性误差/限流条件及±15 V边界。实际执行6个ngspice瞬态任务，保存全部网表、日志、原始数据，逐样本核验输出节点KCL；严格模型对解析波形最大误差<3 μV。
methods.en: Independently derive the current boundary by output-node KCL, then check the linear-error/current-limit conditions and ±15 V limits pointwise. Execute six ngspice transients and retain every netlist, log, and dataset; verify output KCL sample by sample. The strict model differs from the analytical waveform by <3 μV.

assumptions.zh: (1)(2)为除±40 mA硬限流外的理想运放，供电±15 V。严格SPICE模型采用大跨导1e6 A/V及min/max限流，结果均小于电源边界。(3)TI宏模型原版及仅调整VLP/VLN的研究副本分别记录；其二极管软限流、有限增益/带宽与偏置不属于题设硬限流模型。
assumptions.en: Parts (1) and (2) use an otherwise ideal op amp with strict ±40 mA limiting and ±15 V supplies. The strict SPICE implementation uses large transconductance 1e6 A/V with min/max current clamping; every output stays inside the rails. Part (3) separately records the original TI macro model and a research copy changing only VLP/VLN; their diode soft limiting, finite gain/bandwidth, and bias differ from the textbook hard-limit model.

externalReferences.title: TI UA741 product page and official SLOJ138 PSpice model

alt.zh: 100 Hz实际SPICE：严格±40 mA题设模型在500 Ω与100 Ω负载下的v_i与v_o；分别为12 V正弦与±3.993344 V削顶。
alt.en: Executed 100 Hz SPICE input/output waveforms for the strict ±40 mA textbook model at 500 Ω and 100 Ω: a 12 V sine and clipping at ±3.993344 V, respectively.

alt.zh: 实际SPICE对照严格40 mA题设模型、原TI μA741模型（25控制值）及仅改40控制值的软限流副本；100 Ω的平顶分别约3.993、2.556、4.054 V。
alt.en: Executed SPICE comparison of the strict 40 mA textbook model, original TI μA741 model (25 controls), and soft-limit research copy with 40 controls; 100 Ω plateaus are approximately 3.993, 2.556, and 4.054 V.

instructions.zh: 公开网表不嵌入厂商模型。请从TI下载UA741.301，去末尾Ctrl-Z并另存UA741.lib；若复现实验副本，仅把VLP和VLN两行DC 25改DC 40，另存UA741_40mA.lib。不得称其为厂商原版40 mA模型。
instructions.en: Public netlists do not embed the manufacturer model. Download UA741.301 from TI, remove its terminal Ctrl-Z, and save it as UA741.lib. For the research copy, change only the VLP and VLN DC 25 values to DC 40 and save as UA741_40mA.lib. Do not describe this copy as an original manufacturer 40 mA model.

label.en: Strict 40 mA textbook model · R_L=100 Ω

label.zh: 严格40 mA题设模型 · R_L=500 Ω
label.en: Strict 40 mA textbook model · R_L=500 Ω

label.en: TI research copy, soft limit with 40 controls · R_L=100 Ω

title.zh: 输入分压、同相增益、供电和带载能力
title.en: Input division, gain, supply, and load capability

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 放大电路如图题2.3.4所示。（1）试求电路的电压增益A_v=v_o/v_i和输入电阻R_i；（2）若运放的饱和压降为2 V，要求v_o能在−10～+10 V范围内变化，那么电源电压应为多少？（3）在（2）的基础上，若运放输出端最大电流为±20 mA，且已知输出最大电压时，R₂中的电流为500 μA，那么电路对负载阻值有何要求？
statement.en: For the amplifier in Figure 2.3.4: (1) Find voltage gain A_v=v_o/v_i and input resistance R_i. (2) With 2 V output saturation headroom, what supply voltages allow v_o to span −10 to +10 V? (3) Under (2), the maximum output current is ±20 mA and current through R₂ at maximum output voltage is 500 μA. What requirement must the load resistance satisfy?

alt.zh: v_i经R₃接同相端，同相端经R₄接地；反相端经R₁接地、经R₂反馈至输出。输入电阻由v_i端看入。
alt.en: v_i reaches the noninverting input through R₃ with shunt R₄; R₁ grounds the inverting input and R₂ feeds back from the output. R_i is measured looking into the v_i terminal.

prerequisites.zh: 无载输入分压；同相放大；输出摆幅与电源压差；KCL。
prerequisites.en: Unloaded input division; noninverting gain; supply headroom; KCL.

recognition.zh: R₃、R₄先把输入衰减，R₁、R₂再同相放大。负载能力问题要从总输出电流中扣掉反馈电流。
recognition.en: R₃ and R₄ attenuate the input before R₁ and R₂ provide noninverting gain. Subtract feedback current from total output-current capability to obtain load capacity.

text.zh: 运放同相端不吸收电流，R₃与R₄为纯分压；负反馈运放再放大1+R₂/R₁倍。
text.en: Zero noninverting input current makes R₃–R₄ an unloaded divider; the feedback amplifier then multiplies by 1+R₂/R₁.

text.zh: 输入源的电流只能依次流过R₃与R₄，不能流进运放输入端。
text.en: Source current must pass through R₃ and R₄ in series because none enters the op amp.

text.zh: 正、负输出极限都要离相应电源轨2 V，因此每侧供电的幅值至少12 V。
text.en: Each output extreme must remain 2 V away from its respective rail; each supply magnitude must therefore be at least 12 V.

steps.formula: V_+\ge+12\,\mathrm V,\qquad V_-\le-12\,\mathrm V;\qquad \text{minimum symmetric supplies: }\pm12\,\mathrm V

title.zh: (3) 剩余输出电流供给负载
title.en: (3) Allocate remaining current to the load

text.zh: 在|v_o|=10 V时，反馈支路已占0.5 mA，留给对地电阻负载最多19.5 mA；正负峰值对称。
text.en: At |v_o|=10 V, the feedback branch draws 0.5 mA, leaving at most 19.5 mA for a resistive load to ground; the positive and negative peaks are symmetric.

answer.zh: (1) A_v=(1+R₂/R₁)R₄/(R₃+R₄)，R_i=R₃+R₄。(2) 对称供电最低±12 V。(3) 对地电阻负载R_L≥512.82 Ω；若要求留余量，应取更大值。
answer.en: (1) A_v=(1+R₂/R₁)R₄/(R₃+R₄), and R_i=R₃+R₄. (2) The minimum symmetric supplies are ±12 V. (3) A resistive load to ground requires R_L≥512.82 Ω; a larger value provides margin.

pitfalls.zh: 同相端有R₄对地，因此从v_i端看到的输入电阻不是无穷大。
pitfalls.en: Because R₄ shunts the noninverting node, input resistance at v_i is not infinite.

pitfalls.zh: 10 V输出加2 V饱和压降，对应每侧12 V，双电源总差为24 V。
pitfalls.en: A 10 V output plus 2 V headroom requires 12 V on each rail, or 24 V rail-to-rail.

pitfalls.zh: R_L≥500 Ω会忽略0.5 mA反馈电流，在10 V峰值处超过总电流上限。
pitfalls.en: R_L≥500 Ω neglects the 0.5 mA feedback current and exceeds the total-current limit at the 10 V peak.

methods.zh: 用独立三节点方程检查输入分压及反馈比；在负载边界计算i_L=19.5 mA、i_f=0.5 mA，总计20 mA，并由i_f检查R₁+R₂=20 kΩ。
methods.en: Check input division and feedback ratio with independent three-node equations; at the load boundary verify i_L=19.5 mA and i_f=0.5 mA total 20 mA, and infer R₁+R₂=20 kΩ from i_f.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放线性负反馈；第(2)问额外计入2 V饱和压降，第(3)问再加入对称±20 mA限制。负载为输出到地的无源电阻；输入共模范围足够。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback, augmented by 2 V saturation headroom in (2) and symmetric ±20 mA limiting in (3). The load is a passive resistor from output to ground; input common-mode range is sufficient.

completionNote.en: Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

title.zh: 有限开环增益的跟随误差
title.en: Follower error with finite open-loop gain

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 若运放的开环差模电压增益为A_vo，共模抑制比为无穷大。（1）求电压跟随器输出电压与输入电压的实际关系；（2）若要求跟随误差不超过0.01%，A_vo至少要达到多少？
statement.en: An op amp has open-loop differential gain A_vo and infinite common-mode rejection ratio. (1) Find the actual voltage-follower output/input relation. (2) How large must A_vo be to keep following error at or below 0.01%?

prerequisites.zh: 开环传输式；单位负反馈；相对误差。
prerequisites.en: Open-loop transfer; unity negative feedback; relative error.

recognition.zh: 此题要算有限增益误差，必须保留v_i−v_o。直接使用虚短会把要求计算的误差消掉。
recognition.en: The finite-gain error is the quantity of interest, so retain v_i−v_o. Imposing an exact virtual short would erase that error.

title.zh: (1) 保留输入差，再解闭环关系
title.en: (1) Keep the differential input and solve

text.zh: 跟随器同相端接v_i，反相端直接接v_o；共模项为零。
text.en: The noninverting input receives v_i and the inverting input receives v_o directly; there is no common-mode contribution.

title.zh: (2) 按输入值定义跟随相对误差
title.en: (2) Define relative following error with respect to input

text.zh: 对正的准静态开环增益，输出略小于输入。0.01%=10⁻⁴；这里采用|v_i−v_o|/|v_i|的通常定义。
text.en: For positive quasistatic open-loop gain, output is slightly smaller than input. Since 0.01%=10⁻⁴, use the usual error definition |v_i−v_o|/|v_i|.

answer.zh: (1) v_o=[A_vo/(1+A_vo)]v_i。(2) 按相对于输入的跟随误差，精确下限A_vo=9999 V/V，工程上约取10⁴ V/V（约80 dB）。
answer.en: (1) v_o=[A_vo/(1+A_vo)]v_i. (2) For error relative to the input, the exact minimum is A_vo=9999 V/V, commonly rounded to 10⁴ V/V (about 80 dB).

pitfalls.zh: 本题不能先令v_o=v_i；那相当于把有限A_vo重新理想化成无穷大。
pitfalls.en: Do not start from v_o=v_i; that would replace the specified finite A_vo with infinity.

pitfalls.zh: 若把误差改定义成|v_i−v_o|/|v_o|，结果是1/A_vo，下限为10000；分母必须写清。本解采用常见的输入归一化定义。
pitfalls.en: If error were instead defined as |v_i−v_o|/|v_o|, it would equal 1/A_vo and require 10000. State the denominator; this solution uses the usual input-normalized definition.

methods.zh: 对A_vo=9999、10⁴及多组较小/较大正值，独立解v_o=A_vo(v_i−v_o)，检查误差单调下降，并核验边界正好等于10⁻⁴。
methods.en: For A_vo=9999, 10⁴, and other positive values, independently solve v_o=A_vo(v_i−v_o), verify monotonic error reduction, and confirm the boundary equals 10⁻⁴.

assumptions.zh: 准静态正实数开环增益，单位负反馈稳定；其他特性理想，未发生输出限幅；误差相对于输入定义。v_i=0时输出也为零，可用增益误差连续延拓。
assumptions.en: Positive real quasistatic gain, stable unity negative feedback, other properties ideal, and no output clipping. Error is input-normalized; at v_i=0 both voltages are zero and gain error is defined by continuity.

title.zh: 虚地让光电流全部进入反馈电阻
title.en: Virtual ground sends the photocurrent through feedback

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电流-电压转换电路如图题2.3.6所示。设i_s是光探测仪的输出电流，R_si是其内阻。（1）试证明输出电压v_o=−i_sR；（2）当i_s=0.5 mA、R_si=10 kΩ、R=10 kΩ时，求输出电压v_o和互阻增益A_r。
statement.en: For the current-to-voltage converter in Figure 2.3.6, i_s is the photodetector output current and R_si its internal resistance. (1) Prove v_o=−i_sR. (2) For i_s=0.5 mA, R_si=10 kΩ, and R=10 kΩ, find v_o and transresistance gain A_r.

alt.zh: 光电流源i_s与R_si并联注入运放反相端，反馈电阻R由输出接反相端，同相端接地；i_s向上、反馈电流向右。
alt.en: Photocurrent source i_s and parallel R_si feed the inverting input; feedback resistor R joins output and inverting input, and the noninverting input is grounded. i_s points upward and feedback current rightward.

prerequisites.zh: 诺顿电流源；理想运放虚地/虚断；节点KCL；互阻单位Ω。
prerequisites.en: Norton current source; ideal-op-amp virtual ground and zero input current; KCL; transresistance in ohms.

recognition.zh: R_si并在电流源两端，但虚地使它两端电压为零。因此它不分走信号电流，不能按普通并联分流公式处理。
recognition.en: R_si shunts the current source, but virtual ground gives it zero voltage. It therefore draws no signal current; ordinary current division does not apply.

text.zh: 同相端接地且负反馈线性工作，故v_N=0；运放输入电流为零，R_si电流也为零。所有i_s经R流向输出。
text.en: Grounded noninverting input and linear negative feedback give v_N=0. Both op amp input current and R_si current are zero, so all i_s passes through R toward the output.

text.zh: 正向注入的电流必须从输入虚地点经R流向负电压输出，因此输出符号为负。
text.en: A positive injected current flows from virtual ground through R to a negative output, which establishes the minus sign.

text.zh: 0.5 mA乘10 kΩ为5 V；10 kΩ内阻不改变理想虚地关系。
text.en: 0.5 mA times 10 kΩ is 5 V; the 10 kΩ internal resistance does not alter ideal virtual-ground operation.

answer.zh: (1) v_o=−i_sR，A_r=−R。(2) v_o=−5 V，互阻增益A_r=−10 kΩ。
answer.en: (1) v_o=−i_sR and A_r=−R. (2) v_o=−5 V and transresistance gain A_r=−10 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: 电流源内阻R_si与反馈电阻R并不直接并联在同一对节点上；R另一端是运放输出，不是地。
pitfalls.en: R_si and feedback R are not directly across the same node pair; R terminates at the output, not ground.

pitfalls.zh: 互阻增益的单位是Ω，不能只写无单位的−10。
pitfalls.en: Transresistance has units of ohms; do not report a dimensionless −10.

pitfalls.zh: 若输出饱和或带宽不足，虚地条件会失效，此时R_si可能分流。
pitfalls.en: If clipping or inadequate bandwidth destroys virtual ground, R_si can draw part of the source current.

methods.zh: 在原图输入节点独立写完整KCL并检查R_si支路零电流；多组R_si及电流符号数值代入均满足KCL，给定数值时R流过0.5 mA。
methods.en: Independently write complete input-node KCL and verify zero R_si current; numerical checks over several R_si values and both current signs satisfy KCL, with 0.5 mA through R in the stated case.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放稳定负反馈，供电与输出电流能力足以达到−5 V和0.5 mA；准静态忽略探测器及输入寄生电容。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp with stable negative feedback and sufficient supply/output capability for −5 V and 0.5 mA; quasistatic analysis neglects detector and input parasitic capacitance.

title.zh: 两个虚短先定电位，再测β
title.en: Use two feedback constraints before finding β

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.3.8所示，三极管T电极b、e间的压差V_BE=V_B−V_E=0.7 V。（1）求三极管电极c、b、e的电位；（2）若电压表的读数为200 mV，试求三极管电流放大系数β=I_C/I_B的值。
statement.en: In Figure 2.3.8, transistor T has V_BE=V_B−V_E=0.7 V. (1) Find the collector, base, and emitter potentials. (2) If the voltmeter reads 200 mV, find current gain β=I_C/I_B.

alt.zh: A₁同相端+6 V、反相端接T集电极，输出驱动T发射极；+12 V经R₁=6 kΩ给集电极供电。A₂反相端接基极，R₂=10 kΩ反馈，R₃=10 kΩ使同相端接地，输出电压表读200 mV。
alt.en: A₁ has +6 V at its noninverting input, collector feedback at its inverting input, and drives the emitter. +12 V supplies the collector through R₁=6 kΩ. A₂ senses the base at its inverting input with R₂=10 kΩ feedback; R₃=10 kΩ grounds its noninverting input. Its output voltmeter reads 200 mV.

prerequisites.zh: 理想运放负反馈；BJT电位与放大区条件；KCL；β=I_C/I_B。
prerequisites.en: Ideal op amp negative feedback; BJT terminal potentials and active-region conditions; KCL; β=I_C/I_B.

recognition.zh: A₁通过晶体管把集电极钳在+6 V；A₂把基极保持在0 V。不要把A₁输出误当集电极，A₁输出实际接发射极。
recognition.en: A₁ controls the transistor to hold its collector at +6 V; A₂ holds the base at 0 V. A₁ output is connected to the emitter, not the collector.

text.zh: A₁两输入相等给V_C=+6 V。A₂同相端经R₃接地且无输入电流，因此V_B=0。由给定V_BE求发射极。
text.en: Equal A₁ input voltages give V_C=+6 V. A₂ noninverting input is grounded through R₃ without input current, so V_B=0. Use the given V_BE for the emitter.

text.zh: A₁输入不取电流，R₁的电流全部进入晶体管集电极。
text.en: A₁ input draws no current, so all current through R₁ enters the collector.

text.zh: NPN管基极需要正的流入电流，因此A₂输出为正的+200 mV，电流从输出经R₂流向0 V基极；R₃不承载输入电流。
text.en: The NPN base requires positive current into the device, so A₂ output is +200 mV. Current flows from that output through R₂ toward the 0 V base; R₃ carries no input current.

title.zh: 核对晶体管工作区与输出电流
title.en: Check the transistor region and output currents

text.zh: 集电极高于基极6 V，集电结反偏；基极比发射极高0.7 V，发射结正偏，符合NPN正向放大。A₁输出需吸收I_E=1.02 mA，A₂输出提供20 μA。
text.en: The collector is 6 V above the base, so the collector junction is reverse biased; the base is 0.7 V above the emitter, so the emitter junction is forward biased. This is NPN forward-active operation. A₁ must sink I_E=1.02 mA and A₂ supplies 20 μA.

answer.zh: (1) V_C=+6 V，V_B=0 V，V_E=−0.7 V。(2) I_C=1 mA、I_B=20 μA，β=50；晶体管处于正向放大区。
answer.en: (1) V_C=+6 V, V_B=0 V, and V_E=−0.7 V. (2) I_C=1 mA, I_B=20 μA, and β=50; the transistor is forward active.

pitfalls.zh: 6 kΩ电阻的压降是12−6=6 V，不是12 V。
pitfalls.en: The 6 kΩ resistor drops 12−6=6 V, not 12 V.

pitfalls.zh: 200 mV是A₂输出对地电压，基极本身由反馈保持0 V。
pitfalls.en: The 200 mV reading is A₂ output relative to ground; feedback holds the base itself at 0 V.

pitfalls.zh: 给定V_BE=V_B−V_E=+0.7 V，故基极0 V时发射极为−0.7 V。
pitfalls.en: Given V_BE=V_B−V_E=+0.7 V, a 0 V base requires a −0.7 V emitter.

methods.zh: 从两个独立运放约束与集电极/基极节点KCL重算；再检查NPN发射结正偏、集电结反偏及I_E=I_C+I_B，避免先套β公式而遗漏工作区。
methods.en: Recompute from the two independent op amp constraints and collector/base KCL; then check NPN emitter forward bias, collector reverse bias, and I_E=I_C+I_B rather than applying β without a region check.

assumptions.zh: 两运放理想、反馈稳定且未饱和；供电/共模范围支持A₁输入+6 V、输出−0.7 V及A₂输出+0.2 V。晶体管按题设V_BE=0.7 V，忽略漏电流；电压表输入电阻无限大。
assumptions.en: Both op amps are ideal, stable, and unclipped, with supply/common-mode capability for A₁ inputs at +6 V, its output at −0.7 V, and A₂ output at +0.2 V. Use specified transistor V_BE=0.7 V, neglect leakage, and treat the voltmeter as infinitely resistive.

completionNote.en: Every exercise part has been independently checked; underdetermined data are answered with explicit conditional conclusions.

title.zh: 用T型反馈得到大增益，同时计入麦克风内阻
title.en: Use T feedback and include microphone source resistance

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图2.3.8所示电路作为麦克风电路的前置放大器，麦克风的输入电压有效值为12 mV，其内阻R_si=1 kΩ，R₁=R₁′+R_si（R₁′为外接电阻）。要求输出电压有效值为1.2 V，求电路中各阻值，设计时该电路所有电阻小于500 kΩ。
statement.en: Use the circuit in body Figure 2.3.8 as a microphone preamplifier. The microphone source voltage is 12 mV rms and its internal resistance is R_si=1 kΩ; R₁=R₁′+R_si, where R₁′ is the external resistor. Design the resistances for an output of 1.2 V rms, with every resistor below 500 kΩ.

alt.zh: 正文T型反馈反相放大器：R₁连接输入源与反相虚地点N，R₂连接N与节点M，R₃连接M与输出，R₄连接M与地；同相端接地。图中的R₁包括麦克风内阻及外接R₁′。
alt.en: Body T-feedback inverting amplifier: R₁ joins the source to virtual-ground N; R₂ joins N to M, R₃ joins M to output, and R₄ joins M to ground. The noninverting input is grounded; R₁ includes microphone internal resistance and external R₁′.

prerequisites.zh: 反相运放虚地；T型网络节点KCL；有效值增益；源内阻串联。
prerequisites.en: Inverting-amplifier virtual ground; T-network KCL; rms gain; series source resistance.

recognition.zh: 题目引用正文图2.3.8（印刷p29/PDF62），不是下面的图题2.3.8晶体管测β电路。12 mV是带1 kΩ内阻的源电压，必须把内阻加进R₁。设计解不唯一，给出一组满足全部约束的解即可。
recognition.en: The reference is body Figure 2.3.8 (printed p29/PDF62), not exercise Figure 2.3.8 for transistor β measurement. The 12 mV belongs to a source with 1 kΩ internal resistance, which must be included in R₁. The design is not unique; one set satisfying all constraints is sufficient.

text.zh: 输出与输入有效值之比为100。正文电路反相，故所需带符号增益为−100。
text.en: The ratio of output to source rms voltage is 100. The body circuit is inverting, so the required signed gain is −100.

title.en: Write KCL at both original nodes

text.zh: N点为0 V，输入电流等于从N流向M的电流；M点另有R₄接地电流，不能把R₂与R₃简单串联。
text.en: N is at 0 V, so input current equals current from N to M. M also connects through R₄ to ground, so R₂ and R₃ cannot be treated as a simple series pair.

title.zh: 得到T型反馈的有效增益

text.zh: 消去v_M；R₂R₃/R₄这一项可使等效反馈电阻很大，同时每个实际电阻都不必很大。
text.en: Eliminate v_M. The R₂R₃/R₄ term produces a large effective feedback resistance without requiring a large individual resistor.

text.zh: 取外接R₁′=9 kΩ，与麦克风1 kΩ内阻合成R₁=10 kΩ；选R₂=R₃=100 kΩ。所需等效反馈电阻为1 MΩ，解得R₄=12.5 kΩ。全部实际电阻均严格小于500 kΩ。
text.en: Choose external R₁′=9 kΩ so the 1 kΩ microphone resistance gives R₁=10 kΩ. Set R₂=R₃=100 kΩ. The required effective feedback resistance is 1 MΩ, giving R₄=12.5 kΩ. Every actual resistor is strictly below 500 kΩ.

title.zh: 带源内阻核对输出与支路电流
title.en: Verify with source resistance and branch currents

text.zh: 对12 mV源电压，输入电流有效值1.2 μA，麦克风端电压10.8 mV；M点反相为−0.12 V，对应输出−1.2 V。以正的源电压相量为参考，图示i₂=1.2 μA、i₄=9.6 μA、i₃=10.8 μA，M点KCL闭合。
text.en: For a 12 mV source, input current is 1.2 μA rms and the microphone terminal voltage is 10.8 mV. M has signed phasor −0.12 V and output −1.2 V. Relative to a positive source phasor, the drawn currents are i₂=1.2 μA, i₄=9.6 μA, and i₃=10.8 μA, satisfying M-node KCL.

answer.zh: 一组可行设计：R₁′=9 kΩ（外接）、R_si=1 kΩ（已有），因此R₁=10 kΩ；R₂=R₃=100 kΩ，R₄=12.5 kΩ。源电压增益−100，输出1.2 V有效值；全部电阻小于500 kΩ。R₁为总串联值，不能在已有内阻之外再接一个10 kΩ电阻。
answer.en: One valid design is external R₁′=9 kΩ with existing R_si=1 kΩ, hence total R₁=10 kΩ; R₂=R₃=100 kΩ and R₄=12.5 kΩ. Source-voltage gain is −100 and output is 1.2 V rms; every resistor is below 500 kΩ. R₁ is the total series value, not an additional external 10 kΩ resistor.

pitfalls.zh: 图2.3.8和图题2.3.8是两个不同电路，须读正文T型网络图。
pitfalls.en: Body Figure 2.3.8 and exercise Figure 2.3.8 are different circuits; this question uses the body’s T network.

pitfalls.zh: 源内阻1 kΩ必须与外接R₁′相加；漏掉它会改变从麦克风源电压到输出的增益。
pitfalls.en: Add the 1 kΩ source resistance to external R₁′; omitting it changes gain from microphone source voltage to output.

pitfalls.zh: 等效反馈阻值1 MΩ不是一个实际1 MΩ电阻；实际最大电阻仍为100 kΩ。
pitfalls.en: The 1 MΩ effective feedback value is not a physical 1 MΩ resistor; the largest actual resistor here is 100 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: 有效值比等于幅值比，输入与输出都用有效值，不要额外乘√2。
pitfalls.en: An rms ratio equals the amplitude ratio; both stated voltages are rms, so do not insert an extra √2.

methods.zh: 目视正文p29/PDF62的原图，独立求解包含1 kΩ源内阻、9 kΩ外接电阻及T网络的四节点线性方程；检查源端加载、N与M点KCL、增益−100及所有电阻上限。
methods.en: Visually inspect the body figure on p29/PDF62 and independently solve four-node equations including the 1 kΩ source resistance, external 9 kΩ resistor, and T network. Check source loading, N/M-node KCL, gain −100, and every resistance constraint.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、稳定线性负反馈；题目12 mV有效值视为源开路等效电压，R₁按题设含源内阻。未给负载，默认输出高阻测量，且供电足以支持1.2 V有效值（约1.697 V峰值）。设计解不唯一。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp with stable linear negative feedback. The stated 12 mV rms is the Thevenin source voltage, and R₁ includes source resistance as specified. No output load is given, so measurement is high impedance; supply headroom supports 1.2 V rms (about 1.697 V peak). The design is not unique.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先统一单位，再反解指数式
title.en: Unify units, then invert the exponential

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在室温（300 K）情况下，若二极管的反向饱和电流为1 nA，问它的正向电流为0.5 mA时应加多大的电压？设二极管的指数模型为i_D=I_S(e^{v_D/(nV_T)}−1)，其中n=1，V_T=26 mV。
statement.en: At 300 K, a diode has reverse saturation current 1 nA. What voltage produces a forward current of 0.5 mA? Use i_D=I_S(exp(v_D/(nV_T))−1), n=1 and V_T=26 mV.

prerequisites.zh: 指数模型；自然对数；mA与nA单位换算。
prerequisites.en: Exponential model; natural logarithms; mA/nA conversion.

recognition.zh: 已知I_S和目标电流，直接反解电压；这里的比值为500000。
recognition.en: I_S and target current are known, so invert for voltage; their ratio is 500000.

text.zh: 保留−1项，电流比使用同一单位。
text.en: Retain the −1 term and use consistent current units.

text.zh: 回代所得电流为0.5 mA；强正向近似只差约52 nV。
text.en: Back-substitution gives 0.5 mA; dropping the −1 term changes voltage by only about 52 nV.

pitfalls.zh: 不要将0.5 mA/1 nA错算成500。

methods.zh: 独立回代指数式得到0.500000 mA，并核对所有单位。
methods.en: Independent exponential back-substitution returns 0.500000 mA; units were checked.

assumptions.zh: 题给指数模型，n=1，V_T=26 mV。
assumptions.en: Given exponential model, n=1 and V_T=26 mV.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 把导通条件写成输入门限
title.en: Express conduction as an input threshold

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.1所示，电源v_s=2sinωt V，试分别使用二极管理想模型和恒压降模型（V_D=0.7 V）分析，绘出负载R_L两端的电压波形，并标出幅值。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.1 with v_s=2sinωt V, use both an ideal diode and a constant 0.7 V drop to draw the load-voltage waveform and label its peak.

alt.zh: 电源v_s、正向从电源接至负载的二极管D、R_L串联；输出v_L取R_L上正下负。
alt.en: Source v_s, diode conducting toward the load, and R_L are in series; v_L is positive at the load top.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 截止时负载电流为零，所以输出为零；导通时用源电压减正向压降。
recognition.en: Off means zero load current and voltage; on means source voltage minus forward drop.

text.zh: 正半周导通，负半周截止，输出峰值2 V。
text.en: On for the positive half-cycle, off for the negative; peak is 2 V.

text.zh: 只有输入超过0.7 V才导通；峰值降为1.3 V。令θ=ωt，导通区θ∈(arcsin0.35,π−arcsin0.35)再按2π周期延拓。
text.en: Conduction requires input above 0.7 V; peak becomes 1.3 V. For θ=ωt, the interval is (arcsin0.35, π−arcsin0.35), repeated every 2π.

answer.zh: 理想半波峰值2 V；恒压降半波峰值1.3 V，导通起点约20.487°。
answer.en: Ideal half-wave peak 2 V; constant-drop peak 1.3 V, with turn-on at about 20.487°.

pitfalls.zh: 截止输出是0，而不是负半周输入。
pitfalls.en: Off-state output is zero, not the negative input half-cycle.

methods.zh: 分别枚举开路和固定压降两种二极管状态，检查支路电流非负、截止v_D≤V_D及负载KCL；峰值与门限独立计算。
methods.en: Enumerated open and fixed-drop states, checking nonnegative branch current, off-state v_D≤V_D and load KCL; independently checked peaks and thresholds.

assumptions.zh: 正R_L，无其他负载；分别采用理想和0.7 V恒压降模型。
assumptions.en: Positive R_L without other loading; separate ideal and 0.7 V constant-drop models.

alt.zh: 2 V正弦输入：理想输出峰2 V，0.7 V模型峰1.3 V。
alt.en: 2 V sine: ideal output peak 2 V, constant-drop peak 1.3 V.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 桥内电流整流，运放抵消二极管影响
title.en: Rectify meter current inside the feedback bridge

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题3.4.4是一高输入阻抗交流电压表电路，二极管用理想模型分析，被测电压v_i=√2 V_i sinωt。（1）当v_i瞬时极性为正时，标出流过表头M的电流方向，说明哪几个二极管导通；（2）写出流过表头M的电流平均值表达式；（3）设表头满刻度平均电流为100 μA，要求V_i=1 V时满刻度，试求R；（4）若改为1 V直流电压表，满刻度时R应如何改变？
statement.en: Figure 3.4.4 is a high-input-impedance AC voltmeter. With ideal diodes and v_i=√2 V_i sinωt: (1) for positive instantaneous input, identify conducting diodes and meter-current direction; (2) derive average meter current; (3) find R for 100 μA full-scale average current at V_i=1 V; (4) find R for a 1 V DC full-scale range.

alt.zh: 同相端接v_i；反相节点v_n经R接地，也是整流桥左端，运放输出接桥右端；表头M位于桥A（上、+）与B（下、−）之间。D₄左→A，D₃右→A，D₁B→左，D₂B→右。
alt.en: Noninverting input is v_i. Node v_n connects through R to ground and to the bridge left terminal; op-amp output is the bridge right terminal. Meter is between upper A (+) and lower B (−). D₄ runs left→A, D₃ right→A, D₁ B→left and D₂ B→right.

prerequisites.zh: 同相负反馈；全波整流平均值；正弦有效值。
prerequisites.en: Noninverting negative feedback; full-wave average; sinusoidal RMS.

recognition.zh: 虚短给v_n=v_i，电阻电流由v_i/R决定；桥把两个方向都转成表头A→B。
recognition.en: Virtual short gives v_n=v_i, setting resistor current v_i/R; the bridge routes both signs through the meter A→B.

text.zh: v_i>0：运放输出→D₃→A→M→B→D₁→v_n→R→地，D₁/D₃导通。v_i<0：地→R→v_n→D₄→A→M→B→D₂→输出，D₂/D₄导通。两种情况M均A→B。
text.en: For v_i>0: output→D₃→A→M→B→D₁→v_n→R→ground; D₁/D₃ conduct. For v_i<0: ground→R→v_n→D₄→A→M→B→D₂→output; D₂/D₄ conduct. Meter current always flows A→B.

text.zh: V_i为有效值，不是峰值。全波正弦平均值为峰值的2/π。
text.en: V_i is RMS, not peak. A full-wave sine has average equal to 2/π times its peak.

text.zh: 直流无需整流平均系数，故R增加至10 kΩ，约为原来的1.11072倍。
text.en: DC requires no waveform averaging factor; increase R to 10 kΩ, about 1.11072 times the AC value.

answer.zh: 正半周D₁、D₃导通，表头电流A→B；I平均=2√2V_i/(πR)。交流1 V量程R≈9.003 kΩ，直流1 V量程R=10 kΩ。
answer.en: Positive input turns on D₁/D₃, with meter current A→B. Average current is 2√2V_i/(πR). Use R≈9.003 kΩ for 1 V RMS AC and 10 kΩ for 1 V DC.

pitfalls.zh: 不能用1 V/100 μA直接得到交流量程R。
pitfalls.en: Do not use 1 V/100 μA for the RMS AC range.

methods.zh: 按原桥四个二极管方向逐状态列KCL，正负输入分别得到两条一致电流路径；数值积分|√2sinθ|/R的整周期平均为100 μA。
methods.en: Original bridge directions and state KCL give the two consistent current paths. Numerical full-cycle integration of |√2sinθ|/R gives 100 μA.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放在线性负反馈内；输出有足够余量推动表头；理想二极管，表头串联阻抗由反馈补偿。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp in linear negative feedback with enough output compliance; ideal diodes and meter series impedance inside the feedback loop.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.en: Identify the active feedback path in each half-cycle

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.5所示，运放电源±10 V，二极管导通压降0.7 V。（1）v_s=2 V时，v_A和v_o各是多少？（2）v_s=−2 V时各是多少？（3）正弦v_s振幅分别为2 V和0.5 V时，绘出相应v_A、v_o波形并标幅值。（4）若图题3.4.1中v_s振幅也为0.5 V、二极管导通压降0.7 V，则v_L波形怎样？据此说明本题电路的优点。提示：正负半周两管状态不同。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.5, op-amp supplies are ±10 V and diode drop is 0.7 V. (1) Find v_A and v_o for v_s=2 V. (2) Repeat for −2 V. (3) Draw v_A/v_o for sinusoidal amplitudes 2 V and 0.5 V, labeling peaks. (4) Compare with Fig. 3.4.1 for a 0.5 V sine and 0.7 V diode, explaining this circuit’s advantage. Hint: diode states differ between half-cycles.

alt.zh: 输入v_s经R到反相节点；输出v_o经R反馈至反相节点；同相端接地。D₁由反相节点指向运放输出v_A，D₂由v_A指向v_o。
alt.en: Input v_s reaches the inverting node through R; equal R returns v_o to that node. Noninverting input is grounded. D₁ runs from inverting node to op-amp output v_A; D₂ runs from v_A to v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 运放虚短/虚断；二极管状态；精密半波整流。
prerequisites.en: Op-amp input conditions; diode states; precision half-wave rectification.

recognition.zh: v_s正时走D₁反馈、输出为零；v_s负时走D₂反馈、输出反相。二极管压降由v_A承担。
recognition.en: Positive input uses D₁ feedback with zero output; negative input uses D₂ feedback with inverted output. v_A supplies the diode drop.

text.zh: D₁通、D₂断，v_n=0，因此v_A=−0.7 V、v_o=0；v_s=2 V同此。
text.en: D₁ on, D₂ off and v_n=0 give v_A=−0.7 V and v_o=0, including v_s=2 V.

text.zh: D₂通、D₁断，等值R给v_o=−v_s，v_A=v_o+0.7；−2 V时分别为2.7 V、2 V，均在电源余量内。
text.en: D₂ on and D₁ off; equal resistors give v_o=−v_s and v_A=v_o+0.7. For −2 V, these are 2 V and 2.7 V, within supply limits.

text.zh: 振幅V_m时，v_o= max(−V_m sinωt,0)，峰值V_m；v_A正峰值V_m+0.7、正输入半周为−0.7。故2 V输入输出峰值2 V、v_A正峰2.7 V；0.5 V输入为0.5 V、1.2 V。普通图3.4.1的0.5 V输入不够导通，v_L恒0；本题可整流小于0.7 V的信号。
text.en: For amplitude V_m, output is max(−V_m sinωt,0), peaking at V_m. v_A peaks at V_m+0.7 and is −0.7 during positive input. The two cases give output peaks 2/0.5 V and v_A positive peaks 2.7/1.2 V. The ordinary 0.5 V rectifier remains off; this precision circuit rectifies signals below 0.7 V.

answer.zh: （1）v_A=−0.7 V，v_o=0；（2）v_A=2.7 V，v_o=2 V；（3）v_o为输入负半周反相，峰值分别2 V、0.5 V；v_A按上述分段式；（4）普通整流输出0，本题能对小信号精密整流。
answer.en: (1) v_A=−0.7 V, v_o=0. (2) v_A=2.7 V, v_o=2 V. (3) Negative input half-cycles become positive output peaks of 2/0.5 V; v_A follows the stated piecewise rule. (4) Ordinary output is zero; this circuit rectifies small signals.

pitfalls.zh: 输出取D₂之后的v_o，不等于运放裸输出v_A。
pitfalls.en: Use v_o after D₂, not the raw op-amp output v_A.

pitfalls.zh: 零交越处理想恒压降模型不唯一限定v_A；真实转换受带宽限制。
pitfalls.en: At exact zero crossing, the ideal constant-drop model does not uniquely fix v_A; real switching is bandwidth limited.

methods.zh: 分别将两种状态代回反相端KCL和两管端电压，确认导通电流非负、另一管反偏；各指定峰值均小于±10 V。
methods.en: Substituted each state into inverting-node KCL and both diode voltages, confirming nonnegative conducting current and reverse bias of the other diode; stated peaks remain within ±10 V.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放有足够带宽且处于负反馈；±10 V电源；二极管0.7 V恒压降；不把零交越的理想跳变当作真实动态。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amp with sufficient bandwidth in negative feedback, ±10 V supplies, 0.7 V diode drops; ideal zero-crossing jumps are not real transient predictions.

alt.zh: 2 V和0.5 V输入下的恒压降模型波形；裸输出理想零交越跳变不代表真实动态。
alt.en: Constant-drop waveforms for 2/0.5 V inputs; ideal raw-output jumps are not real switching dynamics.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先半波，再加权相加得到绝对值
title.en: Half-wave rectification followed by weighted summation

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.6所示，二极管导通压降0.7 V。（1）证明v_o=|v_s|，即绝对值运算电路，分v_s>0和v_s≤0推导v_o1、v_o。（2）v_s为振幅2 V正弦波时，绘v_o1、v_o并标幅值。（3）比较本题与图题3.4.3桥式整流的优缺点。（4）A₁、A₂用μA741，电源±12 V，D₁、D₂用1N4148，R=10 kΩ，v_s=sin(2π×1000t) V，用SPICE绘输入、输出波形及v_o=f(v_s)传输特性。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.6 with 0.7 V diode drops: (1) prove v_o=|v_s| by deriving v_o1/v_o for v_s>0 and v_s≤0; (2) draw both outputs for a 2 V-amplitude sine; (3) compare advantages/disadvantages with the bridge of Fig. 3.4.3; (4) use μA741 op amps, ±12 V supplies, 1N4148 diodes, R=10 kΩ and v_s=sin(2π×1000t) V in SPICE, plotting input/output and transfer characteristic.

alt.zh: A₁反相端经R接v_s、经R接v_o1；D₁从A₁输出到反相端，D₂从v_o1到A₁输出。A₂为加权反相求和，v_s经2R、v_o1经R输入，反馈2R；两同相端接地。
alt.en: A₁ inverting input connects through R to v_s and R to v_o1; D₁ runs from A₁ output to its inverting input and D₂ from v_o1 to A₁ output. A₂ is an inverting summer with inputs v_s through 2R and v_o1 through R, and feedback 2R; both noninverting inputs are grounded.

prerequisites.zh: 精密整流；反相加法；实际运放带宽与转换。
prerequisites.en: Precision rectification; inverting summation; real op-amp bandwidth and switching.

recognition.zh: A₁给负半波v_o1，A₂实现−v_s−2v_o1；分别带入两种状态即可。
recognition.en: A₁ creates negative half-wave v_o1; A₂ forms −v_s−2v_o1. Substitute the two states.

text.zh: v_s>0时D₂通、D₁断，v_o1=−v_s；v_s≤0时D₁通、D₂断，v_o1=0。0.7 V压降落在A₁裸输出内。
text.en: For v_s>0, D₂ on and D₁ off give v_o1=−v_s. For v_s≤0, D₁ on and D₂ off give v_o1=0. The 0.7 V drop is supplied by A₁’s raw output.

text.zh: 虚地KCL给v_o=−v_s−2v_o1，因此正负半周均为|v_s|。2 V正弦输入下，v_o1从−2到0 V，v_o为0到2 V的全波。
text.en: Virtual-ground KCL yields v_o=−v_s−2v_o1, hence |v_s| for both signs. A 2 V sine gives v_o1 from −2 to 0 V and full-wave v_o from 0 to 2 V.

text.zh: 优点：避免两只二极管正向压降导致的小信号死区，可由后级提供低输出阻抗。缺点：需供电、两只运放及匹配电阻，受输出范围、带宽和转换速度限制；桥式无需额外运放供电且适于较大功率整流。
text.en: Advantages: avoids the two-diode small-signal dead zone and provides a low-impedance driven output. Costs: supplies, two op amps, matched resistors, finite output range/bandwidth/switching speed. A passive bridge needs no separate amplifier supplies and suits power rectification.

text.zh: 已实际运行ngspice 47，使用TI官方UA741宏模型和OUP列出的EVAL 1N4148参数。1 kHz、1 V峰值的末周期输出约−0.04795到1.00156 V，零交越附近有动态尖差，最大|v_o−|v_s||约0.09030 V，不能把真实741仿真画成完美绝对值。附瞬态和直流扫描传输图；网表需从下方TI链接下载模型，去末尾Ctrl-Z并另存为同目录UA741.lib。
text.en: Executed ngspice 47 with TI’s UA741 macro-model and the OUP-listed EVAL 1N4148 parameters. At 1 kHz and 1 V peak, last-cycle output spans about −0.04795 to 1.00156 V, with crossover transients and maximum |v_o−|v_s||≈0.09030 V. The real-741 simulation is not an ideal absolute value. Transient and DC-transfer plots are attached. Download the TI model below, remove its trailing Ctrl-Z and save it beside the netlist as UA741.lib.

answer.zh: 理想v_o1=−max(v_s,0)，v_o=|v_s|；2 V输入时分别为−2～0 V、0～2 V。μA741实际仿真另见附图，保留其零交越动态误差。
answer.en: Ideal v_o1=−max(v_s,0), v_o=|v_s|; a 2 V input gives −2…0 V and 0…2 V respectively. Attached μA741 simulations retain crossover errors.

pitfalls.zh: A₂输入系数为−1和−2；不能忽略v_s的直通求和支路。
pitfalls.en: A₂ coefficients are −1 and −2; retain the direct v_s summing branch.

pitfalls.zh: 静态传输与1 kHz瞬态的零交越误差不是同一个结果。
pitfalls.en: DC transfer and 1 kHz transient crossover errors are distinct.

methods.zh: 理想分段式经A₁/A₂原节点KCL和二极管一致性复核；实际网表逐条按原图连接，执行瞬态及DC扫描，并减半时间步检查波形与误差。
methods.en: Checked ideal piecewise relations using both original summing-node KCL equations and diode consistency; wired the actual netlist from the source and executed transient/DC analyses, with a half-step convergence check.

assumptions.zh: （1）～（3）理想线性运放、0.7 V二极管；（4）TI UA741宏模型及指定EVAL 1N4148参数，27°C，供电按题为±12 V；模型预测不是器件误差保证。
assumptions.en: Parts (1)–(3): ideal linear op amps and 0.7 V diodes. Part (4): TI UA741 macro-model plus specified EVAL 1N4148 parameters at 27°C, with the requested ±12 V supplies. Simulation is a model prediction, not a guaranteed device error bound.

externalReferences.title: TI · UA741 PSpice model (download, save cleaned UA741.lib beside netlist)

alt.zh: 第（2）问2 V正弦输入的理想半波及全波。
alt.en: Part (2): ideal half-wave and full-wave outputs for a 2 V sine.

alt.zh: 实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。
alt.en: Executed ngspice input/output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

caption.zh: 实际执行的SPICE模型输出；所用模型和条件见解析。

alt.en: Executed DC transfer versus the stated simplified model.

caption.zh: 实际执行的SPICE模型输出；所用模型和条件见解析。
caption.en: Executed SPICE model output; models and conditions are stated in the solution.

title.zh: 电源偏置加上正向压降形成限幅
title.en: Biased supplies plus diode drop set clipping levels

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.4.7，D₁、D₂为硅二极管。（1）v_s=6sinωt V，用恒压降模型分析并绘v_o波形；（2）二极管用1N4148，v_s=6sin(2π×100t) V，用SPICE绘v_o波形和v_o=f(v_s)传输特性。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.7 with silicon D₁/D₂: (1) use a constant-drop model for v_s=6sinωt V and draw v_o; (2) use 1N4148 and v_s=6sin(2π×100t) V in SPICE, plotting output and transfer.

alt.zh: 输入经1 kΩ到输出；D₁阳极在输出、阴极接+3 V，D₂阳极接−3 V、阴极在输出。
alt.en: Input reaches output through 1 kΩ. D₁ anode is at output and cathode at +3 V; D₂ anode is at −3 V and cathode at output.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 两管均断时无R压降，输出跟随输入；超出±(3+0.7)V才分别导通。
recognition.en: With both off there is no resistor drop; output follows input until ±(3+0.7) V is exceeded.

text.zh: 高于3.7 V时D₁导通钳到+3.7；低于−3.7时D₂导通钳到−3.7；中间两管截止。
text.en: Above +3.7 V D₁ clips the output; below −3.7 V D₂ clips it. Both are off between these limits.

text.zh: 1N4148实际模型输出峰值约±3.65617 V，过渡圆滑，非恒定0.7 V压降；已附100 Hz末周期波形和−6～6 V直流扫描。
text.en: The executed 1N4148 model peaks at about ±3.65617 V with rounded transitions and a current-dependent forward drop; attached are a 100 Hz final-cycle waveform and −6…6 V DC sweep.

answer.zh: 恒压降答案为±3.7 V双向限幅；本次1N4148模型仿真峰值约±3.65617 V。
answer.en: Constant-drop answer: clipping at ±3.7 V. Executed 1N4148 model: peaks about ±3.65617 V.

pitfalls.zh: 限幅值包含偏置3 V和正向压降，不是±3 V。
pitfalls.en: Limits include both the 3 V bias and diode drop, not just ±3 V.

methods.zh: 逐状态KCL确认导通电流符号；实际SPICE对称输入得到对称输出，DC扫描与低频瞬态对应，减半步长复核峰值。
methods.en: State KCL confirms current signs. Executed SPICE gives symmetric output, agreement between DC and low-frequency transient curves, and a half-step peak check.

assumptions.zh: （1）0.7 V恒压降；（2）OUP列出的EVAL 1N4148参数，27°C，理想±3 V偏置源。
assumptions.en: Part (1): 0.7 V drop. Part (2): OUP-listed EVAL 1N4148 model at 27°C with ideal ±3 V bias sources.

alt.en: Executed ngspice input/output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

title.zh: 先求截止输出，再找开通门限
title.en: Find off-state output before turn-on threshold

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 二极管电路如图题3.4.8a，输入如图b在0<t<5 ms内由0线性升至10 V。（1）理想二极管，绘v_o(t)；（2）二极管用1N4148，v_i=10sin(2π×1000t) V，用SPICE绘v_o(t)。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.8a, the input in (b) ramps from 0 to 10 V over 0<t<5 ms. (1) Draw v_o(t) for an ideal diode. (2) With 1N4148 and v_i=10sin(2π×1000t) V, plot v_o(t) in SPICE.

alt.zh: 输入经200 Ω到二极管阳极，阴极接输出；输出经200 Ω接+6 V电源上端，电源下端接地。图b为0～5 ms、0～10 V斜坡。
alt.en: Input passes through 200 Ω to the diode anode; cathode is output. Output connects through 200 Ω to a +6 V source. Figure (b) is the 0…5 ms, 0…10 V ramp.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 截止时负载电阻没有电流，输出已被6 V电源拉到6 V，不能从零起画。
recognition.en: When off, the load resistor has zero current and output is already 6 V; do not draw from zero.

text.zh: v_i≤6 V时截止，v_o=6 V。v_i>6 V时导通，两只等值电阻串联在v_i与6 V之间，v_o=(v_i+6)/2。
text.en: Off for v_i≤6 V, with v_o=6 V. Above 6 V, equal series resistors divide between v_i and 6 V, giving v_o=(v_i+6)/2.

text.zh: 第（2）问改用正弦输入，不沿用斜坡。实际执行1N4148瞬态输出约5.99996～7.63590 V；仅在正峰附近明显导通，负半周仍约6 V。
text.en: Part (2) uses a sine, not the ramp. Executed 1N4148 transient output spans about 5.99996…7.63590 V; appreciable conduction occurs only around positive peaks, while negative half-cycles remain near 6 V.

answer.zh: （1）0～3 ms为6 V；3～5 ms为(t_ms+3)V，末值趋于8 V。（2）实际模型正弦输出约6～7.63590 V，见波形。
answer.en: (1) 6 V until 3 ms, then (t_ms+3)V, approaching 8 V at 5 ms. (2) Executed sine-input output is about 6…7.63590 V; see plot.

pitfalls.zh: 6 V电源的极性是上正下负；截止不代表输出接地。
pitfalls.en: The 6 V source is positive at the top; off does not mean grounded output.

methods.zh: 用两只200 Ω原支路KCL检查导通分压和截止电压，t=3 ms两段连续；实际SPICE另外使用题给正弦，DC/瞬态及半步长结果对照。
methods.en: Original 200 Ω branch KCL verifies on/off results and continuity at 3 ms. SPICE separately uses the requested sine; DC/transient and half-step results were compared.

assumptions.zh: （1）理想二极管；（2）指定EVAL 1N4148模型、27°C。输入源与6 V电源均理想。
assumptions.en: Part (1): ideal diode. Part (2): specified EVAL 1N4148 model at 27°C; ideal input and 6 V sources.

alt.zh: 实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。
alt.en: Executed ngspice input/output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

caption.zh: 实际执行的SPICE模型输出；所用模型和条件见解析。
caption.en: Executed SPICE model output; models and conditions are stated in the solution.

alt.zh: 斜坡输入：理想3 ms开通、0.7 V模型3.35 ms开通。
alt.en: Ramp input: ideal turn-on at 3 ms; constant-drop turn-on at 3.35 ms.

title.en: Shift the turn-on threshold by 0.7 V

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 使用恒压降模型（V_D=0.7 V），重复题3.4.8第（1）问：图3.4.8a的两个电阻均200 Ω，负载支路串联+6 V电源，输入在0<t<5 ms由0线性升至10 V，绘v_o(t)。
statement.en: Repeat exercise 3.4.8(1) using V_D=0.7 V: both resistors in Fig. 3.4.8a are 200 Ω, the load branch includes a +6 V source, and input ramps 0→10 V over 0<t<5 ms. Draw v_o(t).

alt.zh: 本题引用图3.4.8：输入经200 Ω和正向二极管到输出，输出经200 Ω到+6 V；输入为图示斜坡。
alt.en: Uses Fig. 3.4.8: input through 200 Ω and a forward diode to output, then 200 Ω to +6 V; input is the shown ramp.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 截止输出仍是6 V；要使阳极比阴极高0.7 V，输入须超过6.7 V。
recognition.en: Off-state output remains 6 V; input must exceed 6.7 V to forward-bias the diode by 0.7 V.

text.zh: 2 V/ms斜率给门限时刻3.35 ms；导通电流(v_i−6−0.7)/400，输出为6+200i_D。
text.en: The 2 V/ms slope gives a threshold at 3.35 ms. On-state current is (v_i−6−0.7)/400 and output is 6+200i_D.

answer.en: 6 V until 3.35 ms, then (t_ms+2.65)V, approaching 7.65 V at 5 ms.

pitfalls.zh: 导通后0.7 V由整个串联回路承担，等值分压使输出比理想情况低0.35 V。
pitfalls.en: The 0.7 V belongs to the series loop; equal division lowers output by 0.35 V relative to the ideal on-state.

methods.zh: 导通KVL：v_i−v_o−0.7=200i_D，输出支路v_o−6=200i_D；联立独立检查门限、连续性和峰值。
methods.en: Independent KVL equations v_i−v_o−0.7=200i_D and v_o−6=200i_D verify threshold, continuity and peak.

assumptions.zh: 硅二极管恒压降0.7 V；反向截止，忽略漏电及动态寄生。
assumptions.en: Silicon diode with constant 0.7 V forward drop, no reverse current or dynamic parasitics.

alt.zh: 斜坡输入：理想3 ms开通、0.7 V模型3.35 ms开通。
alt.en: Ramp input: ideal turn-on at 3 ms; constant-drop turn-on at 3.35 ms.

title.zh: 从被钳住的正峰求电容电压
title.en: Find capacitor charge at the clamped positive peak

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 二极管钳位电路如图题3.4.10，D为硅二极管，v_s=6sinωt V，且R_L C≫2π/ω。用恒压降模型分析，绘v_o稳态波形。
statement.en: For the clamper in Fig. 3.4.10, D is silicon, v_s=6sinωt V and R_L C≫2π/ω. Use a constant-drop model to draw steady-state v_o.

alt.zh: 输入经串联电容C到输出，R_L并接输出与地；D阳极在输出、阴极接地，钳住正峰。
alt.en: Input couples through series C to output, with R_L to ground. Diode anode is output and cathode is ground, clamping the positive peak.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 正峰6 V时输出被钳到0.7 V，电容左正右负充至5.3 V；余下周期近似保持。
recognition.en: At a +6 V input peak, output clamps at +0.7 V, charging the capacitor left-to-right to +5.3 V, approximately held for the cycle.

title.en: Use held capacitor voltage for the shift

text.zh: 周期远短于放电时间常数，可忽略R_L导致的缓慢下垂；输出为原正弦向下平移5.3 V。
text.en: The period is much shorter than the discharge time constant, so slow load droop is neglected; shift the sine down by 5.3 V.

text.zh: 正峰0.7 V，负峰−11.3 V，峰峰值仍约12 V。
text.en: Maximum +0.7 V, minimum −11.3 V; peak-to-peak remains approximately 12 V.

answer.zh: v_o≈6sinωt−5.3 V，范围−11.3～+0.7 V；这是稳态大时间常数近似。
answer.en: v_o≈6sinωt−5.3 V, spanning −11.3…+0.7 V under the steady-state large-time-constant approximation.

pitfalls.zh: 此处钳正峰；不能把波形误向上平移。
pitfalls.en: The positive peak is clamped; do not shift upward.

methods.zh: 正峰时检查D导通v_o=0.7；其余时刻v_o≤0.7满足截止；输出减输入的电压为固定−5.3 V，满足电容保持条件。
methods.en: At the positive peak v_o=0.7 satisfies conduction; elsewhere v_o≤0.7 is consistent with off-state operation. The constant −5.3 V output-input difference matches held capacitor charge.

assumptions.zh: 0.7 V恒压降；已达稳态，R_L C远大于周期；忽略周期内放电下垂。
assumptions.en: 0.7 V drop, steady state and R_L C much larger than the period; within-cycle droop neglected.

alt.zh: 大时间常数近似：输出−11.3至+0.7 V。
alt.en: Large-time-constant approximation: output −11.3…+0.7 V.
