completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先认偏置极性；空载仿真要检查周期电荷
title.en: Read bias polarity; check periodic charge for an unloaded clamper

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 钳位电路如图题3.4.11，D为硅二极管。（1）v_s=4sinωt V，用恒压降模型绘v_o稳态波形；（2）二极管用1N4148，v_s=4sin(2π×1000t) V，C=10 μF，用SPICE绘v_o(t)稳态波形。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.11 with a silicon diode: (1) use a constant-drop model for v_s=4sinωt V and draw steady-state output; (2) use 1N4148, v_s=4sin(2π×1000t) V and C=10 μF in SPICE to plot steady-state output.

alt.zh: 输入经C到输出；二极管阳极接+3 V偏置上端，阴极在输出，电源下端接地；原图没有负载电阻。
alt.en: Input couples through C to output; diode anode is at the +3 V bias source and cathode is at output. The original figure has no load resistor.

prerequisites.zh: 偏置钳位；电容电压连续；空载周期电荷平衡。
prerequisites.en: Biased clamping; capacitor-voltage continuity; unloaded periodic charge balance.

recognition.zh: 这是下限钳位：0.7 V模型将最低输出固定在3−0.7=2.3 V。真实二极管空载时没有规定的毫安正向电流，不能强制保持0.7 V。
recognition.en: This is a lower clamp: the 0.7 V model sets minimum output to 3−0.7=2.3 V. A real unloaded diode has no fixed milliamp forward current, so its drop need not remain 0.7 V.

text.zh: 负峰v_s=−4 V时v_o=2.3 V，电容左减右为−6.3 V，所以输出为原波形上移6.3 V。
text.en: At v_s=−4 V, output is 2.3 V and capacitor left-minus-right is −6.3 V, shifting the sine upward by 6.3 V.

text.zh: 实际1N4148空载仿真没有擅加负载。先由整周期二极管平均电流为0求周期初始电荷，再运行10周期；所得平移约6.84579 V、输出约2.84579～10.84579 V。末周期输出减输入的变化约1.88 μV，周期二极管电荷积分约4.16×10⁻¹⁵ C，确认已近周期稳态。这个结果与0.7 V近似不同，原因是实际模型的空载小电流压降不同。
text.en: The executed unloaded 1N4148 simulation adds no load. Periodic initial charge is found from zero cycle-average diode current, then simulated for 10 cycles. Offset is about 6.84579 V and output about 2.84579…10.84579 V. Last-cycle output-input ripple is about 1.88 μV and integrated diode charge about 4.16×10⁻¹⁵ C, confirming near-periodic steady state. It differs from the 0.7 V approximation because the actual unloaded, low-current diode drop differs.

answer.zh: （1）v_o≈4sinωt+6.3 V，2.3～10.3 V。（2）指定1N4148模型、原图空载的周期稳态约2.84579～10.84579 V，不能混用固定0.7 V答案。
answer.en: (1) v_o≈4sinωt+6.3 V, from 2.3 to 10.3 V. (2) The specified unloaded 1N4148 model has periodic output about 2.84579…10.84579 V; do not substitute the fixed-drop answer.

pitfalls.zh: 原图没有R_L；随意加负载会改变实际二极管稳态。
pitfalls.en: No R_L is drawn; an added load changes real-diode steady state.

pitfalls.zh: 初始电容为零的前几个周期不等于稳态波形。
pitfalls.en: The first cycles from zero capacitor charge are not the steady waveform.

methods.zh: 恒压降式按原二极管极性检查最低输出；实际模型用独立DC I–V扫描及整周期电荷平衡求初始状态，再以瞬态周期端点、电荷积分、半步长检查。
methods.en: Checked constant-drop minimum against diode polarity. For the actual model, an independent DC I–V sweep and cycle charge balance determine the initial state, then transient endpoints, charge integration and a half-step check verify it.

assumptions.zh: （1）0.7 V恒压降、稳态电容保持；（2）指定EVAL 1N4148、27°C、原图空载、C=10 μF、理想输入及3 V偏置源。
assumptions.en: Part (1): held steady-state capacitor charge and 0.7 V drop. Part (2): specified EVAL 1N4148 at 27°C, original unloaded circuit, C=10 μF and ideal input/3 V sources.

alt.zh: 实际ngspice末两周期的输入与输出波形，模型条件见解析。
alt.en: Executed ngspice input/output over the final two cycles; see stated models.

caption.zh: 实际执行的SPICE模型输出；所用模型和条件见解析。
caption.en: Executed SPICE model output; models and conditions are stated in the solution.

completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先算每管偏置电流，再算小信号分压
title.en: Find each diode bias current, then incremental division

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 低压稳压电路如图题3.4.15，V_DD=(10±1)V，R=1 kΩ，三只硅二极管串联接地。（1）用恒压降模型求I_D、V_O（V_D=0.7 V）；（2）室温300 K，利用小信号模型求V_O变化范围。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.15, V_DD=(10±1)V, R=1 kΩ and three series silicon diodes to ground. (1) Find I_D and V_O using 0.7 V diode drops. (2) At 300 K, use the small-signal model to find output range.

alt.zh: V_DD经1 kΩ到输出，输出经三只同向串联二极管接地。无外接负载。
alt.en: V_DD reaches output through 1 kΩ; three forward series diodes connect output to ground. There is no external load.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 三管静态输出约2.1 V，偏置电流为7.9 mA。用各管r_d=26 mV/I_D，再把三个r_d串联。
recognition.en: The three-diode DC output is about 2.1 V. Bias current is 7.9 mA. Use r_d=26 mV/I_D for each, then series-connect the three.

text.en: Constant-drop approximation gives V_OQ=2.1 V. I_DQ=(10−2.1)/1k=7.9 mA.

text.zh: 每管r_d≈3.291139 Ω，三管总计9.873418 Ω。供电±1 V通过1 kΩ与输出等效电阻分压。
text.en: Each diode has r_d≈3.291139 Ω, total 9.873418 Ω. The ±1 V supply change divides between 1 kΩ and the incremental shunt.

answer.en: First-order small-signal approximation: V_O≈2.1 V±9.776886 mV, or 2.090223…2.109777 V.

pitfalls.zh: r_d由每只二极管的静态电流决定，不是总供电电流。
pitfalls.en: r_d uses each diode’s bias current, not total supply current.

pitfalls.zh: 这是围绕静态点的线性化范围，不是指数模型大信号精确端点。
pitfalls.en: This range is linearized around bias, not exact large-signal exponential endpoints.

methods.zh: 独立线性化原节点KCL，求输出对供电的导数；有负载时同时保留R_L项，所得导数与小信号分压一致。
methods.en: Independently differentiated original node KCL with respect to supply, retaining the load term where present; sensitivity agrees with incremental division.

assumptions.zh: 静态每管0.7 V；小信号n=1、V_T=26 mV，围绕10 V供电线性化；不包含温漂及器件离散性。
assumptions.en: DC drop 0.7 V per diode; small-signal n=1 and V_T=26 mV, linearized at 10 V supply; temperature drift and device spread excluded.

title.zh: 先算每管偏置电流，再算小信号分压
title.en: Find each diode bias current, then incremental division

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在图题3.4.15的基础上，输出端外接R_L=1 kΩ负载，问输出电压的变化范围是多少？原电路V_DD=(10±1)V，R=1 kΩ，三个硅二极管串联，按室温小信号模型分析。
statement.en: Add R_L=1 kΩ at the output of Fig. 3.4.15. Find output-voltage range using the room-temperature small-signal model. The original supply is (10±1)V, R=1 kΩ, and three series silicon diodes.

alt.zh: V_DD经1 kΩ到输出，输出经三只同向串联二极管接地。另有1 kΩ负载从输出到地。
alt.en: V_DD reaches output through 1 kΩ; three forward series diodes connect output to ground. An additional 1 kΩ load connects output to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 三管静态输出约2.1 V，负载先分走2.1 mA，剩余5.8 mA才流过二极管。用各管r_d=26 mV/I_D，再把三个r_d串联。
recognition.en: The three-diode DC output is about 2.1 V. Load takes 2.1 mA, leaving 5.8 mA in each diode. Use r_d=26 mV/I_D for each, then series-connect the three.

text.zh: 恒压降近似给V_OQ=3×0.7=2.1 V。总电阻电流7.9 mA扣除负载2.1 mA，I_DQ=5.8 mA。
text.en: Constant-drop approximation gives V_OQ=2.1 V. Subtract 2.1 mA load from 7.9 mA resistor current to obtain 5.8 mA diode current.

text.zh: 每管r_d≈4.482759 Ω，三管总计13.448276 Ω。还须与1 kΩ负载并联。供电±1 V通过1 kΩ与输出等效电阻分压。
text.en: Each diode has r_d≈4.482759 Ω, total 13.448276 Ω. Place this in parallel with the 1 kΩ load. The ±1 V supply change divides between 1 kΩ and the incremental shunt.

answer.en: First-order small-signal approximation: V_O≈2.1 V±13.096038 mV, or 2.086904…2.113096 V.

pitfalls.zh: r_d由每只二极管的静态电流决定，不是总供电电流。
pitfalls.en: r_d uses each diode’s bias current, not total supply current.

pitfalls.zh: 这是围绕静态点的线性化范围，不是指数模型大信号精确端点。
pitfalls.en: This range is linearized around bias, not exact large-signal exponential endpoints.

methods.zh: 独立线性化原节点KCL，求输出对供电的导数；有负载时同时保留R_L项，所得导数与小信号分压一致。
methods.en: Independently differentiated original node KCL with respect to supply, retaining the load term where present; sensitivity agrees with incremental division.

assumptions.zh: 静态每管0.7 V；小信号n=1、V_T=26 mV，围绕10 V供电线性化；不包含温漂及器件离散性。
assumptions.en: DC drop 0.7 V per diode; small-signal n=1 and V_T=26 mV, linearized at 10 V supply; temperature drift and device spread excluded.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 把最差输入端点化为两个联立约束
title.en: Turn supply extremes into coupled constraints

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 低压稳压电路如图题3.4.17，5 V≤V_I≤10 V；保证二极管正向压降0.7 V的最小电流I_D(min)=2 mA，最大整流电流I_D(max)=15 mA。用恒压降模型，在保持V_O=0.7 V时讨论R、R_L取值范围。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.4.17, 5 V≤V_I≤10 V. Diode current must be at least 2 mA to maintain a 0.7 V drop and no more than 15 mA. Using a constant-drop model, determine allowed R and R_L while maintaining V_O=0.7 V.

alt.zh: V_I经R到输出，正向二极管和R_L均从输出并联接地。
alt.en: V_I reaches output through R; the forward diode and R_L both shunt output to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 小输入检查二极管最小电流，大输入检查最大电流；负载电流0.7/R_L一直存在。R和R_L是耦合范围，不能分别给两个互不相关区间。
recognition.en: Minimum supply checks minimum diode current, maximum supply checks maximum current. Load current is always 0.7/R_L; R/R_L ranges are coupled, not independent intervals.

text.zh: 二极管电流随V_I单调增加，故只需检查5 V和10 V两个端点。
text.en: Diode current increases monotonically with supply, so only the 5 V and 10 V endpoints need checking.

title.en: R interval for a given load

text.zh: 两不等式联立即为完整设计条件；区间存在需R_L≥76.2527 Ω（允许边界等号）。
text.en: Their intersection gives the complete design condition; it exists for R_L≥76.2527 Ω, including equality.

text.zh: 例如R=1 kΩ，则R_L≥304.3478 Ω（含空载）满足两端电流；临界负载76.2527 Ω时，R只能为384.6154 Ω。空载时R为620～2150 Ω。
text.en: For example R=1 kΩ permits R_L≥304.3478 Ω, including open load. At the limiting load 76.2527 Ω, R is fixed at 384.6154 Ω. With no load, R may be 620…2150 Ω.

answer.zh: 完整范围由两端电流不等式或上述R(R_L)区间给出；可行负载R_L≥76.2527 Ω。取R=1 kΩ时，R_L≥304.3478 Ω。
answer.en: The coupled endpoint inequalities, or the stated R(R_L) interval, give the full range. Feasible R_L≥76.2527 Ω; for R=1 kΩ, R_L≥304.3478 Ω.

pitfalls.zh: 最大输入还必须检查15 mA上限，不能只保留最低2 mA。
pitfalls.en: Check the 15 mA limit at maximum supply as well as the 2 mA minimum.

methods.zh: 按原图KCL在输入两端独立回算电流；可行负载边界同时达到2 mA和15 mA，随机可行点扫描中间供电均在范围内。
methods.en: Independent original-node KCL checks both endpoints; the limiting design attains 2/15 mA simultaneously, and sampled feasible designs remain within bounds at intermediate supplies.

assumptions.zh: 0.7 V恒压降，仅在题给2～15 mA内使用；电阻均正，允许R_L→∞。
assumptions.en: 0.7 V model used only within the specified 2…15 mA diode-current range; positive resistances, including R_L→∞.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 单管两向不同；反串双管两向对称
title.en: One zener is asymmetric; an opposing pair is symmetric

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题3.5.1，所有稳压管均为硅管，稳定电压V_Z=8 V，v_i=15sinωt V。绘出v_o1和v_o2波形。
statement.en: In Fig. 3.5.1 all zeners are silicon with V_Z=8 V. For v_i=15sinωt V, draw v_o1 and v_o2.

alt.zh: 两图输入均经3 kΩ到输出。（a）单稳压管阴极在输出、阳极接地；（b）两只稳压管反向串联接在输出与地之间。
alt.en: Both inputs feed output through 3 kΩ. (a) One zener has cathode at output and anode at ground. (b) Two opposing series zeners connect output to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 单管正向只需0.7 V，反向需8 V；反串双管任一方向都是一只击穿、一只正向，总计8.7 V。
recognition.en: A single zener needs 0.7 V forward or 8 V reverse. An opposing pair has one in breakdown and one forward in either direction, totaling 8.7 V.

text.zh: v_o1正峰钳8 V、负峰钳−0.7 V；未达限幅时跟随输入。
text.en: v_o1 clips at +8 V and −0.7 V, following input between limits.

text.zh: v_o2在±8.7 V对称限幅；不能把正向那只压降漏掉。
text.en: v_o2 clips symmetrically at ±8.7 V; include the forward-biased diode drop.

answer.zh: v_o1：−0.7～+8 V；v_o2：−8.7～+8.7 V，均在限幅区外截顶、区内跟随输入。
answer.en: v_o1 spans −0.7…+8 V; v_o2 spans −8.7…+8.7 V. Both follow input until clipping.

pitfalls.zh: 稳压管反向8 V不意味着正向也8 V。
pitfalls.en: An 8 V reverse zener rating does not imply an 8 V forward drop.

methods.zh: 逐极性枚举截止、正向和击穿状态，以串联3 kΩ求电流并确认状态一致；双管输出对称，单管方向与原图阴极一致。
methods.en: Enumerated off, forward and breakdown states by polarity; series 3 kΩ currents confirm each state. Pair symmetry and the single-zener orientation match the source.

assumptions.zh: 理想8 V击穿稳压、硅正向0.7 V；忽略动态电阻和反向漏电。
assumptions.en: Ideal 8 V reverse regulation and 0.7 V forward drop; dynamic resistance and leakage neglected.

alt.zh: 单管限幅−0.7/+8 V，反串双管限幅±8.7 V。
alt.en: Single-zener limits −0.7/+8 V; opposing pair limits ±8.7 V.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先写功率，再说明数值范围依赖I–V模型
title.en: Write power first; numerical current range needs an I–V model

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 稳压电路如图题3.5.2。（1）近似写稳压管耗散功率P_Z表达式，说明输入V_I和负载R_L在何种情况下P_Z最大或最小；（2）写负载吸收功率和限流电阻R耗散功率表达式；（3）稳压管选1N4733（V_Z=5.1 V、I_Z(max)=178 mA、I_ZT=49 mA），V_I=10 V、R=30 Ω、输出稳压值5.1 V，用SPICE分析V_O不小于5 V时输出电流范围。
statement.en: For Fig. 3.5.2: (1) derive approximate zener power and identify input/load conditions for maximum/minimum; (2) give load and series-resistor power; (3) use 1N4733 with V_Z=5.1 V, I_Z(max)=178 mA and I_ZT=49 mA, V_I=10 V and R=30 Ω in SPICE to find output-current range for V_O≥5 V.

alt.zh: V_I经R到V_O；稳压管阴极接V_O、阳极接地；R_L并接输出。I_R流入节点，I_Z向下，I_O流向负载。
alt.en: V_I reaches V_O through R; zener cathode is V_O and anode is ground, with R_L across output. I_R enters, I_Z flows downward and I_O feeds the load.

prerequisites.zh: 稳压管电流分配；功率；器件I–V模型与误差边界。
prerequisites.en: Zener current sharing; power; device I–V models and uncertainty.

recognition.zh: 先用I_R=I_Z+I_O。只给5.1 V@49 mA并不能唯一确定5 V时I_Z，所以SPICE数值必须绑定具体模型。
recognition.en: Start with I_R=I_Z+I_O. A 5.1 V @49 mA point does not uniquely determine I_Z at 5 V, so numerical SPICE results must name a model.

title.zh: 稳压管功率与最差条件

text.zh: 在稳压成立时V_O≈V_Z，输入越高、负载电阻越大（负载电流越小），P_Z越大，空载最危险；输入最低且负载电阻最小时P_Z最小，直到失稳边界。
text.en: While regulation holds V_O≈V_Z. Higher input and larger load resistance increase zener power; open load is worst. Lowest input and smallest load resistance minimize it, down to the loss-of-regulation boundary.

text.zh: 表达式仅适用于输出仍稳压的区间。
text.en: These expressions apply while the output remains regulated.

text.zh: 在V_O=5 V边界，负载电流=(10−5)/30−I_Z(5 V)，并须满足0≤I_Z≤178 mA。仅以恒定5.1 V且I_Z≥0近似，只能得到0～163.333 mA的理想极限；不能把它说成真实1N4733的5 V门限电流。
text.en: At the 5 V boundary, load current is (10−5)/30−I_Z(5 V), with 0≤I_Z≤178 mA. An ideal fixed-5.1 V approximation gives only a 0…163.333 mA limit; it is not a real 1N4733 5 V threshold prediction.

text.zh: 为给出可复现示例，另用自写分段线性模型V_Z=5.1+7(I_Z−0.049)（V/A单位），7 Ω选自数据表在49 mA处的最大微分阻抗，绝非完整厂商模型。实际DC扫描得V_O=5 V时I_O≈131.952 mA，示例范围0～131.952 mA；空载约5.74892 V、I_Z≈141.703 mA<178 mA。用最大局部斜率跨区外推不构成实物保证，其他SPICE模型会改变数值；原题未指定模型，真实数值不唯一。
text.en: For a reproducible illustration, an authored piecewise model uses V_Z=5.1+7(I_Z−0.049), in V/A. The 7 Ω is the datasheet’s maximum differential impedance at 49 mA, not a full manufacturer model. An executed DC sweep reaches V_O=5 V at I_O≈131.952 mA, giving the illustrative range 0…131.952 mA; no-load is about 5.74892 V at I_Z≈141.703 mA<178 mA. Extrapolating a maximum local slope is not a device guarantee. Other SPICE models change this result; the unspecified original model prevents a unique real-device number.

answer.zh: （1）（2）见功率式。（3）一般上限为166.667 mA−I_Z(5 V)，必须说明器件模型。本次明确标注的7 Ω分段线性SPICE示例为0～131.952 mA，不冒充真实器件唯一答案。
answer.en: (1)–(2) See power expressions. (3) General upper limit is 166.667 mA−I_Z(5 V), requiring an explicit I–V model. The clearly labeled 7 Ω piecewise SPICE example gives 0…131.952 mA, not a unique real-device answer.

pitfalls.zh: I_ZT=49 mA是测试电流，既不是最小稳压电流，也不是最大电流。
pitfalls.en: 49 mA is test current, not minimum regulation current or maximum current.

pitfalls.zh: 数据表局部最大微分阻抗不等于全范围真实I–V直线。
pitfalls.en: A maximum local differential impedance is not the full-range actual I–V line.

methods.zh: 原节点KCL及功率守恒独立推得各式；示例网表实际DC扫描，与分段线性节点方程独立求解的5 V交点及空载值相符，并检查178 mA上限。
methods.en: Original-node KCL and power conservation independently give the expressions. The executed illustrative DC sweep agrees with independent piecewise nodal solutions for the 5 V intersection and no-load point; the 178 mA limit was checked.

assumptions.zh: 功率式用理想恒压稳压近似；数值SPICE示例另用显式7 Ω局部斜率外推，不能据此保证实际1N4733输出精度。
assumptions.en: Power expressions use ideal voltage regulation. The numerical SPICE example explicitly extrapolates a 7 Ω local slope and does not guarantee actual 1N4733 accuracy.

results.model: authored piecewise linear approximation, not manufacturer macro-model

alt.zh: 自写7 Ω分段线性模型的实际DC扫描，非厂商完整模型或实物保证。
alt.en: Executed DC sweep of the authored 7 Ω piecewise model; not a manufacturer model or device guarantee.

caption.zh: 实际执行的SPICE模型输出；所用模型和条件见解析。
caption.en: Executed SPICE model output; models and conditions are stated in the solution.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 先由二极管电流限制反推负载电流
title.en: Infer allowed load current from zener limits

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 稳压电路如图题3.5.2，V_I=10 V，R=100 Ω，稳压管V_Z=5 V，I_Z(min)=5 mA、I_Z(max)=50 mA。（1）允许R_L变化范围？（2）最大输出功率P_OM？（3）稳压管最大耗散功率P_ZM和R上最大耗散功率P_RM？
statement.en: For Fig. 3.5.2, V_I=10 V, R=100 Ω, V_Z=5 V, I_Z(min)=5 mA and I_Z(max)=50 mA. (1) Find allowed R_L; (2) maximum output power; (3) maximum zener and resistor powers.

alt.zh: 本题引用图3.5.2：输入经100 Ω到输出，5 V稳压管与负载并联。
alt.en: Uses Fig. 3.5.2: input through 100 Ω, with the 5 V zener and load in parallel.

prerequisites.zh: 二极管导通/截止；KCL/KVL；所列简化模型。
prerequisites.en: Diode on/off states; KCL/KVL; the stated simplified models.

recognition.zh: 稳压时总电流固定50 mA，二极管至少保留5 mA，故负载最多取45 mA。
recognition.en: Regulated total current is fixed at 50 mA; reserve at least 5 mA for the zener, leaving at most 45 mA load current.

text.zh: I_R=(10−5)/100=50 mA，故0≤I_L≤45 mA，空载恰好达到I_Z最大值。
text.en: I_R=50 mA, so 0≤I_L≤45 mA; open load exactly reaches maximum zener current.

text.zh: 负载最大功率在R_L最小时；稳压管最大功率在空载；R压降固定5 V，耗散不随负载变化。
text.en: Maximum load power occurs at minimum R_L; maximum zener power at open load; resistor drop stays at 5 V, so its power is load independent.

answer.zh: R_L≥111.111 Ω，允许空载；P_OM=225 mW，P_ZM=250 mW，P_RM=250 mW。
answer.en: R_L≥111.111 Ω including open load; P_OM=225 mW, P_ZM=250 mW, P_RM=250 mW.

pitfalls.zh: 负载最大功率和稳压管最大功率发生在不同负载条件。
pitfalls.en: Maximum load and zener powers occur at different loads.

methods.zh: 分别在最大负载与空载检查I_R=I_Z+I_L以及V_I I_R=P_R+P_Z+P_L，两个端点均满足。
methods.en: At both maximum load and open load, checked I_R=I_Z+I_L and V_I I_R=P_R+P_Z+P_L.

assumptions.zh: 理想5 V稳压，二极管仅在5～50 mA范围使用；不计电源/电阻容差。
assumptions.en: Ideal 5 V regulation over the specified 5…50 mA range; source and resistor tolerances excluded.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题的全部小问已按所列模型核验。
completionNote.en: All parts of this main exercise have been checked under the stated models.

title.zh: 由最低输入定R，再用最高输入验功率
title.en: Set R from minimum input, then check maximum-input power

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设计一稳压管并联式稳压电路，要求V_O=4 V、I_O=15 mA；输入直流V_I=6 V且有10%波动。试选稳压管型号和合适限流电阻，检验功率定额。
statement.en: Design a shunt-zener regulator with V_O=4 V and I_O=15 mA from a 6 V DC input varying by ±10%. Choose a zener type and series resistor, checking power ratings.

prerequisites.zh: 并联稳压；输入上下限；器件容差；额定功率。
prerequisites.en: Shunt regulation; supply extremes; device tolerance; power ratings.

recognition.zh: 输入范围5.4～6.6 V。先为稳压管保留电流，再选R；题目未给输出误差，必须区分教材4 V近似与实物3.9 V标称。
recognition.en: Input spans 5.4…6.6 V. Reserve zener current before selecting R. No output tolerance is given, so distinguish a textbook 4 V approximation from a nominal 3.9 V part.

title.zh: 教材4 V模型的一组设计
title.en: One design under the textbook 4 V model

text.zh: 选R=62 Ω，最低输入时I_Z=(5.4−4)/62−15m≈7.581 mA，最高输入时≈26.935 mA，均为正且远低于0.5 W/4 V。
text.en: Choose R=62 Ω. Zener current ranges from (5.4−4)/62−15m≈7.581 mA to 26.935 mA, positive and far below 0.5 W/4 V.

title.zh: 给出实物候选并说明精度

text.zh: 可用Vishay BZX55C3V9（标称3.9 V、0.5 W）作约4 V方案，配62 Ω、0.5 W电阻。数据表在5 mA测试点的电压档为3.7～4.1 V；该器件并不保证4.000 V。若要求严格4 V，原题缺少误差与温度条件，应选实测4 V分档/校准方案，并复核整个工作电流范围，不能把3.9 V直接宣称精确4 V。
text.en: Vishay BZX55C3V9 (nominal 3.9 V, 0.5 W) with a 62 Ω, 0.5 W resistor is an approximately 4 V candidate. Its datasheet range at the 5 mA test point is 3.7…4.1 V; it does not guarantee 4.000 V. Strict 4 V requires missing tolerance/temperature requirements, screened or calibrated parts, and verification over the operating-current range; nominal 3.9 V must not be called exact 4 V.

text.zh: 在理想4 V模型、15 mA负载下，P_Z最大≈0.107742 W，P_R最大≈0.109032 W；高输入空载P_Z≈0.167742 W。若仅作3.7～4.1 V恒压档的保守角点核验，带载最小I_Z≈5.968 mA，P_Z≤0.117565 W、P_R≤0.135645 W，空载P_Z≤0.173065 W；均低于所选0.5 W额定。该角点检查不把数据表测试点容差当作全电流范围电压保证。
text.en: In the ideal 4 V model at 15 mA load, maximum P_Z≈0.107742 W and P_R≈0.109032 W; high-input open-load P_Z≈0.167742 W. A conservative constant-voltage corner check over 3.7…4.1 V gives loaded minimum I_Z≈5.968 mA, P_Z≤0.117565 W, P_R≤0.135645 W and open-load P_Z≤0.173065 W, below 0.5 W ratings. This corner check does not turn test-point tolerance into a full-current voltage guarantee.

answer.zh: 一组教材近似设计：约4 V、≥0.5 W稳压管，R=62 Ω/0.5 W；可选BZX55C3V9作约4 V候选，须明确其标称3.9 V及精度限制。严格4.000 V不能由原题信息或此型号直接保证。
answer.en: One textbook approximate design: approximately 4 V zener rated at least 0.5 W and R=62 Ω/0.5 W. BZX55C3V9 is an approximately 4 V candidate with nominal 3.9 V and explicit accuracy limits; strict 4.000 V is not guaranteed by this part or the given information.

pitfalls.zh: 输入最低时仍须给稳压管留电流，不能只按15 mA负载算R。
pitfalls.en: Reserve zener current at minimum input; do not size R using load current alone.

pitfalls.zh: 型号的标称、容差、测试电流及温度条件都影响实物输出。
pitfalls.en: Nominal voltage, tolerance, test current and temperature all affect real output.

methods.zh: 按原并联稳压KCL独立检查输入上下限、负载与空载；功率逐角点计算，并检查V_Z(6.6−V_Z)/R在给定电压区间单调下降，最差值发生在3.7 V端。
methods.en: Independent shunt-node KCL checks input extremes with load and open load. Power was checked at each corner; V_Z(6.6−V_Z)/R decreases over the stated voltage interval, placing worst-case open-load power at 3.7 V.

assumptions.zh: 教材计算用恒定4 V；实物选型仅为约4 V候选，0.5 W按数据表规定散热条件使用；未声称跨温度/电流/容差保证4 V。
assumptions.en: Textbook calculations use constant 4 V. The real part is only an approximately 4 V candidate, with 0.5 W rating subject to datasheet thermal conditions; no exact 4 V guarantee across temperature/current/tolerance is claimed.

externalReferences.title: Vishay · BZX55 voltage bins and thermal ratings

title.zh: 平衡四电阻，让负载电压项抵消
title.en: Balance four resistors to cancel the load-voltage term

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题2.3.10所示电路可以将电压源v_s转换为电流源i_L，驱动线圈Z_L。为使i_L独立于Z_L，电路中设定R₂/(R₁R₃)=1/R₄。试求i_L/v_s表达式。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 2.3.10 converts source voltage v_s to current i_L to drive coil Z_L. To make i_L independent of Z_L, set R₂/(R₁R₃)=1/R₄. Derive i_L/v_s.

alt.zh: v_s经R₁接反相节点，R₂从该节点反馈到运放输出v_o；同相端接负载上端v_L。输出经R₃接v_L；R₄及Z_L分别由v_L接地，i_L箭头向下。
alt.en: v_s connects through R₁ to the inverting node, with R₂ to output v_o. The noninverting input senses load voltage v_L. R₃ connects output to v_L; R₄ and Z_L each connect v_L to ground. i_L points downward.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.

recognition.zh: 不能把运放看成简单反相放大器：同相端不是地。先令v_n=v_L，最后用平衡条件消掉v_L。
recognition.en: This is not a grounded-input inverter: its noninverting input is v_L. Set v_n=v_L and use the balance condition only after writing load KCL.

text.zh: 输入电流为零，先把v_o写成v_L和v_s的函数。
text.en: Zero input current expresses v_o in terms of v_L and v_s.

text.zh: 由R₃流入的电流要分给R₄和线圈；不要把R₃电流全当作i_L。
text.en: Current through R₃ splits between R₄ and the coil; it is not all load current.

title.zh: 代入平衡条件并检查符号
title.en: Apply balance and check the sign

text.zh: v_L项抵消，向下为正的电流与v_s反相。若Z_L在线性频域为有限阻抗，v_L=Z_L i_L，运放仍需提供随负载变化的v_o；“电流不依赖负载”不等于无限输出余量。
text.en: The v_L term cancels. Downward-reference load current has opposite sign to v_s. For finite linear impedance Z_L, v_L=Z_L i_L, while v_o still changes with the load; load independence does not imply unlimited compliance.

answer.zh: i_L/v_s=−R₂/(R₁R₃)=−1/R₄（按原图向下的i_L参考方向）。
answer.en: i_L/v_s=−R₂/(R₁R₃)=−1/R₄ for the downward i_L reference in the source figure.

pitfalls.zh: 这里有负号；若把输出电流箭头反向，才写成+1/R₄。
pitfalls.en: Retain the negative sign; reversing the load-current arrow gives +1/R₄.

pitfalls.zh: 电阻失配会留下v_L项，实际负载独立性也受运放输出余量限制。
pitfalls.en: Mismatch leaves a v_L-dependent term; real compliance also limits load independence.

methods.zh: 用独立线性节点求解扫描多组平衡电阻、源电压和负载电阻，逐项回代原反相节点与负载节点KCL；另用复数负载检查同一传输关系。
methods.en: Independent linear nodal solves scan balanced resistor sets, sources and resistive loads, then substitute both original KCL equations; complex loads verify the same transfer.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 双虚地电桥给出严格线性失衡信号
title.en: A dual-virtual-ground bridge gives a linear imbalance signal

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电桥测量电路如图题2.3.11所示。试推导v_o与δ的关系式，并说明电路特点。
statement.en: For the bridge measurement circuit in Fig. 2.3.11, derive v_o as a function of δ and explain its characteristics.

alt.zh: 电桥顶端接V_REF，底端由A₁输出v_o1驱动；上两臂均R₁，下左臂R(1+δ)、下右臂R。左中点A接A₁反相端，右中点B接A₂反相端，A₂以R₂反馈；两同相端均接地。
alt.en: Bridge top is V_REF and bottom is driven by A₁ output v_o1. Both upper arms are R₁; lower left is R(1+δ) and lower right R. Midpoint A feeds A₁ inverting input; B feeds A₂ inverting input with R₂ feedback. Both noninverting inputs are grounded.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.

recognition.zh: 两个中点都是0 V，先从左臂平衡求桥底电压，再用右中点KCL求输出；不需要小δ展开。
recognition.en: Both midpoints are held at 0 V. Left-arm KCL determines the bridge-bottom voltage; right-arm KCL determines output without a small-δ expansion.

title.en: Find the bridge drive from A

text.zh: A₁输入不取电流，V_REF经R₁流来的电流全部经R(1+δ)流到v_o1。
text.en: A₁ draws no input current, so the current from V_REF through R₁ flows through R(1+δ) to v_o1.

text.zh: B也为0 V，R₂反馈电流抵消右桥臂失衡电流。
text.en: B is also at 0 V; feedback through R₂ cancels the right-arm imbalance current.

title.en: Interpret the measurement and its limits

text.zh: δ=0时输出0；在理想电阻和运放模型下对相对电阻变化δ严格线性，灵敏度为V_REF R₂/R₁，结果与下臂标称R无关。代价是两运放和足够输出余量；需1+δ>0，匹配误差、偏置和饱和会破坏理想结果。
text.en: Output is zero at δ=0 and exactly linear in relative resistance change δ in the ideal model. Sensitivity is V_REF R₂/R₁, independent of nominal lower-arm R. It requires two op amps and output headroom, with 1+δ>0; mismatch, offsets and clipping cause errors.

answer.zh: v_o=(R₂/R₁)V_REF δ；理想模型下零点平衡、对δ严格线性、灵敏度可调，且不依赖下臂标称R。
answer.en: v_o=(R₂/R₁)V_REF δ: balanced zero, exactly linear ideal response, adjustable sensitivity, and independence from nominal lower-arm R.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把桥底端误当地；它是A₁的可变输出。
pitfalls.en: The bridge bottom is A₁’s driven output, not ground.

pitfalls.zh: 这里的线性是反馈电桥的精确理想结果，不是普通无源电桥的小信号近似。
pitfalls.en: Linearity is exact for this ideal feedback bridge, not a small-signal approximation for a passive bridge.

methods.zh: 逐组独立解两中点KCL，扫描δ、V_REF及不同R；核查δ=0输出为0和δ反号输出反号，并回代全部支路电流。
methods.en: Independent midpoint-KCL solves scan δ, V_REF and R, verifying balanced zero and sign reversal, with branch-current substitution.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 先算非零同相偏置，再做输出级功率账
title.en: Find the nonzero bias before the output-stage power balance

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.3.12所示，设运放的静态电流I_Q=1.5 mA。（1）当v_i=2 V时，求输出电压v_o、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率；（2）当v_i=−2 V时，再求输出电压v_o、各支路电流和运放的耗散功率。
statement.en: For Fig. 2.3.12 with op-amp quiescent current I_Q=1.5 mA: (1) find output voltage, all branch currents, and op-amp dissipation for v_i=2 V; (2) repeat for v_i=−2 V.

alt.zh: 反相输入经10 kΩ接v_i、经30 kΩ接输出；输出以2 kΩ接地。同相输入经10 kΩ接地、经140 kΩ接−15 V。运放供电±15 V。
alt.en: Inverting input connects through 10 kΩ to v_i and 30 kΩ to output. Output has a 2 kΩ load to ground. Noninverting input connects through 10 kΩ to ground and 140 kΩ to −15 V. Supplies are ±15 V.

prerequisites.zh: 带偏置的反相电路；源出/吸收输出电流；供电功率减输出功率。
prerequisites.en: Biased inverting circuit; source/sink output current; supply power minus output power.

recognition.zh: 同相端不是地！10 kΩ与140 kΩ先分出−1 V。输出级的电流还包含反馈电阻电流，不能只算2 kΩ负载。
recognition.en: The noninverting input is not grounded: the 10/140 kΩ divider sets −1 V. Output current includes the feedback branch as well as the 2 kΩ load.

title.zh: 先求公共偏置与传输式
title.en: Find the bias and transfer relation

text.zh: 分压支路电流为15 V/150 kΩ=0.100 mA，从地经10 kΩ、140 kΩ流向−15 V。两运放输入电流均0，v_n=v_p=−1 V。
text.en: Divider current is 0.100 mA, from ground through 10 kΩ and 140 kΩ to −15 V. Both input currents are zero and v_n=v_p=−1 V.

text.zh: 定义i_i从输入源流向反相节点，i_f从反相节点流向输出，i_L从输出流向地，i_o从运放输出端流向外部电路。
text.en: Define i_i from source to inverting node, i_f from that node to output, i_L from output to ground, and i_o out of the op amp.

text.zh: 输出−10 V；i_i=i_f=+0.300 mA，i_L=−5.000 mA，i_o=−5.300 mA。实际负载电流由地流向输出；输出级把5.300 mA送到−15 V电源，输出级压差5 V。
text.en: Output is −10 V; i_i=i_f=+0.300 mA, i_L=−5.000 mA, i_o=−5.300 mA. Load current flows from ground toward output, and the stage sinks 5.300 mA to −15 V across a 5 V drop.

text.zh: 输出+2 V；i_i=i_f=−0.100 mA，i_L=+1.000 mA，i_o=+1.100 mA。输出向负载供1.000 mA、向反馈支路供0.100 mA，输出级从+15 V取电，压差13 V。
text.en: Output is +2 V; i_i=i_f=−0.100 mA, i_L=+1.000 mA, i_o=+1.100 mA. Output supplies 1.000 mA to the load and 0.100 mA through feedback; its stage drops 13 V from the +15 V rail.

title.en: Check independently at the supply terminals

text.zh: （1）运放+轨取1.5 mA、−轨吸收6.8 mA，供电124.5 mW，输出交付53.0 mW，差71.5 mW。（2）+轨取2.6 mA、−轨吸收1.5 mA，供电61.5 mW，输出交付2.2 mW，差59.3 mW。偏置分压另耗1.5 mW，属于外部电阻，不纳入运放。
text.en: (1) Op-amp rail currents are 1.5 mA from +15 V and 6.8 mA into −15 V: 124.5 mW supply minus 53.0 mW output equals 71.5 mW. (2) They are 2.6/1.5 mA: 61.5 mW minus 2.2 mW equals 59.3 mW. The bias divider separately dissipates 1.5 mW outside the op amp.

answer.zh: v_p=v_n=−1 V，偏置支路0.100 mA，输入端电流0。（1）v_o=−10 V，输出吸收5.300 mA，运放耗散71.5 mW；（2）v_o=+2 V，输出提供1.100 mA，运放耗散59.3 mW。各支路方向见步骤。
answer.en: v_p=v_n=−1 V, divider current 0.100 mA, input-pin currents zero. (1) v_o=−10 V, sinking 5.300 mA, dissipation 71.5 mW. (2) v_o=+2 V, sourcing 1.100 mA, dissipation 59.3 mW. Branch directions are defined in the steps.

pitfalls.zh: 将同相端当0 V会把两问输出都算错。
pitfalls.en: Treating the noninverting input as 0 V gives wrong outputs in both parts.

pitfalls.zh: 运放耗散既不是负载功率，也不是总电源功率；需要扣除输出交付功率。
pitfalls.en: Op-amp dissipation is neither load power nor total supply power; subtract delivered output power.

pitfalls.zh: 电源总表若包含外部分压器，其负轨还多0.100 mA；这不是芯片自身电流。
pitfalls.en: A supply measurement including the external divider adds 0.100 mA to the negative rail; it is not chip current.

methods.zh: 独立解反相与偏置两节点KCL，核对输出KCL；分别用输出级压降乘电流、各运放供电端输入功率减输出功率两种算法，均得71.5/59.3 mW；再以含输入源及外部电阻的全电路功率平衡复核。
methods.en: Independent bias/inverting KCL and output KCL. Stage voltage-drop loss and rail-power-minus-output calculations both give 71.5/59.3 mW; a whole-circuit balance including the input source and external resistors provides another check.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放输入端不取电流、在线性区，供电±15 V；I_Q=1.5 mA为每条电源的静态电流。按教材输出级供电近似：源出电流由+15 V供给、吸收电流流入−15 V，除I_Q外不加其他内部电流。外部电阻耗散不计作运放耗散。
assumptions.en: Ideal linear op amp, zero input currents, ±15 V supplies; I_Q=1.5 mA is the quiescent current in each supply rail. Use the textbook output-stage approximation: source current comes from +15 V and sink current enters −15 V, without additional internal current beyond I_Q. External resistor loss is not op-amp dissipation.

completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 先定反馈电阻，再按系数分配输入电阻
title.en: Choose feedback resistance, then divide by each coefficient

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 设计一反相加法器，使其输出电压v_o=−(7v_i1+14v_i2+3.5v_i3+10v_i4)，允许使用的最大电阻值为280 kΩ，求各支路的电阻。
statement.en: Design an inverting summer with v_o=−(7v_i1+14v_i2+3.5v_i3+10v_i4). The largest allowed resistor is 280 kΩ. Find the branch resistances.

prerequisites.zh: 反相加法器与虚地KCL；电阻比设计。
prerequisites.en: Inverting summation and virtual-ground KCL; resistor-ratio design.

recognition.zh: 系数等于R_f/R_i，题目给的是电阻上限，解不是唯一。选择R_f=280 kΩ可得到一组便于核对的输入电阻。
recognition.en: Each coefficient is R_f/R_i. A maximum resistance does not make the design unique; R_f=280 kΩ gives a convenient valid set.

text.zh: 四个输入各经R_i进入反相节点，R_f从输出反馈，同相端接地。虚地KCL给加权和。
text.en: Each input reaches the inverting node through R_i; R_f feeds back output, and the noninverting input is grounded. Virtual-ground KCL gives the weighted sum.

title.zh: 选取一组满足上限的阻值
title.en: Select a set within the limit

text.zh: 取R_f=280 kΩ，各输入电阻如下；全部不大于280 kΩ。理想模型下同相端可直接接地，不额外要求偏置补偿电阻。
text.en: Choose R_f=280 kΩ, giving the following input values; all satisfy the limit. The ideal noninverting input may connect directly to ground; no bias-compensation resistor is required.

title.en: Check one input at a time

text.zh: 分别只令一个输入为1 V，其余接地，输出应为−7、−14、−3.5、−10 V；这也是检查输入编号与权重是否交换的快速方法。
text.en: Set each input to 1 V in turn, grounding the others: outputs must be −7, −14, −3.5 and −10 V. This quickly detects swapped input weights.

answer.zh: 一组解：反馈R_f=280 kΩ；输入R₁=40 kΩ、R₂=20 kΩ、R₃=80 kΩ、R₄=28 kΩ。也可同比缩小整组电阻。
answer.en: One solution: feedback R_f=280 kΩ; inputs R₁=40 kΩ, R₂=20 kΩ, R₃=80 kΩ, R₄=28 kΩ. Uniformly smaller sets also work.

pitfalls.zh: 权重越大，输入电阻越小，不是越大。
pitfalls.en: A larger coefficient requires a smaller input resistance.

pitfalls.zh: 系数关系不保证任意输入下都不饱和；实际输入幅值仍须满足输出范围。
pitfalls.en: Correct ratios do not prevent clipping for arbitrary input levels; signals must fit the output range.

methods.zh: 四个独立单位输入与随机输入向量代入原虚地KCL，核对所有系数和280 kΩ上限。
methods.en: Four unit-input checks and random input vectors are substituted into original virtual-ground KCL; all coefficients and the 280 kΩ maximum are checked.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 同相节点先做电导加权平均
title.en: First find the conductance-weighted noninverting input

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 同相输入加法电路如图题2.4.2a、b所示。（1）求图a中输出电压v_o的表达式。当R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄时，v_o应为多少？（2）求图b中输出电压v_o的表达式。当R₁=R₂=R₃时，v_o应为多少？
statement.en: For the noninverting summing circuits in Fig. 2.4.2: (1) derive v_o for (a), and specialize to R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄; (2) derive v_o for (b), and specialize to R₁=R₂=R₃.

alt.zh: 图a：v_i1、v_i2经R₁、R₂接同相端；反相端经R₃接地、R₄接输出。图b：三个输入各经R₁、R₂、R₃接同相端；输出直接反馈反相端。
alt.en: (a) v_i1/v_i2 reach the noninverting input through R₁/R₂; R₃ grounds the inverting node and R₄ feeds back output. (b) Three inputs reach the noninverting input through R₁/R₂/R₃, with direct output-to-inverting feedback.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.

recognition.zh: 同相端不取电流，但输入电阻之间仍有电流；先算加权平均，再乘闭环电压增益。
recognition.en: The input pin draws no current, but current flows between input sources through their resistors. Compute the weighted average before multiplying by closed-loop gain.

text.zh: 同相节点KCL给两信号的电导加权平均；反相反馈的增益为1+R₄/R₃。
text.en: Noninverting KCL gives a conductance-weighted average; feedback gain is 1+R₄/R₃.

text.zh: 输入节点是二者平均值，闭环增益2正好抵消除以2。
text.en: The input is the average, and gain 2 cancels the factor 1/2.

text.zh: 闭环增益1，输出直接等于三路输入的电导加权平均。
text.en: Unity gain makes output equal to the three-input conductance-weighted average.

answer.zh: 图a：v_o=(1+R₄/R₃)(R₂v_i1+R₁v_i2)/(R₁+R₂)，等值时为两输入之和。图b：电导加权平均，等值时为三输入之和的1/3。
answer.en: (a) v_o=(1+R₄/R₃)(R₂v_i1+R₁v_i2)/(R₁+R₂), giving the sum for equal resistors. (b) A conductance-weighted average, giving one third of the sum for equal resistors.

pitfalls.zh: 图b没有增益3，不能直接写三路相加。
pitfalls.en: Circuit (b) has no gain of 3; its output is not the unscaled sum.

pitfalls.zh: 等值之前先写一般电导式，避免把R₁、R₂的权重写反。
pitfalls.en: Write the general conductance formula first to avoid exchanging resistor weights.

methods.zh: 随机输入及正电阻独立解同相节点与反相节点线性方程，并核对等值特例和共同输入时的增益。
methods.en: Independent linear input-node solves for random sources and positive resistors, with equal-resistor and equal-input special cases.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 区分差模端口与单端输入电阻
title.en: Distinguish differential-port and single-ended input resistances

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 差分放大电路如图2.4.3a所示，已知R₄/R₁=R₃/R₂，差模电压增益A_vd=10。（1）若差模输入电阻R_id=20 kΩ，且R₁=R₂，求R₁、R₂、R₃和R₄的阻值；（2）v_i2=0时，求从v_i1输入端看进去的输入电阻R_i1；（3）v_i1=0时，求从v_i2输入端看进去的输入电阻R_i2。
statement.en: For the differential amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.3(a), R₄/R₁=R₃/R₂ and differential gain A_vd=10. (1) With differential input resistance R_id=20 kΩ and R₁=R₂, find all four resistors. (2) With v_i2=0, find input resistance seen at v_i1. (3) With v_i1=0, find input resistance seen at v_i2.

alt.zh: 正文图2.4.3：v_i1经R₁接反相端，反馈R₄；v_i2经R₂接同相端，同相端经R₃接地；图b展示浮置差模测试源。
alt.en: Body Fig. 2.4.3: v_i1 reaches the inverting node through R₁, with R₄ feedback. v_i2 reaches the noninverting node through R₂, with R₃ to ground. Part (b) illustrates a floating differential test source.

prerequisites.zh: 求差电路；浮置差模端口；输入测试源法。
prerequisites.en: Differential amplifier; floating differential port; input test-source method.

recognition.zh: R_id、R_i1、R_i2是三种不同的测试连接。差模源跨两输入；单端测试则将另一输入接地。
recognition.en: R_id, R_i1 and R_i2 correspond to different test connections: a differential source bridges both inputs, whereas single-ended tests ground the other input.

text.zh: 浮置差模源的两端电流相等反向；由于v_n=v_p，源电压只降在R₁+R₂上。由增益10再定R₃、R₄。
text.en: A floating differential source has equal opposite terminal currents. Since v_n=v_p, source voltage drops across R₁+R₂. Gain 10 then fixes R₃ and R₄.

text.zh: 同相端为0 V，反相端虚地；输入v_i1直接看到R₁。
text.en: The noninverting node and virtual inverting node are at 0 V, so v_i1 sees R₁.

text.zh: 同相输入引脚不取电流，v_i2的全部输入电流经R₂与R₃串联到地；运放反馈自动调整反相节点，不会给同相支路增加引脚电流。
text.en: The noninverting pin draws no current, so all v_i2 input current passes through series R₂ and R₃ to ground. Feedback adjusts the inverting node without drawing current into the noninverting pin.

answer.zh: R₁=R₂=10 kΩ，R₃=R₄=100 kΩ；R_i1=10 kΩ，R_i2=110 kΩ，而浮置差模输入电阻为20 kΩ。
answer.en: R₁=R₂=10 kΩ, R₃=R₄=100 kΩ; R_i1=10 kΩ, R_i2=110 kΩ, while floating differential input resistance is 20 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把R_id直接当作任一单端输入电阻。
pitfalls.en: Do not use R_id as either single-ended input resistance.

pitfalls.zh: 本题引用正文图2.4.3，不是同号图题。
pitfalls.en: This exercise refers to the body figure, not a similarly numbered exercise diagram.

methods.zh: 分别搭建浮置两端测试源、v_i2短路、v_i1短路三组原电路节点方程，以1 V测试计算电流；独立得到50 μA、100 μA及9.090909 μA。
methods.en: Three independent nodal tests use a floating differential source, grounded v_i2, and grounded v_i1. A 1 V test yields 50 μA, 100 μA and 9.090909 μA respectively.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 先读电桥分压，再确定求差极性
title.en: Read the bridge dividers before assigning subtraction polarity

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电桥信号放大电路如图题2.4.4所示。（1）试写出v_o=f(δ)的表达式（δ=ΔR/R）；（2）当v_i=7.5 V、δ=0.01时，求v_A、v_B、v_AB和v_o；（3）说明A₁、A₂电路的作用。
statement.en: For the bridge signal amplifier in Fig. 2.4.4: (1) derive v_o=f(δ), where δ=ΔR/R; (2) find v_A, v_B, v_AB and v_o for v_i=7.5 V and δ=0.01; (3) explain the role of A₁ and A₂.

alt.zh: 电桥左臂上下均R，右上R(1+δ)、右下R，顶端+v_i、底端地。A₁、A₂分别跟随v_A、v_B。A₃反相输入经R₁接v_o1，反馈R₂；同相输入经R₁接v_o2、经R₂接地。
alt.en: Bridge left arms are both R, upper right is R(1+δ), lower right R, with +v_i at top and ground at bottom. A₁/A₂ buffer v_A/v_B. A₃ has v_o1 through R₁ to its inverting input and R₂ feedback; v_o2 reaches its noninverting input through R₁, with R₂ to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 无负载分压；电压跟随器；匹配差分放大器。
prerequisites.en: Unloaded divider; voltage follower; matched differential amplifier.

recognition.zh: A₁、A₂隔离后，电桥按开路分压求电位。A₃放大的是v_B−v_A，因此v_o与按A减B定义的v_AB反号。
recognition.en: Buffers leave the bridge unloaded. A₃ amplifies v_B−v_A, so output is opposite in sign to v_AB defined as v_A−v_B.

text.zh: 左中点v_A=v_i/2，右中点v_B=v_i/(2+δ)。按v_AB=v_A−v_B化简，再用求差增益。
text.en: v_A=v_i/2 and v_B=v_i/(2+δ). Simplify v_AB=v_A−v_B and apply differential gain.

text.zh: R₂/R₁未给定，输出只能保留增益比，不能擅自设为1。δ=0.01使右中点略低。
text.en: R₂/R₁ is not specified; retain it rather than silently setting gain to 1. δ=0.01 makes the right midpoint slightly lower.

text.zh: A₁、A₂为电压跟随器：高输入电阻避免后级电阻网络加载电桥，低输出电阻驱动A₃；本身电压增益为1。A₃求差并按R₂/R₁放大，电阻比匹配时抑制共模电压。
text.en: A₁/A₂ are unity-gain buffers with high input resistance to avoid bridge loading and low output resistance to drive A₃. A₃ subtracts and amplifies by R₂/R₁, rejecting common-mode voltage when ratios match.

text.zh: 只有|δ|远小于1时，才可将分母2(2+δ)近似为4。此题近似值18.75 mV比精确值高0.5%，数值答案采用精确式。
text.en: Only for |δ|≪1 may 2(2+δ) be replaced by 4. Here 18.75 mV is 0.5% above the exact result, so numerical answers use the exact relation.

answer.zh: v_o=−(R₂/R₁)v_iδ/[2(2+δ)]；给定数值时v_A=3.75 V、v_B≈3.731343 V、v_AB≈18.656716 mV、v_o≈−18.656716(R₂/R₁) mV。A₁、A₂为隔离电桥与求差级的跟随器。
answer.en: v_o=−(R₂/R₁)v_iδ/[2(2+δ)]. Numerically v_A=3.75 V, v_B≈3.731343 V, v_AB≈18.656716 mV and v_o≈−18.656716(R₂/R₁) mV. A₁/A₂ buffer the bridge from the subtractor.

pitfalls.zh: 右上臂变化，正δ令v_B降低；最终输出为负。
pitfalls.en: An increase in the upper-right arm lowers v_B; output is negative for positive δ.

pitfalls.zh: 输出数值需保留未给定的R₂/R₁。
pitfalls.en: Retain the unspecified R₂/R₁ in the numerical output.

methods.zh: 直接解左右分压节点、两跟随器约束以及A₃两输入KCL；扫描δ及增益比并回代精确式，检查δ=0零输出。
methods.en: Direct solves use both divider nodes, follower constraints, and A₃ input KCL; scans of δ and gain ratio verify the exact formula and zero output at δ=0.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 两级反馈先求驱动电阻上的压差
title.en: Use both feedback constraints to find the drive-resistor voltage

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题2.4.6所示电路可将电压v_id转换为电流i_o，驱动负载Z_L，且i_o与Z_L无关。试求i_o与v_id的函数关系。原图定义v_id=v₁−v₂，i_o由负载上端向下流向地。
statement.en: The circuit in Fig. 2.4.6 converts v_id to current i_o to drive Z_L independently of the load. Derive i_o(v_id). The figure defines v_id=v₁−v₂ and i_o downward through the load to ground.

alt.zh: A₁反相端以两个相等R₁接v₁及v₃；同相端以两个相等R₁接v₂及v₄。A₂跟随负载电压v_o，故v₄=v_o。A₁输出v₃经R接负载上端v_o，Z_L由v_o接地，i_o向下。
alt.en: A₁ inverting node connects through equal R₁ to v₁ and v₃; its noninverting node connects through equal R₁ to v₂ and v₄. A₂ follows load voltage v_o, so v₄=v_o. A₁ output v₃ drives load node v_o through R; Z_L runs to ground with downward i_o.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.

recognition.zh: 先由A₂得到v₄=v_o，再用A₁两输入电位相等消去中点；需要的是v₃−v_o，不必先求负载电压。
recognition.en: First use A₂ to set v₄=v_o, then equate A₁ input-node voltages. The needed quantity is v₃−v_o, not load voltage itself.

text.zh: 两输入节点均无引脚电流；同相和反相中点分别是对应两个端点的平均值。
text.en: Zero pin currents make each midpoint the average of its two connected endpoint voltages.

text.zh: v_n1=v_p1，整理出v₃−v_o=v₂−v₁=−v_id。
text.en: Equating input nodes gives v₃−v_o=v₂−v₁=−v_id.

text.zh: A₂同相端不取电流，因此R的电流全部流入负载，按向下参考方向得到负跨导。
text.en: A₂ noninverting input draws no current, so all R current reaches the load. Its downward reference gives negative transconductance.

text.zh: R₁只需四只相等以抵消中点关系，跨导由R设定。对有限Z_L，v_o=Z_L i_o、v₃=v_o−v_id；实际两个输出都须在允许范围，不能据理想式认为能驱动任意开路负载。
text.en: The four R₁ values must match; R sets transconductance. For finite Z_L, v_o=Z_L i_o and v₃=v_o−v_id. Both actual outputs must remain in range; the ideal relation does not give unlimited open-circuit compliance.

answer.zh: i_o=−v_id/R=−(v₁−v₂)/R，按题图向下参考方向；与Z_L及匹配的R₁数值无关。
answer.en: i_o=−v_id/R=−(v₁−v₂)/R for the downward reference; it is independent of Z_L and the common R₁ value.

pitfalls.zh: 符号由v_id正负端和i_o箭头共同决定，不能只套“电压除电阻”。
pitfalls.en: The sign follows both the input polarity and load-current arrow.

pitfalls.zh: A₂输出不直接接负载；它通过R₁网络提供电压反馈。
pitfalls.en: A₂ output is not connected directly to the load; it returns voltage feedback through R₁.

methods.zh: 独立列两输入中点KCL、A₂跟随条件和负载KCL，扫描源电压、匹配R₁和负载（含复阻抗），得到同一负跨导。
methods.en: Independent midpoint KCL, follower constraint and load KCL are solved for multiple inputs, matched R₁ values and loads, including complex impedances; all give the same negative transconductance.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 先求同相权重，再汇总正负输入
title.en: Find noninverting weights before combining all inputs

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 加减运算电路如图题2.4.7所示，求输出电压v_o的表达式。图中R₁=40 kΩ、R₂=25 kΩ、R₃=10 kΩ、R₄=20 kΩ、R₅=30 kΩ、R₆=50 kΩ。
statement.en: Find v_o for the adding/subtracting circuit in Fig. 2.4.7, with R₁=40 kΩ, R₂=25 kΩ, R₃=10 kΩ, R₄=20 kΩ, R₅=30 kΩ and R₆=50 kΩ.

alt.zh: v_i1、v_i2经R₁、R₂接反相端，R₆反馈。v_i3、v_i4经R₃、R₄接同相端，同相端经R₅接地。
alt.en: v_i1/v_i2 enter the inverting node through R₁/R₂, with R₆ feedback. v_i3/v_i4 enter the noninverting node through R₃/R₄, with R₅ to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；KCL；电压和电流参考方向。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; KCL; voltage and current references.

recognition.zh: 同相端还有R₅接地，所以加权平均的分母必须包括1/R₅；反相输入的存在也增加同相通路的闭环增益。
recognition.en: Ground resistor R₅ belongs in the noninverting conductance denominator. The inverting source resistors also contribute to gain from the noninverting node.

text.zh: 把接地支路视为0 V输入，所有电导都进入分母。
text.en: Treat the grounded branch as a 0 V input; include every conductance in the denominator.

text.zh: v_n=v_p；先保留v_p再解v_o，可避免遗漏增益里的1。
text.en: Use v_n=v_p and solve for v_o before substituting v_p, retaining the unity term.

text.zh: 代入同相权重并逐路核对正负号。
text.en: Substitute the noninverting weights and check each input sign.

answer.en: v_o=−1.25v_i1−2v_i2+(51/22)v_i3+(51/44)v_i4; the last two coefficients are approximately 2.318182 and 1.159091.

pitfalls.zh: 不能忽略R₅，也不能将两个同相输入各直接乘1+R₆/R₁。
pitfalls.en: Do not omit R₅ or give each positive input the gain 1+R₆/R₁.

pitfalls.zh: 第一步以kΩ为统一单位，分子分母的电导单位相消。
pitfalls.en: The first equation consistently uses kΩ; conductance units cancel.

methods.zh: 使用与推导不同的二节点线性矩阵求解，对四个单位输入和200组随机输入检查两节点KCL及最终系数。
methods.en: An independent two-node matrix solve checks both KCL equations and the final coefficients for four unit inputs and 200 random input vectors.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 整道主习题全部小问已核读并按所列条件独立核验。
completionNote.en: Every part of this main exercise was read and independently checked under the stated conditions.

title.zh: 端点先精确设计，标称器件再核对覆盖范围
title.en: Design exact endpoints, then check coverage with nominal parts

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 仪用放大器电路如图2.4.5所示，设电路中R₄=R₃，R₁为固定电阻R′₁=1 kΩ和电位器R_P串联，若要求差模电压增益在5～400之间可调，求R₂和R_P的阻值，并选取R₂、R₃、R₄和R_P的标称阻值，要求电路中每个电阻值必须小于250 kΩ。
statement.en: For the instrumentation amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.5, set R₄=R₃ and let R₁ be fixed R′₁=1 kΩ in series with potentiometer R_P. Find R₂ and R_P for adjustable differential gain magnitude 5–400, then choose nominal R₂, R₃, R₄ and R_P values, each below 250 kΩ.

alt.zh: 正文图2.4.5是三运放仪用放大器：A₁、A₂同相输入v₁、v₂，反馈各R₂，两个反相端之间R₁；A₃用匹配R₃/R₄求差。此图不同于图题2.4.5的双运放电路。
alt.en: Body Fig. 2.4.5 is a three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier: A₁/A₂ take v₁/v₂ at noninverting inputs, each with R₂ feedback and R₁ between inverting nodes; A₃ subtracts with matched R₃/R₄. It differs from the two-op-amp exercise Fig. 2.4.5.

prerequisites.zh: 三运放仪用放大器；端点设计；标称阻值与实际调节范围。
prerequisites.en: Three-op-amp instrumentation amplifier; endpoint design; nominal values and adjustment coverage.

recognition.zh: 增益大小在电位器阻值最小时最大。先按两个精确端点解R₂和电位器最大有效电阻，再选标称值并重新验算，不能把四舍五入后的端点称为精确。
recognition.en: Gain magnitude is largest at minimum potentiometer resistance. Solve exact endpoint values first, then select nominal parts and recompute the range; rounded endpoints are not exact.

text.zh: 正文图定义的输出对v₁−v₂为反相，教材的5～400指差模增益的大小。R₄=R₃使末级增益大小为1。
text.en: The body figure inverts v₁−v₂, so the requested 5–400 is a gain magnitude. With R₄=R₃ the final stage has unity magnitude.

text.zh: 电位器有效阻值r_P=0时最大；将1+2R₂/1 kΩ设为400。
text.en: Maximum gain occurs at r_P=0; set 1+2R₂/1 kΩ to 400.

title.zh: 最小增益5定最大电位器阻值
title.en: Set the potentiometer maximum using gain 5

text.zh: 将1+399 kΩ/(1 kΩ+R_P)设为5。R₃=R₄可任取满足限制的匹配正电阻。
text.en: Set 1+399 kΩ/(1 kΩ+R_P) to 5. Choose any matched positive R₃=R₄ satisfying the limit.

title.zh: 给一组常见标称阻值并验算
title.en: Choose convenient nominal values and recheck

text.zh: 取R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、电位器R_P=100 kΩ，固定R′₁仍1 kΩ。理想标称增益范围约4.960396～401，覆盖5～400；要恰好输出400和5，电位器分别调到约2.506266 Ω和99 kΩ。若要求全行程端点恰为5与400，需按199.5/98.75 kΩ校准或限位，不能直接声称标称组精确达到端点。
text.en: Choose R₂=200 kΩ, matched R₃=R₄=100 kΩ and a 100 kΩ pot, keeping fixed R′₁=1 kΩ. Nominal ideal gain spans about 4.960396–401, covering 5–400. Gains 400 and 5 occur at pot settings about 2.506266 Ω and 99 kΩ. Exact full-travel endpoints require calibrated 199.5/98.75 kΩ values or travel limits; the nominal set does not have exact endpoints.

text.zh: 单只R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、电位器100 kΩ均小于250 kΩ，R₁总阻值也最多101 kΩ。未给器件公差，标称覆盖不等于任意公差下保证；实作需测量调校并保持差分级电阻比匹配。
text.en: Each 200/100/100/100 kΩ component is below 250 kΩ, and total R₁ is at most 101 kΩ. Without tolerances, nominal coverage is not a worst-case guarantee; measure and calibrate actual parts and maintain final-stage ratio matching.

answer.zh: 精确端点设计：R₂=199.5 kΩ、R_P最大有效值98.75 kΩ。标称可取R₂=200 kΩ、R₃=R₄=100 kΩ、R_P=100 kΩ，理想可调范围约4.9604～401，覆盖目标5～400，需调校端点。
answer.en: Exact endpoint design: R₂=199.5 kΩ, maximum effective R_P=98.75 kΩ. A nominal set is R₂=200 kΩ, R₃=R₄=100 kΩ, R_P=100 kΩ, giving approximately 4.9604–401 and covering 5–400 with endpoint calibration.

pitfalls.zh: 引用的是正文图2.4.5三运放结构，不是图题2.4.5。
pitfalls.en: Use the three-op-amp body figure, not exercise Fig. 2.4.5.

pitfalls.zh: 增益与电位器电阻反向变化；最大增益发生在r_P=0。
pitfalls.en: Gain decreases with pot resistance; maximum gain is at r_P=0.

pitfalls.zh: 200 kΩ/100 kΩ标称组合覆盖目标，却不是精确5～400的全行程。
pitfalls.en: The 200/100 kΩ nominal set covers the target but does not have exact 5–400 full-travel endpoints.

methods.zh: 按原三运放图独立解四条KCL和虚短约束，检查两个精确端点、标称端点及5和400的电位器反解；所有元件上限逐项比较。
methods.en: Independent original-circuit KCL and equal-input constraints verify exact endpoints, nominal endpoints and inverse pot settings for gains 5/400; every component is checked against the limit.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零；负反馈稳定且工作在线性区；实际供电和输出电流能力须满足所得电压、电流。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable feedback and linear operation; real supply and output-current limits must accommodate the derived voltages and currents.

completionNote.zh: 本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。
completionNote.en: All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

title.zh: 电阻失配：先写一般求差式，再找最坏角点
title.en: Resistor mismatch: derive the general subtractor before testing corners

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在图2.4.5所示的仪用放大器中，已知R₁=2 kΩ，R₂=50 kΩ，R₃=30 kΩ，R₄=90 kΩ。（1）求差模电压增益A_vd；（2）如果R₃有±5%的误差，求最大共模电压增益|A_vc|和共模抑制比K_CMR。
statement.en: In the instrumentation amplifier of body Fig. 2.4.5, R₁=2 kΩ, R₂=50 kΩ, R₃=30 kΩ and R₄=90 kΩ. (1) Find differential gain A_vd. (2) If R₃ has ±5% tolerance, find maximum common-mode gain magnitude and CMRR.

alt.zh: 引用正文图2.4.5三运放仪用放大器：首级反馈各R₂，反相端之间R₁；末级两输入串联电阻各标R₃，反馈及同相接地电阻各R₄。
alt.en: Uses the three-op-amp body Fig. 2.4.5: first-stage feedback R₂ and a shared R₁; final-stage input resistors are both R₃, with R₄ feedback and R₄ from the noninverting node to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.

recognition.zh: “R₃有±5%误差”必须说明两只R₃的关系。主结果按两只独立取±5%且其他电阻精确；共同等比例偏移不会引入电阻失配共模增益。
recognition.en: Specify how the two R₃ errors relate. The main result uses independent ±5% tolerances with other resistors exact; identical tracking errors create no resistor-mismatch common-mode gain.

text.zh: 以v_id=v₁−v₂为差模输入，首级差值放大51倍，末级反相3倍。若把差模输入定义反向，增益符号也反向。
text.en: For v_id=v₁−v₂, the first stage multiplies the difference by 51 and the final stage inverts with magnitude 3. Reversing the differential-input definition reverses the gain sign.

title.zh: 不匹配末级的一般表达式
title.en: General expression for the mismatched last stage

text.zh: 记反相输入串联电阻为r_a，同相输入串联电阻为r_b，F=90 kΩ。节点KCL给v_o=bv₄−av₃；共同输入下首级两个输出均等于v_c。
text.en: Let r_a be the inverting input resistor, r_b the noninverting input resistor and F=90 kΩ. Nodal KCL gives v_o=bv₄−av₃; equal common-mode inputs make both first-stage outputs v_c.

steps.formula: a=\frac F{r_a},\quad b=\left(1+\frac F{r_a}\right)\frac F{r_b+F},\quad A_{vc}=b-a=\frac{F(r_a-r_b)}{r_a(r_b+F)}

title.zh: 两只独立误差的最坏共模角点
title.en: Worst common-mode corner for independent errors

text.zh: r_a、r_b各在28.5～31.5 kΩ。|A_vc|最大在r_a=28.5、r_b=31.5 kΩ；反向角点略小。
text.en: Each resistor lies in 28.5–31.5 kΩ. Maximum |A_vc| occurs at r_a=28.5 and r_b=31.5 kΩ; the opposite corner is slightly smaller.

title.zh: 用同一实际电路的差模增益求CMRR
title.en: Use differential and common-mode gains of the same actual circuit

text.zh: 对称差模输入v₁=+v_id/2、v₂=−v_id/2，实际A_vd=−(51/2)(a+b)。比值简化后，两只误差独立时最坏CMRR在两个反向角点，均为2040。不要用一个电路的标称差模增益与另一个电路的实际共模增益混成“精确CMRR”。
text.en: For symmetric differential excitation v₁=+v_id/2 and v₂=−v_id/2, actual A_vd=−(51/2)(a+b). The ratio simplifies; its worst value is 2040 at either opposite corner. A nominal differential gain divided by another circuit’s actual common-mode gain is not an exact CMRR.

title.zh: 说明其他误差解释与常用估算
title.en: Other interpretations and the nominal-gain estimate

text.zh: 若沿用标称|A_vd|=153估算，153/0.07797271≈1962.225，约65.85 dB，应注明是标称增益估算。若只有一只R₃偏差、另一只精确，最坏|A_vc|≈0.03947368，实际最坏CMRR=4054.5（72.16 dB）。若两只R₃同幅同向变化，则A_vc=0，理想电阻模型CMRR无限；真实运放本身有限CMRR未由本题给出。
text.en: Using nominal |A_vd|=153 gives the explicitly nominal estimate 1962.225, about 65.85 dB. If only one R₃ varies and the other is exact, worst |A_vc|≈0.03947368 and worst actual CMRR=4054.5 (72.16 dB). Identical tracking gives A_vc=0 and infinite ideal resistor-model CMRR; real op-amp CMRR is not specified.

answer.zh: （1）A_vd=−153（按v₁−v₂定义）。（2）两只R₃独立±5%时，最大|A_vc|≈0.07797271，实际最坏K_CMR=2040≈66.19 dB；用标称差模增益估算则约1962.225≈65.85 dB。误差共同跟踪或仅一只误差的结果另见步骤。
answer.en: (1) A_vd=−153 for v₁−v₂. (2) Independent ±5% errors give maximum |A_vc|≈0.07797271 and worst actual CMRR=2040≈66.19 dB. A nominal-differential-gain estimate is 1962.225≈65.85 dB. Tracking and single-resistor cases are explained separately.

pitfalls.zh: 两只同标号电阻不代表误差一定同向或完全一致。
pitfalls.en: Two resistors sharing a label need not have tracking errors.

pitfalls.zh: CMRR必须说明用实际还是标称差模增益。
pitfalls.en: State whether CMRR uses actual or nominal differential gain.

methods.zh: 独立原三运放节点矩阵分别施加共同和对称差模输入，扫描两个误差的二维网格及四角点；核对同向误差A_vc=0、单只误差和同电路增益比。
methods.en: Independent original three-op-amp matrices are excited with common and symmetric differential inputs over a two-dimensional error grid and corners, checking tracking, single-resistor and same-circuit gain ratios.

assumptions.zh: 理想线性运放；主结果为两只R₃独立±5%，其余电阻精确；差模定义v₁−v₂，实际增益以对称差模激励测量。
assumptions.en: Ideal linear op amps; main result uses independent ±5% errors in both R₃ values with other resistors exact; differential input is v₁−v₂ with symmetric excitation for actual gain.

completionNote.zh: 本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。
completionNote.en: All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

title.zh: 先定抑制比，再用输出余量限制反馈增益
title.en: Set suppression first, then limit feedback gain by output headroom

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 在图2.4.6所示的心电信号放大电路中，设R₁/2=1 kΩ，R_si=120 kΩ，v_cm的最大幅值为20 V，所有运放的电源电压为±15 V，A₅的输出饱和压降为1 V。（1）求心电信号的增益；（2）若要求加到INA128输入端的共模电压是v_cm的1/800，求R₇的最大值和K的值。
statement.en: For the ECG amplifier in body Fig. 2.4.6, R₁/2=1 kΩ, R_si=120 kΩ, maximum v_cm amplitude is 20 V, all op-amp supplies are ±15 V, and A₅ output saturates 1 V from either rail. (1) Find ECG differential gain. (2) To reduce common-mode input at INA128 to v_cm/800, find maximum R₇ and gain K.

alt.zh: 正文图2.4.6：INA128的增益电阻R₁分为两个R₁/2，中心提取共模v_ic；A₄跟随v_ic；A₅以R₆/R₅=K反相输出v_oc，经过R₇返回共模节点；干扰v_cm经R_si到该节点。
alt.en: Body Fig. 2.4.6: INA128 gain resistor R₁ is split into two R₁/2 halves to sense v_ic. A₄ buffers it; A₅ inverts with K=R₆/R₅ to produce v_oc, returned through R₇. Interference v_cm reaches the common-mode node through R_si.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.

recognition.zh: R₁是两个1 kΩ串联的总值2 kΩ。共模环路先由KCL给抑制比，再用A₅的14 V输出边界确定最大允许K。
recognition.en: R₁ is the total of two 1 kΩ halves, hence 2 kΩ. Common-mode KCL sets suppression, then A₅’s 14 V output boundary sets the largest K.

text.zh: 教材图2.4.6与式2.4.15给INA128的增益大小1+50 kΩ/R₁；按v_la−v_ra定义为负。共模提取点在对称差模下为0，不改变该差模增益。
text.en: Body Fig. 2.4.6 and Eq. 2.4.15 give gain magnitude 1+50 kΩ/R₁; it is negative for v_la−v_ra. The common-mode sensing point is zero under symmetric differential excitation, leaving differential gain unchanged.

text.zh: 同相输入不取电流，A₄输出v_ic，A₅输出v_oc=−K v_ic。对干扰/返回节点列KCL。
text.en: Inputs draw no current. A₄ outputs v_ic and A₅ outputs −K v_ic. Apply KCL at the interference/return node.

title.zh: 用1/800和14 V输出限制求边界
title.en: Use 1/800 and the 14 V output limit

text.zh: 最大共模输入变为20/800=0.025 V；|v_oc|=0.025K≤14，故K≤560。保持800倍抑制需R₇=R_si(1+K)/799，随K增大，因此最大值出现在K=560。
text.en: Peak residual input is 20/800=0.025 V. Thus |v_oc|=0.025K≤14 gives K≤560. Suppression 800 requires R₇=R_si(1+K)/799, increasing with K, so the limiting maximum occurs at K=560.

title.zh: 区分近似结果与实作余量

text.zh: 若采用正文K远大于1+R₇/R_si的近似，则R₇≈14×120 kΩ/20=84 kΩ，K≈560。精确边界84.255 kΩ保留了1+K及分母799；要保证严格在线性区，R₇、K应略小于此边界，并重新检查元件误差。
text.en: The body’s large-K approximation gives R₇≈14×120 kΩ/20=84 kΩ and K≈560. Exact limiting values retain 1+K and denominator 799. Strict linear headroom requires slightly smaller R₇/K and a tolerance check.

answer.zh: （1）按v_la−v_ra定义，增益−26，大小26。（2）精确饱和边界K=560，R₇最大约84.2553 kΩ；教材大增益近似为R₇≈84 kΩ。实际线性设计需留输出余量。
answer.en: (1) Gain is −26 for v_la−v_ra, magnitude 26. (2) Exact saturation boundary: K=560 and maximum R₇≈84.2553 kΩ; large-gain approximation gives about 84 kΩ. A linear implementation needs headroom.

pitfalls.zh: R₁/2=1 kΩ不是R₁=1 kΩ。
pitfalls.en: R₁/2=1 kΩ means R₁=2 kΩ.

pitfalls.zh: A₅可用输出峰值为14 V，而非15 V。
pitfalls.en: A₅ available peak output is 14 V, not 15 V.

pitfalls.zh: 84 kΩ来自近似；代入完整方程时应区分精确边界。
pitfalls.en: 84 kΩ is approximate; distinguish it from the exact full-equation boundary.

methods.zh: 核读正文37～38页的图2.4.6与式2.4.15、2.4.18～20；独立解共模节点与A₅虚地KCL，回代20 V输入得v_ic=25 mV、v_oc=−14 V，两端返回电流均166.458333 μA。
methods.en: Read body pp. 37–38, Fig. 2.4.6 and Eqs. 2.4.15, 2.4.18–20. Independent common-node and A₅ KCL give v_ic=25 mV and v_oc=−14 V at 20 V input, with matching return/source currents 166.458333 μA.

assumptions.zh: 教材理想共模等效电路，忽略人体阻抗和输入偏置；K=R₆/R₅；A₅输出边界±14 V。仅为题设电路分析，非实际设备性能保证。
assumptions.en: Textbook ideal common-mode equivalent circuit, neglecting body impedance and input bias; K=R₆/R₅ and A₅ output boundary ±14 V. This analyzes the specified model and does not guarantee actual device performance.

completionNote.zh: 本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。
completionNote.en: All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

title.zh: 跟随器隔离输入，反相辅助级闭合负反馈
title.en: Input buffers and an inverting auxiliary stage close the feedback loop

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 图题2.4.12所示为一增益线性调节运放电路，试推导该电路的电压增益表达式A_v=v_o/(v_i1−v_i2)。
statement.en: For the linearly adjustable-gain circuit in Fig. 2.4.12, derive A_v=v_o/(v_i1−v_i2).

alt.zh: A₁、A₂跟随两个输入。A₃反相端经R₁接v_o1、经R₂接地；同相端经R₁接v_o2、经R₂接A₄输出v_o4。A₄同相端接地，反相端经R₃接其输出、经可调R₄接最终v_o。
alt.en: A₁/A₂ buffer both inputs. A₃ inverting node connects through R₁ to v_o1 and R₂ to ground; its noninverting node connects through R₁ to v_o2 and R₂ to A₄ output v_o4. A₄ noninverting input is grounded; its inverting node has R₃ feedback and adjustable R₄ to final v_o.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.

recognition.zh: A₃没有直接的普通反相反馈电阻；反馈经A₄反相后进入A₃同相端，整体仍是负反馈。先分别写两个中点与A₄虚地。
recognition.en: A₃ does not use an ordinary direct inverting feedback resistor. Its feedback is inverted by A₄ before reaching A₃’s noninverting input, making the total loop negative. Write midpoint and A₄ virtual-ground constraints.

title.en: Input buffers and A₃ inverting divider

text.zh: A₁、A₂电压增益1；A₃反相端分压为R₂/(R₁+R₂)倍v_i1，其同相端电位相等。
text.en: A₁/A₂ have unity gain. A₃ inverting input divides v_i1 by R₂/(R₁+R₂); its noninverting input has the same potential.

text.zh: 该节点从两个源接入，解出辅助输出v_o4。
text.en: The node connects to two sources; solve its KCL for auxiliary output v_o4.

title.en: A₄ inversion gives the final gain

text.zh: A₄的输入电阻是可调R₄、反馈是R₃。由v_o4=−(R₃/R₄)v_o解v_o，结果随R₄线性变化。
text.en: For A₄, the input resistor is adjustable R₄ and feedback is R₃. Invert v_o4=−(R₃/R₄)v_o to obtain an output gain linear in R₄.

answer.zh: A_v=−R₂R₄/(R₁R₃)，电压增益随可调R₄线性变化；前提是各运放未饱和、环路稳定。
answer.en: A_v=−R₂R₄/(R₁R₃), linear in adjustable R₄, provided all amplifiers remain linear and the loop is stable.

pitfalls.zh: R₄是A₄输入电阻，R₃才是A₄反馈电阻。
pitfalls.en: R₄ is A₄’s input resistor; R₃ is its feedback resistor.

pitfalls.zh: A₃同相端不是地，不能套标准反相式。
pitfalls.en: A₃ noninverting input is not grounded; do not use a standard inverter formula.

methods.zh: 独立构造四个未知量v_n3、v_p3、v_o4、v_o的原节点矩阵，扫描输入及正电阻，检查虚短、两个输入节点和A₄虚地KCL。
methods.en: An independent original-node matrix for v_n3, v_p3, v_o4 and v_o scans inputs and positive resistors, checking equal-input and original KCL constraints.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

completionNote.zh: 本题全部小问已核读并独立验算，误差与理想模型条件另行说明。
completionNote.en: All parts were read and independently checked, with tolerance and ideal-model assumptions stated explicitly.

title.zh: 积分面积定斜率，脉冲宽度定峰值
title.en: Input area determines slope and pulse width determines peak

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 积分电路如图题2.4.13a所示。已知初始状态时v_C(0)=0，试回答下列问题：（1）当R=100 kΩ，C=2 μF时，若t=0时刻加入阶跃电压v_i(t)=1 V，求t=1 s时的v_o；（2）若C=0.47 μF，输入电压波形如图题2.4.13b所示，试定量画出v_o的波形。图b为0～60 ms输入+6 V、60～120 ms输入−6 V，随后为0。
statement.en: For the integrator in Fig. 2.4.13(a), v_C(0)=0. (1) With R=100 kΩ and C=2 μF, apply a 1 V step at t=0 and find v_o at 1 s. (2) With C=0.47 μF, draw a quantitative output for (b): +6 V over 0–60 ms, −6 V over 60–120 ms, then zero.

alt.zh: 反相积分器：v_i经R=100 kΩ接反相端，反馈C，同相端接地；图b的矩形脉冲高度±6 V、时间标记60、120 ms。
alt.en: Inverting integrator: R=100 kΩ connects input to the inverting node, C feeds back output, and the noninverting input is grounded. Pulse heights are ±6 V with times 60 and 120 ms.

prerequisites.zh: 电容电流；零初始条件；分段积分与连续性。
prerequisites.en: Capacitor current; zero initial condition; piecewise integration and continuity.

recognition.zh: 先算RC，再用斜率−v_i/(RC)逐段累计；电容电压与输出在输入跳变处连续。
recognition.en: Calculate RC, then accumulate slopes −v_i/(RC) interval by interval. Capacitor and output voltages stay continuous at input steps.

text.zh: RC=100 kΩ×2 μF=0.2 s，输出从0以−5 V/s下降。
text.en: RC=100 kΩ×2 μF=0.2 s, so output starts at zero and falls at −5 V/s.

steps.formula: v_o(t)=-\frac1{RC}\int_0^t v_i(\tau)\,d\tau=-5t\,\mathrm V\quad(t\text{ in s}),\qquad v_o(1\,\mathrm s)=-5\,\mathrm V

text.en: New RC is 0.047 s=47 ms. From 0 to 60 ms, slope is −6/47 V/ms, reaching −360/47≈−7.659574 V.

title.en: (2) Negative pulse and full piecewise result

text.zh: 后一个脉冲面积相反，输出以+6/47 V/ms回升，120 ms恢复0，此后输入0使输出保持0。令t_ms为以ms计的时间，见附波形。
text.en: The opposite pulse reverses the slope to +6/47 V/ms, returning to zero at 120 ms and remaining there. Let t_ms denote numerical time in ms; see the plot.

answer.zh: （1）t=1 s时v_o=−5 V。（2）0→60 ms线性降至−7.659574 V，60→120 ms线性回到0，此后保持0；完整分段式及波形见上。
answer.en: (1) v_o(1 s)=−5 V. (2) Fall linearly to −7.659574 V at 60 ms, rise to zero at 120 ms, then remain zero; see the piecewise expression and waveform.

pitfalls.zh: 第二问将C改为0.47 μF，不要仍用2 μF。
pitfalls.en: Part (2) changes C to 0.47 μF.

pitfalls.zh: 时间刻度是ms，必须与RC单位一致。
pitfalls.en: Time is in ms; match units to RC.

pitfalls.zh: 输入跳变改变斜率，不让积分器输出瞬间跳变。
pitfalls.en: Input steps change slope, not output voltage instantaneously.

methods.zh: 用电容电荷ΔQ=∫v_i/R dt独立核对每段端点，首脉冲3.6 μC使输出下降7.659574 V，等面积反脉冲使总电荷恢复；另以离散节点电容积分检查连续性。
methods.en: Independent capacitor-charge integration verifies endpoints: the first pulse supplies 3.6 μC, corresponding to a 7.659574 V output fall; the equal opposite pulse restores charge. Discrete nodal integration also checks continuity.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

caption.zh: 按题设参数推导的理想电路波形；不是SPICE仿真。
caption.en: Ideal-circuit waveform derived from the stated parameters; not a SPICE simulation.

alt.zh: 本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。
alt.en: Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

title.zh: 先求差分级，再对加权和积分
title.en: Solve the subtractor, then integrate the weighted sum

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.4.14所示，设电容的初始电压v_C(0)=0。（1）写出v_o与v_i1、v_i2和v_i3之间的关系式；（2）当电阻满足R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄=R₅=R₆=R时，写出输出电压v_o的表达式。
statement.en: For Fig. 2.4.14 with capacitor initial voltage v_C(0)=0: (1) relate v_o to v_i1, v_i2 and v_i3; (2) specialize to all six resistors equal to R.

alt.zh: A₁：v_i1经R₁接反相端、R₄反馈；v_i2经R₂接同相端、R₃接地。A₂：v_o1经R₅、v_i3经R₆接反相虚地，C反馈，同相端接地。
alt.en: A₁: v_i1 enters through R₁, with R₄ feedback; v_i2 reaches the noninverting node through R₂ with R₃ to ground. A₂ sums v_o1 through R₅ and v_i3 through R₆ at virtual ground, with C feedback and grounded noninverting input.

prerequisites.zh: 虚短与虚断；节点KCL；差模与共模输入定义。
prerequisites.en: Equal input voltages and zero input currents; nodal KCL; differential and common-mode definitions.

recognition.zh: A₂是反相加法积分器，所以A₁产生的正负号还要整体反相一次。
recognition.en: A₂ is an inverting summing integrator, so the signs from A₁ are inverted again.

text.zh: 先分压求同相电位，再列反相节点KCL。
text.en: First divide for the noninverting voltage, then apply inverting-node KCL.

text.zh: 零初始电容电压给v_o(0)=0。输出导数等于两个输入支路电流之和的−1/C倍。
text.en: Zero initial capacitor voltage gives v_o(0)=0. Output derivative is −1/C times the sum of the input branch currents.

text.zh: A₁输出v_i2−v_i1，积分级再反相，把符号整理为v_i1−v_i2−v_i3。
text.en: A₁ gives v_i2−v_i1; integration inverts again to produce v_i1−v_i2−v_i3.

answer.zh: 一般式见步骤；六电阻相等时，v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i1−v_i2−v_i3)dτ，v_o(0)=0。
answer.en: Use the general expression above. For equal resistors, v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i1−v_i2−v_i3)dτ with v_o(0)=0.

pitfalls.zh: 不能把A₁的输入正负号直接当最终输出符号。
pitfalls.en: Do not copy A₁’s signs directly to the final output.

pitfalls.zh: 非等值时同相输入系数需保留分压和闭环增益。
pitfalls.en: For unequal values, retain both the divider and feedback factors.

methods.zh: 随机正电阻与输入独立解A₁节点KCL，再用A₂虚地电容KCL求导数，与一般积分式的被积函数一致；等值时逐路单位输入检查+1、−1、−1。
methods.en: Independent A₁ node solves with random positive resistors and inputs followed by A₂ capacitor KCL match the general integrand; equal-resistor unit inputs verify +1/−1/−1 signs.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

title.zh: 同相低通与反相积分恰好配平
title.en: A matched low-pass input and integrator produce exact differencing

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 差分式积分运算电路如图题2.4.15所示，设两电容器上的初始电压为零，且C₁=C₂=C，R₁=R₂=R。（1）当v_i1=0时，推导v_o与v_i2的关系；（2）当v_i2=0时，推导v_o与v_i1的关系；（3）求v_o与v_i1、v_i2的关系式。
statement.en: For the differential integrator in Fig. 2.4.15, both capacitors initially have zero voltage, C₁=C₂=C and R₁=R₂=R. (1) Derive the response to v_i2 with v_i1=0. (2) Derive the response to v_i1 with v_i2=0. (3) Combine both inputs.

alt.zh: v_i1经R₁接反相端，C₁从输出反馈；v_i2经R₂接同相端，C₂由同相端接地。
alt.en: v_i1 reaches the inverting input through R₁ with capacitor C₁ feedback. v_i2 reaches the noninverting input through R₂, with C₂ from that node to ground.

prerequisites.zh: 叠加定理；RC低通；理想运放电容KCL；零初值拉普拉斯变换。
prerequisites.en: Superposition; RC low-pass; op-amp capacitor KCL; zero-initial-condition Laplace transforms.

recognition.zh: 不能把同相端直接视为v_i2；它先经过RC低通。这个低通与同相闭环传输相乘后，恰好化成正积分。
recognition.en: The noninverting node is not v_i2; it follows an RC low-pass. Multiplication by the noninverting closed-loop transfer yields a positive integrator.

text.zh: 同相节点传输为1/(1+sRC)，带电容反馈的同相增益为1+1/(sRC)。二者相乘后消去1+sRC。
text.en: The noninverting node has transfer 1/(1+sRC), while the closed-loop gain from that node is 1+1/(sRC). Their product cancels 1+sRC.

text.zh: v_i2=0且C₂初压0，使同相端恒0，退化为普通反相积分器。
text.en: With v_i2=0 and zero C₂ voltage, the noninverting node remains at zero, leaving an inverting integrator.

title.en: (3) Superpose and check with time-domain KCL

text.zh: 令v_p=v_n，C₂的KCL给RC·dv_p/dt=v_i2−v_p；C₁反馈给RC·dv_o/dt=RC·dv_p/dt+v_p−v_i1。相加抵消v_p，得到差分积分；两电容零初值使v_o(0)=0。
text.en: C₂ KCL gives RC·dv_p/dt=v_i2−v_p. C₁ feedback gives RC·dv_o/dt=RC·dv_p/dt+v_p−v_i1. Substitution cancels v_p, yielding differential integration; both zero initial voltages imply v_o(0)=0.

answer.zh: 分别为正积分v_i2、负积分v_i1；总输出v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i2−v_i1)dτ，v_o(0)=0。
answer.en: The two responses are positive integration of v_i2 and negative integration of v_i1; total v_o=(1/RC)∫₀ᵗ(v_i2−v_i1)dτ, with v_o(0)=0.

pitfalls.zh: 匹配R、C和零初值是抵消成立的条件。
pitfalls.en: Matched R/C values and zero initial conditions are required for the cancellation.

pitfalls.zh: 同相端先低通，不可跳过后恰好得到错误的额外直通项。
pitfalls.en: Retain the noninverting low-pass to avoid an erroneous direct-feedthrough term.

methods.zh: 独立复频域双节点KCL扫描频率与输入，核对两个单输入传输及叠加；时域两个电容微分方程直接消元确认输出导数。
methods.en: Independent complex-frequency two-node KCL scans verify both single-input transfers and superposition; direct elimination of the two capacitor ODEs independently verifies the output derivative.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

title.zh: 梯形求斜率，连续拐点不产生冲激
title.en: Differentiate the trapezoid; continuous corners do not create impulses

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 微分电路及其输入电压波形如图题2.4.16所示，设R=10 kΩ，C=100 μF，试定量画出输出电压v_o的波形。输入0～10 s从0线性升至1 V，10～30 s保持1 V，30～40 s线性降至0，随后为0。
statement.en: For the differentiator and input waveform in Fig. 2.4.16, R=10 kΩ and C=100 μF. Draw the quantitative output. Input rises from 0 to 1 V in 0–10 s, stays at 1 V in 10–30 s, falls to zero in 30–40 s, then stays zero.

alt.zh: 输入经C到反相端，反馈R，同相端接地；图b时间单位为秒，梯形顶端1 V、转折10、30、40 s。
alt.en: Input passes through C to the inverting node with R feedback and grounded noninverting input. Time is in seconds, with a 1 V trapezoid and corners at 10, 30 and 40 s.

prerequisites.zh: 电容电流i=C·dv_i/dt；反相虚地与KCL；分段斜率。
prerequisites.en: Capacitor current i=C·dv_i/dt; virtual ground and KCL; piecewise slopes.

recognition.zh: RC=1 s。输出看输入斜率，不看输入电平；1 V平顶的输出是0，不是−1 V。
recognition.en: RC=1 s. Output follows input slope rather than input level; a flat 1 V top gives zero output.

text.zh: 用统一单位计算10⁴ Ω×100×10⁻⁶ F=1 s。
text.en: Consistent units give 10⁴ Ω×100×10⁻⁶ F=1 s.

text.zh: 上升段斜率+0.1 V/s，输出−0.1 V；平顶0；下降段−0.1 V/s，输出+0.1 V；此后0。
text.en: Rising slope +0.1 V/s gives −0.1 V output; the flat top gives zero; falling slope −0.1 V/s gives +0.1 V; then zero.

steps.formula: v_o(t)=\begin{cases}-0.1\,\mathrm V,&0<t<10\,\mathrm s\\0,&10<t<30\,\mathrm s\\+0.1\,\mathrm V,&30<t<40\,\mathrm s\\0,&t>40\,\mathrm s\end{cases}

text.zh: 输入连续、只有斜率改变，所以输出是有限阶跃而非狄拉克冲激；理想导数在转折瞬间按左右极限说明，不给唯一瞬时值。真实运放转换受带宽约束。
text.en: Input is continuous with slope changes, so output has finite steps rather than Dirac impulses. At corners use one-sided limits, without a unique ideal instantaneous derivative; real transitions have finite bandwidth.

answer.zh: 0～10 s输出−0.1 V；10～30 s为0；30～40 s为+0.1 V；之后0。转折点取单侧极限，输入连续所以无冲激。
answer.en: Output is −0.1 V in 0–10 s, zero in 10–30 s, +0.1 V in 30–40 s, then zero. Use one-sided limits at corners; continuous input gives no impulse.

pitfalls.zh: C是100 μF，时间轴为s，不能改成nF或ms。
pitfalls.en: C is 100 μF and time is in seconds.

pitfalls.zh: 不要把输入斜率跳变误当输入电压跳变。
pitfalls.en: A slope discontinuity is not a voltage discontinuity.

methods.zh: 独立由每段Δv/Δt求电容电流±10 μA，再由反馈电阻乘电流得∓0.1 V；输出全时段积分反向恢复原梯形的增减量。
methods.en: Independent Δv/Δt gives capacitor currents ±10 μA and resistor drops ∓0.1 V; reverse integration of the output recovers the trapezoid changes.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

caption.zh: 按题设参数推导的理想电路波形；不是SPICE仿真。
caption.en: Ideal-circuit waveform derived from the stated parameters; not a SPICE simulation.

alt.zh: 本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。
alt.en: Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

title.zh: 两个极点限制微分频带
title.en: Two poles bound the useful differentiation band

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 一实用微分电路如图题2.4.17所示，它具有衰减高频噪声的作用。（1）确定电路的传递函数V_o(s)/V_i(s)；（2）若R₁=R₂=R，C₁=C₂=C，试问应当怎样限制v_i的频率，才能使电路不失去微分功能？
statement.en: The practical differentiator in Fig. 2.4.17 attenuates high-frequency noise. (1) Determine V_o(s)/V_i(s). (2) If R₁=R₂=R and C₁=C₂=C, what input-frequency restriction preserves differentiation?

alt.zh: 输入串联R₁、C₁到反相虚地；反馈R₂与C₂并联，同相端接地。
alt.en: Input has series R₁/C₁ to virtual ground; feedback is parallel R₂/C₂, with the noninverting input grounded.

prerequisites.zh: 复阻抗；反相传输−Z_f/Z_i；低频近似与幅相误差。
prerequisites.en: Complex impedance; inverting transfer −Z_f/Z_i; low-frequency approximation and magnitude/phase error.

recognition.zh: 先按串联输入、并联反馈分别写阻抗。微分要求两个分母因子都接近1；不能只要求频率低于截止而不说明远低于。
recognition.en: Write series input and parallel feedback impedances separately. Differentiation requires both denominator factors near 1; merely being below cutoff is insufficient.

text.zh: 理想虚地反相式给−Z_f/Z_i，零初始条件下写s域表达式。
text.en: The ideal virtual-ground inverter gives −Z_f/Z_i under zero initial conditions.

text.zh: R、C相等时H(s)=−sRC/(1+sRC)²。只有输入中需要微分的频率成分满足ωRC远小于1，才近似H≈−sRC。
text.en: Matching gives H(s)=−sRC/(1+sRC)². Desired input-frequency components must satisfy ωRC≪1 to approximate H≈−sRC.

text.zh: 令x=ωRC，实际传输与理想微分的比为1/(1+jx)²，幅度比1/(1+x²)，额外相位−2 arctan x。x=0.1时幅度低约0.99%，仍有约−11.42°相位偏差；频率上限应由允许的幅相误差决定。
text.en: For x=ωRC, actual/ideal transfer is 1/(1+jx)², with magnitude 1/(1+x²) and extra phase −2 arctan x. At x=0.1 magnitude is about 0.99% low but phase error is still −11.42°; select the band from acceptable magnitude and phase errors.

title.zh: 高频噪声为何受到衰减

text.zh: 高频时传输衰减为1/ω，而普通理想微分器增益随ω升高；两个极点抑制高频放大，但不能在高频仍称其精确微分。
text.en: At high frequency the gain decays as 1/ω, unlike the increasing gain of an ideal differentiator. Its poles suppress high-frequency amplification, at the cost of losing high-frequency differentiation.

answer.zh: H(s)=−sR₂C₁/[(1+sR₁C₁)(1+sR₂C₂)]。匹配时H=−sRC/(1+sRC)²；输入需满足ωRC≪1，即f≪1/(2πRC)，具体范围取决于允许幅相误差。
answer.en: H(s)=−sR₂C₁/[(1+sR₁C₁)(1+sR₂C₂)]. For matched values H=−sRC/(1+sRC)²; require ωRC≪1 or f≪1/(2πRC), with the usable band determined by allowed magnitude/phase errors.

pitfalls.zh: 两个RC分母都要保留，不能把实用微分器写成理想−sRC。
pitfalls.en: Retain both RC factors; the practical differentiator is not exactly −sRC.

pitfalls.zh: ω是rad/s，f是Hz，转换需要2π。
pitfalls.en: ω is in rad/s and f in Hz; retain 2π.

methods.zh: 独立由输入支路电流和反馈支路电流KCL扫描复频率，核对传输的低频微分、高频衰减及x=0.1的幅相误差。
methods.en: Independent complex-frequency input/feedback branch KCL verifies low-frequency differentiation, high-frequency rolloff and magnitude/phase errors at x=0.1.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.
