title.zh: 反相放大、反相积分，再做反相求和
title.en: Invert, integrate, then invert their sum

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题2.4.18a所示，设电容器C上的初始电压为零。（1）求v_o1、v_o2、v_o与输入电压的关系；（2）当输入电压v_i1、v_i2如图题2.4.18b所示时，试定量画出v_o的波形。图中R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄=R₂₃=100 kΩ、R₂₁=300 kΩ、C=100 μF；0～5 s内v_i1=−0.1 V，v_i2从+3 V开始每1 s在±3 V之间切换。
statement.en: For Fig. 2.4.18(a), capacitor C initially has zero voltage. (1) Relate v_o1, v_o2 and v_o to the inputs. (2) Draw a quantitative v_o for (b). R₁=R₂=R₃=R₄=R₂₃=100 kΩ, R₂₁=300 kΩ and C=100 μF. Over 0–5 s, v_i1=−0.1 V and v_i2 alternates ±3 V every second, beginning positive.

alt.zh: A₁反相增益−R₂₁/R₁；A₂输入R₂、反馈C为积分器；A₃从v_o1经R₃、v_o2经R₄求和，反馈R₂₃。图b为恒定−0.1 V及1 s间隔±3 V方波。
alt.en: A₁ inverts with −R₂₁/R₁; A₂ integrates through R₂/C; A₃ sums v_o1/R₃ and v_o2/R₄ with R₂₃ feedback. Figure (b) gives constant −0.1 V and an alternating ±3 V square wave at 1 s intervals.

prerequisites.zh: 反相放大；积分；求和；分段连续累计。
prerequisites.en: Inverting gain; integration; summation; continuous piecewise accumulation.

recognition.zh: 每级先算中间输出，最后再做求和反相。C×R₂=10 s，所以积分斜率大小为0.3 V/s，不是3 V/s。
recognition.en: Compute intermediate outputs before final inversion. R₂C=10 s gives integration slopes of 0.3 V/s, not 3 V/s.

text.zh: A₁为−3倍；A₂零初值积分；A₃两输入权重均−1。
text.en: A₁ gain is −3, A₂ integrates from zero, and A₃ has −1 weights on both inputs.

steps.formula: v_{o1}=-3v_{i1},\qquad v_{o2}=-\frac1{10\,\mathrm s}\int_0^t v_{i2}(\tau)\,d\tau,\qquad v_o=-v_{o1}-v_{o2}=3v_{i1}+\frac1{10\,\mathrm s}\int_0^t v_{i2}(\tau)\,d\tau

text.zh: v_o1恒为+0.3 V；v_o2在每个+3 V区间以−0.3 V/s下降，在−3 V区间以+0.3 V/s上升，端点依次0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3 V。
text.en: v_o1 is +0.3 V. v_o2 falls at −0.3 V/s during +3 V intervals and rises at +0.3 V/s during −3 V intervals; values at t=0…5 s are 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3 V.

text.zh: v_o=−0.3−v_o2，因此最终端点依次−0.3、0、−0.3、0、−0.3、0 V，连成连续三角波。时间t以秒计，只在原图0～5 s区间作答。
text.en: v_o=−0.3−v_o2, giving endpoint values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0 V, joined linearly as a continuous triangular waveform. Time t is in seconds; the result covers only the plotted 0–5 s interval.

answer.en: v_o1=−3v_i1, v_o2=−(1/10 s)∫v_i2dτ and v_o=−v_o1−v_o2. For the given input, output ramps between −0.3 and 0 V, with values −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0, −0.3, 0 V at t=0…5 s.

pitfalls.zh: 积分器每段必须继承上一段末值，不能反复重置0。
pitfalls.en: Carry each interval’s final value into the next; do not reset the integrator.

pitfalls.zh: 方波先+3 V，最终输出先上升。
pitfalls.en: The square wave begins at +3 V, so final output initially rises.

pitfalls.zh: 原图只规定0～5 s，不擅自规定此后输入与输出。
pitfalls.en: Do not invent input or output behavior beyond the plotted 0–5 s interval.

methods.zh: 独立以每段30 μC电容电荷计算v_o2端点，再由A₃原虚地KCL求最终输出；逐段检查连续性、斜率和1 s端点。
methods.en: Independent 30 μC capacitor-charge increments determine v_o2 endpoints, followed by original A₃ virtual-ground KCL for final output; continuity, slopes and all 1 s endpoints are checked.

assumptions.zh: 理想运放、输入电流为零、负反馈稳定且未饱和；电阻/电容按题设，实际输出余量须支持所得电压。
assumptions.en: Ideal op amps with zero input currents, stable negative feedback and no clipping; use the stated components and sufficient actual output compliance.

caption.zh: 按题设参数推导的理想电路波形；不是SPICE仿真。
caption.en: Ideal-circuit waveform derived from the stated parameters; not a SPICE simulation.

alt.zh: 本题输入、输出波形及时间与电压刻度，数值与解析中的分段式一致。
alt.en: Input/output waveforms with labeled time and voltage scales, matching the derived piecewise expressions.

title.zh: 从零漏源电压电导求可调电阻
title.en: Find the adjustable resistance from zero-drain-voltage conductance

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 某增强型NMOS管在较低的v_DS电压下工作，以使MOS管工作在可变电阻区。已知K′_n=50 μA/V²，W=10 μm，L=1 μm，V_TN=1 V。当r_ds0在500 Ω到20 kΩ之间变化时，求v_GS的变化范围。
statement.en: An enhancement NMOS operates at low v_DS in the variable-resistance region. K′_n=50 μA/V², W=10 μm, L=1 μm and V_TN=1 V. Find the v_GS range for r_ds0 from 500 Ω to 20 kΩ.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: 下标0指v_DS趋于0时的电阻。先对可变电阻区电流求漏源电导，再反解过驱动电压，别把恒流区平方律当作欧姆定律。
recognition.en: The subscript 0 denotes the resistance as v_DS tends to zero. Differentiate the triode-region current, then solve for overdrive; the saturation square law is not an Ohmic law.

text.zh: 取k=K′_nW/L=500 μA/V²；题中K′_n不是已含W/L与1/2的K_n。
text.en: Let k=K′_nW/L=500 μA/V². K′_n does not include W/L or the saturation factor 1/2.

title.en: Evaluate resistance at zero drain voltage

text.zh: 零点的微分电导为k(v_GS−V_TN)。正的有限电阻要求v_GS>V_TN。
text.en: The zero-voltage differential conductance is k(v_GS−V_TN). A positive finite resistance requires v_GS>V_TN.

title.zh: 代入两端并检查小电压条件
title.en: Evaluate endpoints and check the low-voltage condition

text.zh: 500 Ω对应5 V，20 kΩ对应1.1 V；阻值随栅压上升而下降。全范围近似线性电阻需|v_DS|远小于最小过驱动0.1 V；单说v_DS较低不足以保证任意精度。
text.en: 500 Ω gives 5 V and 20 kΩ gives 1.1 V. Resistance decreases with gate voltage. For an approximately linear resistor over the whole range, |v_DS| must be much smaller than the minimum overdrive 0.1 V; an unspecified low voltage does not guarantee any chosen accuracy.

answer.zh: v_GS范围为1.1～5 V；500 Ω对应5 V，20 kΩ对应1.1 V。结果为v_DS→0的电阻条件。
answer.en: v_GS ranges from 1.1 to 5 V: 500 Ω at 5 V and 20 kΩ at 1.1 V, for resistance in the v_DS→0 limit.

pitfalls.zh: 不要漏乘W/L=10，或多乘/漏乘1/2。
pitfalls.en: Include W/L=10 and distinguish triode k from saturation K=k/2.

pitfalls.zh: r_ds0与有限v_DS下的静态v_DS/i_D并不完全相同。
pitfalls.en: r_ds0 differs from the static v_DS/i_D at finite v_DS.

methods.zh: 用原可变电阻区方程的±h中央差分求导，并分别代入两个栅压核对500 Ω和20 kΩ；另检查有限漏压的电阻偏差随漏压趋零而消失。
methods.en: Central differences of the original triode equation independently reproduce 500 Ω and 20 kΩ; finite-drain-voltage resistance errors vanish as drain voltage tends to zero.

assumptions.zh: 长沟道低场模型，忽略体效应和沟道长度调制，r_ds0按v_DS=0的微分定义。
assumptions.en: Long-channel low-field model, neglecting body effect and channel-length modulation; r_ds0 is differential resistance at v_DS=0.

title.zh: 耗尽型PMOS：先定电流符号，再求夹断边界
title.en: Depletion PMOS: establish current sign, then find the pinch-off boundary

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 已知耗尽型PMOS管的参数为K_p=0.2 mA/V²，V_TP=0.5 V，i_D=−0.5 mA（参考方向为流进漏极）。试求此时的夹断点栅源电压v_GS和漏源电压v_DS。
statement.en: A depletion PMOS has K_p=0.2 mA/V², V_TP=+0.5 V and i_D=−0.5 mA, referenced into the drain. Find v_GS and v_DS at the pinch-off boundary.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: 耗尽型PMOS的阈值可以为正，不能擅自改成−0.5 V。“夹断点”指定恒流区与可变电阻区的边界，而非任意恒流区漏压。
recognition.en: A depletion PMOS can have a positive threshold; do not change it to −0.5 V. Pinch-off specifies the boundary between triode and saturation, not an arbitrary saturation drain voltage.

title.zh: 用正的过驱动量求栅压
title.en: Solve gate voltage with a positive overdrive

text.zh: PMOS导通要求v_GS<V_TP。记u=V_TP−v_GS>0，流进漏极的电流为负。
text.en: A conducting PMOS requires v_GS<V_TP. Define u=V_TP−v_GS>0; drain-entering current is negative.

title.zh: 选择物理解并写夹断条件
title.en: Select the physical root and impose pinch-off

text.zh: 应取v_GS=V_TP−u，另一个平方根分支不满足导通条件。边界处漏栅电压为−V_TP=−0.5 V。
text.en: Use v_GS=V_TP−u; the other square-root branch fails the conduction condition. At pinch-off the drain-to-gate voltage is −V_TP=−0.5 V.

text.zh: 夹断后仍有−0.5 mA恒流区电流；本题理想恒流区满足v_DS≤−1.581139 V。截止则为v_GS≥+0.5 V。
text.en: Pinch-off still supports −0.5 mA. Ideal saturation extends to v_DS≤−1.581139 V at this gate voltage. Cutoff instead requires v_GS≥+0.5 V.

answer.zh: 夹断边界v_GS≈−1.081139 V，v_DS≈−1.581139 V；不是截止点。
answer.en: At pinch-off, v_GS≈−1.081139 V and v_DS≈−1.581139 V; this is not cutoff.

pitfalls.zh: i_D按流入漏极定义，PMOS正常电流为负。
pitfalls.en: With current referenced into the drain, normal PMOS current is negative.

pitfalls.zh: 正阈值是耗尽型PMOS的题设，不能改号。
pitfalls.en: The positive threshold is intentional for the specified depletion PMOS.

methods.zh: 分别将所得电压代入PMOS恒流区平方律和可变电阻区方程，边界两者均得−0.5 mA；检查v_D−v_G=−0.5 V。
methods.en: The PMOS saturation square law and triode equation both give −0.5 mA at the boundary; v_D−v_G=−0.5 V is checked separately.

assumptions.zh: 教材长沟道平方律；K_p已含几何系数和1/2，忽略沟道长度调制及体效应。
assumptions.en: Textbook long-channel square law; K_p includes geometry and 1/2. Channel-length modulation and body effect are neglected.

completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 栅漏短接：何时成立平方律“二极管”
title.en: Gate–drain connection: when the square-law diode model applies

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 接成“二极管”的MOS管如图题4.1.5所示。（1）试分别说明在什么情况下它们的i–v关系为i=K(v−|V_T|)²；（2）为什么可以称它们为“二极管”？（注：V_T表示V_TN或V_TP，K表示K_n或K_p。）图(a)为NMOS栅漏短接，图(b)为PMOS栅漏短接；端口电压上正下负，电流向下。
statement.en: The diode-connected MOS devices in Fig. 4.1.5 use voltage positive at the top and current downward. (1) State when i=K(v−|V_T|)² holds for each. (2) Explain why they are called diodes. V_T denotes V_TN or V_TP and K denotes K_n or K_p. (a) is gate–drain-connected NMOS; (b) is gate–drain-connected PMOS.

alt.zh: (a)NMOS上端为栅/漏，下端为源及衬底；(b)PMOS上端为源及衬底，下端为栅/漏，两个端口均为上正下负、电流向下。
alt.en: (a) NMOS gate/drain is the upper terminal and source/body the lower. (b) PMOS source/body is upper and gate/drain lower. Both use downward port current and voltage positive at the top.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: 先把端口v转为每只管的v_GS、v_DS，再检查阈值与恒流区条件。栅漏短接本身不能让任意耗尽型MOS都自动满足恒流区平方律。
recognition.en: Translate port v into v_GS and v_DS, then test threshold and saturation. A gate–drain connection alone does not put every depletion MOS in saturation.

text.zh: V_TN>0，且v≥V_TN时，v_GS=v_DS=v。恒流区条件v_DS≥v_GS−V_TN自动满足；阈值以上有向下电流。
text.en: For V_TN>0 and v≥V_TN, v_GS=v_DS=v. Saturation inequality v_DS≥v_GS−V_TN is automatic, giving downward current above threshold.

text.zh: V_TP<0，且v≥−V_TP时，v_GS=v_DS=−v。漏极流入电流i_D为负，但端口向下电流i=−i_D为正。
text.en: For V_TP<0 and v≥−V_TP, v_GS=v_DS=−v. Drain-entering i_D is negative but downward port current i=−i_D is positive.

text.zh: 在0≤v<|V_T|时，理想增强型沟道截止，不能把平方后的正数当成电流。耗尽型阈值符号相反，栅漏短接的正向工作通常在可变电阻区，不能直接套本式。反向v<0时还需考虑图示衬底与源短接所形成的体二极管，原题未给反向定量模型。
text.en: For 0≤v<|V_T|, an ideal enhancement channel is off; squaring a negative overdrive does not create current. Depletion devices have the opposite threshold sign and generally operate in triode for this positive-port connection. Reverse v<0 additionally involves the source-tied-body diode; the problem supplies no quantitative reverse model.

text.zh: 栅漏短接后只剩两个独立端子；正向超过阈值有电流，阈值以下电流近似为零，因而有类似二极管的整流特性。这里的正向沟道特性是平方律，不是PN结指数律，也不是固定0.7 V压降。
text.en: Connecting gate and drain leaves two independent terminals. Current flows above a forward threshold and is approximately zero below it, giving diode-like rectification. The forward channel follows a square law rather than a PN exponential or fixed 0.7 V drop.

answer.zh: (a)增强型NMOS且v≥V_TN>0；(b)增强型PMOS且v≥|V_TP|、V_TP<0。两者此时均在恒流区且i=K(v−|V_T|)²。因栅漏短接构成两端非线性整流器件，称MOS“二极管”。
answer.en: (a) Enhancement NMOS with v≥V_TN>0; (b) enhancement PMOS with V_TP<0 and v≥|V_TP|. Both then satisfy saturation and i=K(v−|V_T|)². Gate–drain connection creates a two-terminal nonlinear rectifying device.

pitfalls.zh: 平方律有导通区间，不能延伸到阈值以下。
pitfalls.en: The square law must not be extended below threshold.

pitfalls.zh: PMOS端口电流与流入漏极的i_D符号相反。
pitfalls.en: PMOS port current has the opposite sign to drain-entering i_D.

methods.zh: 按原接线分别代入NMOS与PMOS三端电流式，扫描正向端口电压核对工作区及端口电流符号；对耗尽型检验恒流区不等式以排除错误套式。
methods.en: Original three-terminal NMOS/PMOS equations are evaluated over a port-voltage sweep, checking operating region and current signs; depletion-device saturation inequalities are checked to reject an invalid extension.

assumptions.zh: 理想增强型长沟道沟道模型，忽略亚阈值电流与沟道长度调制；体二极管反向端口导通只作定性说明，不虚构固定压降。
assumptions.en: Ideal long-channel enhancement-channel model without subthreshold current or channel-length modulation; reverse-port body-diode conduction is qualitative, without an invented fixed drop.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 判断放大：先查直流通路，再查交流通路
title.en: Check DC paths before AC signal paths

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 试分析图题4.2.1所示各电路对交流信号有无放大作用，并简述理由（设各电路元件参数合适，电容对交流信号可视为短路）。图含(a)～(e)五个电路。
statement.en: For circuits (a)–(e) in Fig. 4.2.1, determine whether each amplifies an AC signal and briefly explain. Assume suitable component values and capacitors that are short circuits for AC.

alt.zh: (a)NMOS偏置V_GG在输入耦合电容左侧；(b)PMOS源接V_DD，栅有电阻分压偏置；(c)NMOS栅直接接V_DD；(d)NMOS输入与V_GG串联后直接接栅；(e)增强型NMOS栅经电阻接地且源接地。
alt.en: (a) NMOS V_GG lies before the input coupling capacitor. (b) PMOS source is at V_DD with gate-divider bias. (c) NMOS gate is directly tied to V_DD. (d) NMOS gate is directly driven by input plus V_GG. (e) Enhancement NMOS gate is resistively grounded and source is grounded.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: “元件参数合适”不能修复缺失的直流通路或被电源短路的交流输入。对每图先把电容开路找Q点，再把电源交流接地。
recognition.en: Suitable values cannot repair a missing DC path or an AC input shorted by a supply. Open capacitors to find Q, then AC-ground the supplies.

text.zh: 直流时C_b1开路，V_GG被隔断；栅极没有直流偏置通路，理想模型下栅电位未定。不能建立确定的线性静态工作点；实际漏电或初始电荷不是题设偏置。
text.en: C_b1 is open for DC and disconnects V_GG. The gate has no DC bias path and its ideal voltage is undetermined. No defined linear quiescent point is established; unspecified leakage or stored charge is not a bias design.

text.zh: 分压电阻给栅静态电位，源接正电源；合适参数使PMOS在恒流区。交流源极接地，栅压上升使PMOS下行电流减小，漏极电压下降，输出反相。
text.en: The divider biases the gate and suitable values put the PMOS in saturation. Its source is AC-grounded. Rising gate voltage reduces downward PMOS current and lowers the drain voltage, giving inversion.

text.zh: 栅极直接接理想V_DD，是交流地。C_b1把输入接到交流地，v_gs交流分量为0；即使直流有漏电流，也无所要求的信号电压放大。
text.en: The gate is tied directly to ideal V_DD, an AC ground. C_b1 therefore connects the input to AC ground and the AC v_gs is zero. A possible DC drain current does not create signal amplification.

title.en: (d) Yes: gate receives DC bias directly

text.zh: V_GG与输入串联，直流偏置不被电容隔断；适当Q点下输入直接改变v_GS，漏极经R_d将电流变化变为反相电压。
text.en: V_GG is in series with the input and is not blocked by a capacitor. With a suitable Q point, input changes v_GS and R_d converts drain-current changes into an inverted voltage.

text.zh: 图示为增强型NMOS。栅、源的直流电位均为0，V_GSQ=0<V_TN，管子截止且g_mQ=0。大信号可能产生半波式失真导通，但不能算围绕Q点的线性放大。
text.en: The depicted device is enhancement NMOS. Both gate and source are zero for DC, so V_GSQ=0<V_TN and g_mQ=0. A large input may produce distorted partial-cycle conduction, not linear amplification about Q.

answer.zh: 有线性交流放大作用的是(b)、(d)；(a)缺栅极直流偏置通路，(c)栅被电源交流接地，(e)增强型NMOS在零偏置处截止。
answer.en: (b) and (d) can amplify linearly. (a) lacks a gate DC-bias path; (c) has an AC-grounded gate; (e) has a cutoff enhancement NMOS at zero gate bias.

pitfalls.zh: 耦合电容前的V_GG不会穿过电容提供直流栅偏置。
pitfalls.en: V_GG before a coupling capacitor cannot bias the gate through it.

pitfalls.zh: 静态有电流与交流有增益是两项独立检查。
pitfalls.en: DC current and AC gain are separate checks.

methods.zh: 逐图按原接线做直流连通性及交流接地检查；对(b)(d)用漏极节点KCL得到负增益，对(c)验证v_gs=0，对(e)用分段MOS模型验证g_mQ=0。
methods.en: Original wiring is checked for DC connectivity and AC grounding. Drain KCL produces negative gains for (b)/(d); (c) enforces zero AC v_gs and the piecewise MOS model gives g_mQ=0 for (e).

assumptions.zh: 图示增强型MOS，理想输入/偏置源；合适的线性Q点和小信号、无额外输出负载。浮置栅不假定未给定的漏电或初始电荷。
assumptions.en: Depicted enhancement MOS devices and ideal signal/bias sources; suitable linear Q points and small signals, without an extra output load. No unspecified leakage or initial charge is imposed on the floating gate.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: PMOS分压偏置：保留源漏负号
title.en: PMOS divider bias: retain signed drain–source voltage

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 电路如图题4.2.4所示。已知MOS管K_p=4 mA/V²，λ=0，V_TP=−1.5 V，电源V_DD=18 V。现要求MOS管工作在恒流区，静态时I_DQ=1 mA（按图中向下电流），V_DSQ=−9 V，R_g1、R_g2支路电流为2 μA。（1）确定R_d、R_g1、R_g2；（2）若要保证静态工作在恒流区，R_d的最大值为多少？
statement.en: For Fig. 4.2.4, K_p=4 mA/V², λ=0, V_TP=−1.5 V and V_DD=18 V. Require saturation, downward quiescent current 1 mA, V_DSQ=−9 V and 2 μA in the gate-divider branch. (1) Find R_d, R_g1 and R_g2. (2) Find the maximum R_d compatible with saturation.

alt.zh: PMOS源和衬底接18 V；漏经R_d接地，栅由上端R_g2和下端R_g1分压，输入/输出均经电容耦合。
alt.en: PMOS source/body is at 18 V; drain connects through R_d to ground. R_g2 is the upper divider resistor and R_g1 the lower; input/output are capacitively coupled.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: 先定V_S=18 V、V_D=V_S+V_DS，再从电流求V_SG；图中R_g2在上、R_g1在下，别按名称猜位置。
recognition.en: First set V_S=18 V and V_D=V_S+V_DS, then infer V_SG from current. R_g2 is above the gate and R_g1 below; use the actual diagram.

text.zh: 静态电容开路，V_D=18−9=9 V；向下1 mA全部流过R_d。
text.en: Capacitors are open for DC. V_D=18−9=9 V, and the downward 1 mA all passes through R_d.

text.zh: 由I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)²得过驱动0.5 V，V_SG=2 V、V_G=16 V。栅不取电流，分压两电阻电流均2 μA。
text.en: I=K_p(V_SG−|V_TP|)² gives 0.5 V overdrive, V_SG=2 V and V_G=16 V. With zero gate current, each divider resistor carries 2 μA.

title.en: (2) Increase R_d to the saturation boundary

text.zh: 栅偏置不变、λ=0，在恒流区电流保持1 mA。恒流条件V_SD≥V_SG−|V_TP|=0.5 V，故漏电位最多17.5 V。
text.en: With fixed gate bias and λ=0, current stays 1 mA in saturation. V_SD≥V_SG−|V_TP|=0.5 V limits the drain voltage to 17.5 V.

answer.zh: R_d=9 kΩ，R_g1=8 MΩ，R_g2=1 MΩ。恒流区边界最大R_d=17.5 kΩ；严格留在恒流区内部应小于该值。
answer.en: R_d=9 kΩ, R_g1=8 MΩ and R_g2=1 MΩ. The saturation-boundary maximum is R_d=17.5 kΩ; strict interior operation needs a smaller value.

pitfalls.zh: V_DS=−9 V不等于V_D=−9 V；源为+18 V。
pitfalls.en: V_DS=−9 V does not mean V_D=−9 V; source is +18 V.

pitfalls.zh: 增加R_d使漏极上升、V_SD下降，因此最终进入可变电阻区。
pitfalls.en: Increasing R_d raises drain voltage and reduces V_SD, eventually entering triode.

methods.zh: 由两电阻独立分压重算V_G=16 V，再用PMOS分段方程核对电流、原Q点及17.5 kΩ边界；节点KCL、供电与电阻/MOS功率平衡复核通过。
methods.en: An independent divider calculation gives V_G=16 V. The piecewise PMOS law verifies current, original Q and the 17.5 kΩ boundary; node KCL and supply/resistor/MOS power balance are checked.

assumptions.zh: 理想长沟道PMOS，λ=0、栅电流0，衬底接源；2 μA分压电流独立于漏极支路。
assumptions.en: Ideal long-channel PMOS, λ=0 and zero gate current, body tied to source; the 2 μA divider current is separate from drain current.

completionNote.zh: 整道题全部小问已核验；指定作业小问另行标注。
completionNote.en: All exercise parts have been checked; assigned parts are separately marked.

title.zh: 先判解是否存在，再解四个节点
title.en: Test solution existence before solving four nodes

source.title: 电子技术基础（模拟部分）

statement.zh: 求图题4.2.5所示各电路所标节点的电压。已知所有MOS管K_n=0.25 mA/V²，λ=0，V_TN=0.8 V。图(a)：漏接+5 V、栅源短接于V₁，向下10 μA电流源接−5 V；(b)：漏接+5 V、栅接地、源为V₂，向下1 mA电流源接−5 V；(c)：栅漏短接为V₃，源接地，上接来自+5 V的1 mA电流源；(d)：栅漏短接为V₄，源接地，V₄经400 kΩ接+5 V。
statement.en: Find the labeled voltages in Fig. 4.2.5 with K_n=0.25 mA/V², λ=0 and V_TN=0.8 V for all devices. (a) Drain +5 V, gate/source joined at V₁, 10 μA sink to −5 V. (b) Drain +5 V, gate grounded, source V₂, 1 mA sink to −5 V. (c) Gate/drain V₃, grounded source, 1 mA source from +5 V. (d) Gate/drain V₄, grounded source, 400 kΩ to +5 V.

alt.zh: 四个原电路保留±5 V电源、电流源箭头、400 kΩ和节点V₁～V₄；(a)栅明确与源连接，而非漏。
alt.en: Four source circuits retain ±5 V supplies, current arrows, 400 kΩ and nodes V₁–V₄. In (a), the gate is connected to source, not drain.

prerequisites.zh: MOS管电压方向、阈值与工作区；直流时电容开路、交流时理想电源接地。
prerequisites.en: MOS voltage references, thresholds and operating regions; capacitors are open for DC and ideal supplies are grounded for AC.

recognition.zh: (a)不能因为电流源给了电流就强迫截止管套平方律。每个代数根都必须回查V_GS>V_TN、饱和条件与电流源端电压。
recognition.en: A specified current source cannot force a cutoff channel to satisfy the saturation square law. Check every algebraic root against V_GS>V_TN, saturation and available source voltage.

text.zh: 栅源短接使V_GS=0<0.8 V，增强型NMOS截止，i_D=0；理想电流源却要求节点向下流出10 μA。KCL矛盾，因而题设理想模型没有有限稳态V₁。实际电流源会触及顺从电压限制，或由未给定的漏电/击穿决定节点，不能虚构V₁数值。
text.en: The gate–source short fixes V_GS=0<0.8 V, so the enhancement channel is off and i_D=0. The ideal sink demands 10 μA out of the node, contradicting KCL. No finite steady V₁ exists in this ideal model. A real sink reaches compliance or unspecified leakage/breakdown intervenes; the source gives no unique value.

text.zh: 向下1 mA给V_GS=0.8+√(1/0.25)=2.8 V，栅为0故源为−2.8 V。V_DS=7.8 V大于过驱动2 V，满足恒流区；电流源剩2.2 V电压。
text.en: A downward 1 mA requires V_GS=0.8+√(1/0.25)=2.8 V. Grounded gate gives V₂=−2.8 V. V_DS=7.8 V exceeds 2 V overdrive and the sink has 2.2 V across it.

text.zh: 源接地，V_GS=V_DS=V₃。1 mA给V₃=2.8 V；2.8≥2使恒流区成立，上方电流源两端为2.2 V。
text.en: With grounded source, V_GS=V_DS=V₃. The 1 mA current gives V₃=2.8 V, satisfying 2.8≥2 V for saturation. The upper current source has 2.2 V.

title.en: (d) Resistor load line and valid root

text.zh: 电阻电流与沟道电流相等。方程给1 V与0.59 V两个代数根；0.59 V低于阈值，不能用导通平方律，必须舍去。
text.en: Equate resistor current to channel current. The algebraic roots are 1 V and 0.59 V; 0.59 V is below threshold and invalid for the on-state square law.

answer.zh: (a)按题设理想模型无有限直流稳态解，V₁不能确定为某个数；(b)V₂=−2.8 V；(c)V₃=2.8 V；(d)V₄=1 V。
answer.en: (a) No finite ideal DC steady-state solution, hence no numerical V₁; (b) V₂=−2.8 V; (c) V₃=2.8 V; (d) V₄=1 V.

pitfalls.zh: (a)是栅源短接，不能读成栅漏短接。
pitfalls.en: (a) shorts gate to source, not gate to drain.

pitfalls.zh: 平方后的低于阈值代数根是伪解。
pitfalls.en: A squared-law root below threshold is extraneous.

methods.zh: 独立采用带截止分支的分段MOS函数，逐节点回代KCL与工作区；(d)另用单调负载线二分法求唯一有效根；(a)直接检查恒定10 μA的节点残差而不运行无解迭代。
methods.en: An independent piecewise MOS law with cutoff checks each node’s KCL and region. A monotonic load-line bisection finds the unique valid root for (d); (a) is verified by its unavoidable 10 μA KCL residual instead of a futile root search.

assumptions.zh: 题给增强型NMOS的理想长沟道模型，λ=0，栅和体电流忽略，衬底与源相接；电流源理想，未给顺从电压/漏电/击穿模型。
assumptions.en: Specified enhancement-NMOS ideal long-channel model, λ=0, zero gate/body current and body tied to source; ideal current sources without supplied compliance/leakage/breakdown models.
